status: DRAFT — 11/04 재번역(능동형·확신 어조), 원어민 검수 전

A1.name: 별자리 기본 정보
A1.used_in: 태양·달·상승궁 표, 휠 별자리 칸 탭

rows.ko: 시작 · 용기 · 직진
rows.en: Beginnings · Courage · Full speed ahead
rows.tone_reason: 3번째 키워드 직역투 'Going straight ahead' → 자연스러운 표현
rows.en_before_tone: Beginnings · Courage · Going straight ahead

rows.ko: 먼저 불을 붙이고 부딪히며 길을 여는 별자리예요.
rows.en: The sign that lights the first spark and clears a path by diving right in.

rows.ko: 양자리는 열두 별자리의 첫 번째 자리로, 무언가를 처음 시작하는 기운을 상징합니다. 망설이기보다 일단 움직이고, 몸으로 부딪히며 배우는 힘이에요.
rows.en: Aries is the first of the twelve signs and stands for the energy of starting something new. It's the power to move first instead of hesitating, and to learn by doing.

rows.ko: 안정 · 감각 · 꾸준함
rows.en: Stability · The senses · Steadiness

rows.ko: 천천히, 하지만 한번 뿌리내리면 오래가는 별자리입니다.
rows.en: A slow-moving sign, but once it puts down roots, it stays for the long haul.

rows.ko: 황소자리는 손에 잡히는 안정과 몸의 감각을 소중히 여기는 기운이에요. 맛있는 밥, 익숙한 공간, 꾸준히 쌓아 온 것에서 힘을 얻는 자리입니다.
rows.en: Taurus is the energy that treasures solid, tangible security and the pleasures of the body. It draws strength from a good meal, a familiar space, and the things it has built up steadily over time.

rows.ko: 호기심 · 대화 · 연결
rows.en: Curiosity · Conversation · Connection

rows.ko: 궁금한 것을 묻고 잇고 전하며 세상을 넓히는 별자리예요.
rows.en: The sign that widens its world by asking questions, linking ideas, and passing them on.

rows.ko: 쌍둥이자리는 생각과 말, 정보가 빠르게 오가는 기운을 상징합니다. 한 가지에 머물기보다 여러 이야기를 연결하며 가볍게 움직일 때 살아나요.
rows.en: Gemini stands for the quick back-and-forth of thoughts, words, and information. It comes alive when it moves lightly, connecting many stories instead of staying with just one.

rows.ko: 돌봄 · 소속감 · 보호
rows.en: Care · Belonging · Protection

rows.ko: 내 사람과 내 자리를 따뜻하게 지키는 별자리입니다.
rows.en: The sign that warmly protects its people and its place.

rows.ko: 게자리는 품고 돌보는 기운, 마음이 돌아갈 집을 상징해요. 단단한 껍질 안에 여린 속을 지니고 있어, 안전하다고 느끼는 곳에서 가장 다정해집니다.
rows.en: Cancer stands for the energy of holding and caring, and for the home your heart returns to. With a soft heart inside a sturdy shell, it is at its most tender wherever it feels safe.

rows.ko: 표현 · 자부심 · 온기
rows.en: Self-expression · Pride · Warmth

rows.ko: 자기만의 빛을 드러내고 주변을 환하게 데우는 별자리예요.
rows.en: The sign that lets its own light shine and warms everyone around it.

rows.ko: 사자자리는 나를 표현하고 마음껏 빛나고 싶은 기운을 상징합니다. 무대 위의 자신감뿐 아니라, 소중한 사람에게 아낌없이 내어 주는 너그러움도 이 자리의 힘이에요.
rows.en: Leo stands for the urge to express yourself and shine freely. Its strength isn't only confidence on stage; it's also the generosity of giving wholeheartedly to the people you love.

rows.ko: 정리 · 섬세함 · 쓸모
rows.en: Order · Attention to detail · Usefulness

rows.ko: 작은 것을 살피고 다듬어 더 낫게 만드는 별자리입니다.
rows.en: The sign that notices the small things and refines them to make them better.

rows.ko: 처녀자리는 흩어진 것을 분류하고 고치고 다듬는 기운이에요. 눈에 잘 띄지 않는 일상의 디테일에서 쓸모를 찾아내는 성실함을 상징합니다.
rows.en: Virgo is the energy that sorts, fixes, and polishes what's scattered. It stands for a quiet diligence that finds usefulness in the everyday details most people overlook.

rows.ko: 균형 · 관계 · 아름다움
rows.en: Balance · Relationships · Beauty

rows.ko: 서로의 마음이 기울지 않도록 균형을 맞추는 별자리예요.
rows.en: The sign that keeps things in balance so neither side's heart tips too far.
rows.tone_reason: 'no one's heart is left tipping' 어색한 표현 → 자연스럽게
rows.en_before_tone: The sign that keeps things in balance so no one's heart is left tipping to one side.

rows.ko: 천칭자리는 나와 너 사이의 균형, 조화로운 관계를 상징합니다. 공정함과 아름다움을 중요하게 여기고, 함께할 때 더 좋은 답을 찾는 기운이에요.
rows.en: Libra stands for balance between you and others, and for harmonious relationships. It values fairness and beauty, and it's the energy that finds better answers together.

rows.ko: 깊이 · 집중 · 변형
rows.en: Depth · Focus · Transformation

rows.ko: 얕게 머물지 않고 끝까지 파고드는 별자리입니다.
rows.en: The sign that never stays on the surface and digs all the way down.

rows.ko: 전갈자리는 겉보다 속, 넓이보다 깊이를 향하는 기운이에요. 한번 마음을 주면 깊게 연결되고, 무너진 자리에서 다시 일어서는 힘을 상징합니다.
rows.en: Scorpio is the energy that looks past the surface to what's inside, choosing depth over breadth. Once it gives its heart, it bonds deeply, and it stands for the strength to rise again after things fall apart.
rows.tone_reason: 2문장: 'from what has fallen apart' 어색 → 'after things fall apart'
rows.en_before_tone: Scorpio is the energy that looks past the surface to what's inside, choosing depth over breadth. Once it gives its heart, it bonds deeply, and it stands for the strength to rise again from what has fallen apart.

rows.ko: 탐험 · 자유 · 의미
rows.en: Exploration · Freedom · Meaning

rows.ko: 더 넓은 세상과 더 큰 의미를 향해 활을 쏘는 별자리예요.
rows.en: The sign that aims its arrow toward a wider world and deeper meaning.
rows.en_before_tone: The sign that aims its arrow toward a wider world and a bigger meaning.

rows.ko: 사수자리는 멀리 가 보고, 배우고, 나만의 믿음을 찾아가는 기운을 상징합니다. 낙천적인 시선으로 익숙한 경계를 넘어설 때 살아나는 자리예요.
rows.en: Sagittarius stands for the drive to travel far, keep learning, and find a belief of your own. It comes alive when it crosses familiar borders with an optimistic eye.

rows.ko: 책임 · 인내 · 성취
rows.en: Responsibility · Patience · Achievement

rows.ko: 긴 시간을 들여 한 계단씩 정상에 오르는 별자리입니다.
rows.en: The sign that takes its time and climbs to the summit one step at a time.

rows.ko: 염소자리는 목표를 세우고 차근차근 쌓아 올리는 기운이에요. 당장의 성과보다 오래 버티는 구조와 믿을 만한 결과를 중요하게 여기는 자리입니다.
rows.en: Capricorn is the energy of setting goals and building toward them step by step. It values lasting structures and reliable results over quick wins.

rows.ko: 독립 · 새로움 · 공동체
rows.en: Independence · Newness · Community

rows.ko: 익숙한 틀 밖에서 새로운 방식을 떠올리는 별자리예요.
rows.en: The sign that dreams up new ways of doing things outside the usual box.

rows.ko: 물병자리는 남과 다른 생각, 더 나은 미래를 향한 기운을 상징합니다. 개인의 자유를 지키면서도 여럿이 함께 잘 사는 방법을 고민하는 자리예요.
rows.en: Aquarius stands for thinking differently and reaching toward a better future. It protects personal freedom while also thinking about how everyone can live well together.

rows.ko: 공감 · 상상 · 흐름
rows.en: Empathy · Imagination · Flow

rows.ko: 경계 없이 스며들며 남의 마음을 느끼는 별자리입니다.
rows.en: The sign that flows past boundaries and feels what others feel.

rows.ko: 물고기자리는 열두 별자리의 마지막 자리로, 경계를 풀고 하나로 녹아드는 기운이에요. 공감과 상상력, 말로 다 설명되지 않는 감각을 상징합니다.
rows.en: Pisces is the last of the twelve signs, the energy of letting boundaries soften and melting into a greater whole. It stands for empathy, imagination, and a kind of sensing that words can't fully explain.

rows.ko: 먼저 시작하고 부딪히며 배우는 사람이에요. 새로운 도전 앞에서 가장 살아 있다고 느낍니다.
rows.en: You're a starter. You'd rather jump in and figure things out as you go, and nothing makes you feel more alive than a fresh challenge.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be the one who starts first and learns by doing. You feel most alive when you're facing a new challenge.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘해 보고 싶다’는 순수한 의욕입니다. 회의에서 아무도 손들지 않을 때 먼저 ‘제가 해 볼게요’라고 말하는 쪽이 당신일 때가 많아요. 속도가 붙을 때 오히려 머리가 맑아지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your fuel is the pure itch to try. When the room goes quiet and no one volunteers, you're the first to say, "I'll take it." And once things pick up speed, your mind grows even sharper.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is a pure, simple urge: "I want to try this." When no one raises a hand in a meeting, you're often the one who says, "I'll give it a go." Your mind actually gets clearer once things pick up speed.

rows.ko: 마음이 급해지면 끝까지 듣기 전에 결론부터 내려 버리기 쉬워요.
rows.en: When impatience kicks in, you're quick to jump to conclusions before hearing the whole story.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're in a hurry, you may jump to a conclusion before you've heard the whole story.

rows.ko: 천천히 쌓아 올린 안정 위에서 힘을 내는 사람입니다. 내 속도와 감각을 믿을 때 가장 단단해져요.
rows.en: Your strength grows from the stability you've built slowly and surely. Trust your own pace and instincts; that's when you stand strongest.
rows.en_before_tone: You draw strength from stability you've built slowly. You're at your steadiest when you trust your own pace and senses.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 손에 잡히는 결과와 오래가는 편안함이에요. 퇴근길에 좋아하는 빵집에 들러 늘 사던 빵을 고르는 작은 습관이 하루를 지탱해 주기도 합니다. 한번 정한 일은 묵묵히 끝까지 해내는 꾸준함이 큰 무기예요.
rows.en: You're driven by results you can hold in your hands and comforts that last. A small ritual carries you through the day, like stopping by your favorite bakery after work for the usual. Once you commit, you quietly see it through, and that staying power is your secret weapon.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is something real you can hold and a comfort that lasts. Sometimes a small habit, like stopping at your favorite bakery on the way home for the bread you always get, is what carries you through the day. Your steady way of quietly seeing things through is a real strength.

rows.ko: 익숙함을 지키려다 꼭 필요한 변화까지 미뤄 둘 때가 있어요.
rows.en: Your love of the familiar can tempt you to put off changes you truly need.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're holding on to what's familiar, you may sometimes put off changes you really need.

rows.ko: 궁금한 것을 따라가며 생각과 사람을 연결하는 사람이에요. 새로운 이야기가 오갈 때 에너지가 차오릅니다.
rows.en: You follow your curiosity wherever it leads, weaving ideas and people together along the way. Lively conversation charges you up.
rows.en_before_tone: You follow your curiosity and connect ideas and people. Your energy fills up when new stories are flowing.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘이건 왜 그럴까?’ 하는 호기심입니다. 점심시간에 들은 이야기를 저녁에 찾아보고, 다음 날 누군가에게 신나게 전해 주는 장면이 자연스러워요. 머릿속에 창이 여러 개 열려 있을 때 오히려 생기가 돕니다.
rows.en: Curiosity runs the show for you: "Wait, why is that?" You hear something at lunch, look it up that night, and can't wait to share it the next day. A dozen tabs open in your head doesn't drain you; it wakes you up.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is curiosity: "Why is that?" Looking up something you heard at lunch that evening, then excitedly telling someone about it the next day, comes naturally to you. You actually feel most alive with lots of tabs open in your head.

rows.ko: 관심이 여러 곳으로 흩어지면 마무리 직전에 흥미가 식기도 해요.
rows.en: Pulled in too many directions, you can lose interest right before the finish line.
rows.en_before_tone: When your attention scatters, your interest can fade just before the finish line.

rows.ko: 아끼는 사람과 머물 곳을 지키는 데서 힘이 나는 사람입니다. 누군가를 챙길 때 마음이 가장 단단해져요.
rows.en: You draw strength from protecting the people you love and the place you call home. Caring for someone grounds you like nothing else.
rows.en_before_tone: You draw strength from protecting the people you love and the place you call home. Your heart is steadiest when you're looking after someone.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘내 사람들이 편안했으면’ 하는 마음이에요. 친구가 지나가듯 한 말을 기억해 두었다가 다음 만남에 작은 간식을 챙겨 가는 다정함이 자연스럽습니다. 돌아갈 자리가 든든할수록 바깥에서도 용감해져요.
rows.en: At heart, you want your people to feel at ease. You're the friend who remembers an offhand comment and shows up next time with the very snack they mentioned. The safer your home base, the braver you are out in the world.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is the wish that your people feel at ease. Remembering something a friend mentioned in passing and bringing a little treat next time comes naturally to you. The more secure your home base feels, the braver you become out in the world.

rows.ko: 남을 챙기느라 정작 내 마음의 허기는 뒤로 미루기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: You're so busy looking after everyone else that your own needs tend to end up last in line.
rows.en_before_tone: While you're busy caring for others, it's easy to put your own emotional needs on hold.

rows.ko: 나다운 빛을 드러내고 누군가 알아봐 줄 때 살아나는 사람이에요. 진심을 다해 표현하는 것이 삶의 큰 동력입니다.
rows.en: You light up when you get to be fully yourself and someone notices. Pouring your whole heart into self-expression keeps your fire burning.
rows.en_before_tone: You come alive when you show your own light and someone notices it. Expressing yourself wholeheartedly is a big driving force in your life.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘이건 내가 만든 거야’라고 말할 수 있는 자부심입니다. 발표 자료 한 장도 그냥 넘기지 않고 내 색을 입혀야 마음이 놓이는 편이에요. 주변을 즐겁게 만들 때 스스로도 가장 따뜻해집니다.
rows.en: Nothing motivates you like saying, "I made this." Even a single presentation slide doesn't feel finished until it carries your signature touch. And when you fill the room with laughter, you glow your warmest too.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is the pride of being able to say, "I made this." Even a single presentation slide doesn't feel done until you've added your own touch. You feel warmest yourself when you're bringing joy to the people around you.

rows.ko: 애쓴 만큼 알아봐 주지 않으면 서운함이 생각보다 오래 남을 수 있어요.
rows.en: When your hard work goes unrecognized, the sting lingers longer than you expect.
rows.en_before_tone: When your effort goes unnoticed, the hurt can linger longer than you'd expect.

rows.ko: 작은 것을 다듬어 더 쓸모 있게 만드는 사람입니다. 내가 도움이 되고 있다는 감각이 큰 힘이 돼요.
rows.en: You have a gift for refining the little things until they truly work. Knowing you're genuinely useful fuels you.
rows.en_before_tone: You refine small things and make them more useful. Feeling that you're genuinely helping gives you great strength.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘조금 더 낫게 할 수 있겠다’ 하는 눈썰미예요. 남들이 지나치는 표의 오타나 일정의 빈틈을 먼저 발견하고 조용히 고쳐 두곤 합니다. 정돈된 할 일 목록을 하나씩 지워 갈 때 하루가 개운해져요.
rows.en: Your eye is always thinking, "This could be a little better." You're the first to catch the typo in a spreadsheet or the gap in a schedule that everyone else missed, and you fix it without fuss. Checking off a neat to-do list, one item at a time, leaves your whole day feeling lighter.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is a sharp eye that thinks, "I could make this a little better." You're often the first to spot a typo in a spreadsheet or a gap in a schedule that others miss, and you quietly fix it. Your day feels lighter as you cross items off a tidy to-do list.

rows.ko: 완성도를 높이려다 스스로에게 지나치게 엄격해지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: In aiming for perfection, you can end up sweating every little detail and being far too hard on yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're aiming for polish, it's easy to become too hard on yourself.

rows.ko: 관계 속에서 균형과 조화를 만들어 가는 사람이에요. 함께여서 더 좋은 답을 찾을 때 빛이 납니다.
rows.en: You're the natural mediator, the one who brings balance to relationships and smooths out the rough edges. You shine brightest when everyone lands on a better answer together.
rows.en_before_tone: You create balance and harmony within relationships. You shine when you find a better answer together.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 모두가 납득할 수 있는 공정함과 아름다움입니다. 단체 메뉴를 정할 때 조용히 모두의 취향을 살펴 가장 무난한 곳을 제안하는 사람이 당신일 수 있어요. 공간과 분위기가 조화로울 때 생각도 한결 맑아집니다.
rows.en: What drives you is the sweet spot where everyone feels heard and everything looks and feels just right. When a group can't decide where to eat, you're the one quietly reading everyone's preferences and suggesting a spot that works for all. Your thoughts run clearest in a calm, harmonious space.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is resulting in aligned ideas that making sure everyone is happy. When a group is picking a place to eat, you might be the one quietly weighing everyone's tastes and suggesting the spot that works for all. Your thinking gets clearer, too, when a space and its mood feel harmonious.

rows.ko: 모두를 만족시키려다 내 마음이 어느 쪽인지 놓칠 때가 있습니다.
rows.en: Trying to keep everyone happy, you sometimes lose sight of what you actually want.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're trying to please everyone, you can lose track of where your own heart stands.

rows.ko: 한번 마음먹은 것에 깊이 몰입하는 사람입니다. 진짜를 알아낼 때까지 파고드는 힘이 삶의 중심이에요.
rows.en: Once you set your mind on something, you go all in. You won't stop digging until you get to the truth, and that drive sits at the very core of who you are.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you set your mind on something, you go deep. The drive to dig until you find what's real is at the center of your life.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 겉으로 보이는 것 너머의 진심을 알고 싶은 마음이에요. 넓게 아는 사람 열 명보다 속 깊은 이야기를 나누는 한 사람이 더 소중하게 느껴지는 편입니다. 쉽게 드러내지 않지만, 한번 집중하면 끝까지 가는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You're always searching for what's real beneath the surface. One soul you can go truly deep with means more to you than ten casual friends. You don't open up easily, but once you lock in on something, you see it all the way through.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is the wish to know the truth beneath what's on the surface. One person you can share deep conversations with tends to mean more to you than ten casual acquaintances. You don't reveal much easily, but once you focus, you go all the way.

rows.ko: 믿음이 흔들리면 마음의 문을 한꺼번에 닫아 버리기 쉬워요.
rows.en: When your trust is shaken, you're quick to close your heart all at once.
rows.en_before_tone: When your trust is shaken, you may shut the door to your heart all at once.

rows.ko: 더 넓은 세상과 의미를 찾아 나아가는 사람이에요. 배우고 떠나고 넓어질 때 가장 생기가 돕니다.
rows.en: You're always heading toward a bigger world and meaningful insights. Learning, traveling, and stretching yourself make you feel most alive.
rows.en_before_tone: You move forward in search of a wider world and deeper meaning. You feel most alive when you're learning, traveling, and growing.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘저 너머에는 뭐가 있을까’ 하는 탐험심입니다. 주말에 가 보지 않은 동네를 걷거나 새 분야의 책을 집어 드는 일이 큰 충전이 돼요. 어려운 상황에서도 웃을 거리를 찾아내는 낙천성이 주변까지 밝힙니다.
rows.en: Your adventurous spirit keeps asking, "What's out there?" Wandering an unfamiliar neighborhood on the weekend, or picking up a book on a subject that's new to you, recharges you deeply. And your knack for finding something to laugh about, even in tough times, lifts everyone around you.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is a spirit of exploration: "What's out there?" Walking through a neighborhood you've never visited on the weekend, or picking up a book in a new field, really recharges you. Your optimism, which finds something to smile about even in tough times, brightens the people around you.

rows.ko: 자유를 지키려다 약속과 마무리를 가볍게 넘길 때가 있어요.
rows.en: Guarding your freedom, you sometimes let promises and follow-through slide.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're guarding your freedom, you may sometimes let promises and follow-through slide.

rows.ko: 목표를 세우고 한 계단씩 쌓아 올리는 사람입니다. 믿을 만한 결과를 만들어 낼 때 마음이 단단해져요.
rows.en: You set goals and climb toward them one step at a time. Delivering results people can count on makes you feel rock-solid.
rows.en_before_tone: You set goals and build toward them one step at a time. Your heart feels steady when you deliver results people can rely on.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 오래 남는 성취와 책임을 다했다는 감각이에요. 남들이 손을 놓은 일도 일정표를 다시 짜서 끝까지 끌고 가는 끈기가 있습니다. 시간이 갈수록 더 깊은 신뢰를 얻는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're driven by a strong sense of responsibility and the satisfaction of hitting milestones, one after another. When others have given up on a project, you're the one who reworks the schedule and pushes it over the finish line. People's trust in you only deepens with time.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is lasting achievement and the sense of having done your part. Even when others have given up on a task, you have the grit to redo the schedule and carry it through to the end. You tend to earn deeper trust as time goes on.

rows.ko: 해야 할 일에 몰두하다 쉬는 것까지 숙제처럼 느끼기 쉬워요.
rows.en: Locked onto your to-do list, you can start treating even rest as another chore.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're absorbed in what needs doing, even rest can start to feel like homework.

rows.ko: 남과 다른 시선으로 더 나은 방식을 떠올리는 사람이에요. 나답게 자유로울 때 가장 큰 힘이 납니다.
rows.en: You see things from a fresh angle and dream up better ways of doing them. You're at your most powerful when you're free to be completely yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: You see things differently and imagine better ways of doing them. You're at your strongest when you're free to be yourself.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 ‘꼭 이렇게 해야 할까?’ 하는 물음입니다. 모두가 당연하게 따르던 방식에 새로운 도구나 규칙을 제안해 흐름을 바꾸곤 해요. 저마다의 개성을 지키면서도 함께 잘 지내는 방법에 관심이 많습니다.
rows.en: The question that drives you: "Does it really have to be done this way?" You're the one who shakes things up, proposing a new tool or rule for something everyone else took for granted. You care deeply about how people can get along while staying true to who they are.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is the question, "Does it really have to be this way?" You often change the flow by suggesting a new tool or rule for something everyone took for granted. You care a lot about how people can get along well while each keeps their own individuality.

rows.ko: 감정보다 생각이 앞서면 가까운 사람에게 거리감을 주기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: When you lead with your head instead of your heart, the people closest to you can feel a little shut out.
rows.en_before_tone: When your head gets ahead of your heart, people close to you may feel a bit of distance.

rows.ko: 다른 사람의 마음을 섬세하게 느끼고 품어 주는 사람입니다. 상상하고 공감할 때 삶이 풍성해져요.
rows.en: You sense what others are feeling and hold space for it with real tenderness. Life feels richest when you're dreaming and empathizing.
rows.en_before_tone: You sense other people's feelings with great sensitivity and hold space for them. Life feels rich when you imagine and empathize.

rows.ko: 나를 움직이는 건 말로 다 설명되지 않는 마음의 울림이에요. 좋아하는 노래 한 곡에 하루의 기분이 바뀌고, 친구의 표정만 보고도 무슨 일이 있는지 알아채곤 합니다. 경계를 부드럽게 녹이는 상상력이 큰 재능입니다.
rows.en: You're moved by feelings that words can't quite capture. One favorite song shifts your whole mood, and one look at a friend's face tells you something's off. Your imagination, which gently dissolves the line between you and the world, is a true gift.
rows.en_before_tone: What moves you is an inner resonance that words can't fully capture. A single favorite song can shift your whole mood, and you can often tell something's up with a friend just from their face. Your imagination, which gently softens boundaries, is a real gift.

rows.ko: 남의 감정을 너무 깊이 받아들여 내 경계가 흐려지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: You can take other people's feelings so much to heart that you start to lose track of where they end and you begin.
rows.en_before_tone: You may take in others' emotions so deeply that your own boundaries blur.

rows.ko: 감정이 빠르고 솔직하게 올라오는 편이에요. 바로 표현하고 움직일 수 있을 때 마음이 풀립니다.
rows.en: Your feelings rise fast and honest. You find relief the moment you can voice them and act.
rows.en_before_tone: Your feelings rise quickly and honestly. Your heart eases when you can express them and act right away.

rows.ko: 화가 나거나 속상하면 오래 담아 두기보다 그 자리에서 꺼내고 금방 털어 내는 편입니다. 답답한 날에는 생각을 정리하기보다 빠르게 걷거나 몸을 움직이는 쪽이 더 효과가 있어요. 내 뜻대로 움직일 수 있는 여지가 있을 때 감정도 안정됩니다.
rows.en: When anger or hurt flares, you let it out on the spot and shake it off rather than let it simmer. On a restless day, skip the overthinking: a brisk walk or a quick workout clears your head faster. You feel most settled when you have room to move on your own terms.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're angry or upset, you tend to let it out on the spot and shake it off quickly rather than holding on to it. On a frustrating day, walking fast or moving your body works better than trying to think it through. Your emotions settle when you have some room to act on your own terms.

rows.ko: 땀이 살짝 날 만큼 몸을 움직이고 나면 엉킨 마음이 한결 가벼워져요.
rows.en: Work up a light sweat and feel the knots inside you loosen.
rows.en_before_tone: Moving your body until you break a light sweat can make a tangled heart feel much lighter.

rows.ko: 익숙한 리듬과 편안한 감각 속에서 마음이 놓여요. 급하게 바뀌지 않는 일상이 안정의 기준입니다.
rows.en: Familiar rhythms and simple comforts let you exhale. For you, stability means a daily life that doesn't shift overnight.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart settles in familiar rhythms and comfortable sensations. Everyday life that doesn't change suddenly is what stability means to you.

rows.ko: 감정이 흔들려도 겉으로는 잘 드러나지 않고, 천천히 소화하는 편이에요. 따뜻한 밥 한 끼, 포근한 이불, 늘 가던 산책길 같은 감각이 마음을 가장 빨리 진정시킵니다. 갑작스러운 변화 앞에서는 받아들일 시간이 조금 더 필요해요.
rows.en: Even when you're shaken, you rarely show it; you digest your feelings slowly and thoroughly. A warm meal, a soft blanket, your usual walking route: these small comforts calm you faster than anything. When change arrives out of nowhere, give yourself a little extra time to take it in.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when your feelings are stirred, it rarely shows, and you tend to process things slowly. Sensations like a warm meal, a cozy blanket, or your usual walking route calm you fastest. When change comes suddenly, you need a little more time to take it in.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 음식과 익숙한 공간에서 천천히 쉬는 시간이 회복을 돕습니다.
rows.en: Savor a favorite meal in a space that feels like yours. That's how you refill.
rows.en_before_tone: Slow, restful time with food you love in a familiar space helps you recover.

rows.ko: 마음을 말로 꺼내고 나눌 때 한결 편해져요. 생각이 오갈 여유가 있어야 감정도 숨을 쉽니다.
rows.en: Putting feelings into words lightens you. Your emotions breathe best when ideas flow freely back and forth.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel lighter when you put your feelings into words and share them. Your feelings can breathe when there's room for thoughts to flow back and forth.

rows.ko: 속상한 일이 생기면 누군가에게 이야기하거나 글로 적으면서 감정을 이해하는 편입니다. 메신저로 친구와 수다를 떨다 보면 어느새 고민이 정리되어 있기도 해요. 같은 자리에 오래 갇혀 있으면 마음이 답답해지기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: When something upsets you, you make sense of it by talking it through or writing it down. One long text chat with a friend, and you often find the worry has sorted itself out. Stay stuck in one place too long, though, and you grow restless and cooped up.
rows.en_before_tone: When something upsets you, you tend to understand your feelings by talking to someone or writing them down. Sometimes, after chatting with a friend over messages, you realize your worry has sorted itself out. Being stuck in one place for too long can leave you feeling stifled.

rows.ko: 머릿속 생각을 종이에 쏟아 내거나 믿는 사람과 가볍게 대화해 보세요.
rows.en: Pour everything in your head onto paper, or share an easy conversation with someone you trust.
rows.en_before_tone: Try pouring the thoughts in your head onto paper, or having a light chat with someone you trust.

rows.ko: 아끼는 사람과 내 공간이 안전할 때 마음이 편해져요. 돌보고 돌봄 받는 관계가 안정의 뿌리입니다.
rows.en: You feel at ease when your loved ones and your space are safe. Caring and being cared for are the roots of your calm.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart is at ease when the people you love and your own space feel safe. Relationships where you care and are cared for are the root of your stability.

rows.ko: 감정을 깊고 섬세하게 느끼고, 분위기의 작은 변화도 금방 알아채는 편입니다. 지친 날에는 집에 돌아와 익숙한 음식을 해 먹는 것만으로 마음이 데워지기도 해요. 서운함을 바로 말하기보다 속으로 품는 편이라, 안전한 상대가 곁에 있는 것이 중요합니다.
rows.en: You feel deeply and catch even the smallest shift in a room's mood. After a draining day, simply coming home and cooking something familiar warms you right back up. You tend to hold hurt inside rather than voice it, so keep someone safe close by.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel emotions deeply and delicately, and you quickly notice even small shifts in the mood. On tiring days, just coming home and cooking something familiar can warm your heart. Because you tend to hold hurt feelings inside instead of saying them right away, having someone safe by your side matters a lot.

rows.ko: 편안한 사람과 집밥 같은 따뜻한 시간을 보내면 마음이 차오릅니다.
rows.en: Share unhurried time with someone easy to be around, ideally over a home-cooked meal, and feel your cup fill again.
rows.en_before_tone: Warm, unhurried time with someone you're comfortable with, like sharing a home-cooked meal, fills your heart back up.

rows.ko: 내 마음이 진심으로 받아들여질 때 편안해져요. 따뜻한 관심과 반응이 감정의 연료입니다.
rows.en: You relax when your true feelings are seen and welcomed. Warm attention and a genuine response are your emotional fuel.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel at ease when your heart is sincerely received. Warm attention and a real response help fuel your emotions.

rows.ko: 기쁨도 서운함도 크고 분명하게 느끼는 편이에요. 내가 준비한 작은 선물에 상대가 환하게 웃어 줄 때 하루의 피로가 풀리기도 합니다. 마음이 상했을 때는 자존심 때문에 괜찮은 척하기 쉬워서, 솔직하게 말할 수 있는 자리가 필요해요.
rows.en: Your joy and your hurt both run big and bright. Watching someone light up over a little gift you chose melts a long day away. When you're hurt, pride tempts you to act as if everything's fine, so seek out a space where you can be honest.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel both joy and hurt in big, clear ways. Seeing someone light up at a small gift you prepared can wash away a whole day's tiredness. When your feelings are hurt, pride can make it easy to pretend you're fine, so you need a place where you can speak honestly.

rows.ko: 나를 즐겁게 하는 취미에 푹 빠지는 시간이 마음에 다시 불을 켜 줍니다.
rows.en: Lose yourself in a hobby that's pure fun for you. It rekindles your inner fire.
rows.en_before_tone: Losing yourself in a hobby that delights you rekindles the fire in your heart.

rows.ko: 주변이 정돈되고 할 일이 보일 때 마음이 놓여요. 걱정은 정리하고 고치는 방식으로 다루는 편입니다.
rows.en: An orderly space and a clear to-do list put your mind at rest. You meet worry by sorting things out and fixing them.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart settles when things around you are tidy and you can see what needs doing. You tend to handle worry by organizing and fixing.

rows.ko: 불안한 마음이 들면 할 일을 적어 보거나 책상을 치우면서 감정을 가라앉히는 편이에요. 누군가 힘들어할 때 위로의 말보다 실질적으로 손을 보태는 것으로 마음을 표현합니다. 다만 스스로를 점검하는 목소리가 커지면 쉬어도 쉬는 것 같지 않을 수 있어요.
rows.en: When anxiety creeps in, you steady yourself by jotting down a to-do list or clearing your desk. When someone's struggling, you show love by rolling up your sleeves rather than reaching for comforting words. Just watch your inner critic: when it gets loud, even downtime stops feeling like rest.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel anxious, you tend to calm down by writing a to-do list or clearing your desk. When someone is struggling, you show you care by lending a practical hand more than with comforting words. But when the voice inside that keeps checking on you gets loud, even rest may not feel restful.

rows.ko: 작은 공간 하나를 정리하고 오늘 해낸 일을 적어 보면 마음이 가라앉습니다.
rows.en: Tidy one small corner, then write down what you accomplished today. Your mind settles as you do.
rows.en_before_tone: Tidying one small space and writing down what you got done today helps your mind settle.

rows.ko: 주변 관계가 평화롭고 조화로울 때 마음이 놓입니다. 어긋난 관계가 있으면 마음 한구석이 계속 편치 않아요.
rows.en: Peace and harmony among your people let you breathe easy. When one relationship falls out of tune, part of you can't fully relax.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart settles when the relationships around you are peaceful and harmonious. If one relationship is out of tune, a corner of your heart stays uneasy.

rows.ko: 감정을 혼자 삭이기보다 누군가와 나누고 대화하면서 균형을 찾는 편이에요. 다툼이 생기면 내 기분보다 분위기를 먼저 살피고 서둘러 화해의 말을 꺼내기도 합니다. 좋은 음악이나 정돈된 공간처럼 조화로운 환경도 마음을 진정시켜 줘요.
rows.en: Rather than stewing alone, you find your balance by talking things over with someone. When an argument breaks out, you read the room before checking in with yourself, and you rush to make peace. Harmonious surroundings, like good music or a well-kept space, calm you too.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than working through feelings alone, you tend to find your balance by sharing and talking with someone. When a disagreement comes up, you may check the mood before your own feelings and hurry to make peace. A harmonious environment, like good music or a well-arranged space, also calms you.

rows.ko: 마음이 맞는 사람과 차 한잔하거나 아름다운 것을 보며 쉬어 보세요.
rows.en: Share a cup of tea with a kindred spirit, or rest your eyes on something beautiful.
rows.en_before_tone: Try having a cup of tea with someone you click with, or resting while taking in something beautiful.

rows.ko: 깊이 믿을 수 있는 사람이 곁에 있을 때 마음이 놓여요. 감정을 얕게 나누기보다 깊게 연결되고 싶어 합니다.
rows.en: With someone you trust completely by your side, you finally relax. You crave deep connection over surface-level sharing.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart settles when someone you can trust deeply is by your side. You'd rather connect deeply than share feelings on the surface.

rows.ko: 감정을 강하게 느끼지만 쉽게 드러내지 않고, 속에서 오래 소화하는 편입니다. 상처받은 일은 겉으로 넘어간 것처럼 보여도 마음속에서 여러 번 곱씹기도 해요. 온전히 믿는 사람 앞에서야 비로소 속마음을 꺼내 놓습니다.
rows.en: You feel things intensely but rarely let it show, processing them inside for a long time. Even when a hurt looks resolved, you turn it over in your mind again and again. Only with someone you fully trust do you reveal what's really going on.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel emotions intensely but don't show them easily, processing them inside for a long time. Even when a hurt seems to have passed on the outside, you may turn it over many times in your mind. It's only with someone you fully trust that you finally open up about what's in your heart.

rows.ko: 혼자만의 시간에 감정을 충분히 느끼고 글로 흘려보내는 것이 도움이 돼요.
rows.en: Claim some time alone to feel your emotions fully, then let them flow out onto the page.
rows.en_before_tone: It helps to fully feel your emotions in time alone and let them flow out in writing.

rows.ko: 자유롭게 움직이고 새로운 것을 경험할 때 마음이 가벼워져요. 답답하게 묶여 있으면 감정도 무거워집니다.
rows.en: Freedom to roam and fresh experiences lift your spirits. Feel boxed in, and your mood sinks with it.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart feels lighter when you can move freely and experience new things. When you feel tied down, your emotions grow heavy too.

rows.ko: 힘든 일이 있어도 의미를 찾아 웃으며 넘기려는 낙천성이 있는 편입니다. 마음이 꽉 막힌 날에는 무작정 버스를 타고 낯선 동네에 가 보는 것만으로 숨통이 트이기도 해요. 다만 무거운 감정을 너무 빨리 넘기면 나중에 한꺼번에 밀려올 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Even when life gets hard, your optimism hunts for the meaning and finds a way to laugh it off. On days you feel completely stuck, simply hopping on a bus to an unfamiliar neighborhood helps you breathe again. Still, give heavy feelings their due: brush past them too quickly, and they tend to come flooding back later.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when things are hard, you have an optimism that looks for meaning and tries to move past it with a smile. On days when you feel completely stuck, just hopping on a bus to an unfamiliar neighborhood can help you breathe again. But if you move past heavy feelings too quickly, they may come rushing back all at once later.

rows.ko: 짧은 나들이나 새로운 배움처럼 시야를 넓혀 주는 경험이 마음을 풀어 줘요.
rows.en: Take a short day trip or learn something new. Widening your horizons helps you unwind.
rows.en_before_tone: Experiences that widen your view, like a short outing or learning something new, can help ease your heart.

rows.ko: 상황을 내가 감당하고 있다는 느낌이 들 때 마음이 놓여요. 감정보다 해야 할 일을 먼저 챙기는 편입니다.
rows.en: You feel calm when you know you have things in hand. You tackle what needs doing before you tend to how you feel.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart settles when you feel you've got the situation handled. You tend to deal with what needs doing before you turn to your feelings.

rows.ko: 속상해도 먼저 할 일을 처리하고, 감정은 나중에 혼자 다루는 편이에요. 힘들다는 말을 꺼내기보다 묵묵히 버티는 쪽이 익숙합니다. 안정된 계획과 예측할 수 있는 일정이 있을 때 마음도 조용히 단단해져요.
rows.en: Even when you're upset, you take care of business first and deal with your feelings later, on your own. Quietly toughing it out comes more naturally to you than admitting you're struggling. A solid plan and a predictable schedule make you steadfast inside.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when you're upset, you tend to deal with your tasks first and handle your feelings later, on your own. Quietly pushing through feels more familiar than saying you're having a hard time. When you have a steady plan and a predictable schedule, your heart quietly grows steady too.

rows.ko: 해낸 일을 스스로 인정해 주고, 일과 상관없는 쉬는 시간을 미리 정해 두세요.
rows.en: Give yourself credit for what you've achieved, and block out downtime in advance that has nothing to do with work.
rows.en_before_tone: It can help to give yourself credit for what you've done, and to set aside rest time that has nothing to do with work ahead of time.

rows.ko: 내 공간과 생각의 자유가 지켜질 때 마음이 편해져요. 감정을 한 걸음 떨어져서 바라보는 편입니다.
rows.en: You feel at ease when your space and your freedom of thought are respected. You observe your emotions from a step away.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel at ease when your space and freedom of thought are respected. You tend to look at your emotions from a step back.

rows.ko: 감정이 크게 일어나면 먼저 거리를 두고 차분히 이해해 보려는 편이에요. 가까운 사이일수록 너무 붙어 있기보다 각자의 시간을 존중할 때 더 편안함을 느낍니다. 생각이 통하는 친구들과의 느슨한 연결이 든든한 안전망이 돼요.
rows.en: When strong feelings hit, your first move is to step back and understand them calmly. Even with the people closest to you, you thrive on giving each other room rather than being joined at the hip. Loose ties with like-minded friends form your safety net.
rows.en_before_tone: When strong feelings come up, you tend to step back first and try to understand them calmly. With people close to you, you feel more comfortable when you respect each other's time rather than being glued together. Loose ties with friends who think like you are a reassuring safety net.

rows.ko: 혼자만의 시간을 지키면서 생각이 통하는 사람과 가볍게 연결돼 있는 것이 힘이 됩니다.
rows.en: Protect your alone time while staying loosely connected to people who get you. That balance is your strength.
rows.en_before_tone: Protecting your time alone while staying lightly connected with like-minded people gives you strength.

rows.ko: 마음이 조용히 흐를 수 있는 여유가 있을 때 편안해져요. 주변의 감정을 스펀지처럼 흡수하는 편입니다.
rows.en: You feel at peace when your emotions have room to drift and flow. Like a sponge, you soak up the feelings around you.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel at ease when your heart has room to flow quietly. You tend to soak up the emotions around you like a sponge.

rows.ko: 다른 사람의 기분을 내 것처럼 느끼고, 슬픈 영화 한 편에도 깊이 젖어 드는 편이에요. 지친 날에는 음악을 들으며 멍하니 있거나 물가를 걷는 시간이 마음을 씻어 줍니다. 사람 많은 곳에 오래 있으면 나도 모르게 에너지가 빠져나가기 쉬워요.
rows.en: You feel other people's moods as if they were your own, and a single sad film can move you to tears. On draining days, drifting along to music or strolling by the water washes the day away. Long stretches in crowds sap your energy before you even notice.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel other people's moods as if they were your own, and you can be deeply moved by even one sad movie. On tiring days, zoning out to music or walking by the water helps wash your heart clean. Spending a long time in crowded places can drain your energy before you even notice.

rows.ko: 음악, 따뜻한 목욕, 물가 산책처럼 감각을 부드럽게 쉬게 하는 시간이 도움이 됩니다.
rows.en: Music, a warm bath, a walk by the water: give your senses something gentle to rest on.
rows.en_before_tone: It can help to spend time that gently rests your senses, like music, a warm bath, or a walk by the water.

rows.ko: 에너지 넘치고 시원시원한 사람으로 보여요. 망설이기보다 먼저 행동으로 세상에 다가갑니다.
rows.en: People see you as energetic and refreshingly direct. Instead of hesitating, you greet the world with action.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as energetic and refreshingly direct. You approach the world through action rather than hesitation.

rows.ko: 처음 만난 자리에서도 먼저 말을 걸거나 분위기를 이끄는 모습이 눈에 띄는 편입니다. 걸음이 빠르고 표정이 솔직해서 생각이 얼굴에 잘 드러나요. 새로운 환경에 금방 뛰어드는 힘이 이 상승궁의 강점입니다.
rows.en: Even among strangers, you're the one who speaks up first or sets the tone. You walk fast and your face is an open book, so people read your thoughts at a glance. Your greatest strength with this rising sign: diving straight into new situations.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when meeting people for the first time, you often stand out as the one who speaks up first or sets the mood. You walk fast and your expressions are honest, so your thoughts tend to show on your face. The ability to jump right into new environments is the strength of this Ascendant.

rows.ko: 차분하고 편안한 사람으로 보여요. 서두르지 않고 내 속도로 세상과 관계를 맺습니다.
rows.en: You give off a calm, easygoing presence. You connect with the world and its people at your own unhurried pace.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as calm and easygoing. You connect with the world and with people at your own unhurried pace.

rows.ko: 처음에는 말수가 적어 보여도 곁에 있으면 안정감을 주는 사람이라는 인상을 남깁니다. 옷이나 소품, 향처럼 감각적인 취향이 자연스럽게 드러나는 편이에요. 낯선 환경에는 천천히 적응하지만, 한번 익숙해지면 그 자리를 오래 지킵니다.
rows.en: You seem quiet at first, yet people walk away feeling steadied by your presence. Your love of texture, beauty, and scent shows naturally in your clothes, the objects you keep close, and the fragrances you choose. You warm to new places slowly, but once you settle in, you stay for the long haul.
rows.en_before_tone: You may seem quiet at first, but you leave the impression of someone who feels steadying to be around. Your sensory tastes, in clothes, small objects, or scents, tend to show naturally. You adjust slowly to new places, but once you're settled, you stay put for a long time.

rows.ko: 가볍고 호기심 많은 사람으로 보여요. 말이 잘 통하고 새 정보에 빠르게 반응합니다.
rows.en: First impression: light, curious, and easy to talk to. You respond to new information in a flash.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as light and full of curiosity. You're easy to talk to and quick to pick up on new information.

rows.ko: 처음 만난 사람과도 금방 대화의 실마리를 찾아내는 재치가 있는 편입니다. 표정과 손짓이 풍부해서 경쾌하고 젊은 분위기라는 말을 듣기도 해요. 여러 사람과 두루 어울리며 자리를 부드럽게 만드는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: Your quick wit finds a thread of conversation with anyone, even someone you've just met. With your expressive face and animated hands, people often call you upbeat and youthful. You mingle easily with all kinds of people and help the whole room loosen up.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a knack for quickly finding a thread of conversation, even with someone you've just met. Your expressions and gestures are lively, so people sometimes describe your vibe as upbeat and youthful. You have a way of mixing with all kinds of people and easing the mood in the room.

rows.ko: 부드럽고 다정한 사람으로 보여요. 낯선 곳에서는 조심스럽게 살핀 뒤 마음을 엽니다.
rows.en: Others read you as gentle and kind. In unfamiliar settings, you take the measure of a place before you open up.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as gentle and kind. In unfamiliar places, you look around carefully before opening up.

rows.ko: 처음에는 조금 수줍어 보여도 상대를 편하게 해 주는 따뜻한 분위기가 있는 편입니다. 모임에서 혼자 있는 사람을 먼저 챙기는 세심함이 자연스럽게 드러나요. 안전하다고 느끼면 그때부터 웃음이 많아지고 마음을 활짝 엽니다.
rows.en: You seem a little shy at first, but your warmth puts people at ease. Your thoughtfulness shows without effort, like when you make a point of checking on the person sitting alone at a gathering. Once you feel safe, you laugh more freely and open your heart wide.
rows.en_before_tone: You may seem a little shy at first, but you have a warm presence that puts people at ease. Your thoughtfulness shows naturally, like checking on someone sitting alone at a gathering. Once you feel safe, you smile more and open up fully.

rows.ko: 존재감 있고 밝은 사람으로 보여요. 당당하게 나를 드러내며 세상을 마주합니다.
rows.en: You carry a bright, magnetic presence. You face the world with confidence, unafraid to show who you are.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as bright, with a strong presence. You face the world by confidently showing who you are.

rows.ko: 들어서는 순간 분위기가 환해진다는 말을 듣기 쉬운 인상입니다. 옷차림이나 말투에 나만의 개성이 묻어나고, 자연스럽게 시선을 모으는 편이에요. 사람들 앞에 설 때 오히려 힘이 나는 상승궁입니다.
rows.en: People often say a room lights up the moment you walk in. Your personal flair shines through in how you dress and speak, and eyes naturally drift your way. With this rising sign, stepping in front of people energizes you rather than drains you.
rows.en_before_tone: People often say a room brightens the moment you walk in. Your personal style shows in how you dress and speak, and you tend to draw attention naturally. With this Ascendant, you may actually gain energy when you're in front of people.

rows.ko: 단정하고 신중한 사람으로 보여요. 상황을 꼼꼼히 살핀 뒤 필요한 곳에 손을 보탭니다.
rows.en: You come across as polished and thoughtful. You take stock of the situation first, then pitch in exactly where you're needed.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as neat and thoughtful. You take in the situation carefully, then lend a hand where it's needed.

rows.ko: 처음에는 조용히 관찰하는 쪽이라 차분하고 성실하다는 인상을 주는 편입니다. 약속 시간을 지키고 필요한 것을 미리 챙겨 오는 작은 습관이 신뢰를 쌓아요. 겉으로는 침착해 보여도 속으로는 세세한 것까지 살피고 있습니다.
rows.en: At first you observe quietly, so people see you as calm and conscientious. Small habits, like arriving on time and bringing what's needed before anyone asks, earn their trust. You look composed on the outside while taking in every detail within.
rows.en_before_tone: At first you tend to observe quietly, which gives the impression that you're calm and conscientious. Small habits, like being on time and bringing what's needed ahead of time, build trust. You may look composed on the outside, but inside you're noticing every detail.

rows.ko: 상냥하고 세련된 사람으로 보여요. 상대를 배려하며 부드럽게 다가갑니다.
rows.en: To others, you seem warm and refined. You approach people with grace and consideration.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as friendly and polished. You approach people gently, with consideration.

rows.ko: 처음 만난 자리에서도 예의 바르고 편안한 분위기를 만드는 편입니다. 상대의 말에 고개를 끄덕이며 귀 기울이는 모습이 호감을 주기 쉬워요. 부딪히기보다 접점을 먼저 찾는 태도가 첫인상에 자연스럽게 묻어납니다.
rows.en: Even with people you've just met, you set a polite, comfortable tone. The way you nod along and truly listen wins people over quickly. Your instinct to seek common ground rather than clash shines through in every first impression.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when meeting people for the first time, you tend to create a polite, comfortable atmosphere. The way you nod and really listen to others easily wins people over. Your instinct to look for common ground rather than clash shows naturally in first impressions.

rows.ko: 속을 쉽게 알 수 없는, 깊이 있는 사람으로 보여요. 상대를 충분히 살핀 뒤에야 마음을 엽니다.
rows.en: People sense a depth in you they can't easily read. You open up only after you've taken someone's full measure.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as deep and hard to read. You open up only after you've taken your time getting to know someone.

rows.ko: 말수는 많지 않아도 눈빛과 분위기에서 강한 존재감이 느껴지는 편입니다. 처음에는 거리를 두는 듯 보이지만, 그만큼 신중하게 사람을 알아 가는 중이에요. 한번 마음을 연 상대에게는 누구보다 깊게 곁을 내어 줍니다.
rows.en: You don't say much, yet your gaze and presence carry real intensity. Others read distance at first, but you're simply getting to know them with care. Once you let someone in, you hold them closer than almost anyone else would.
rows.en_before_tone: You may not say much, but people feel a strong presence in your eyes and energy. You might seem distant at first, but that's because you're carefully getting to know people. With someone you've opened up to, you let them closer than almost anyone.

rows.ko: 밝고 개방적인 사람으로 보여요. 낯선 사람과 새로운 경험에 거리낌 없이 다가갑니다.
rows.en: You strike people as upbeat and open-minded. You embrace new people and new experiences without a second thought.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as bright and open. You approach new people and new experiences without hesitation.

rows.ko: 솔직하고 유쾌한 말투 덕분에 처음 만난 사람도 금방 편해지는 인상입니다. 여행 이야기나 새로 배운 것을 신나게 나누며 대화의 폭을 넓혀 가는 편이에요. 틀에 얽매이지 않는 자유로운 태도가 첫인상의 매력입니다.
rows.en: Your frank, playful way of talking puts even new acquaintances at ease fast. You love swapping travel stories and sharing what you've just learned, and conversations open wide around you. Your free spirit and refusal to be boxed in are what make your first impression so charming.
rows.en_before_tone: Your frank, cheerful way of talking makes even people you've just met feel at ease quickly. You tend to widen conversations by happily sharing travel stories or things you've recently learned. Your free-spirited attitude, not bound by convention, is a big part of your charm when people first meet you.

rows.ko: 믿음직하고 어른스러운 사람으로 보여요. 신중하게 거리를 지키며 차근차근 신뢰를 쌓습니다.
rows.en: You come off as reliable and mature beyond your years. You keep a measured distance and build trust step by step.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as dependable and mature. You keep a careful distance and build trust step by step.

rows.ko: 처음에는 진지하고 다가가기 어려워 보일 수 있지만, 맡은 일을 끝까지 해내는 모습에서 신뢰를 얻는 편입니다. 시간이 지날수록 의외의 유머와 따뜻함이 드러나요. 오래 알수록 더 편해지는 사람이라는 말을 듣기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: At first you seem serious, even hard to approach, but people trust you because you always follow through. Over time, a surprising sense of humor and real warmth come to light. People often say you grow easier to be around the longer they know you.
rows.en_before_tone: You may seem serious and hard to approach at first, but you earn trust by seeing your responsibilities through. Over time, a surprising sense of humor and warmth come through. People often say you get easier to be around the longer they know you.

rows.ko: 독특하고 자유로운 사람으로 보여요. 친근하지만 자기만의 거리를 지키며 세상과 만납니다.
rows.en: You read as one of a kind and free-spirited. You greet the world warmly while keeping a little space of your own.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as unique and free-spirited. You meet the world in a friendly way while keeping your own space.

rows.ko: 누구와도 스스럼없이 이야기하지만, 어딘가 남다른 생각을 가진 사람이라는 인상을 줍니다. 유행보다 내 기준을 따르는 취향이 자연스럽게 드러나는 편이에요. 여럿 속에서도 나만의 색을 잃지 않는 것이 이 상승궁의 힘입니다.
rows.en: You chat easily with anyone, yet people sense you see the world a little differently. Your taste follows your own compass, not the trends. The gift of this rising sign: you stay true to your own colors, even in a crowd.
rows.en_before_tone: You talk easily with anyone, yet you give the impression of someone who thinks a little differently. Your taste tends to follow your own standards rather than trends. Keeping your own color even in a crowd is the strength of this Ascendant.

rows.ko: 부드럽고 몽환적인 사람으로 보여요. 주변 분위기에 섬세하게 결을 맞추며 세상과 만납니다.
rows.en: You seem soft and dreamy to others. You meet the world by tuning delicately in to the mood around you.
rows.en_before_tone: You come across as soft and dreamy. You meet the world by gently tuning in to the mood around you.

rows.ko: 처음 만난 사람도 편하게 속 이야기를 꺼내게 만드는 포근한 분위기가 있는 편입니다. 표정이 부드럽고 상대의 기분에 따라 자연스럽게 말투를 맞춰요. 다만 사람이 많은 자리에서는 금방 지칠 수 있어, 혼자 쉬는 틈이 필요합니다.
rows.en: Your cozy, welcoming aura makes even new acquaintances want to confide in you. Your expression is gentle, and you naturally match your tone to how the other person feels. Big crowds wear you out quickly, though, so carve out time to recharge on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a cozy presence that makes even new acquaintances feel comfortable opening up. Your expression is gentle, and you naturally adjust your tone to the other person's mood. But crowded settings can tire you out quickly, so you need little breaks to rest on your own.

A5.name: 캐릭터 20종 (점성술판)
A5.used_in: 2번 섹션 — 당분간 show_character=false: 동물 이름·intro·share_line은 화면에 쓰지 않고 type_line + why_text만 사용

rows.ko: 수달
rows.en: River Otter
rows.en_before_tone: Otter

rows.ko: 누군가에게 기대는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 먼저 다가가는 유형
rows.en: Leaning on others takes a lot out of you, and when it does, you're the first to reach out
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom leaning on others takes a lot of energy, and who reaches out first in those moments

rows.ko: 수달은 마음이 허전할 때 먼저 물에 뛰어들어 친구에게 장난을 거는 캐릭터예요. 혼자 버티기보다 함께 헤엄치며 온기를 나누는 쪽을 고릅니다.
rows.en: When loneliness creeps in, River Otter is the first to dive in and start a playful splash with a friend. Rather than toughing it out alone, it chooses to swim together and share the warmth.
rows.en_before_tone: The river otter is a character who, when it feels empty inside, dives into the water first and starts playing with a friend. Rather than holding on alone, it chooses to swim together and share warmth.

rows.ko: 감정을 맡는 달이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 누군가에게 기대는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이 돼요. 그럴 때 기다리기보다 먼저 연락하고 움직이는 것은 차트에서 불의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Of your five planets, the Moon, ruler of your emotions, carries the most tension. That makes leaning on others the capacity that costs you the most energy. And because Fire burns strongest in your chart, you reach out and make the first move instead of waiting.
rows.en_before_tone: The Moon, which governs your emotions, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why leaning on others takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to reach out and act first instead of waiting comes from Fire being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 어색함을 먼저 깨고 다가가 주변을 금세 따뜻하게 만드는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You break the ice first and make everyone around you feel welcome in no time.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a gift for breaking the ice first and quickly warming up the people around you.

rows.ko: 먼저 건넨 연락에 답이 늦으면 혼자 마음이 바빠지는 순간입니다.
rows.en: A message you sent first sits unanswered, and your mind starts racing on its own.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when someone is slow to reply to the message you sent first, and your mind starts racing on its own.

rows.ko: 연락을 보내기 전에 지금 내게 필요한 것이 대화인지 쉼인지 한 번 물어봐 주세요.
rows.en: Before you hit send, check in with yourself: is it conversation you need right now, or rest?
rows.en_before_tone: Before you send that message, you might pause and ask yourself whether what you need right now is a conversation or rest.

rows.ko: 먼저 다가가는 용기, 그게 수달의 온기예요
rows.en: The courage to reach out first: that's River Otter's warmth
rows.en_before_tone: The courage to reach out first: that's the river otter's warmth

rows.ko: 해달
rows.en: Sea Otter
rows.note: 수달(river otter)과 해달(sea otter)을 구분하기 위해 영어에서는 River Otter / Sea Otter로 표기

rows.ko: 누군가에게 기대는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 상대에게 맞춰 주는 유형
rows.en: Leaning on others is hard work for you, so you tune in and go along with the other person
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom leaning on others takes a lot of energy, and who adapts to the other person in those moments

rows.ko: 해달은 잠들 때 서로 손을 잡아 떠내려가지 않게 하는 캐릭터입니다. 곁에 있는 이의 물결에 몸을 맞추며 조용히 기대는 법을 알아요.
rows.en: Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so no one drifts away. Sea Otter knows the art of leaning in quietly, moving with the rhythm of whoever floats beside it.
rows.en_before_tone: The sea otter is a character who holds hands while sleeping so no one drifts away. It knows how to lean quietly, moving with the waves of the one beside it.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정을 맡는 달이 다섯 행성 중 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 누군가에게 기대는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그때 내 마음보다 상대의 기분을 먼저 살피며 곁을 지키는 것은, 차트에서 물의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: The Moon, keeper of your emotional security, is the most stressed of your five planets. So leaning on someone is where you spend the most energy. With Water strongest in your chart, you tune in to the other person's feelings before your own and simply stay close.
rows.en_before_tone: The Moon, which governs emotional security, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why leaning on others takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to check the other person's feelings before your own and simply stay by their side comes from Water being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 말하지 않아도 상대의 기분을 알아채고 편안한 곁이 되어 주는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You sense how someone feels without a word, and you become the comforting presence they need.
rows.en_before_tone: You can sense how someone feels without being told, and you become a comforting presence beside them.

rows.ko: 기대고 싶은 날에도 상대 기분부터 맞추느라 내 이야기를 꺼내지 못하는 순간이에요.
rows.en: Even on days you need a shoulder, you get so absorbed in their mood that your own story stays unspoken.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, even on a day you want to lean on someone, you're so busy attending to their mood that you never bring up your own story.

rows.ko: 오늘은 상대 기분 말고 내 기분을 한 단어로 먼저 적어 보세요.
rows.en: Today, before checking anyone else's mood, write down your own in a single word.
rows.en_before_tone: Today, before thinking about anyone else's mood, try writing down your own in a single word.

rows.ko: 손잡고 떠 있는 해달처럼, 곁에 있어 줘서 고마워요
rows.en: Like sea otters floating hand in hand: thank you for staying by my side
rows.en_before_tone: Like sea otters floating hand in hand, thank you for staying by my side

rows.ko: 물범
rows.en: Seal
rows.note: 물범(harbor seal 계열)을 일반 명칭 Seal로 처리. 필요 시 Harbor Seal

rows.ko: 누군가에게 기대는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 한발 물러나 혼자 정리하는 유형
rows.en: Leaning on others drains you, so you'd rather step back and sort things out on your own
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom leaning on others takes a lot of energy, and who steps back to sort things out alone in those moments

rows.ko: 물범은 무리 가까이 있으면서도 바위 위에 저만의 자리를 두고 쉬는 캐릭터예요. 마음이 무거운 날엔 물속에 잠겼다가 조용히 고개만 내밀어 바깥을 살핍니다.
rows.en: Seal stays close to the group yet always keeps its own spot on the rocks to rest. On heavy days, it slips beneath the water and surfaces just its head to survey the world.
rows.en_before_tone: The seal is a character who stays close to the group but keeps its own spot on a rock to rest. On heavy-hearted days, it slips under the water and quietly pokes just its head out to look around.

rows.ko: 감정의 별인 달이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 누군가에게 마음을 기대는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이에요. 그럴 때 바로 기대기보다 혼자 생각을 정리할 시간을 먼저 찾는 것은, 차트에서 공기의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Your Moon, the planet of feelings, carries more tension than any of your other four planets. That makes leaning on others emotionally your most draining capacity. Air is the strongest element in your chart, so you seek time to sort out your thoughts alone before leaning on anyone.
rows.en_before_tone: The Moon, the planet of feelings, is under the most tension of your five planets. That makes emotionally leaning on others the capacity that takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to look for time to sort out your thoughts alone, rather than leaning on someone right away, comes from Air being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 감정이 차오를 때도 한발 떨어져 차분하게 상황을 바라보는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: Even when emotions run high, you step back and see the situation with a clear head.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when emotions are welling up, you can take a step back and look at the situation calmly.

rows.ko: 위로받고 싶으면서도 괜찮다고 말하고 혼자 바위로 올라가는 순간입니다.
rows.en: Part of you longs for comfort, yet you say "I'm fine" and haul yourself up onto your rock alone.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when you want comfort, yet you say you're fine and climb up onto your rock alone.

rows.ko: 혼자 정리한 뒤에는 믿는 한 사람에게 그 결론만이라도 짧게 나눠 보세요.
rows.en: Once you've sorted things out on your own, share just the conclusion with one person you trust, even in a sentence or two.
rows.en_before_tone: After you've sorted things out on your own, try briefly sharing even just your conclusion with one person you trust.

rows.ko: 혼자 쉬다가도 고개 내밀어 줘서 반가워요
rows.en: Even while resting solo, you popped your head up. So glad you did
rows.en_before_tone: So glad you poked your head out, even while resting on your own

rows.ko: 비버
rows.en: Beaver

rows.ko: 누군가에게 기대는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 현실적으로 따져 조율하는 유형
rows.en: Leaning on others takes real effort, so you work it out in practical terms
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom leaning on others takes a lot of energy, and who works things out practically in those moments

rows.ko: 비버는 기대고 싶은 마음이 들면 말보다 먼저 함께 머물 집을 짓는 캐릭터입니다. 나뭇가지를 하나씩 쌓듯 기댈 수 있는 자리를 차근차근 만들어요.
rows.en: When Beaver longs for someone to lean on, it starts building a shared home before saying a word. Branch by branch, it creates a place where leaning on each other feels safe.
rows.en_before_tone: The beaver is a character who, when it wants to lean on someone, builds a home to share before saying a word. Like stacking branches one by one, it steadily creates a place where leaning feels possible.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정을 맡는 달이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 누군가에게 기대는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량입니다. 그럴 때 감정을 털어놓기보다 함께할 일과 일정을 현실적으로 맞춰 보는 것은, 차트에서 흙의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Among your five planets, the Moon, guardian of your emotional security, faces the most tension. As a result, leaning on others takes more energy than anything else. Earth is your chart's strongest element, so instead of pouring your heart out, you get practical and line up shared plans and schedules.
rows.en_before_tone: The Moon, which governs emotional security, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why leaning on others takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to practically line up shared plans and schedules instead of pouring out your feelings comes from Earth being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 말로만 하지 않고 실제로 기댈 수 있는 생활의 터전을 만드는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: Support, for you, is never just talk: you build a real, everyday foundation others can lean on.
rows.en_before_tone: You don't just talk about it; you build a real, everyday home base where people can actually lean on each other.

rows.ko: 속상한 마음은 뒤로하고 할 일 목록만 정리하다 혼자 지치는 순간이에요.
rows.en: You push your hurt aside, keep working through your to-do list, and quietly run yourself ragged.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when you set your hurt feelings aside, keep organizing your to-do list, and quietly wear yourself out.

rows.ko: 할 일 목록 맨 위에 오늘 기분 나누기를 한 줄 넣어 보세요.
rows.en: Add one line to the very top of your to-do list: tell someone how I feel today.
rows.en_before_tone: Try adding one line to the very top of your to-do list: share how I'm feeling today.

rows.ko: 함께 쉴 보금자리를 짓는 비버, 참 든든해요
rows.en: Building a cozy nest where we can rest together. What a steadfast Beaver
rows.en_before_tone: A beaver building a cozy nest to rest in together. So reassuring

rows.ko: 원앙
rows.en: Mandarin Duck
rows.note: 원앙은 한국에서 금슬 좋은 부부의 상징이지만 영어권에서는 그 연상이 약함. 본문 묘사로 충분히 전달됨

rows.ko: 관계를 믿고 마음을 놓는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 먼저 다가가는 유형
rows.en: Trusting a relationship enough to relax takes a lot of energy, so you reach out first to check in
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom trusting a relationship and letting their guard down takes a lot of energy, and who reaches out first in those moments

rows.ko: 원앙은 마음이 불안할 때 먼저 다가가 나란히 헤엄치며 곁을 확인하는 캐릭터예요. 함께 있는 시간이 쌓일수록 물결 위의 마음도 고요해집니다.
rows.en: When worry stirs, Mandarin Duck paddles over first and swims side by side, just to make sure you're still there. The more time you share, the calmer it grows.
rows.en_before_tone: The mandarin duck is a character who, when it feels uneasy, swims up first and paddles side by side to make sure someone is still there. The more time they spend together, the calmer its heart grows, like water settling.

rows.ko: 책임과 구조를 맡는 토성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 관계를 믿고 마음을 놓는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이에요. 그럴 때 혼자 걱정하기보다 먼저 묻고 표현해 확인하는 것은 차트에서 불의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility and structure, is the most stressed of your five planets. That makes trusting a relationship enough to relax your most draining capacity. Since Fire is your strongest element, you ask and say how you feel rather than worry in silence.
rows.en_before_tone: Saturn, which governs responsibility and structure, is under the most tension of your five planets. That makes trusting a relationship and letting your guard down the capacity that takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to check in by asking and saying how you feel, rather than worrying alone, comes from Fire being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 아끼는 마음을 숨기지 않고 표현해 관계에 온기를 불어넣는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You never hide how much you care, and that openness breathes warmth into your relationships.
rows.en_before_tone: You don't hide how much you care; you show it, and that breathes warmth into your relationships.

rows.ko: 확인의 말을 들은 뒤에도 마음이 놓이지 않아 다시 묻고 싶어지는 순간입니다.
rows.en: You've already heard the reassurance, yet you still can't settle and long to ask one more time.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, even after hearing reassurance, you still don't feel settled and want to ask again.

rows.ko: 묻고 싶은 마음이 들면 그동안 함께 쌓아 온 장면 세 가지를 떠올려 보세요.
rows.en: When the urge to ask hits, recall three moments the two of you have built together.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel the urge to ask, try recalling three moments you've built together so far.

rows.ko: 나란히 헤엄치는 시간, 원앙에게는 보물이에요
rows.en: Swimming side by side is pure treasure to a Mandarin Duck
rows.en_before_tone: Time spent swimming side by side is a treasure to the mandarin duck

rows.ko: 펭귄
rows.en: Penguin

rows.ko: 관계를 믿고 마음을 놓는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 상대에게 맞춰 주는 유형
rows.en: Letting your guard down in a relationship is hard for you, so you adapt to the other person
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom trusting a relationship and letting their guard down takes a lot of energy, and who adapts to the other person in those moments

rows.ko: 펭귄은 추운 날 서로 몸을 붙이고 번갈아 바깥 자리를 맡는 캐릭터입니다. 수많은 목소리 가운데서도 소중한 이의 소리를 알아듣고 그 곁에 나란히 서요.
rows.en: On cold days, penguins huddle close and take turns braving the windy outer edge. Even amid countless calls, Penguin picks out the voice of someone it loves and goes to stand right beside them.
rows.en_before_tone: The penguin is a character who huddles close with others on cold days, taking turns on the chilly outer edge. Even among countless voices, it recognizes the call of someone dear and stands right beside them.

rows.ko: 시간과 책임을 맡는 토성이 다섯 행성 중 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 관계가 단단하다고 믿는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 상대에게 맞춰 무리의 온기를 지키려는 것은, 차트에서 물의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Saturn, ruler of time and responsibility, bears the heaviest tension among your five planets. That's why believing a relationship stands on solid ground takes the most energy for you. With Water strongest in your chart, you adapt to others to keep the whole huddle warm.
rows.en_before_tone: Saturn, which governs time and responsibility, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why believing a relationship is solid takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to adapt to others to keep the group warm comes from Water being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 함께하는 이들의 마음을 살펴 모두가 따뜻할 수 있도록 자리를 지키는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You keep an eye on everyone's feelings and hold your place so no one is left out in the cold.
rows.en_before_tone: You look out for the hearts of those around you and hold your place so everyone can stay warm.

rows.ko: 관계가 흔들릴까 봐 서운한 마음까지 꾹 참고 맞춰 주는 순간이에요.
rows.en: Afraid of rocking the boat, you swallow even your hurt feelings and simply go along.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, afraid the relationship might wobble, you swallow even your hurt feelings and go along.

rows.ko: 오늘 하나쯤은 내가 원하는 것을 먼저 말하고 관계가 어떤지 지켜봐 주세요.
rows.en: Today, say one thing you want first, and watch how well the relationship holds.
rows.en_before_tone: Today, try saying one thing you want first, and see how the relationship holds up.

rows.ko: 추운 날 곁을 내어 주는 펭귄, 정말 따뜻해요
rows.en: Making room for others on the coldest days. Such a warm Penguin
rows.en_before_tone: A penguin who makes room for you on cold days. So warm

rows.ko: 왜가리
rows.en: Heron

rows.ko: 관계를 믿고 마음을 놓는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 한발 물러나 혼자 정리하는 유형
rows.en: Trusting others is draining for you, so you step back and think it through alone
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom trusting a relationship and letting their guard down takes a lot of energy, and who steps back to sort things out alone in those moments

rows.ko: 왜가리는 얕은 물가에 오래 서서 물결을 지켜본 뒤에야 한 걸음 내딛는 캐릭터예요. 서두르지 않고 멀리서 바라보며 믿어도 될지 스스로 가늠합니다.
rows.en: Heron stands in the shallows for a long while, watching the ripples before taking a single step. Unhurried, it observes from a distance and decides for itself whether it's safe to trust.
rows.en_before_tone: The heron is a character who stands a long time at the water's edge, watching the ripples before taking a single step. Without rushing, it watches from a distance and decides for itself whether it's safe to trust.

rows.ko: 책임과 시험의 별 토성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 관계를 믿고 마음을 맡기는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이 돼요. 그럴 때 가까이 붙기보다 한발 떨어져 생각으로 상황을 살피는 것은, 차트에서 공기의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Of your five planets, Saturn, the planet of responsibility and tests, is under the most tension. That's why fully trusting a relationship takes so much out of you. Air is your strongest element, so instead of moving in close, you step back and think the situation through.
rows.en_before_tone: Saturn, the planet of responsibility and tests, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why trusting a relationship and opening your heart takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to step back and think the situation through rather than move in close comes from Air being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 감정에 휩쓸리지 않고 사람과 상황을 차분하게 지켜보는 눈이 있어요.
rows.en: You watch people and situations with a calm, clear eye, never swept away by the moment.
rows.en_before_tone: You have an eye for watching people and situations calmly, without getting swept up in emotion.

rows.ko: 다가오는 마음을 반기면서도 정말 믿어도 될지 혼자 오래 따져 보는 순간입니다.
rows.en: You welcome someone's warmth, yet you spend ages alone weighing whether you can truly trust it.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when you welcome someone's warmth, yet spend a long time alone weighing whether you can really trust it.

rows.ko: 지켜본 것 가운데 이미 믿을 만했던 순간을 하나 골라 고맙다고 전해 보세요.
rows.en: From everything you've observed, choose one moment when someone already proved trustworthy, and thank them for it.
rows.en_before_tone: From everything you've observed, try picking one moment when someone already proved trustworthy, and thank them for it.

rows.ko: 오래 지켜본 만큼 깊이 믿는 왜가리예요
rows.en: Heron watches long and trusts deeply
rows.en_before_tone: The heron watches long, and trusts just as deeply

rows.ko: 백조
rows.en: Swan

rows.ko: 관계를 믿고 마음을 놓는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 현실적으로 따져 조율하는 유형
rows.en: Feeling secure in a relationship takes effort, so you find practical ways to make it work
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom trusting a relationship and letting their guard down takes a lot of energy, and who works things out practically in those moments

rows.ko: 백조는 물 위에서는 우아하게 떠 있지만 물 아래에서는 쉬지 않고 발을 젓는 캐릭터입니다. 겉으로는 고요해 보여도 관계가 흔들리지 않도록 속에서 차근차근 균형을 잡아요.
rows.en: On the surface, Swan glides with effortless grace, but beneath the water its feet never stop paddling. It looks serene, yet it works steadily below to keep the relationship balanced.
rows.en_before_tone: The swan is a character who glides gracefully on the surface while paddling nonstop underneath. It may look calm on the outside, but inside it's steadily keeping the balance so the relationship doesn't wobble.

rows.ko: 구조와 약속을 맡는 토성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 관계를 믿고 마음을 놓는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 약속과 생활의 틀을 현실적으로 맞춰 가며 안심을 찾는 것은, 차트에서 흙의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Saturn rules structure and commitments, and of your five planets, it carries the most tension. As a result, trusting a relationship enough to relax takes more energy than anything else. Because Earth is strongest in your chart, you find reassurance by aligning promises and daily routines in practical ways.
rows.en_before_tone: Saturn, which governs structure and commitments, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why trusting a relationship and letting your guard down takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to find reassurance by practically lining up promises and daily routines comes from Earth being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 약속을 지키고 일상을 꾸준히 이어 가며 믿을 만한 관계를 쌓는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You keep your word and show up day after day, building relationships people can rely on.
rows.en_before_tone: You build trustworthy relationships by keeping your promises and showing up steadily day after day.

rows.ko: 겉으로는 평온한 척하며 물 아래에서 혼자 계획을 다시 짜는 순간이에요.
rows.en: You act calm on the surface while quietly redrawing all your plans underneath.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when you act calm on the surface while redoing your plans alone beneath the water.

rows.ko: 물 아래에서 젓던 발을 잠시 멈추고, 지금 불안한 점 하나를 말로 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: Stop paddling for a moment, and put one worry into words.
rows.en_before_tone: Try pausing the paddling under the water for a moment and putting one worry into words.

rows.ko: 고요한 물 위의 백조, 속으로 늘 애쓰고 있어요
rows.en: A Swan on still water, always working hard beneath
rows.en_before_tone: A swan on still water, always working hard underneath

rows.ko: 복어
rows.en: Pufferfish

rows.ko: 내 선을 지키는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 먼저 다가가는 유형
rows.en: Holding your boundaries takes a lot out of you, so you speak up and meet it head-on
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom holding their boundaries takes a lot of energy, and who reaches out first in those moments

rows.ko: 복어는 누가 내 선을 넘어온다 싶으면 몸을 크게 부풀려 바로 신호를 보내는 캐릭터예요. 평소엔 동글동글 순하지만 지킬 것 앞에서는 망설이지 않습니다.
rows.en: When Pufferfish senses someone crossing a line, it puffs up to send a clear signal right away. Most of the time it's round and mellow, but it never hesitates when something needs protecting.
rows.en_before_tone: The pufferfish is a character who puffs up big to send a clear signal the moment someone seems to cross the line. Usually round and gentle, it doesn't hesitate when there's something to protect.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동을 맡는 화성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 나의 선을 세우고 지키는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이에요. 그럴 때 참고 넘기기보다 바로 표현해 선을 그으려는 것은, 차트에서 불의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Mars, ruler of drive and action, faces the most tension among your five planets. That makes setting and holding your boundaries your most draining capacity. Fire is the strongest element in your chart, so rather than letting things slide, you draw the line by speaking up on the spot.
rows.en_before_tone: Mars, which governs drive and action, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why setting and holding your boundaries takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to draw the line by speaking up right away rather than putting up with things comes from Fire being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 불편한 것을 오래 묵히지 않고 솔직하게 알려 관계를 투명하게 만드는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You never let things fester. You speak up honestly, and that keeps your relationships clear and transparent.
rows.en_before_tone: You don't let discomfort sit for long; you say it honestly, which keeps your relationships transparent.

rows.ko: 마음보다 몸이 먼저 부풀어 올라 말이 생각보다 세게 나가는 순간입니다.
rows.en: Your body puffs up before your feelings catch up, and your words come out harsher than you meant.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when your body puffs up before your heart catches up, and your words come out stronger than you meant.

rows.ko: 몸이 부풀어 오를 때 숨을 길게 내쉬고, 원하는 것 하나만 골라 말해 보세요.
rows.en: When you feel yourself puffing up, breathe out slowly and choose just one thing you want to say.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel yourself puffing up, try breathing out slowly and choosing just one thing you want to say.

rows.ko: 솔직하게 부풀 줄 아는 복어, 그 용기 멋져요
rows.en: A Pufferfish brave enough to puff up honestly. Love that courage
rows.en_before_tone: A pufferfish brave enough to puff up honestly. Love that courage

rows.ko: 소라게
rows.en: Hermit Crab

rows.ko: 내 선을 지키는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 상대에게 맞춰 주는 유형
rows.en: Saying where your limits are is hard for you, so you often go along with others
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom holding their boundaries takes a lot of energy, and who adapts to the other person in those moments

rows.ko: 소라게는 주변 친구들과 차례를 맞춰 껍데기를 바꿔 입는 캐릭터입니다. 모두가 편하도록 자리를 내주다 보면 정작 내게 맞는 집을 놓치기도 해요.
rows.en: Hermit crabs line up with their neighbors and take turns swapping shells. Hermit Crab works so hard to make everyone comfortable that it sometimes misses the home that truly fits.
rows.en_before_tone: The hermit crab is a character who swaps shells with nearby friends, taking turns in line. While it makes room so everyone is comfortable, it can sometimes miss out on a home that truly fits.

rows.ko: 나를 지키는 힘을 맡는 화성이 다섯 행성 중 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 여기까지라고 선을 긋는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 거절하기보다 상대 기분에 맞춰 내 자리를 조금씩 내어 주는 것은, 차트에서 물의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Mars governs your power to stand up for yourself, and of your five planets, it's under the most tension. So saying "this far, no further" is where you spend the most energy. With Water as your strongest element, you give up a little of your own space to match someone's mood instead of saying no.
rows.en_before_tone: Mars, which governs your power to protect yourself, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why drawing a line and saying "this far, no further" takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to give up a little of your space to match someone's mood instead of saying no comes from Water being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 상대의 사정을 헤아려 부드럽게 양보하며 관계의 평화를 지키는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You read what others are going through and yield gracefully to keep the peace.
rows.en_before_tone: You consider other people's situations and give way gently, keeping the peace in your relationships.

rows.ko: 싫다는 말이 목까지 왔는데 상대 표정을 보고 다시 삼키는 순간이에요.
rows.en: "No" is right on the tip of your tongue, then you see their face and swallow it.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when "no" is right on the tip of your tongue, but you see their face and swallow it again.

rows.ko: 이번 주에는 작은 부탁 하나쯤 ‘이번엔 어려워요’라고 다정하게 거절해 보세요.
rows.en: This week, kindly turn down one small request: "I can't this time."
rows.en_before_tone: This week, try kindly turning down one small request: "I can't this time."

rows.ko: 내게 꼭 맞는 껍데기도 챙기는 소라게가 되길
rows.en: Here's to finding a shell that fits you just right, Hermit Crab
rows.en_before_tone: Here's to a hermit crab who also finds a shell that fits just right

rows.ko: 거북
rows.en: Turtle

rows.ko: 내 선을 지키는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 한발 물러나 혼자 정리하는 유형
rows.en: Defending your boundaries drains you, so you pull back and regroup on your own
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom holding their boundaries takes a lot of energy, and who steps back to sort things out alone in those moments

rows.ko: 거북은 마음이 침범당한다고 느끼면 조용히 등딱지 안으로 들어가 숨을 고르는 캐릭터예요. 충분히 쉰 뒤에야 다시 고개를 내밀고 천천히 길을 이어 갑니다.
rows.en: When Turtle feels its space invaded, it quietly withdraws into its shell to catch its breath. Only after a good rest does it poke its head back out and slowly carry on.
rows.en_before_tone: The turtle is a character who, when its space feels invaded, quietly pulls into its shell to catch its breath. Only after resting enough does it poke its head out again and slowly continue on its way.

rows.ko: 행동과 자기주장을 맡는 화성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 나의 선을 말로 세우는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이 돼요. 그럴 때 맞서기보다 잠시 물러나 혼자 생각을 정리하는 것은, 차트에서 공기의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Of your five planets, Mars, the planet of action and self-assertion, bears the most strain. That's why putting your boundaries into words takes so much energy. Air is strongest in your chart, so instead of pushing back, you step away for a while and sort through your thoughts alone.
rows.en_before_tone: Mars, which governs action and self-assertion, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why putting your boundaries into words takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to step back for a while and sort out your thoughts alone rather than push back comes from Air being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 부딪힐 때도 감정적으로 맞서지 않고 차분하게 나를 지키는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: Even in a clash, you hold your ground calmly instead of reacting in the heat of the moment.
rows.en_before_tone: Even in a clash, you protect yourself calmly instead of reacting emotionally.

rows.ko: 불편하다는 말 대신 등딱지 안에서 혼자 오래 머무는 순간입니다.
rows.en: Instead of saying something feels off, you retreat into your shell and linger there a long time.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, instead of saying you're uncomfortable, you stay inside your shell alone for a long time.

rows.ko: 등딱지 안에 들어갈 때 조금 쉬고 다시 이야기하겠다고 한마디 남겨 보세요.
rows.en: When you head into your shell, leave a quick word: you need a little rest, and you'll talk again soon.
rows.en_before_tone: When you retreat into your shell, try leaving a quick word: you need a little rest and will talk again soon.

rows.ko: 쉬었다 다시 걷는 거북, 그 속도도 괜찮아요
rows.en: Rest, then walk on. Turtle's pace is perfectly fine
rows.en_before_tone: A turtle who rests and then walks on. That pace is just fine

rows.ko: 조개
rows.en: Clam

rows.ko: 내 선을 지키는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 현실적으로 따져 조율하는 유형
rows.en: Holding your boundaries takes real effort, so you weigh things practically and adjust
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom holding their boundaries takes a lot of energy, and who works things out practically in those moments

rows.ko: 조개는 물이 맑을 때만 껍데기를 살짝 열고, 흐려지면 단단히 닫는 캐릭터입니다. 얼마나 열지 상황을 보며 하나하나 가늠하는 신중한 문지기예요.
rows.en: Clam opens its shell just a crack when the water runs clear and clamps it shut when the water turns murky. A careful gatekeeper, it reads each situation to decide how far to open.
rows.en_before_tone: The clam is a character who opens its shell just a little when the water is clear and closes it tight when it turns murky. It's a careful gatekeeper, gauging case by case how far to open.

rows.ko: 나를 지키는 추진력의 별 화성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 내 경계를 세우고 지키는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 감정보다 조건과 사정을 따져 어디까지 열지 조정하는 것은 차트에서 흙의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Mars, your planet of drive and self-protection, carries more tension than any of your other four planets. That's why setting and holding your boundaries takes the most energy. Because Earth is your strongest element, you weigh conditions and circumstances, not feelings, to decide how far to open up.
