rows.en_before_tone: Mars, the planet of drive and self-protection, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why setting and holding your boundaries takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to weigh conditions and circumstances over feelings to decide how far to open up comes from Earth being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 무엇을 받아들이고 무엇을 거를지 현실적으로 가려내는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You have a practical gift for sorting what to let in from what to keep out.
rows.en_before_tone: You can realistically sort out what to let in and what to filter out.

rows.ko: 열어야 할지 닫아야 할지 계산하느라 내 마음을 들여다볼 틈이 없는 순간이에요.
rows.en: You're so busy calculating whether to open or close that you never pause to check how you actually feel.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when you're so busy calculating whether to open or close that there's no room to look at how you actually feel.

rows.ko: 따져 보기 전에 지금 내 마음이 열고 싶은지부터 물어봐 주세요.
rows.en: Before you weigh the pros and cons, ask yourself whether you even want to open up right now.
rows.en_before_tone: Before weighing things up, you might first ask yourself whether your heart actually wants to open right now.

rows.ko: 천천히 열리는 조개, 그 안은 참 부드러워요
rows.en: Slow to open, yet so soft inside. That's Clam
rows.en_before_tone: A clam that opens slowly is so soft inside

rows.ko: 물개
rows.en: Fur Seal
rows.note: 물범(Seal)과 구분하기 위해 물개는 Fur Seal로 표기. 필요 시 Sea Lion도 가능

rows.ko: 마음을 말로 꺼내는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 먼저 다가가는 유형
rows.en: Putting your feelings into words takes a lot out of you, yet you still reach out first
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom putting their feelings into words takes a lot of energy, and who reaches out first in those moments

rows.ko: 물개는 하고 싶은 말이 생기면 바위 위로 올라와 큰 소리로 먼저 불러 보는 캐릭터예요. 시끌벅적한 무리 속에서도 제 목소리를 내며 대화를 엽니다.
rows.en: When Fur Seal has something to say, it hauls itself onto a rock and calls out loud and clear. Even in a noisy, crowded colony, it raises its voice to get the conversation going.
rows.en_before_tone: The fur seal is a character who, when it has something to say, climbs up onto a rock and calls out loudly first. Even in a noisy crowd, it uses its own voice to start the conversation.

rows.ko: 생각과 말을 맡는 수성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 마음을 말로 옮기는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이에요. 그럴 때 망설이기보다 일단 말을 꺼내 보는 것은 차트에서 불의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Mercury, ruler of thought and speech, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why putting your feelings into words takes the most out of you. With Fire as your strongest element, you speak up first instead of holding back.
rows.en_before_tone: Mercury, which governs thinking and speech, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why putting your feelings into words takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to just start talking rather than hesitate comes from Fire being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 어색한 침묵을 먼저 깨고 솔직한 말로 대화의 물꼬를 트는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You break awkward silences first and get the conversation flowing with your honesty.
rows.en_before_tone: You're the one who breaks an awkward silence and gets the conversation flowing with honest words.

rows.ko: 급한 마음에 말이 먼저 나가고, 돌아서서 그 말을 다시 곱씹는 순간입니다.
rows.en: In a rush, the words tumble out first, and afterward you replay them again and again.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, in a rush, the words come out first, and afterward you keep replaying them.

rows.ko: 중요한 말을 꺼내기 전에 가장 전하고 싶은 한 문장을 먼저 골라 보세요.
rows.en: Before you bring up something important, choose the one sentence you most want them to hear.
rows.en_before_tone: Before bringing up something important, try picking the one sentence you most want to get across.

rows.ko: 먼저 말 걸어 주는 물개 덕분에 웃어요
rows.en: Thanks for always saying hi first, Fur Seal. You make me smile
rows.en_before_tone: Smiling thanks to a fur seal who talks to me first

rows.ko: 돌고래
rows.en: Dolphin

rows.ko: 마음을 말로 꺼내는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 상대에게 맞춰 주는 유형
rows.en: Saying what you really think is hard for you, so you follow the other person's lead
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom putting their feelings into words takes a lot of energy, and who adapts to the other person in those moments

rows.ko: 돌고래는 무리의 소리에 귀 기울이고 그 박자에 맞춰 휘파람을 부는 캐릭터입니다. 분위기가 밝아지는 말을 고르는 데 누구보다 재빨라요.
rows.en: Dolphins listen closely to the sounds of their pod and whistle along in rhythm. Dolphin finds the words that lift the mood faster than anyone.
rows.en_before_tone: The dolphin is a character who listens to the sounds of its pod and whistles along to the rhythm. It's quicker than anyone at choosing the words that brighten the mood.

rows.ko: 말과 연락을 맡는 수성이 다섯 행성 중 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 내 생각을 그대로 표현하는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 내 말보다 상대가 듣고 싶은 말을 먼저 고르는 것은, 차트에서 물의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of words and communication, is the most stressed of your five planets. So saying exactly what you think takes the most energy for you. Water is your strongest element, which is why you reach for what the other person wants to hear before what you want to say.
rows.en_before_tone: Mercury, which governs words and communication, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why expressing your thoughts as they are takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to choose what the other person wants to hear before what you want to say comes from Water being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 상대의 마음을 읽고 그 사람에게 닿는 말투를 찾아내는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You read people and find just the right tone to reach each one.
rows.en_before_tone: You read people's hearts and find the way of speaking that reaches each of them.

rows.ko: 분위기를 맞추느라 정작 내 진짜 생각은 꺼내지 못한 채 대화가 끝나는 순간이에요.
rows.en: You're so busy matching the mood that the conversation ends before you share what you really think.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, busy matching the mood, you reach the end of a conversation without ever sharing what you really think.

rows.ko: 맞장구를 친 다음에 나는 이렇게 느꼈다는 한 문장을 덧붙여 보세요.
rows.en: After you agree with someone, add one sentence about how you actually felt.
rows.en_before_tone: After agreeing with someone, try adding one sentence about how you felt.

rows.ko: 박자를 맞추는 돌고래, 당신 노래도 궁금해요
rows.en: A Dolphin who keeps the beat. I'd love to hear your song too
rows.en_before_tone: A dolphin who keeps the beat. I'd love to hear your song too

rows.ko: 혹등고래
rows.en: Humpback Whale

rows.ko: 마음을 말로 꺼내는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 한발 물러나 혼자 정리하는 유형
rows.en: Putting feelings into words drains you, so you step back and sort out your thoughts first
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom putting their feelings into words takes a lot of energy, and who steps back to sort things out alone in those moments

rows.ko: 혹등고래는 깊은 바다에서 혼자 오래 노래를 다듬은 뒤 멀리까지 띄워 보내는 캐릭터예요. 한번 꺼낸 소리는 느리지만 깊고 멀리 닿습니다.
rows.en: Deep in the ocean, Humpback Whale spends a long time alone refining its song before sending it out across the sea. Its voice is slow to emerge, but it carries deep and far.
rows.en_before_tone: The humpback whale is a character who spends a long time alone in the deep sea polishing its song before sending it far away. Once its voice is released, it travels slowly, but deep and far.

rows.ko: 말과 생각의 별인 수성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 마음을 말로 꺼내는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이 돼요. 그럴 때 바로 말하기보다 혼자 생각을 충분히 정리할 시간을 갖는 것은, 차트에서 공기의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Mercury, the planet of words and thought, faces the most tension among your five planets. That makes putting your feelings into words your most draining capacity. Because Air is strongest in your chart, you take time to fully sort out your thoughts before you speak.
rows.en_before_tone: Mercury, the planet of words and thought, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why putting your feelings into words takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to take time to fully sort out your thoughts alone rather than speak right away comes from Air being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 충분히 생각한 뒤 꺼내는 말이라 깊이 있고 오래 남는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You think things through before you speak, so your words carry weight and linger with people.
rows.en_before_tone: Because you speak after thinking things through, your words have depth and stay with people.

rows.ko: 생각을 다듬는 사이 대화의 때가 지나가 혼자 말을 품고 있는 순간입니다.
rows.en: While you're still polishing your thoughts, the moment to speak slips by, and you're left holding the words alone.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, while you're refining your thoughts, the right time to speak passes and you're left holding the words alone.

rows.ko: 정리가 덜 됐어도 지금 생각 중이니 조금 있다 말하겠다고 먼저 알려 보세요.
rows.en: Even if your thoughts aren't fully sorted, let people know you're still thinking and will come back to it soon.
rows.en_before_tone: Even if your thoughts aren't fully sorted, try letting people know first that you're still thinking and will share in a bit.

rows.ko: 천천히 부르는 혹등고래의 노래, 멀리까지 닿아요
rows.en: Humpback Whale's slow song travels far
rows.en_before_tone: The humpback's slow song travels far

rows.ko: 개구리
rows.en: Frog

rows.ko: 마음을 말로 꺼내는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 현실적으로 따져 조율하는 유형
rows.en: Speaking your mind takes effort, so you choose your moment and approach it practically
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom putting their feelings into words takes a lot of energy, and who works things out practically in those moments

rows.ko: 개구리는 비가 내리고 때가 무르익었다 싶을 때 목청을 높이는 캐릭터입니다. 물과 땅을 오가듯 말할 자리와 때를 현실적으로 골라요.
rows.en: Frog waits until the rain falls and the moment ripens, then raises its voice. Moving between water and land, it chooses the right place and time to speak.
rows.en_before_tone: The frog is a character who raises its voice once the rain falls and the time feels right. Just as it moves between water and land, it chooses the right place and moment to speak in a practical way.

rows.ko: 생각과 표현을 맡는 수성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 하고 싶은 말을 꺼내는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 감정대로 말하기보다 때와 방법을 따져 조정하는 것은 차트에서 흙의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Mercury, ruler of thought and expression, is the most stressed of your five planets. That's why voicing what's on your mind takes so much energy. Earth is your strongest element, so rather than speaking on impulse, you weigh the timing and the best way to say it.
rows.en_before_tone: Mercury, which governs thought and expression, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why saying what you want to say takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to weigh the timing and approach rather than speak from emotion comes from Earth being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 말할 때와 자리를 잘 가려 오해 없이 필요한 이야기를 전하는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You know when and where to raise things, so you get your point across without misunderstandings.
rows.en_before_tone: You choose the right time and place, so you can say what's needed without misunderstandings.

rows.ko: 더 좋은 때를 기다리다 결국 말할 기회를 자꾸 미뤄 두는 순간이에요.
rows.en: You keep waiting for a better moment, and the chance to speak keeps slipping further away.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, waiting for a better time, you keep putting off your chance to speak.

rows.ko: 완벽한 때를 기다리기보다 이번 주 안에 말할 날을 하나 정해 두세요.
rows.en: Instead of holding out for the perfect moment, choose one day this week to say it.
rows.en_before_tone: Instead of waiting for the perfect moment, it can help to pick one day this week to say it.

rows.ko: 때를 아는 개구리의 한마디, 참 든든해요
rows.en: When a Frog with perfect timing speaks up, you can count on it
rows.en_before_tone: A word from a frog who knows the right moment. So reassuring

rows.ko: 문어
rows.en: Octopus

rows.ko: 다툰 뒤 다시 가까워지는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 먼저 다가가는 유형
rows.en: Making up after a fight takes a lot out of you, yet you're the first to reach out
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom getting close again after a conflict takes a lot of energy, and who reaches out first in those moments

rows.ko: 문어는 사이가 어긋나면 여덟 개의 팔을 뻗어 먼저 풀어 보려는 캐릭터예요. 몸 색을 바꿔 가며 지금 마음을 숨김없이 드러내기도 합니다.
rows.en: When a relationship hits a snag, Octopus reaches out with all eight arms, eager to be the first to mend it. It even shifts colors, showing exactly how it feels.
rows.en_before_tone: The octopus is a character who, when things go wrong in a relationship, reaches out with all eight arms, trying to be the first to make things right. Sometimes it changes color, showing exactly how it feels without hiding anything.

rows.ko: 관계와 조화를 맡는 금성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 다툼 뒤 관계를 다시 잇는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이에요. 그럴 때 기다리기보다 먼저 손을 뻗어 화해를 청하는 것은, 차트에서 불의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Among your five planets, Venus, ruler of relationships and harmony, faces the most tension. So reconnecting after a fight is the capacity that takes the most out of you. Fire burns strongest in your chart, so you reach out and offer to make up rather than wait it out.
rows.en_before_tone: Venus, which governs relationships and harmony, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why reconnecting after a conflict takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to reach out first and offer to make up rather than wait comes from Fire being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 어색해진 사이에 먼저 손을 내밀어 다시 웃게 만드는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: When things turn awkward, you're the first to reach out and get everyone smiling again.
rows.en_before_tone: When things get awkward, you're the one who reaches out first and gets everyone smiling again.

rows.ko: 상대는 아직 마음을 추스르는 중인데 빨리 풀고 싶어 여러 팔을 한꺼번에 뻗는 순간입니다.
rows.en: The other person is still collecting themselves, but you want it fixed now and reach out with every arm at once.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when the other person is still collecting themselves, but you want to fix it fast and reach out with all your arms at once.

rows.ko: 화해를 청한 뒤에는 상대가 답할 시간을 하루쯤 기다려 주세요.
rows.en: Once you've offered to make up, give them about a day to respond.
rows.en_before_tone: After offering to make up, try giving the other person about a day to respond.

rows.ko: 먼저 손 내미는 문어, 그 마음 잘 받았어요
rows.en: Thanks for reaching out first, Octopus. Message received, with love
rows.en_before_tone: An octopus who reaches out first. Your heart came through loud and clear

rows.ko: 해파리
rows.en: Jellyfish

rows.ko: 다툰 뒤 다시 가까워지는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 상대에게 맞춰 주는 유형
rows.en: Getting close again after a conflict is hard work, so you adapt to the other person
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom getting close again after a conflict takes a lot of energy, and who adapts to the other person in those moments

rows.ko: 해파리는 물살이 거세지면 맞서지 않고 흐름에 몸을 맡겨 함께 흔들리는 캐릭터입니다. 투명한 몸처럼 상대의 기분을 그대로 비추며 분위기를 부드럽게 만들어요.
rows.en: When the water turns rough, Jellyfish doesn't fight it. It lets go and sways along. Like its translucent body, it mirrors the other person's mood and softens the atmosphere.
rows.en_before_tone: The jellyfish is a character who, when the current gets rough, doesn't fight it but lets itself sway along with the flow. Like its see-through body, it reflects the other person's mood as it is and softens the atmosphere.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것과 관계를 맡는 금성이 다섯 행성 중 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 어긋난 관계를 다시 따뜻하게 잇는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 내 입장보다 상대의 감정에 맞춰 분위기를 먼저 풀려는 것은, 차트에서 물의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Venus governs what you love and who you hold close, and it's the most stressed of your five planets. That's why warming a strained relationship back up takes the most energy. With Water strongest in your chart, you ease the mood by putting the other person's feelings ahead of your own side of things.
rows.en_before_tone: Venus, which governs what you love and your relationships, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why warmly reconnecting a strained relationship takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to ease the mood by putting the other person's feelings ahead of your own position comes from Water being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 날카로운 공기를 부드럽게 풀어 다시 함께 머물 수 있게 만드는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You take the edge off a tense moment so everyone can settle back in together.
rows.en_before_tone: You soften a tense atmosphere so people can be together again.

rows.ko: 다툼을 빨리 덮으려 내 서운함은 말하지 않고 흘려보내는 순간이에요.
rows.en: Eager to smooth things over fast, you let your own hurt drift by unspoken.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when, wanting to smooth over a conflict quickly, you let your own hurt slip by unspoken.

rows.ko: 분위기가 풀린 뒤에 서운했던 점 하나를 조용히 다시 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: Once things have calmed down, gently bring up one thing that hurt you.
rows.en_before_tone: Once the mood has eased, try quietly bringing up one thing that hurt you.

rows.ko: 흐름을 부드럽게 만드는 해파리, 고마워요
rows.en: Thanks for keeping the waters calm, Jellyfish
rows.en_before_tone: A jellyfish who keeps the flow gentle. Thank you

rows.ko: 가오리
rows.en: Stingray

rows.ko: 다툰 뒤 다시 가까워지는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 한발 물러나 혼자 정리하는 유형
rows.en: Reconnecting after a conflict drains you, so you settle your feelings on your own first
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom getting close again after a conflict takes a lot of energy, and who steps back to sort things out alone in those moments

rows.ko: 가오리는 물결이 거칠어지면 모래 속에 몸을 묻고 잠잠해질 때까지 쉬는 캐릭터예요. 숨을 고른 뒤에는 넓은 날개를 펴고 부드럽게 다시 떠오릅니다.
rows.en: When the waves get rough, Stingray buries itself in the sand and rests until the waters settle. Once it's caught its breath, it spreads its wide wings and glides gracefully back up.
rows.en_before_tone: The stingray is a character who, when the waves get rough, buries itself in the sand and rests until things calm down. After catching its breath, it spreads its wide wings and gently rises again.

rows.ko: 조화와 관계를 맡는 금성이 다섯 행성 가운데 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있습니다. 그래서 다툼 뒤 다시 가까워지는 일이 가장 에너지가 드는 역량이 돼요. 그럴 때 바로 풀기보다 혼자 감정을 가라앉힐 시간을 먼저 갖는 것은, 차트에서 공기의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문입니다.
rows.en: Of your five planets, Venus, which governs harmony and relationships, carries the most tension. That's why drawing close again after a conflict drains you so much. Air is your strongest element, so before resolving anything, you take time alone to let your feelings settle.
rows.en_before_tone: Venus, which governs harmony and relationships, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why getting close again after a conflict takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to take time alone to let your feelings settle rather than resolve things right away comes from Air being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 감정이 가라앉은 뒤 차분한 말로 다시 대화를 여는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: Once the storm passes, you reopen the conversation with calm, clear words.
rows.en_before_tone: Once your feelings have settled, you can reopen the conversation with calm words.

rows.ko: 모래 속에서 쉬는 시간이 길어져 상대가 기다리다 지쳐 가는 순간입니다.
rows.en: Your rest in the sand drags on, and the other person grows weary of waiting.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when your rest in the sand stretches on, and the other person grows tired of waiting.

rows.ko: 숨을 고르러 갈 때 언제쯤 다시 이야기할지 미리 약속해 두세요.
rows.en: When you step away to catch your breath, agree in advance on when you'll talk again.
rows.en_before_tone: When you step away to catch your breath, it can help to agree ahead of time on when you'll talk again.

rows.ko: 쉬었다 다시 떠오르는 가오리를 기다릴게요
rows.en: Take your time resting, stingray. I'll be here when you rise again
rows.en_before_tone: I'll wait for the stingray to rest and rise again

rows.ko: 불가사리
rows.en: Starfish

rows.ko: 다툰 뒤 다시 가까워지는 일에 에너지가 많이 들고, 그럴 때 현실적으로 따져 조율하는 유형
rows.en: Patching things up after a fight takes effort, so you work through it practically, step by step
rows.en_before_tone: A type for whom getting close again after a conflict takes a lot of energy, and who works things out practically in those moments

rows.ko: 불가사리는 상처 난 팔도 시간을 들여 천천히 다시 길러 내는 캐릭터입니다. 서두르지 않고 작은 발을 하나씩 움직여 어긋났던 자리로 다시 다가가요.
rows.en: Starfish regrows even an injured arm, taking all the time it needs. Unhurried, it moves its tiny feet one by one, making its way back to where things went wrong.
rows.en_before_tone: The starfish is a character who takes its time to slowly regrow even an injured arm. Without rushing, it moves its tiny feet one by one and makes its way back to where things went wrong.

rows.ko: 관계와 조화를 맡는 금성이 다섯 행성 중 가장 많은 긴장을 받고 있어요. 그래서 다툰 뒤 관계를 회복하는 일에 가장 큰 에너지가 듭니다. 그럴 때 무엇이 어긋났는지 현실적으로 따져 하나씩 맞춰 가는 것은, 차트에서 흙의 기운이 가장 강하기 때문이에요.
rows.en: Venus, the planet of relationships and harmony, carries the most tension of your five. As a result, mending things after a fight takes more energy than anything else. Because Earth leads in your chart, you look practically at what went wrong and set it right piece by piece.
rows.en_before_tone: Venus, which governs relationships and harmony, is under the most tension of your five planets. That's why repairing a relationship after a conflict takes the most energy for you. Your tendency to look practically at what went wrong and fix it piece by piece comes from Earth being the strongest element in your chart.

rows.ko: 다툼의 원인을 차근차근 짚어 같은 일이 덜 반복되도록 다듬는 힘이 있습니다.
rows.en: You trace a conflict back to its roots, step by step, and fine-tune things so it's less likely to repeat.
rows.en_before_tone: You carefully trace the cause of a conflict and smooth things out so the same thing happens less often.

rows.ko: 상대는 마음을 알아주길 바라는데 해결책부터 정리하고 있는 순간이에요.
rows.en: The other person just wants to feel understood, but you're already lining up solutions.
rows.en_before_tone: It's the moment when the other person just wants to be understood, but you're already lining up solutions.

rows.ko: 해결책을 꺼내기 전에 그때 많이 속상했겠다는 한마디를 먼저 건네 보세요.
rows.en: Before offering a fix, start with something simple, like "That must have really hurt."
rows.en_before_tone: Before offering a solution, try starting with a simple, "That must have really hurt."

rows.ko: 천천히 다시 자라는 불가사리, 그 끈기를 응원해요
rows.en: Slowly but surely growing back. Rooting for you, Starfish
rows.en_before_tone: A starfish slowly growing back. Cheering on that persistence

rows.ko: 달
rows.en: Moon

rows.ko: 기대기는 가까운 사람에게 마음을 기대고 위로를 주고받는 친밀감의 역량입니다.
rows.en: Leaning on others is your capacity for intimacy: you rely on the people closest to you, and you give and receive comfort freely.
rows.en_before_tone: Leaning on others is the capacity for closeness: resting your heart on the people near you and giving and receiving comfort.

rows.ko: 달은 차트에서 감정과 마음의 안정을 맡는 별이에요. 달이 긴장하는 각도를 많이 받으면 편히 기대고 싶은 마음과 혼자 버티려는 마음이 자주 부딪힙니다. 그래서 달은 누군가에게 기대는 힘을 비춰 보는 자리로 읽어요.
rows.en: The Moon governs your emotions and your sense of inner safety. When it takes many hard aspects, the part of you that longs to lean on someone keeps colliding with the part that insists on going it alone. So the Moon is where we look to see how freely you let yourself lean on others.
rows.en_before_tone: In a chart, the Moon is the planet of emotions and emotional security. When the Moon receives a lot of tense aspects, the wish to lean on someone and the urge to hold on alone often collide. That's why we look to the Moon to see your ability to lean on others.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 힘든 일이 있어도 괜찮은 척 넘기거나, 반대로 연락 하나에 마음이 크게 출렁이기 쉬워요. 기대고 싶은 마음과 짐이 될까 하는 걱정이 함께 올라오는 때입니다.
rows.en: When things get hard, you either brush it off and act fine, or a single text sends your mood swinging. Part of you longs to lean on someone, while another part worries about becoming a burden.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when things are hard, you may brush it off and act fine, or, the other way around, a single message can send your heart swinging. It's a time when the wish to lean on someone and the worry about being a burden rise together.

rows.ko: 토성
rows.en: Saturn

rows.ko: 믿기는 관계가 쉽게 흔들리지 않으리라 여기고 마음을 놓는 안정감의 역량이에요.
rows.en: Trusting brings you security. You believe a relationship won't crumble at the first bump, and you let yourself relax into it.
rows.en_before_tone: Trusting is the capacity for security: believing a relationship won't easily be shaken, and letting your heart rest in it.

rows.ko: 토성은 책임과 구조, 시간을 견디는 힘을 맡는 별입니다. 토성이 긴장하는 각도를 많이 받으면 관계에서도 이 사이가 단단한지 자꾸 점검하고 싶어져요. 그래서 토성은 시간을 두고 쌓이는 믿음을 비춰 보는 자리로 읽습니다.
rows.en: Saturn governs responsibility, structure, and the power to endure over time. When Saturn takes many hard aspects, you keep testing whether a relationship truly stands on solid ground. Saturn reveals the kind of trust you build slowly, season by season.
rows.en_before_tone: Saturn is the planet of responsibility, structure, and the strength to endure over time. When Saturn receives a lot of tense aspects, you may keep wanting to check whether a relationship is really solid. That's why we look to Saturn to see the trust that builds up over time.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 답장이 늦거나 말투가 조금만 달라져도 관계 전체가 흔들리는 듯 느끼기 쉽습니다. 확인을 받아도 마음이 오래 놓이지 않아 스스로 지치기도 해요.
rows.en: A slow reply or a slight shift in tone makes the whole relationship feel shaky. Even after someone reassures you, the relief fades fast, and all that checking wears you out.
rows.en_before_tone: A late reply or a slight change in tone can make the whole relationship feel shaky. Even after reassurance, your heart may not settle for long, which can wear you out.

rows.ko: 화성
rows.en: Mars

rows.ko: 선 지키기는 내가 편한 범위와 원하지 않는 것을 알고 지켜 내는 경계의 역량입니다.
rows.en: With Holding boundaries, you know what feels comfortable and what doesn't, and you stand by it.
rows.en_before_tone: Holding boundaries is the capacity to know what you're comfortable with and what you don't want, and to protect that.

rows.ko: 화성은 의욕과 행동, 나를 지키려는 추진력을 맡는 별이에요. 화성이 긴장하는 각도를 많이 받으면 싫다는 마음을 언제 어떻게 꺼낼지 고르는 데 힘이 많이 듭니다. 그래서 화성은 나의 선을 세우고 지키는 힘을 비춰 보는 자리로 읽어요.
rows.en: Mars fuels your drive, your actions, and your instinct to protect yourself. When Mars takes many hard aspects, choosing when and how to say "no" costs you real effort. Look to Mars, then, to see how you draw your lines and hold them.
rows.en_before_tone: Mars is the planet of drive, action, and the push to protect yourself. When Mars receives a lot of tense aspects, choosing when and how to say "no" takes a lot of effort. That's why we look to Mars to see your ability to set and hold your boundaries.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 부탁을 거절하지 못해 일을 떠안거나, 참다가 한꺼번에 날카롭게 터지기 쉬워요. 어디까지가 내 몫인지 헷갈려 한참 지나서야 지친 마음을 알아차리기도 합니다.
rows.en: You say yes to every favor and end up overloaded, or you bottle things up until they burst out, sharper than you meant. When you lose track of what's truly yours to handle, you notice how drained you are only much later.
rows.en_before_tone: You may end up taking on extra work because you can't say no, or hold it in until it all bursts out sharply at once. Unsure where your share ends, you may not notice how tired you are until much later.

rows.ko: 수성
rows.en: Mercury

rows.ko: 말하기는 내 생각과 마음을 상대가 알아들을 수 있는 말로 꺼내는 표현의 역량이에요.
rows.en: Speaking up is your gift for expression: you put your thoughts and feelings into words the other person truly understands.
rows.en_before_tone: Speaking up is the capacity for expression: putting your thoughts and feelings into words the other person can understand.

rows.ko: 수성은 생각과 말, 연락을 맡는 별입니다. 수성이 긴장하는 각도를 많이 받으면 머릿속 생각은 많은데 입 밖으로 꺼내는 순간에 힘이 많이 들어요. 그래서 수성은 마음을 말로 옮기는 힘을 비춰 보는 자리로 읽습니다.
rows.en: Mercury rules thought, speech, and staying in touch. With many hard aspects to Mercury, your mind brims with ideas, yet voicing them takes real effort. Mercury shows how readily you turn feelings into words.
rows.en_before_tone: Mercury is the planet of thought, speech, and communication. When Mercury receives a lot of tense aspects, you may have plenty of thoughts in your head, but saying them out loud takes a lot of effort. That's why we look to Mercury to see your ability to turn feelings into words.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 하고 싶은 말을 여러 번 고쳐 쓰다 결국 보내지 못하거나, 말해 놓고 오래 곱씹기 쉽습니다. 내 뜻이 다르게 전해질까 봐 꼭 필요한 말까지 삼키기도 해요.
rows.en: You rewrite a message again and again and never hit send, or you say something and replay it for hours. Afraid of being misunderstood, you swallow even the words that truly need saying.
rows.en_before_tone: You may rewrite what you want to say over and over and never send it, or say it and then replay it for a long time. Worried your meaning will come across wrong, you may even swallow things that really need saying.

rows.ko: 금성
rows.en: Venus

rows.ko: 회복하기는 다툼이나 서운함이 생긴 뒤 관계를 다시 따뜻하게 잇는 갈등 회복의 역량입니다.
rows.en: Repairing is how you work through conflict, finding your way back to warmth after an argument or hurt feelings.
rows.en_before_tone: Repairing is the capacity for mending conflict: warmly reconnecting a relationship after an argument or hurt feelings.

rows.ko: 금성은 좋아하는 것과 관계, 조화를 맡는 별이에요. 금성이 긴장하는 각도를 많이 받으면 어긋난 사이를 다시 부드럽게 맞추는 데 마음이 많이 쓰입니다. 그래서 금성은 틈이 생긴 관계를 다시 잇는 힘을 비춰 보는 자리로 읽어요.
rows.en: Venus governs what you love, your relationships, and harmony itself. When Venus takes many hard aspects, smoothing things over after a falling-out drains you emotionally. We turn to Venus to see how you mend a bond once a rift opens.
rows.en_before_tone: Venus is the planet of what you love, relationships, and harmony. When Venus receives a lot of tense aspects, gently realigning a strained relationship takes a lot of emotional energy. That's why we look to Venus to see your ability to reconnect when a gap has opened up.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 작은 말다툼 뒤에도 분위기가 풀리지 않을까 봐 오래 마음이 무거워지기 쉬워요. 먼저 사과할지 기다릴지 고민하다 화해의 때를 놓치기도 합니다.
rows.en: Even after a small spat, you stay weighed down for days, worried the tension won't lift. While you debate whether to apologize first or wait, the moment to make up passes.
rows.en_before_tone: Even after a small argument, you may feel heavy-hearted for a long time, worried the air won't clear. Torn between apologizing first and waiting, you may miss the moment to make up.

rows.ko: 불
rows.en: Fire

rows.ko: 다가가기는 마음이 흔들릴 때 기다리기보다 먼저 연락하고 움직여 거리를 좁히는 방식입니다.
rows.en: Reaching out is your way of closing the gap when you feel unsettled: instead of waiting, you call, text, or make the first move.
rows.en_before_tone: Reaching out is the style of closing the distance by contacting someone and taking action first, rather than waiting, when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 불의 원소는 양자리·사자자리·사수자리의 기운으로, 열정과 시작하는 힘을 상징해요. 불이 강한 차트는 마음이 움직이면 몸도 먼저 움직이려는 결로 읽습니다. 그래서 흔들릴 때 먼저 다가가는 방식과 이어져요.
rows.en: Fire, the element of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius, burns with passion and the spark to begin. In a Fire-heavy chart, the moment your feelings stir, you want to act. That's why Fire pairs with reaching out first when you're shaken.
rows.en_before_tone: The Fire element is the energy of Aries, Leo, and Sagittarius, standing for passion and the power to begin. A chart with strong Fire is read as one where, once the heart is stirred, the body is quick to follow. That's why it connects to the style of reaching out first when you're unsettled.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 어색한 공기를 오래 두지 않고 먼저 손을 내밀어, 관계가 식지 않게 지켜 준 방법이에요. 다만 지나치면 상대가 준비되기 전에 답을 재촉하게 되어 내 마음이 더 급해질 수 있습니다.
rows.en: This is how you've kept relationships from going cold: you never let an awkward silence linger, and you reach out first. Push it too far, though, and you press for an answer before the other person is ready, which only feeds your own urgency.
rows.en_before_tone: It's how you've kept relationships from cooling: by not letting an awkward silence linger and reaching out first. But if it goes too far, you may push for an answer before the other person is ready, which can make you feel even more rushed inside.

rows.ko: 물
rows.en: Water

rows.ko: 맞춰주기는 마음이 흔들릴 때 상대의 기분과 분위기에 나를 맞춰 관계의 평화를 지키는 방식이에요.
rows.en: Accommodating means keeping the peace when you feel unsettled. You tune yourself to the other person's mood and to the atmosphere in the room.
rows.en_before_tone: Accommodating is the style of keeping the peace by adjusting yourself to the other person's mood and the atmosphere when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 물의 원소는 게자리·전갈자리·물고기자리의 기운으로, 감정을 느끼고 스며드는 힘을 상징합니다. 물이 강한 차트는 말보다 분위기를 먼저 살피는 결로 읽어요. 그래서 흔들릴 때 상대에게 맞춰 주는 방식과 이어집니다.
rows.en: Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces share the Water element, the power to feel deeply and absorb everything around you. A Water-heavy chart means you read the mood before you hear the words. So Water connects to tuning in to the other person when you're shaken.
rows.en_before_tone: The Water element is the energy of Cancer, Scorpio, and Pisces, standing for the power to feel and to blend gently into things. A chart with strong Water is read as one that senses the mood before the words. That's why it connects to the style of adapting to the other person when you're unsettled.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 상대의 마음을 먼저 알아채고 품어 주어, 부딪힘 없이 곁을 지켜 준 방법입니다. 다만 지나치면 내 기분을 자꾸 뒤로 미뤄 두다 나도 모르게 서운함이 쌓일 수 있어요.
rows.en: You sense what others feel before they say it and make room for them, and that's how you've stayed close without clashing. Taken too far, though, your own feelings keep sliding to the back, and quiet resentment can build before you notice.
rows.en_before_tone: It's how you've stayed by people's side without clashing: by sensing and holding their feelings first. But if it goes too far, you may keep putting your own feelings last until hurt quietly builds up without your noticing.

rows.ko: 공기
rows.en: Air

rows.ko: 거리두기는 마음이 흔들릴 때 잠시 한 걸음 물러나 혼자 생각을 정리할 시간을 갖는 방식입니다.
rows.en: In the Stepping back style, you give yourself space when you feel unsettled, taking time alone to sort out your thoughts.
rows.en_before_tone: Stepping back is the style of taking a step away for a while to sort out your thoughts alone when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 공기의 원소는 쌍둥이자리·천칭자리·물병자리의 기운으로, 생각하고 한발 떨어져 바라보는 힘을 상징해요. 공기가 강한 차트는 감정이 차오를 때 머리로 먼저 정리하려는 결로 읽습니다. 그래서 흔들릴 때 거리를 두고 숨을 고르는 방식과 이어져요.
rows.en: Air is the element of Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius: the power to think things through and see them from a step away. When Air dominates your chart, you make sense of rising emotions in your head first. It goes hand in hand with stepping back to catch your breath when you're shaken.
rows.en_before_tone: The Air element is the energy of Gemini, Libra, and Aquarius, standing for the power to think and to look at things from a step back. A chart with strong Air is read as one that tries to sort things out in the head first when feelings well up. That's why it connects to the style of stepping back to catch your breath when you're unsettled.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 감정이 앞설 때 한발 물러나, 후회할 말 대신 차분한 생각을 고르게 해 준 방법이에요. 다만 지나치면 상대에게 닫힌 문처럼 느껴져 마음의 거리가 벌어질 수 있습니다.
rows.en: When emotions race ahead, stepping back has helped you choose calm thoughts over words you'd regret. Lean on it too hard, though, and you start to feel like a closed door to the other person, widening the distance between you.
rows.en_before_tone: It's how you've chosen calm thoughts over words you might regret: by stepping back when emotions run ahead. But taken too far, it can feel like a closed door to the other person and widen the emotional distance.

rows.ko: 흙
rows.en: Earth

rows.ko: 조율하기는 마음이 흔들릴 때 무엇이 가능한지 현실적으로 따져 보고 조정점을 찾는 방식이에요.
rows.en: Balancing is how you get practical when you feel unsettled: you weigh what's realistically possible and find the middle ground.
rows.en_before_tone: Balancing is the style of looking realistically at what's possible and finding a middle ground when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 흙의 원소는 황소자리·처녀자리·염소자리의 기운으로, 현실을 다지고 지키는 힘을 상징합니다. 흙이 강한 차트는 마음보다 눈앞의 해결책을 먼저 찾으려는 결로 읽어요. 그래서 흔들릴 때 차근차근 따지고 맞춰 가는 방식과 이어집니다.
rows.en: As the element of Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn, Earth builds solid ground and protects what's real. With plenty of Earth in your chart, you reach for a practical fix before dwelling on feelings. This is why Earth matches weighing things up step by step and working out a compromise when you're shaken.
rows.en_before_tone: The Earth element is the energy of Taurus, Virgo, and Capricorn, standing for the power to ground and protect what's real. A chart with strong Earth is read as one that looks for a practical solution before tending to feelings. That's why it connects to the style of carefully weighing and adjusting things when you're unsettled.

rows.field_label: 흔들릴 때 / 방식의 힘과 지나칠 때
rows.ko: 감정에 휩쓸리지 않고 할 수 있는 일부터 정리해, 관계를 현실의 땅 위에 붙잡아 준 방법입니다. 다만 지나치면 마음을 듣기보다 해결책부터 내밀어 상대가 서운해할 수 있어요.
rows.en: Rather than getting swept up in emotion, you start with what can actually be done, and that keeps your relationships on solid ground. The flip side: offer solutions before you truly listen, and the other person can end up feeling hurt.
rows.en_before_tone: It's how you've kept relationships grounded in reality: by not getting swept away by emotion and starting with what can be done. But if it goes too far, you may offer solutions before listening to feelings, and the other person may feel hurt.

rows.ko: 강할 때
rows.en: When strong

rows.ko: 불의 기운이 강하면 마음먹은 순간 바로 움직이는 추진력과 열정이 돋보입니다. 새로운 시작 앞에서 설레고, 그 에너지가 주변 사람까지 움직이게 해요. 다만 불이 셀수록 쉬는 타이밍을 의식적으로 정해 두는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: With strong Fire, your drive and passion shine: the moment you decide, you're already moving. New beginnings light you up, and your energy sets everyone around you in motion. The more Fire you carry, the more it pays to schedule rest on purpose. Put it on the calendar.
rows.en_before_tone: When Fire is strong, your drive and passion to act the moment you decide really stand out. New beginnings excite you, and that energy gets the people around you moving too. Still, the stronger your Fire, the more it helps to consciously set times to rest.

rows.ko: 불이 가장 강하면, 마음이 흔들릴 때 먼저 움직여 다가가는 ‘다가가기’ 방식을 쓰기 쉬워요.
rows.en: If Fire is your strongest element, you reach for the 'Reaching out' style, making the first move when you feel unsettled.
rows.en_before_tone: When Fire is your strongest element, you tend to use the 'Reaching out' style, moving toward others first when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 부족할 때
rows.en: When low

rows.ko: 불의 기운이 적은 차트는 즉흥적인 추진력 대신 꾸준함이나 생각, 공감으로 일을 이끌어 온 경우가 많아요. 그렇게 쌓아 온 방식이 이미 나만의 힘입니다. 하고 싶은 일을 미뤄 두고 있다면, 작게라도 오늘 시작해 보는 연습을 의식적으로 챙겨 보세요.
rows.en: When Fire runs low in your chart, you've moved things forward through consistency, careful thought, or empathy rather than spur-of-the-moment drive. That way of working is already a strength of its own. Is something waiting on your list? Start it today, even in a small way.
rows.en_before_tone: A chart with little Fire has often moved things forward through steadiness, thought, or empathy rather than spontaneous drive. The way you've built things up is already your own kind of strength. If you've been putting off something you want to do, you might consciously practice starting it today, even in a small way.

rows.ko: 강할 때
rows.en: When strong

rows.ko: 흙의 기운이 강하면 현실 감각이 뛰어나고, 눈에 보이는 결과를 차근차근 쌓아 가는 힘이 있습니다. 계획을 세우고 끝까지 지켜 내는 성실함이 주변에 믿음을 줘요. 다만 확인할 것이 많아질수록 즉흥적인 즐거움이 줄어들 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Strong Earth gives you sharp practical sense and the power to build real, visible results step by step. You make plans and see them through, and people trust you for it. Just watch that a growing checklist doesn't crowd out spontaneous fun.
rows.en_before_tone: When Earth is strong, you have a great sense of what's practical and the power to build visible results step by step. Your diligence in making plans and sticking to them earns people's trust. Still, the more there is to check, the less room there may be for spontaneous fun.

rows.ko: 흙이 가장 강하면, 마음이 흔들릴 때 현실적으로 따지고 조정하는 ‘조율하기’ 방식을 쓰기 쉬워요.
rows.en: When Earth leads your chart, you naturally fall back on the 'Balancing' style, weighing things up and adjusting course when you feel unsettled.
rows.en_before_tone: When Earth is your strongest element, you tend to use the 'Balancing' style, weighing things practically and adjusting when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 부족할 때
rows.en: When low

rows.ko: 흙의 기운이 적은 차트는 정해진 틀보다 열정이나 아이디어, 감정의 흐름을 따라 움직여 온 경우가 많아요. 그 유연함 덕분에 새로운 상황에도 빠르게 적응할 수 있습니다. 잠, 식사, 정리 같은 생활 루틴을 의식적으로 챙기면 생각과 마음이 한결 안정돼요.
rows.en: With little Earth in your chart, you've followed your passions, ideas, and feelings more than any set structure. That flexibility lets you adapt quickly when life shifts. Anchor yourself with simple routines like sleep, meals, and tidying up, and your mind and mood settle noticeably.
rows.en_before_tone: A chart with little Earth has often moved with passion, ideas, or the flow of feelings rather than a fixed structure. That flexibility helps you adapt quickly to new situations. Consciously looking after daily routines like sleep, meals, and tidying can help your thoughts and heart feel much steadier.

rows.ko: 강할 때
rows.en: When strong

rows.ko: 공기의 기운이 강하면 생각이 빠르고, 상황을 한 걸음 떨어져서 바라보는 힘이 있습니다. 대화와 정보를 통해 사람과 아이디어를 잇는 데 능숙해요. 다만 머리로 이해하는 데서 멈추면 정작 내 감정은 놓치기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: Strong Air makes you a quick thinker who steps back and sees the bigger picture. You excel at connecting people and ideas through conversation and information. The catch: stop at understanding things in your head, and you risk losing touch with how you actually feel.
rows.en_before_tone: When Air is strong, you think quickly and have the ability to look at situations from a step back. You're skilled at connecting people and ideas through conversation and information. Still, if you stop at understanding things in your head, it's easy to miss your own feelings.

rows.ko: 공기가 가장 강하면, 마음이 흔들릴 때 혼자 정리할 시간을 갖는 ‘거리두기’ 방식을 쓰기 쉬워요.
rows.en: With Air as your strongest element, you often lean toward the 'Stepping back' style, taking time alone to sort things out when you feel unsettled.
rows.en_before_tone: When Air is your strongest element, you tend to use the 'Stepping back' style, taking time alone to sort things out when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 부족할 때
rows.en: When low

rows.ko: 공기의 기운이 적은 차트는 말로 풀어내기보다 행동이나 감각, 마음으로 먼저 반응해 온 경우가 많아요. 그만큼 직접 겪으며 얻은 판단에 깊이가 있습니다. 감정이 클 때 한 걸음 물러나 생각을 적어 보거나 다른 사람의 관점을 들어 보는 시간을 챙겨 보세요.
rows.en: A chart with little Air means you react first through action, your senses, or gut feeling rather than talking things through. As a result, the judgment you've earned from hands-on experience runs deep. When emotions run high, step back and jot down your thoughts, or ask someone else how they see it.
rows.en_before_tone: A chart with little Air has often responded first through action, the senses, or the heart rather than talking things through. Because of that, the judgment you've gained from direct experience runs deep. When feelings run high, it can help to make time to step back and write down your thoughts, or hear someone else's perspective.

rows.ko: 강할 때
rows.en: When strong

rows.ko: 물의 기운이 강하면 다른 사람의 마음을 섬세하게 읽고 깊이 공감하는 힘이 있습니다. 말하지 않아도 분위기를 알아채고 먼저 품어 주는 따뜻함이 있어요. 다만 남의 감정까지 함께 짊어지면 금방 지칠 수 있어, 혼자 비워 내는 시간이 필요합니다.
rows.en: Strong Water gives you a gift for reading people and empathizing deeply. You sense the mood without a word being said, and you're often the first to offer comfort. Carrying everyone else's feelings wears you out fast, though, so guard some time alone to release what you've absorbed.
rows.en_before_tone: When Water is strong, you have the power to read others' hearts sensitively and empathize deeply. You have a warmth that senses the mood without being told and embraces people first. Still, carrying other people's feelings along with your own can tire you out quickly, so you need time alone to empty out.

rows.ko: 물이 가장 강하면, 마음이 흔들릴 때 상대에게 맞춰 분위기를 지키는 ‘맞춰주기’ 방식을 쓰기 쉬워요.
rows.en: When Water is strongest, you gravitate toward the 'Accommodating' style, adjusting to the other person to keep the peace when you feel unsettled.
rows.en_before_tone: When Water is your strongest element, you tend to use the 'Accommodating' style, adapting to the other person to protect the mood when your heart is unsettled.

rows.ko: 부족할 때
rows.en: When low

rows.ko: 물의 기운이 적은 차트는 감정에 머물기보다 행동이나 생각, 현실 감각으로 상황을 헤쳐 온 경우가 많아요. 덕분에 어려운 순간에도 침착하게 중심을 잡을 수 있습니다. 가끔은 ‘지금 내 기분은 어떤가’를 스스로 묻고, 그 마음을 믿을 만한 사람에게 꺼내 보는 시간을 챙겨 보세요.
rows.en: If your chart has little Water, you've handled life through action, logic, or practical sense rather than lingering in your feelings. That keeps you calm and centered even when things get tough. Every so often, check in with yourself ('How am I actually feeling right now?') and share the answer with someone you trust.
rows.en_before_tone: A chart with little Water has often worked through situations with action, thought, or practical sense rather than lingering in feelings. That helps you stay calm and centered even in hard moments. Now and then, it can help to make time to ask yourself, 'How am I feeling right now?' and share that with someone you trust.

A12.name: Q2 공감 도입문 (2026 한 단어)
A12.used_in: 2026 회고 섹션 두 번째 문단(첫 문단은 결론) · closing은 같은 섹션 마지막 문단 · care_note는 부드러운 톤(soft=Y)일 때 결과 하단

rows.ko: ‘버텨’를 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해를 버티며 단단해지는 한 해로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You chose ‘Endurance.’ The sky agrees: it maps this as a year of growing stronger simply by standing firm.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Holding on.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as one of growing stronger by holding on.

rows.ko: ‘버텨’를 고를 만큼 애쓴 한 해였다면, 그 마음이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 숨 고를 틈에 대한 이야기도 하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If this year asked so much of you that you chose ‘Endurance,’ your own sense of it counts most. The sky adds one more note: there were openings to pause and catch your breath.
rows.en_before_tone: If this year took so much out of you that you chose ‘Holding on,’ that feeling is the truest guide. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of finding moments to catch your breath.

rows.ko: 버틴 시간은 사라지지 않고 다음 해를 받쳐 줄 힘으로 남습니다. 올해의 나에게 수고했다는 말 한마디를 건네 주세요.
rows.en: The time you spent enduring never vanishes; it becomes the strength that carries you into next year. Tonight, give yourself some credit: you made it through this year.
rows.en_before_tone: The time you spent holding on doesn't disappear; it stays with you as strength to support the year ahead. Take a moment to tell this year's you, "You did well."

rows.ko: ‘배움’을 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해를 새로 알고 넓혀 가는 해로 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Learning’ is your word, and the sky shows exactly that: a year of discovery and wider horizons.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Learning.’ The sky, too, was showing this year as one of discovering new things and broadening your horizons.

rows.ko: ‘배움’을 고르셨다면 올해 손에 쥔 깨달음이 분명히 있었다는 뜻입니다. 하늘은 그 배움 곁에서 다른 이야기도 하나 들려주고 있었어요.
rows.en: Choosing ‘Learning’ means you came away from this year with real insight. Beside that, the sky has one more story to tell.
rows.en_before_tone: If you chose ‘Learning,’ it means there was real insight you gained this year. Alongside that learning, the sky has one more story to tell.

rows.ko: 올해 배운 것 가운데 하나만 골라 내년에도 이어 가 보세요. 작게 이어 가는 배움이 가장 오래 남습니다.
rows.en: Choose one thing you learned this year and carry it forward. The learning that lasts is the kind you keep up in small, steady ways.
rows.en_before_tone: Try picking just one thing you learned this year and carrying it into next year. Learning you keep up in small ways lasts the longest.

rows.ko: ‘변화’를 고르셨죠. 하늘도 같은 말을 하고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You picked ‘Change,’ and the sky is saying the very same thing.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Change.’ The sky is telling the same story.

rows.ko: ‘변화’를 느낀 한 해였다면 그 체감이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 변화 아래에서 조용히 이어지던 흐름에 대해서도 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If this year felt like ‘Change’ to you, trust that feeling. The sky also reveals a steady current that kept running quietly beneath it all.
rows.en_before_tone: If this was a year you felt ‘Change,’ trust that sense first. The sky also speaks of something that kept quietly flowing beneath that change.

rows.ko: 변화는 흔들림이면서 새 자리를 만드는 과정이기도 해요. 올해 달라진 것 하나를 적어 두면 내년의 방향을 잡는 데 도움이 됩니다.
rows.en: Change shakes things up, but it also clears room for something new. Write down one thing that changed this year; it helps you find your bearings for next year.
rows.en_before_tone: Change can feel unsettling, but it's also how new space gets made. Writing down one thing that changed this year can help you find your direction for next year.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’을 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해를 잠시 서서 숨을 고르는 해로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: So your word is ‘Pause.’ The sky sees it the same way: a year to stand still and catch your breath.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Pause.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time to stand still for a while and catch your breath.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’을 고를 만큼 걸음이 무거웠던 한 해, 그 느낌을 그대로 믿으셔도 됩니다. 하늘은 그 멈춤 아래에서 조용히 움직이던 흐름도 함께 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: If every step felt heavy enough this year that you chose ‘Pause,’ trust that feeling completely. The sky also shows things moving quietly beneath the stillness.
rows.en_before_tone: If your steps felt heavy enough this year to choose ‘Pause,’ you can trust that feeling as it is. The sky also shows something that kept quietly moving beneath that pause.

rows.ko: 멈춘 시간은 뒤처진 시간이 아니라 방향을 다시 고르는 시간입니다. 다시 걸을 때는 내 속도를 먼저 정해 보세요.
rows.en: A pause isn't falling behind; it's your chance to choose your direction again. When you're ready to move, set your own pace first.
rows.en_before_tone: Time spent pausing isn't time spent falling behind; it's time to choose your direction again. When you start walking again, try deciding on your own pace first.

rows.ko: ‘성취’를 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해 쌓아 온 것이 모양을 갖추는 흐름을 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Achievement’ it is. The sky backs you up, showing a year when everything you've built takes shape.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Achievement.’ The sky, too, showed this year as a time when what you've built starts to take shape.

rows.ko: ‘성취’를 고르셨다면 올해 이뤄 낸 것이 분명히 있었다는 뜻입니다. 하늘은 그 성취 곁에서 다른 이야기도 하나 하고 있었어요.
rows.en: Choosing ‘Achievement’ means you truly pulled something off this year. Alongside that success, the sky has another story to tell.
rows.en_before_tone: If you chose ‘Achievement,’ it means there was clearly something you accomplished this year. Alongside that achievement, the sky has one more story to tell.

rows.ko: 이룬 것을 바로 다음 목표로 덮기보다 잠시 머물러 바라봐 주세요. 무엇이 나를 여기까지 오게 했는지 아는 것이 다음 걸음의 바탕이 됩니다.
rows.en: Before you race to the next goal, pause and let what you've achieved sink in. Knowing what carried you this far gives your next step solid ground.
rows.en_before_tone: Instead of covering what you've achieved with the next goal right away, try pausing to take it in for a moment. Knowing what brought you this far is the foundation for your next step.

rows.ko: ‘이별’을 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해를 무언가를 떠나보내고 자리를 정리하는 흐름으로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You chose ‘Farewell.’ The sky shows the same: a year of letting something go and clearing space.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Farewell.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time of letting something go and clearing space.

rows.ko: ‘이별’이라는 말이 떠오른 한 해, 그 마음을 그대로 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 나를 돌보는 흐름에 대해서도 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: When ‘Farewell’ is the word that comes to mind, your feelings deserve to be honored exactly as they are. The sky also speaks of tending to yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: In a year when the word ‘Farewell’ came to mind, your feelings deserve respect just as they are. Alongside them, the sky also speaks of caring for yourself.

rows.ko: 떠나보낸 것이 있다면 그 자리를 서둘러 채우지 않아도 괜찮아요. 지금은 나에게 필요한 것이 무엇인지 천천히 살펴볼 수 있는 때입니다.
rows.en: If you've let something go, you don't need to rush to fill the space. Take your time now and listen for what you truly need.
rows.en_before_tone: If you've let something go, you don't have to rush to fill that space. Now is a time when you can slowly explore what you need.

rows.ko: 헤어짐의 무게가 오래 남아 있다면 혼자 견디지 않아도 됩니다. 쏘웰라와 편하게 이야기를 나눠 보거나, 필요할 때는 전문 상담의 도움도 함께 받아 보세요.
rows.en: If the weight of a goodbye still lingers, you don't have to carry it alone. Talk it through with Sowella AI whenever you like, and if you need more support, please reach out to a therapist or counselor too.
rows.en_before_tone: If the weight of a parting is still with you, you don't have to carry it alone. Feel free to talk it through with Sowella, and when you need it, consider reaching out to a professional counselor too.

rows.ko: ‘고생’을 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해가 유난히 무거운 짐을 진 해였다고 말하고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You went with ‘Hardship,’ and the sky confirms it: this year asked you to carry an especially heavy load.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Hardship.’ The sky, too, says this year asked you to carry an especially heavy load.

rows.ko: ‘고생’이라는 말이 먼저 떠오를 만큼 애쓴 한 해였다는 것, 그대로 맞습니다. 하늘은 그 고생 곁에서 조금씩 힘이 붙던 흐름도 함께 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: If ‘Hardship’ was the first word that came to mind, you're right: you worked hard this year. The sky also shows your strength quietly building, bit by bit, through it all.
rows.en_before_tone: This was a year you worked so hard that ‘Hardship’ was the first word to come to mind, and that's exactly right. The sky was also showing a flow where your strength was building, little by little, alongside the hardship.

rows.ko: 고생한 시간은 내가 무엇을 감당할 수 있는지 알려 주기도 합니다. 연말에는 해낸 일보다 쉬어 간 순간을 하나 더 만들어 주세요.
rows.en: Hard times also reveal how much you can handle. As the year winds down, give yourself one more moment of rest instead of one more accomplishment.
rows.en_before_tone: Hard times can also show you what you're able to carry. As the year ends, try making room for one more moment of rest rather than one more accomplishment.

rows.ko: 몸과 마음이 많이 지쳐 있다면 혼자 버티지 않아도 괜찮습니다. 쏘웰라와 지친 마음을 조금씩 나눠 보거나, 필요하면 전문 상담의 도움도 편하게 받아 보세요.
rows.en: If you feel worn out in body and mind, you don't have to push through alone. Share what's weighing on you with Sowella AI, a little at a time, and if you need it, reach out to a therapist or counselor without hesitation.
rows.en_before_tone: If your body and mind feel worn out, you don't have to push through alone. Try sharing your tired heart with Sowella little by little, and if you need it, feel free to get support from a professional counselor too.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’를 고를 만큼 많이 지친 한 해였군요. 하늘도 올해를 오래 쥐고 있던 것을 내려놓고 싶어지는 흐름으로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: This year wore you out so much that you chose ‘Letting go.’ The sky shows the same pull: a time when you long to set down what you've held on to for so long.
rows.en_before_tone: It sounds like this was a year so exhausting that you chose ‘Letting go.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time when you might want to set down what you've held on to for so long.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’를 고를 만큼 지쳐 있는 그 마음이 먼저입니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 쉬어 가며 다시 고를 수 있다는 이야기도 하고 있었어요.
rows.en: How worn out you feel comes first, worn out enough to choose ‘Letting go.’ The sky adds a reminder: you can rest now and decide again later.
rows.en_before_tone: What matters first is how worn out you feel, enough to choose ‘Letting go.’ Alongside that, the sky also says you can rest and then choose again.

rows.ko: 그만하고 싶은 마음은 약해서가 아니라 오래 애써 왔다는 신호예요. 무엇을 그만둘지는 충분히 쉰 다음에 천천히 정해도 늦지 않습니다.
rows.en: Wanting to stop isn't weakness; it's a sign you've been trying hard for a long time. There's no rush to decide what to let go of. Rest fully first, then choose.
rows.en_before_tone: Wanting to stop isn't a sign of weakness; it's a sign you've been trying hard for a long time. You can take your time deciding what to let go of once you've rested enough; it won't be too late.

rows.ko: 지친 마음이 오래 이어지고 있다면 혼자 결론 내리지 않아도 돼요. 쏘웰라에게 지금 마음을 편하게 털어놓거나, 필요할 때는 전문 상담의 도움을 함께 받아 보시길 권합니다.
rows.en: If this exhaustion keeps dragging on, you don't have to reach a conclusion alone. Tell Sowella AI how you're feeling, at your own pace, and when you need it, we encourage you to get support from a therapist or counselor as well.
rows.en_before_tone: If this tiredness has been going on for a long time, you don't have to reach a conclusion alone. We encourage you to share how you're feeling with Sowella, and when you need it, to get support from a professional counselor as well.

rows.ko: ‘시작’을 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해를 새 출발선이 그어지는 해로 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Beginning’ is your pick, and the sky points the same way: this year draws a fresh starting line.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Beginning.’ The sky, too, pointed to this year as a fresh starting line.

rows.ko: ‘시작’을 고르셨다면 올해 무언가에 첫걸음을 뗐다는 뜻입니다. 하늘은 그 시작 곁에서 이전 것을 마무리하는 이야기도 함께 하고 있었어요.
rows.en: Choosing ‘Beginning’ means you took a first step toward something this year. The sky also speaks of wrapping up what came before.
rows.en_before_tone: If you chose ‘Beginning,’ it means you took a first step toward something this year. Alongside that beginning, the sky also speaks of wrapping up what came before.

rows.ko: 시작의 모양은 첫날보다 이어 가는 날들이 만듭니다. 올해 시작한 것을 내년에도 작게 이어 갈 방법 하나를 정해 보세요.
rows.en: The days that follow shape a beginning more than day one ever does. Choose one small way to carry what you started this year into the next.
rows.en_before_tone: A beginning is shaped less by the first day than by the days that follow. Try choosing one small way to keep what you started this year going into next year.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’을 고르셨네요. 하늘도 올해 새로운 가능성이 반짝이는 흐름을 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You chose ‘Butterflies.’ The sky glowed this year too, with fresh possibilities sparkling all around you.
rows.en_before_tone: You chose ‘Excitement.’ The sky, too, showed new possibilities sparkling this year.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’을 고를 만큼 마음이 움직인 한 해였다면 그 감각이 가장 소중한 기록입니다. 하늘은 그 설렘 곁에서 차분히 다지는 이야기도 하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If your heart stirred enough this year for you to choose ‘Butterflies,’ that flutter is the most precious record of your year. The sky also speaks of calmly building a foundation beneath it.
rows.en_before_tone: If your heart was stirred enough this year to choose ‘Excitement,’ that feeling is your most precious record. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of calmly building a foundation.

rows.ko: 설렘이 어디에서 왔는지 한 줄로 적어 두세요. 그 마음이 향한 곳에 내가 바라는 것이 담겨 있을 때가 많습니다.
rows.en: Write down, in one line, where those butterflies came from. Wherever that feeling pointed, you'll often find what you truly hope for.
rows.en_before_tone: Try writing down, in one line, where that excitement came from. Often, what you're hoping for lies wherever that feeling was pointing.

A12b.name: 2026 회고 표현 변형
A12b.used_in: 3번 섹션(2026 회고) 첫 문단·마무리 — A12의 1번 표현과 합쳐 칸마다 5개 중 하나를 고름(같은 출생정보면 같은 표현: 출생정보 해시로 고정)

rows.ko: 하늘의 흐름도 올해를 견디며 뿌리를 내리는 해로 읽고 있었어요. 당신이 고른 ‘버텨’라는 말과 꼭 닮은 그림입니다.
rows.en: The sky reads this year the same way: a season of enduring and putting down roots. It mirrors the word you chose, ‘Endurance.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, read this year as one of enduring and putting down roots. It's a picture that closely matches the word you chose: ‘Holding on.’

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘버텨’ 한 단어로 정리하셨군요. 하늘 역시 무게를 견디는 사이 안쪽이 단단해지는 해라고 말하고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You summed up your year in one word: ‘Endurance.’ The sky says much the same, calling it a year when carrying the weight made you stronger within.
rows.en_before_tone: You summed up this year in one phrase: ‘Holding on.’ The sky, too, says this is a year when you grow stronger inside while carrying the weight.

rows.ko: 쉽게 흔들리지 않으려 애쓴 시간이 보입니다. 하늘도 ‘버텨’라는 말처럼 자리를 지켜 내는 흐름을 그리고 있었어요.
rows.en: You worked hard to stay steady, and it shows. True to your word, ‘Endurance,’ the sky shows you standing your ground.
rows.en_before_tone: I can see the time you spent trying not to be shaken. Just like the words ‘Holding on,’ the sky was also showing you standing your ground.

rows.ko: 하늘이 그린 올해의 모양과 당신의 ‘버텨’가 같은 곳을 가리키고 있어요. 바람을 맞으면서도 제자리를 지킨 한 해로 읽힙니다.
rows.en: The sky's portrait of this year and your ‘Endurance’ point in the same direction. You stood firm, even with the wind in your face.
rows.en_before_tone: The shape the sky drew for this year and your ‘Holding on’ point to the same place. It reads as a year when you held your ground even against the wind.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘버텨’로 기억한다면 그만큼 견딘 시간이 있었다는 뜻이고, 그 기억이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 힘을 빼도 괜찮았던 순간들도 함께 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: If you remember this year as one of ‘Endurance,’ you had a lot to get through, and that memory is the one to trust. The sky also reveals moments when you could loosen your grip.
rows.en_before_tone: If you remember this year as ‘Holding on,’ it means there was that much to endure, and that memory is the truest guide. Alongside it, the sky also shows moments when it was okay to loosen your grip.

rows.ko: 버틴 사람만 아는 무게가 있죠. ‘버텨’라는 당신의 말이 먼저이고, 하늘은 그 옆에서 조금 다른 결의 이야기를 하나 더 들려주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Some weight is truly known only by the one who carries it. Your ‘Endurance’ comes first; the sky simply adds one more story in a slightly different key.
rows.en_before_tone: There's a weight only people who've held on can know. Your words, ‘Holding on,’ come first, and beside them the sky has one more story with a slightly different feel.

rows.ko: 하늘의 흐름만 보면 올해는 조금 다른 색으로 읽히기도 합니다. 그래도 ‘버텨’라고 답한 당신의 체감이 가장 정확하고, 하늘의 이야기는 그 곁에 놓아 두는 또 하나의 시선이에요.
rows.en: Read by this year's transits alone, the year takes on a slightly different color. Still, your own sense of ‘Endurance’ is what counts, and the sky's take is simply another angle to set beside it.
rows.en_before_tone: If you look only at the sky, this year might take on a slightly different color. Still, your own sense of ‘Holding on’ is the truest guide, and the sky's story is just one more view to set beside it.

rows.ko: 하루하루를 ‘버텨’ 온 마음, 그대로 믿으셔도 됩니다. 하늘은 그 시간 아래에서 천천히 쌓이던 여유에 대해서도 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: Day after day, you met this year with ‘Endurance,’ and you can trust that feeling. Beneath it all, the sky also points to breathing room slowly building up.
rows.en_before_tone: You can trust what your heart has felt while ‘Holding on’ day after day. The sky was also talking about the breathing room that slowly built up beneath that time.

rows.ko: 견디는 동안 놓치지 않은 것들이 지금의 나를 지탱하고 있습니다. 올해 끝까지 지켜 낸 것 하나를 떠올리며 잠깐 숨을 골라 보세요.
rows.en: What you refused to let go of while enduring is what holds you up now. Recall one thing you protected all the way through this year, and take a moment to breathe.
rows.en_before_tone: The things you didn't let go of while enduring are what hold you up now. Try thinking of one thing you protected all the way through this year, and take a moment to catch your breath.

rows.ko: 버티는 일에도 힘이 들고, 그 힘을 쓴 건 바로 당신입니다. 이번 주에는 하루쯤 아무것도 해내지 않아도 되는 저녁을 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Endurance takes strength, and you're the one who found it. This week, keep one evening free of anything you have to get done.
rows.en_before_tone: Holding on takes strength too, and you're the one who used it. This week, try setting aside one evening when you don't have to get anything done.

rows.ko: 버틴 날들이 모두 근사하지 않았어도 괜찮아요. 그 하루하루가 모여 다음 해에 기댈 바닥이 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: Not every day you endured had to be a good one. Together, those days become solid ground for you to stand on next year.
rows.en_before_tone: It's okay if not every day you held on was a great one. Together, those days become the ground you can lean on next year.

rows.ko: 올해를 버텨 낸 방법을 한 가지 적어 두면 좋아요. 다음에 힘이 들 때 그 메모가 나만의 작은 안내서가 되어 줄 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Write down one way you got through this year. The next time things get tough, that note becomes your own little survival guide.
rows.en_before_tone: It's a good idea to write down one way you held on this year. Next time things get hard, that note can be your own little guidebook.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 시야가 넓어지고 새로 익히는 해로 보고 있었어요. 당신이 고른 ‘배움’과 같은 방향입니다.
rows.en: The sky sees this year as a time of widening views and new skills taking hold. It points the same way as your word, ‘Learning.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, saw this year as a time of widening your view and learning new things. It points the same way as the word you chose: ‘Learning.’

rows.ko: 무언가를 새로 알게 된 기쁨이 ‘배움’이라는 말에 담겨 있네요. 하늘 역시 올해를 낯선 것을 내 것으로 만들어 가는 흐름으로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: The joy of discovering something new shines through your word, ‘Learning.’ The sky, too, pictures this year as a time of making the unfamiliar your own.
rows.en_before_tone: The joy of discovering something new is right there in the word ‘Learning.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time of making unfamiliar things your own.

rows.ko: ‘배움’, 올해를 잘 담은 단어입니다. 하늘에서도 생각이 자라고 질문이 많아지는 한 해의 모습이 보였어요.
rows.en: ‘Learning’ captures this year beautifully. The sky shows it as well: a year of growing ideas and ever more questions.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Learning’ is a word that captures this year well. In the sky, too, I could see a year of growing thoughts and more and more questions.

rows.ko: 올해 하늘은 새 지식과 경험이 문을 두드리는 그림이었어요. 그래서 ‘배움’을 고른 당신의 답이 더 반갑게 느껴집니다.
rows.en: This year's sky showed new knowledge and experiences knocking at your door. That makes your answer, ‘Learning,’ all the more fitting.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was a picture of new knowledge and experiences knocking at the door. That's why your answer, ‘Learning,’ feels all the more welcome.

rows.ko: 올해가 ‘배움’으로 남았다면 그 감각이 무엇보다 정확합니다. 하늘은 거기에 배운 것을 잠시 쉬게 두는 시간에 대한 이야기도 보태고 있었어요.
rows.en: If this year stayed with you as ‘Learning,’ trust that above all. The sky adds a note about letting what you've learned settle and rest.
rows.en_before_tone: If this year stayed with you as ‘Learning,’ trust that sense above all. The sky also adds a story about giving what you've learned some time to rest.

rows.ko: 무언가를 알게 되고 달라진 순간들이 있었기에 ‘배움’이라는 답이 나왔을 거예요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 조금 다른 방향의 이야기도 함께 건네고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Learning,’ came from moments when you discovered something and it changed you. The sky also offers a story that heads in a slightly different direction.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Learning’ must have come from moments when you discovered something and it changed you. Alongside it, the sky also offers a story that heads in a slightly different direction.

rows.ko: 하늘의 그림은 조금 다른 쪽을 비추고 있었지만, ‘배움’이라고 느낀 당신의 한 해가 먼저입니다. 두 이야기를 나란히 놓으면 올해가 조금 더 입체적으로 보여요.
rows.en: The sky was shining a light on something slightly different, but your year of ‘Learning’ comes first. Put the two side by side, and the year comes into fuller focus.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky's picture was highlighting something slightly different, but your year, which felt like ‘Learning,’ comes first. Set the two stories side by side, and this year looks a little more three-dimensional.

rows.ko: 하루하루에서 무언가를 배워 온 사람의 답, ‘배움’을 그대로 믿으셔도 됩니다. 하늘은 그 배움이 뿌리내릴 자리에 대해서도 조용히 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: ‘Learning’ is the answer of someone who gathers something from every day, so trust it as it is. The sky also hints at where all that learning takes root.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Learning,’ comes from someone who has learned from each day, and you can trust it just as it is. The sky also quietly speaks of where that learning can take root.

rows.ko: 배운 것은 써 볼 때 비로소 내 것이 됩니다. 올해 알게 된 것 하나를 누군가에게 짧게 들려주는 것부터 해 보세요.
rows.en: What you learn becomes yours only when you put it to use. Start by telling someone, briefly, about one thing you learned this year.
rows.en_before_tone: What you learn only becomes yours when you use it. You might start by briefly telling someone about one thing you learned this year.

rows.ko: 다 익히지 못한 것이 남아 있어도 괜찮아요. 배우는 중이라는 것 자체가 올해 당신이 자라고 있었다는 증거입니다.
rows.en: Haven't mastered everything yet? That's fine. Being a work in progress is proof you grew this year.
rows.en_before_tone: It's okay if there are things you haven't fully mastered yet. Still being in the middle of learning is proof that you were growing this year.

rows.ko: 올해 가장 오래 붙잡았던 질문을 한 줄로 적어 두면 좋습니다. 그 질문이 내년의 배움을 고르는 나침반이 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: Write down, in one line, the question you kept returning to most this year. Let it be your compass when you choose what to learn next.
rows.en_before_tone: It's a good idea to write down, in one line, the question you held on to longest this year. That question can become a compass for choosing what to learn next year.

rows.ko: 배움에는 쉬어 가는 시간도 포함됩니다. 새로 채우기 전에 올해 배운 것을 한 번 천천히 돌아보는 시간을 가져 보세요.
rows.en: Rest is part of learning, too. Before you fill up on anything new, take some unhurried time to look back on what you learned this year.
rows.en_before_tone: Learning includes time to rest, too. Before filling up with something new, try taking some time to slowly look back on what you learned this year.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 익숙한 것이 자리를 바꾸는 해로 그리고 있었어요. ‘변화’라는 당신의 답과 겹치는 대목입니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year rearranging the familiar. That lines up with your answer, ‘Change.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was picturing this year as one where familiar things shift places. It overlaps with your answer: ‘Change.’

rows.ko: 많은 것이 움직인 한 해였나 봅니다. ‘변화’라는 답처럼 하늘도 새 자리를 향해 흐름이 바뀌는 모습을 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: A lot shifted for you this year. Just like your answer, ‘Change,’ the sky shows the current turning toward somewhere new.
rows.en_before_tone: It sounds like a lot shifted this year. Just like your answer, ‘Change,’ the sky also showed things turning in a new direction.

rows.ko: ‘변화’, 하늘이 올해를 설명할 때 쓰는 말과도 같습니다. 흔들림과 새 제안이 함께 찾아오는 해로 읽혀요.
rows.en: ‘Change’ is exactly the word the sky would use for this year, too. It brings upheaval and new offers together in the same season.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Change’ is the very word the sky would use to describe this year. It reads as a year when unsettled moments and new offers arrive together.

rows.ko: 바람의 방향이 바뀌듯, 올해 하늘에도 큰 전환이 지나가고 있었어요. 그 한가운데에서 ‘변화’를 고른 당신의 감각이 정확합니다.
rows.en: Like the wind shifting direction, a major turning point passed through your chart this year. You stood right in the middle of it, and your instinct to choose ‘Change’ is exactly right.
rows.en_before_tone: Like the wind changing direction, a big turning point was passing through the sky this year. You were right in the middle of it, and your instinct to choose ‘Change’ is spot on.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘변화’로 느꼈다면 그 느낌이 가장 믿을 만한 기록입니다. 하늘은 그 사이에도 변하지 않고 나를 지켜 준 것에 대해 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If this year felt like ‘Change,’ that feeling is the most reliable record you have. The sky also speaks of what stayed constant and kept you steady through it all.
rows.en_before_tone: If this year felt like ‘Change’ to you, that feeling is the most reliable record. The sky was also talking about what stayed the same and protected you through it all.

rows.ko: 무언가 달라졌다는 감각이 ‘변화’라는 답에 그대로 담겨 있어요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 서두르지 않고 다지는 흐름도 함께 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Change,’ captures the sense that something shifted. Beside it, the sky sketches a slower, unhurried process of laying groundwork.
rows.en_before_tone: The sense that something shifted is right there in your answer, ‘Change.’ Alongside it, the sky was also showing an unhurried flow of building a foundation.

rows.ko: 겉으로는 잔잔해 보여도 안에서는 많은 것이 움직였을 수 있어요. ‘변화’라고 답한 당신의 감각을 믿으며, 하늘이 비추는 다른 결도 함께 살펴보겠습니다.
rows.en: On the surface, things looked calm while a lot was moving underneath. Trust your sense of ‘Change,’ and let's also look at the different shade the sky reveals.
rows.en_before_tone: Things may have looked calm on the outside while a lot was moving inside. Let's trust your sense of ‘Change’ while also looking at the different shade the sky is showing.

rows.ko: 몸으로 겪은 것은 하늘의 그림보다 먼저 알아차릴 때가 많습니다. ‘변화’라고 답한 마음을 믿으면서, 하늘이 건네는 다른 이야기도 가볍게 곁에 두어 보세요.
rows.en: What you live through often registers before anything your chart shows. Trust the part of you that answered ‘Change,’ and hold the sky's other story loosely in mind.
rows.en_before_tone: What you live through often registers before the sky's picture does. You can trust the part of you that answered ‘Change,’ and simply keep the sky's other story lightly beside it.

rows.ko: 달라진 것들 사이에서 그대로 남은 것을 찾아보세요. 바뀐 것과 지켜 낸 것을 함께 볼 때 다음 방향이 조금 더 선명해집니다.
rows.en: Amid all the change, look for what stayed put. When you can see both what shifted and what you kept, the way forward gets a little clearer.
rows.en_before_tone: Among everything that changed, try looking for what stayed the same. Seeing both what shifted and what you held on to makes your next direction a little clearer.

rows.ko: 변화가 반가웠든 낯설었든, 그 한가운데를 지나온 건 당신이에요. 올해 새로 생긴 습관이나 마음 하나에 이름을 붙여 보는 것도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Whether the change felt welcome or strange, you're the one who came through it. Give a name to one new habit or feeling that showed up this year.
rows.en_before_tone: Whether the change felt welcome or strange, you're the one who made it through the middle of it. It might be nice to give a name to one new habit or feeling that came to you this year.

rows.ko: 흔들린 만큼 새로 놓인 자리도 있습니다. 올해 처음 해 본 일을 하나 떠올리며 그때의 나를 칭찬해 주세요.
rows.en: Every shake-up also clears new ground. Think of one thing you tried for the first time this year, and give yourself some credit for it.
rows.en_before_tone: For every shake-up, there's also new ground that's been laid. Try thinking of one thing you tried for the first time this year, and give that version of you some credit.

rows.ko: 변화 속에서는 속도를 늦추는 것도 하나의 방법이에요. 연말에는 바뀐 것들이 자리를 잡도록 일정을 조금 비워 두셔도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: When everything is changing, slowing down is a smart move. As the year wraps up, leave some gaps in your schedule so the changes can settle in.
rows.en_before_tone: In the middle of change, slowing down is also a way forward. As the year ends, it's okay to leave a little space in your schedule so the changes can settle in.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 잠깐 걸음을 늦추고 안을 돌보는 해로 보여 주고 있었어요. ‘멈춤’이라는 답과 꼭 맞는 흐름입니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year as a time to slow down and tend to your inner world. It fits your answer, ‘Pause,’ perfectly.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, showed this year as a time to slow down for a while and tend to what's inside. It fits your answer, ‘Pause,’ perfectly.

rows.ko: 서 있는 동안에도 많은 것을 느끼셨을 것 같아요. 하늘 역시 올해를 ‘멈춤’ 속에서 방향을 다시 살피는 시간으로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Even standing still, you felt a great deal. The sky, too, pictures this year as a ‘Pause,’ a time to check your direction again.
rows.en_before_tone: I imagine you felt a lot even while standing still. The sky, too, was picturing this year as a ‘Pause,’ a time to look at your direction again.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’, 하늘이 올해에 붙인 이름과 닮았습니다. 서두르기보다 머무르며 정리하는 흐름이 보였어요.
rows.en: ‘Pause’ is close to the name the sky would give this year. It calls for staying put and sorting things out rather than rushing ahead.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Pause’ is close to the name the sky gave this year. I could see a time for staying put and sorting things out rather than rushing.

rows.ko: 올해의 하늘은 신호등 앞에서 잠시 기다리는 장면 같았어요. 그 장면에 ‘멈춤’이라는 당신의 답이 자연스럽게 겹칩니다.
rows.en: This year's sky was like waiting at a red light. Your answer, ‘Pause,’ fits right into that picture.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was like a moment of waiting at a traffic light. Your answer, ‘Pause,’ fits naturally into that scene.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘멈춤’으로 기억한다면 그만큼 마음이 쉬어 갈 곳이 필요했다는 뜻이에요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 작은 것부터 다시 고르는 이야기도 함께 들려주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: If you remember this year as a ‘Pause,’ you needed a place to rest. The sky also speaks of choosing again, starting with small things.
rows.en_before_tone: If you remember this year as a ‘Pause,’ it means your heart needed a place to rest. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of choosing again, starting with small things.

rows.ko: 멈춰 선 시간의 무게는 겪은 사람이 가장 잘 압니다. ‘멈춤’이라는 답을 먼저 두고, 하늘은 그 옆에서 다른 장면 하나를 더 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: Nobody knows the weight of standing still better than the one who lived it. Your ‘Pause’ comes first, and the sky simply offers one more scene beside it.
rows.en_before_tone: No one knows the weight of time spent standing still better than the person who lived it. Your answer, ‘Pause,’ comes first, and beside it the sky was showing one more scene.

rows.ko: 바깥의 흐름은 꽤 분주했을지 몰라도 마음은 멈춰 서 있었을 수 있어요. ‘멈춤’이라는 당신의 감각이 가장 정확하고, 하늘의 이야기는 참고로 곁에 두면 충분합니다.
rows.en: Life around you moved fast while you stood still inside. Your sense of ‘Pause’ is what counts; the sky's story is there simply for reference.
rows.en_before_tone: The world around you may have been pretty busy while your heart stood still. Your sense of ‘Pause’ is the truest guide, and it's enough to keep the sky's story nearby just for reference.

rows.ko: 걸음을 멈추고 싶을 만큼의 한 해, ‘멈춤’이라는 그 답을 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 시간 안에서 천천히 차오르던 힘에 대해서도 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: This year made you want to stop in your tracks, and I respect your answer, ‘Pause.’ The sky also points to strength slowly returning during that time.
rows.en_before_tone: In a year that made you want to stop in your tracks, I respect your answer: ‘Pause.’ The sky also speaks of the strength that was slowly filling back up during that time.

rows.ko: 멈춰 있던 동안 보인 것들이 분명 있습니다. 그중 하나를 적어 두면 다시 걸을 때 좋은 이정표가 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: Standing still let you notice things you would otherwise have missed. Write one down, and it becomes a helpful signpost when you start moving again.
rows.en_before_tone: There were surely things you could see while you were standing still. Writing one of them down can give you a good signpost when you start walking again.

rows.ko: 쉬는 것도 한 해를 사는 방식이에요. 다시 움직이고 싶어질 때까지 지금의 속도를 그대로 허락해 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Rest is a way of living your year, too. Keep this pace for as long as you need, until you feel ready to move again.
rows.en_before_tone: Resting is one way of living a year, too. It's okay to allow yourself your current pace until you feel like moving again.

rows.ko: 다시 걷는 첫걸음은 작을수록 편해요. 마음이 내킬 때 할 수 있는 아주 작은 일 하나만 정해 두셔도 충분합니다.
rows.en: The smaller your first step back, the easier it feels. Pick one tiny thing you can do whenever you feel up to it. That's plenty.
rows.en_before_tone: The first step back is easier the smaller it is. It's enough to pick just one tiny thing you can do whenever you feel up to it.

rows.ko: 멈춤이 길게 느껴졌다면 그만큼 나에게 필요한 시간이었을 수 있어요. 올해의 쉼이 무엇을 지켜 주었는지 돌아보는 것으로 이 해를 마무리해도 좋습니다.
rows.en: If the pause felt long, that's how much time you needed. Close out the year by looking back on what that rest protected for you.
rows.en_before_tone: If the pause felt long, it may have been just the time you needed. You might close out this year by looking back on what your rest protected for you.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 노력이 결과로 맺히는 해로 그리고 있었어요. ‘성취’라는 답에 고개가 끄덕여지는 이유입니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year as one when hard work pays off. No wonder your answer, ‘Achievement,’ rings so true.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was picturing this year as one when effort bears fruit. That's why your answer, ‘Achievement,’ makes so much sense.

rows.ko: 무언가를 손에 쥔 한 해였군요. 하늘 역시 ‘성취’처럼 애쓴 만큼 인정과 결실이 돌아오는 흐름을 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: This was a year you had something real to show for your efforts. Like your word, ‘Achievement,’ the sky shows recognition and results returning to match the work you put in.
rows.en_before_tone: So this was a year when something real came into your hands. Like ‘Achievement,’ the sky was also showing a flow where recognition and results come back in proportion to your effort.

rows.ko: ‘성취’, 올해의 하늘과 잘 어울리는 단어입니다. 계단을 하나 올라선 듯한 흐름이 보였어요.
rows.en: ‘Achievement’ suits this year's sky well. It shows you climbing one step higher.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Achievement’ is a word that suits this year's sky well. It looked like stepping up onto the next stair.

rows.ko: 올해 하늘은 씨앗이 열매가 되는 장면에 가까웠어요. 그 장면과 당신이 고른 ‘성취’가 정확히 맞닿아 있습니다.
rows.en: This year's sky was a lot like watching seeds turn into fruit. That image and your pick, ‘Achievement,’ line up perfectly.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was close to a scene of seeds becoming fruit. That scene and the word you chose, ‘Achievement,’ line up perfectly.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘성취’로 기억한다면 그 기억이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 결과 뒤에서 나를 돌보는 시간에 대해서도 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: Looking back on this year as ‘Achievement’? Trust that memory. Behind those results, the sky also makes room for taking care of yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: If you remember this year as ‘Achievement,’ that memory is the truest guide. Behind those results, the sky also speaks of time to take care of yourself.

rows.ko: 해낸 것이 있었기에 ‘성취’라는 답이 나왔을 거예요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 조금 더 느린 리듬에 대한 이야기도 함께 들려주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: You pulled some things off, or ‘Achievement’ wouldn't be your answer. The sky adds a story about a slightly slower rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: There must have been things you accomplished for ‘Achievement’ to be your answer. Alongside it, the sky also tells of a slightly slower rhythm.
