rows.ko: 하늘이 무엇을 보여 주든, 직접 이뤄 낸 ‘성취’의 감각은 당신이 가장 잘 압니다. 하늘은 그 옆에서 아직 자라는 중인 것들에 대해서도 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: Whatever your chart shows, nobody knows the feeling of your own ‘Achievement’ better than you do. The sky also points to things that are still growing.
rows.en_before_tone: Whatever the sky shows, you know the feeling of the ‘Achievement’ you earned yourself better than anyone. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of things that are still growing.

rows.ko: 애쓴 끝에 닿은 자리, ‘성취’라는 그 답을 그대로 믿으셔도 됩니다. 하늘은 거기에 다음을 위해 힘을 모아 두는 이야기도 보태고 있었어요.
rows.en: You got here through real effort, so trust your answer, ‘Achievement,’ just as it is. The sky adds a note about saving your energy for what comes next.
rows.en_before_tone: You reached this point after a lot of effort, so you can trust your answer, ‘Achievement,’ just as it is. The sky also adds a story about gathering your strength for what comes next.

rows.ko: 이룬 것 뒤에는 늘 버텨 준 습관이 있습니다. 올해 나를 도운 습관 하나를 내년에도 데려가 보세요.
rows.en: Behind every achievement is a habit that kept you going. Pick one habit that helped you this year and bring it with you into next year.
rows.en_before_tone: Behind every achievement, there's a habit that kept you going. Try bringing one habit that helped you this year along into next year.

rows.ko: 성취를 축하하는 일은 미루지 않아도 돼요. 작게라도 나만의 방식으로 올해를 기념하는 시간을 가져도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Don't put off celebrating. Mark this year in your own way, even a small one.
rows.en_before_tone: There's no need to put off celebrating what you've achieved. Even in a small way, it's nice to take time to mark this year in your own style.

rows.ko: 결과만큼 그 과정에서 달라진 나도 올해의 성취입니다. 무엇을 해냈는지와 함께 어떤 사람이 되었는지도 적어 보세요.
rows.en: Who you became along the way counts as much as the results. Next to what you accomplished, write down how you've grown.
rows.en_before_tone: Just as much as the results, the way you changed along the way is part of this year's achievement too. Alongside what you accomplished, try writing down who you became.

rows.ko: 다음 목표는 조금 숨을 고른 뒤에 세워도 늦지 않아요. 올해 나를 여기까지 데려온 마음을 먼저 기억해 두면 좋습니다.
rows.en: Your next goal can wait until you've caught your breath. First, remember what drove you this far.
rows.en_before_tone: It's not too late to set your next goal after you've caught your breath a bit. It can help to first remember the feelings that carried you this far this year.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 익숙한 것과 작별하는 흐름으로 보여 주고 있었어요. ‘이별’이라는 말을 고르기까지 마음이 많이 무거웠을 것 같습니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year as a time of saying goodbye to something familiar. Your heart must have felt heavy by the time you chose ‘Farewell.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was showing this year as a time of saying goodbye to something familiar. I imagine your heart felt very heavy by the time you chose the word ‘Farewell.’

rows.ko: 무언가를 떠나보낸 시간이 ‘이별’이라는 한 단어에 담겨 있네요. 하늘 역시 올해를 정든 것과 거리가 생기는 흐름으로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Everything you had to let go of lives in that one word, ‘Farewell.’ The sky, too, pictures this year as a time when distance grew between you and something you cherished.
rows.en_before_tone: The time you spent letting something go is held in that one word, ‘Farewell.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time when distance grows between you and something dear.

rows.ko: ‘이별’을 고른 마음을 조심스럽게 받아 듭니다. 하늘에서도 한 시절이 저물고 자리가 비워지는 흐름이 보였어요.
rows.en: Choosing ‘Farewell’ isn't easy, and I want to honor that. The sky also shows one chapter of life closing and space opening up.
rows.en_before_tone: I gently take in what it meant for you to choose ‘Farewell.’ In the sky, too, I could see a flow of one season drawing to a close and space being cleared.

rows.ko: 올해의 하늘은 문 하나가 조용히 닫히는 장면에 가까웠어요. 그 앞에서 ‘이별’이라고 답한 마음의 무게를 조용히 헤아려 봅니다.
rows.en: This year's sky looked like a door quietly closing. I can only imagine how heavy it felt to answer ‘Farewell’ standing in front of it.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was close to a scene of a door quietly closing. I gently take in how heavy it must have felt to answer ‘Farewell’ as that door closed.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘이별’로 기억한다면, 그 기억이 무엇보다 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 마음이 쉬어 갈 자리에 대해서도 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If ‘Farewell’ is how this year will stay with you, that memory matters more than anything. The sky also speaks of a place where you can rest.
rows.en_before_tone: If you remember this year as ‘Farewell,’ that memory is truer than anything. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of a place where your heart can rest.

rows.ko: 떠나보낸 것의 무게는 겪은 사람만이 압니다. ‘이별’이라는 당신의 답을 먼저 두고, 하늘의 이야기는 마음이 허락할 때 천천히 들어도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Only the person who lived through it knows the weight of what they let go. Your ‘Farewell’ comes first, and you can take in the sky's story slowly, whenever you're ready.
rows.en_before_tone: Only the person who lived it knows the weight of what they let go. Your answer, ‘Farewell,’ comes first, and it's okay to listen to the sky's story slowly, whenever your heart is ready.

rows.ko: 하늘의 그림은 조금 다른 쪽을 비추고 있었지만, ‘이별’을 지나온 당신의 마음이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘의 이야기는 지금 꼭 받아들이지 않아도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Your chart leans in a slightly different direction, but you lived through this ‘Farewell,’ and you know best. You don't need to take in the sky's story right now.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky's picture was highlighting something slightly different, but your heart, which has been through a ‘Farewell,’ is the truest guide. You don't have to take in the sky's story right now.

rows.ko: 무언가와 작별한 한 해였다면, ‘이별’이라는 그 말보다 정확한 것은 없습니다. 하늘은 그 시간 속에서도 끊어지지 않고 남아 있던 작은 연결들에 대해 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If this was a year of goodbyes, no word says it more truly than ‘Farewell.’ The sky also points to the small connections that held on through it all.
rows.en_before_tone: If this was a year of saying goodbye to something, nothing is truer than that word, ‘Farewell.’ The sky also speaks of the small connections that stayed unbroken through it all.

rows.ko: 이별의 마음은 정해진 속도 없이 오고 갑니다. 그리운 날이 있다면 그리워하는 것도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Grief comes and goes on its own schedule. On days you miss what's gone, let yourself miss it.
rows.en_before_tone: Feelings of loss come and go at no set pace. If there are days you miss what's gone, it's okay to miss it.

rows.ko: 아픈 마음을 정리하려 애쓰지 않아도 됩니다. 오늘은 따뜻한 것을 마시며 나를 조금 돌봐 주는 것만으로 충분해요.
rows.en: You don't have to work at getting over the hurt. For today, sipping something warm and being a little kind to yourself is enough.
rows.en_before_tone: You don't have to work at tidying up a hurting heart. Today, just sipping something warm and caring for yourself a little is enough.

rows.ko: 혼자 감당하기 무거운 날에는 믿을 만한 사람에게 마음을 조금 나눠 보세요. 함께 있어 주는 사람이 있다는 것만으로도 숨이 조금 편해질 수 있습니다.
rows.en: On days that feel too heavy to carry alone, open up a little to someone you trust. Simply having someone beside you can make it easier to breathe.
rows.en_before_tone: On days that feel too heavy to carry alone, try sharing a little of your heart with someone you trust. Just having someone with you can make it a little easier to breathe.

rows.ko: 마음이 조금 가라앉은 날, 내 곁에 남아 있는 것들을 천천히 둘러봐도 좋아요. 오늘 하루 나를 편하게 해 준 것 하나만 기억해 두셔도 충분합니다.
rows.en: On days when you feel a little low, take a slow look around at what's still by your side. Remembering just one thing that comforted you today is enough.
rows.en_before_tone: On a day when your heart has settled a bit, it's nice to slowly look around at what's still by your side. It's enough just to remember one thing that brought you comfort today.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 어깨가 무거운 해로 읽고 있었어요. ‘고생’이라는 말이 그냥 나온 것이 아니었다는 뜻입니다.
rows.en: The sky read this year as one that put a lot on your shoulders. In other words, you chose ‘Hardship’ for good reason.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, read this year as one that weighed heavily on your shoulders. It means the word ‘Hardship’ didn't come out of nowhere.

rows.ko: 쉽지 않은 날이 많았다는 게 ‘고생’이라는 한 단어에서 느껴집니다. 하늘 역시 올해를 애쓰는 만큼 짐도 함께 지는 흐름으로 그리고 있었어요.
rows.en: That one word, ‘Hardship,’ says so much about the tough days you faced. The sky shows this year as a time when the harder you tried, the more you carried.
rows.en_before_tone: I can feel from that one word, ‘Hardship,’ that many days weren't easy. The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time when the more you try, the more you carry.

rows.ko: ‘고생’, 그 말 그대로의 한 해였군요. 하늘에서도 해야 할 일과 책임이 겹겹이 쌓이는 흐름이 보였습니다.
rows.en: So it really was a year of ‘Hardship.’ The sky shows tasks and responsibilities stacking up, one on top of another.
rows.en_before_tone: So it was a year of ‘Hardship,’ just as the word says. In the sky, too, I could see tasks and responsibilities piling up layer upon layer.

rows.ko: 오르막길이 길게 이어지는 한 해, 하늘도 올해를 그렇게 그리고 있었습니다. 그 길을 걸어온 당신이 ‘고생’이라고 답한 건 너무나 자연스러워요.
rows.en: A long, uphill climb: that's how the sky saw this year, too. After walking that road, of course your answer was ‘Hardship.’
rows.en_before_tone: A year of a long uphill road: that's how the sky was picturing it too. It's completely natural that you, having walked that road, answered ‘Hardship.’

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘고생’으로 기억한다면 그 기억이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 잠시 짐을 내려놓을 수 있는 순간들에 대해서도 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If ‘Hardship’ is how you remember this year, you're not wrong. The sky also points to moments when you could set your load down for a while.
rows.en_before_tone: If you remember this year as ‘Hardship,’ that memory is the truest guide. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of moments when you could set your load down for a while.

rows.ko: 누가 알아주지 않아도 애쓴 시간은 분명히 있었습니다. ‘고생’이라는 당신의 말을 그대로 믿으며, 하늘이 들려주는 다른 이야기도 하나 조심스럽게 꺼내 볼게요.
rows.en: Even if no one noticed, your effort was real. I take your word, ‘Hardship,’ just as it is, and with that in mind, here is one other story the sky gently offers.
rows.en_before_tone: Even if no one noticed, the time you spent trying was real. Trusting your word, ‘Hardship,’ just as it is, let me gently bring up one other story the sky is telling.

rows.ko: 같은 하늘 아래에서도 한 해의 무게는 사람마다 다르게 느껴집니다. ‘고생’을 지나온 당신의 체감이 먼저이고, 하늘의 이야기는 그다음에 들어도 늦지 않아요.
rows.en: Even under the same sky, a year weighs differently on each person. Your experience of ‘Hardship’ comes first; the sky's story can wait until after.
rows.en_before_tone: Even under the same sky, the weight of a year feels different to each person. Your experience of ‘Hardship’ comes first, and it's not too late to hear the sky's story after that.

rows.ko: 쉬지 못하고 달려온 한 해, ‘고생’이라는 그 답을 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 시간 안에서 당신을 돕던 손길에 대해서도 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: You ran nonstop all year without a break, and your answer, ‘Hardship,’ deserves respect. The sky also tells of the helping hands that were there for you along the way.
rows.en_before_tone: A year of running without rest: I respect your answer, ‘Hardship.’ The sky also speaks of the helping hands that were there for you during that time.

rows.ko: 오늘은 나에게 해야 할 일 대신 쉴 시간을 먼저 건네 보세요. 고생한 시간을 증명하려 애쓰지 않아도, 그 수고는 이미 충분했습니다.
rows.en: Today, put rest at the top of your list, ahead of any to-dos. You don't have to prove how hard it's been; what you've given is already more than enough.
rows.en_before_tone: Today, try giving yourself time to rest before any to-dos. You don't have to prove how hard it's been; your effort has already been more than enough.

rows.ko: 지친 마음은 혼자 들고 있을 때 더 무거워집니다. 가까운 사람에게 올해 힘들었다고 한마디 털어놓는 것만으로도 조금 가벼워질 수 있어요.
rows.en: Tiredness feels heavier when you carry it alone. Tell someone close to you that this year was rough; that alone can lighten the load a little.
rows.en_before_tone: A tired heart feels heavier when you carry it alone. Just telling someone close to you that this year was hard can make it a little lighter.

rows.ko: 고생이 끝났는지 아직 이어지는지와 상관없이, 지금의 피로를 돌보는 것이 먼저예요. 잠드는 시간을 조금 앞당기는 것처럼 작은 쉼부터 챙겨 보셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Whether the hard stretch is behind you or still going, looking after the tiredness you feel right now comes first. Start small, like heading to bed a bit earlier.
rows.en_before_tone: Whether the hard stretch is over or still going, caring for the tiredness you feel now comes first. You might start with small rest, like going to bed a little earlier.

rows.ko: 힘든 한 해를 지나온 것만으로도 충분히 애쓰신 거예요. 연말의 계획표는 잠시 비워 두고, 나를 쉬게 하는 일 하나만 적어 두셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Getting through a hard year is already more than enough effort. Leave your year-end plans blank for now, and write down just one thing that helps you rest.
rows.en_before_tone: Simply making it through a hard year means you've already tried more than enough. It's okay to leave your year-end plans blank for now and just write down one thing that lets you rest.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 힘을 쏟던 자리에서 한 걸음 물러나고 싶어지는 흐름으로 보여 주고 있었어요. ‘그만하자’라는 말이 나올 만큼 마음이 고단했던 한 해였을 것 같습니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year as a time when you want to step back from where you've been pouring your energy. It drained you enough to bring you to ‘Letting go.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was showing this year as a time when you might want to step back from where you'd been pouring your energy. It must have been a year so draining that the words ‘Letting go’ came out.

rows.ko: 많이 애쓰고 많이 지친 시간이 ‘그만하자’라는 말에 고스란히 묻어 있네요. 하늘 역시 올해를 쉼과 정리가 필요한 해로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: All that effort and exhaustion lives in the words ‘Letting go.’ The sky, too, pictures this as a year that calls for rest and clearing things out.
rows.en_before_tone: All the effort and all the exhaustion are soaked right into the words ‘Letting go.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as one that calls for rest and clearing.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’는 말에는 그동안의 수고가 다 들어 있습니다. 하늘에서도 더 밀어붙이기보다 힘을 거두고 싶어지는 흐름이 보였어요.
rows.en: ‘Letting go’ holds all the effort you've put in until now. The sky shows the same pull toward easing off rather than pushing harder.
rows.en_before_tone: The words ‘Letting go’ hold all the effort you've put in until now. In the sky, too, I could see a pull toward drawing your energy back rather than pushing harder.

rows.ko: 긴 길 끝에서 잠시 앉아 쉬고 싶어지는 마음, 하늘도 올해를 그런 흐름으로 그리고 있었어요. 그 마음으로 ‘그만하자’를 고른 당신을 충분히 이해합니다.
rows.en: That urge to sit down and rest at the end of a long road is how the sky pictured this year, too. Feeling that way, of course you chose ‘Letting go.’
rows.en_before_tone: The wish to sit and rest for a while at the end of a long road: the sky was picturing this year that way too. I fully understand why you chose ‘Letting go’ with that feeling.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘그만하자’로 정리했다면, 그만큼 지친 마음이 가장 정확한 답입니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 당신을 아껴 주는 것들에 대해서도 조용히 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If ‘Letting go’ is how you'd sum up this year, the tiredness behind it is the truest answer. The sky also quietly points to the people and things that care for you.
rows.en_before_tone: If you summed up this year as ‘Letting go,’ that tired heart is the truest answer. Alongside it, the sky was also quietly talking about the things that hold you dear.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’는 말이 나오기까지 얼마나 오래 참아 왔을지 다 헤아리기 어렵습니다. 그 마음이 먼저이고, 하늘은 그 곁에 다른 이야기 하나를 조용히 놓아 두고 있었어요.
rows.en: It's hard to imagine how long you held it together before you got to ‘Letting go.’ That feeling comes first, and the sky simply sets one other story quietly beside it.
rows.en_before_tone: It's hard to fully imagine how long you must have held on before the words ‘Letting go’ came out. That feeling comes first, and the sky was quietly setting one other story beside it.

rows.ko: 지금은 하늘의 이야기보다 당신의 마음이 더 중요합니다. ‘그만하자’라고 느낀 그 마음을 그대로 두고, 하늘이 건네는 다른 이야기는 여유가 생길 때 살펴봐도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Right now, how you feel matters more than anything in your chart. Leave ‘Letting go’ just as it is, and look at the sky's other story whenever you have the energy.
rows.en_before_tone: Right now, your heart matters more than the sky's story. You can leave the feeling of ‘Letting go’ just as it is, and look at the sky's other story whenever you have some room.

rows.ko: 오래 버텨 온 끝에 나온 말, ‘그만하자’를 그대로 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 시간 속에서도 당신을 쉬게 해 줄 자리에 대해 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: These words came after carrying so much for so long, and I fully respect your ‘Letting go.’ The sky also speaks of places where you can rest, even in the middle of it all.
rows.en_before_tone: Words that came after holding on for so long: I fully respect your ‘Letting go.’ The sky also speaks of places to rest, even within that time.

rows.ko: 그만하고 싶다는 마음을 부끄러워하지 않아도 됩니다. 오늘 하루만큼은 해야 할 일 대신 나를 편하게 하는 일을 하나 골라 보세요.
rows.en: There's nothing to be ashamed of in wanting to stop. Just for today, pick one thing that makes you feel good instead of one more thing you have to do.
rows.en_before_tone: You don't have to feel ashamed of wanting to stop. Just for today, try choosing one thing that brings you comfort instead of something you have to do.

rows.ko: 기댈 곳이 있다면 지금 기대도 괜찮아요. 누군가 곁에서 이야기를 들어 주는 것만으로도 마음의 짐이 조금 나뉠 수 있습니다.
rows.en: If you have someone to lean on, it's okay to lean on them now. Having someone who just listens can take some of the weight off.
rows.en_before_tone: If you have someone to lean on, it's okay to lean on them now. Just having someone beside you who listens can share a little of the weight on your heart.

rows.ko: 애써 온 날들이 있었기에 지금 이렇게 지친 거예요. 이번 주에는 잠을 조금 더 자거나 좋아하는 곳에 잠시 머무는 것처럼 아주 작은 쉼 하나를 챙겨 두면 좋겠습니다.
rows.en: You're this tired because of all the days you kept pushing. This week, set aside one tiny break, like sleeping in a little or spending a few minutes somewhere you love.
rows.en_before_tone: You're this tired because of all the days you've been trying so hard. This week, it would be good to set aside one very small rest, like sleeping a little more or spending a moment in a place you love.

rows.ko: 내려놓고 싶은 마음이 든다는 건 그만큼 오래 들고 있었다는 뜻이기도 합니다. 오늘은 그 무게를 잠시 바닥에 내려놓고 쉬어 가셔도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Wanting to put something down also means you've been carrying it a long time. Today, it's okay to set that weight down for a while and rest.
rows.en_before_tone: Wanting to put something down also means you've been carrying it for a long time. Today, it's okay to set that weight on the ground for a while and rest.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 새 문이 열리고 첫발을 내딛는 해로 그리고 있었어요. ‘시작’이라는 답과 잘 맞는 흐름입니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year as one when a new door opens and you take your first step. That fits nicely with your answer, ‘Beginning.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was picturing this year as one when a new door opens and you take your first step. It's a flow that fits your answer, ‘Beginning,’ well.

rows.ko: 새로운 것에 손을 내민 한 해가 ‘시작’이라는 말에서 느껴집니다. 하늘 역시 새 장을 펼치는 흐름을 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: Your word, ‘Beginning,’ captures a year of reaching for something new. The sky shows a fresh chapter opening, too.
rows.en_before_tone: I can feel a year of reaching toward something new in the word ‘Beginning.’ The sky, too, showed a new chapter opening.

rows.ko: ‘시작’이라는 답이 올해의 하늘과 나란히 놓입니다. 씨앗을 심고 첫 줄을 쓰는 흐름이 보였어요.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Beginning,’ sits right alongside this year's sky, which shows seeds going into the ground and first lines being written.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Beginning,’ sits right alongside this year's sky. I could see seeds being planted and first lines being written.

rows.ko: 올해의 하늘은 빈 공책의 첫 장을 넘기는 장면에 가까웠어요. 그 첫 장에 ‘시작’이라고 적은 사람이 바로 당신입니다.
rows.en: This year's sky looked a lot like opening a brand-new notebook to the first page. And you're the one who wrote ‘Beginning’ at the top.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky looked a lot like turning to the first page of a blank notebook. And you're the one who wrote ‘Beginning’ on that first page.

rows.ko: 올해를 ‘시작’으로 기억한다면 그 감각이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 새것이 자리 잡도록 속도를 고르는 이야기도 하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If this year feels like a ‘Beginning’ to you, go with that. The sky also talks about pacing yourself so new things have time to settle in.
rows.en_before_tone: If you remember this year as a ‘Beginning,’ that sense is the truest guide. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of pacing yourself so new things can settle in.

rows.ko: 작게라도 첫걸음을 뗐다면 그것만으로 ‘시작’이라는 답은 충분히 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 뿌리를 내리는 시간에 대한 이야기도 함께 보태고 있었어요.
rows.en: If you took even a small first step, ‘Beginning’ is the right answer. The sky adds a story about taking time to put down roots.
rows.en_before_tone: If you took even a small first step, that alone makes ‘Beginning’ an accurate answer. Alongside it, the sky also adds a story about taking time to put down roots.

rows.ko: 하늘이 그린 올해는 조금 다른 색이었지만, ‘시작’을 직접 겪은 당신의 체감이 먼저예요. 두 이야기를 겹쳐 보면 지금 시작한 것을 어떻게 키울지 실마리가 보일 수 있습니다.
rows.en: The sky colored this year a little differently, but your firsthand experience of a ‘Beginning’ comes first. Lay the two stories together, and you'll find clues for growing what you've started.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky painted this year in a slightly different color, but your own experience of a ‘Beginning’ comes first. Layering the two stories together may give you clues about how to grow what you've just started.

rows.ko: 새로운 무언가에 발을 들인 한 해, ‘시작’이라는 그 답을 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 시간 아래에서 천천히 다져지던 기반에 대해서도 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: A year of stepping into something new: ‘Beginning’ is an answer worth honoring. The sky also tells of a foundation being laid, slowly, underneath it all.
rows.en_before_tone: A year of stepping into something new: I respect your answer, ‘Beginning.’ The sky also speaks of a foundation slowly being laid beneath it all.

rows.ko: 시작한 것이 아직 작아 보여도 괜찮아요. 처음의 마음을 한 줄로 적어 두면 흔들릴 때 다시 꺼내 볼 수 있습니다.
rows.en: It's okay if what you started still looks small. Write down in one line how you felt at the start, so you can come back to it when you waver.
rows.en_before_tone: It's okay if what you started still looks small. If you write down how you felt at the start in one line, you can pull it out again when you feel shaky.

rows.ko: 새로 시작한 일에는 서툰 날도 함께 따라옵니다. 그 서툰 순간까지 시작의 일부라고 여겨 주세요.
rows.en: Anything new comes with some awkward days. Count even the clumsy moments as part of the beginning.
rows.en_before_tone: Anything new comes with some clumsy days. Try to see even those clumsy moments as part of the beginning.

rows.ko: 시작은 혼자보다 함께일 때 이어 가기 쉬워져요. 올해 시작한 것을 가까운 사람 한 명에게 이야기해 두는 것도 좋은 방법입니다.
rows.en: New things are easier to sustain when you don't go it alone. Tell one person close to you about what you started this year; it's a simple way to keep it going.
rows.en_before_tone: Beginnings are easier to keep going together than alone. Telling one person close to you about what you started this year is a good way to do that.

rows.ko: 무엇을 시작했는지보다 시작할 수 있었던 나를 먼저 기억해 주세요. 그 용기는 다음에 또 다른 문 앞에 설 때도 곁에 남아 있습니다.
rows.en: More than what you started, remember that you found the nerve to start at all. That courage will still be with you the next time you're standing at a new door.
rows.en_before_tone: More than what you started, try to remember first that you were able to start at all. That courage will stay with you the next time you stand at another door.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 마음이 들뜨고 새로운 것에 끌리는 해로 보여 주고 있었어요. ‘설렘’이라는 답과 같은 결입니다.
rows.en: The sky shows this year as one when your spirits lift and new things catch your eye. It's right in tune with your answer, ‘Butterflies.’
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, showed this year as one when your heart lifts and you're drawn to new things. It has the same feel as your answer: ‘Excitement.’

rows.ko: 마음이 두근거린 순간이 ‘설렘’이라는 한 단어에 담겨 있네요. 하늘 역시 올해를 반가운 제안과 새 관심이 피어나는 흐름으로 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Every moment your heart raced is wrapped up in that one word, ‘Butterflies.’ The sky, too, pictures this year as a time of welcome offers and budding new interests.
rows.en_before_tone: The moments your heart raced are held in that one word, ‘Excitement.’ The sky, too, was picturing this year as a time when welcome offers and new interests bloom.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’이라는 답을 보니 올해의 하늘이 떠오릅니다. 창문을 열자 새 바람이 밀려드는 듯한 흐름이었어요.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Butterflies,’ brings this year's sky to mind: like throwing open a window and letting a fresh breeze rush in.
rows.en_before_tone: Seeing your answer, ‘Excitement,’ brings this year's sky to mind. It felt like opening a window and letting a fresh breeze rush in.

rows.ko: 올해의 하늘은 꽃봉오리가 하나둘 열리는 장면에 가까웠어요. 그 장면과 ‘설렘’을 고른 당신의 마음이 잘 겹쳐집니다.
rows.en: This year's sky was like watching flower buds open, one after another. That image and your choice of ‘Butterflies’ go together beautifully.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was close to a scene of flower buds opening one by one. That scene and your choice of ‘Excitement’ overlap beautifully.

rows.ko: 올해 마음을 두근거리게 한 무언가가 있었다면 ‘설렘’이라는 답이 가장 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 들뜬 마음을 차분히 담아 둘 그릇에 대해서도 말하고 있었어요.
rows.en: If something set your heart fluttering this year, ‘Butterflies’ is the truest answer. The sky also speaks of finding a steady vessel to hold that lightness.
rows.en_before_tone: If something set your heart racing this year, ‘Excitement’ is the truest answer. Alongside it, the sky also speaks of finding a way to calmly hold on to that fluttering feeling.

rows.ko: 무엇이 마음을 움직였는지는 당신이 가장 잘 압니다. ‘설렘’이라는 답을 먼저 두고, 하늘은 그 옆에서 다른 결의 이야기를 하나 더 들려주고 있었어요.
rows.en: You know better than anyone what moved you. Your answer, ‘Butterflies,’ comes first, and the sky simply adds one more story with a different feel.
rows.en_before_tone: You know best what moved your heart. Your answer, ‘Excitement,’ comes first, and beside it the sky was telling one more story with a different feel.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 조금 더 차분한 색으로 그리고 있었지만, ‘설렘’을 느낀 건 바로 당신이에요. 그 체감을 믿으면서 하늘의 이야기도 곁에 살짝 놓아 두면 좋습니다.
rows.en: Your chart painted this year in calmer colors, but you're the one who felt the ‘Butterflies.’ Trust that, and keep the sky's story lightly in the background.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky was painting this year in somewhat calmer colors, but you're the one who felt the ‘Excitement.’ You can trust that feeling and still set the sky's story gently beside it.

rows.ko: 작은 것에도 마음이 반짝인 한 해, ‘설렘’이라는 그 답을 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 설렘이 오래 이어지도록 뿌리를 내리는 시간에 대해서도 이야기하고 있었어요.
rows.en: In a year when even little things made you light up, stand by your answer, ‘Butterflies.’ The sky also speaks of putting down roots so that feeling can last.
rows.en_before_tone: A year when even small things made your heart sparkle: I respect your answer, ‘Excitement.’ The sky also speaks of taking time to put down roots so that excitement can last.

rows.ko: 설렘이 지나간 자리에도 따뜻한 온기는 남습니다. 올해 마음이 뛰었던 순간 하나를 사진이나 메모로 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Even after the thrill fades, a warm glow stays behind. Save one moment that thrilled you this year, in a photo or a quick note.
rows.en_before_tone: Even after excitement passes, a warm glow stays behind. Try keeping one moment that made your heart leap this year in a photo or a note.

rows.ko: 들뜬 마음과 차분한 마음은 함께 있을 수 있어요. 설렘을 오래 간직하고 싶다면 그 마음을 지키는 작은 루틴 하나를 만들어 보는 것도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Feeling elated and feeling calm can go hand in hand. If you want the butterflies to last, build one small routine that keeps them alive.
rows.en_before_tone: A fluttering heart and a calm heart can exist together. If you want to hold on to the excitement, it might help to create one small routine that protects that feeling.

rows.ko: 설렘이 꼭 큰 결과로 이어지지 않아도 괜찮습니다. 마음이 움직였다는 것만으로도 올해는 충분히 빛났어요.
rows.en: Your butterflies don't have to lead to anything big. You were moved, and that alone makes this year shine.
rows.en_before_tone: It's okay if your excitement doesn't lead to big results. Just the fact that your heart was moved made this year shine.

rows.ko: 내년에도 설렐 거리를 하나 미리 심어 두면 어떨까요. 가 보고 싶은 곳이나 배우고 싶은 것을 하나 정해 두는 것만으로 충분합니다.
rows.en: Why not plant one thing to look forward to next year? Just picking a place you'd like to go or something you'd like to learn is enough.
rows.en_before_tone: How about planting one thing to look forward to next year, ahead of time? Just choosing a place you'd like to visit or something you'd like to learn is enough.

A12c.name: 2026 회고 첫 문단 — 단어 × 하늘 주제
A12c.used_in: 3번 섹션(2026 회고) 첫 문단. 엔진이 고른 2026 주제(A12t)와 Q2 단어로 칸을 찾고, 칸 안 3개 중 출생정보 해시로 하나. 바로 뒤에 A18 전환점 문단

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 책임이 하나둘 얹히고 그때마다 조용히 시험받는 해로 그리고 있었어요. 그 무게를 매일 지고 걸으며 ‘버텨’라고 답한 마음이 하늘의 그림과 그대로 겹칩니다.
rows.en: The sky drew this year the same way: responsibilities stacking up one by one, each a quiet test of your resolve. You shouldered that weight every day and answered ‘Endurance’, a perfect match for what the stars were showing.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was picturing this year as one where responsibilities pile on one by one, each quietly testing you. The way you carried that weight every day and answered ‘Holding on’ lines up exactly with the sky's picture.

rows.ko: ‘버텨’라는 한마디에 올해 어깨에 얹혔던 무게가 고스란히 담겨 있네요. 하늘 역시 일이 더디게 풀리는 사이 내 삶의 뼈대를 하나씩 다시 세우는 한 해를 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Endurance’ holds all the weight you carried on your shoulders this year. Your chart tells the same story: while progress moved slowly, you rebuilt the framework of your life, beam by beam.
rows.en_before_tone: The weight that rested on your shoulders this year is all there in the words ‘Holding on.’ The sky, too, showed a year of rebuilding the framework of your life piece by piece while things moved slowly.

rows.ko: 어깨에 놓인 짐이 쉽게 줄지 않던 한 해, 하늘의 흐름도 꼭 그랬습니다. 느린 걸음으로나마 내 기준을 다시 다지고 버팀목을 세워 온 시간이 ‘버텨’라는 답과 같은 곳을 가리켜요.
rows.en: Your load refused to lighten this year, and the sky mirrored that exactly. Slow and steadfast, you reset your standards and raised new supports, and that is precisely where ‘Endurance’ points.
rows.en_before_tone: A year when the load on your shoulders didn't lighten easily: the sky saw it the same way. The time you spent, even at a slow pace, re-establishing your own standards and putting up supports points to the same place as your answer, ‘Holding on.’

rows.ko: ‘버텨’를 고를 만큼 힘을 낸 한 해였다면, 그 체감이 무엇보다 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 닫혀 있던 문이 조금씩 열리고 뜻밖의 도움이 닿는 흐름도 함께 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: This year demanded enough strength that you chose ‘Endurance’, so trust that feeling above all. Right beside it, the sky showed closed doors easing open and help arriving when you least expected it.
rows.en_before_tone: If this was a year of pushing hard enough to choose ‘Holding on,’ that sense is truer than anything. Alongside it, the sky also showed closed doors opening little by little and unexpected help arriving.

rows.ko: 견뎌 온 날들이 많았기에 ‘버텨’라는 답이 나왔을 거예요. 하늘의 그림에는 그 시간 사이로 손을 내밀어 주는 사람과 조금씩 넓어지는 기회, 새로 배울 거리도 함께 그려져 있었습니다.
rows.en: So many days asked you to push through, and that is why ‘Endurance’ became your answer. Woven between them, this year's transits also showed people offering a hand, opportunities widening, and fresh things to learn.
rows.en_before_tone: There must have been many days to get through for ‘Holding on’ to be your answer. The sky's picture also showed, in between those days, people reaching out a hand, chances slowly widening, and new things to learn.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 배우고 넓혀 가는 쪽으로 비추고 있었습니다. 그래도 하루하루를 직접 살아 낸 사람은 당신이니, ‘버텨’라는 말을 올해의 제목으로 먼저 두셔도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: The sky lit this year up as a time for learning and broadening your horizons. But you're the one who lived it day by day, so put ‘Endurance’ first as this year's title.

rows.ko: 하늘만 보면 올해는 속도를 늦추고 맡은 몫을 견디는 쪽에 가까운 해였습니다. 그래도 그 안에서 달라진 것을 몸으로 느꼈다면 ‘변화’라는 답이 올해를 가장 정확하게 담고 있어요.
rows.en: On the sky's map, this year leaned toward slowing down and shouldering your share. Still, you felt something shift in you along the way, and ‘Change’ captures your year best.
rows.en_before_tone: Looking at the sky alone, this year leaned toward slowing down and carrying your share. Still, if you felt something shift within it, your answer, ‘Change,’ captures this year most accurately.

rows.ko: 무거운 짐을 지고 걷다 보면 사람은 안에서부터 달라지기도 해요. 올해 하늘이 시험과 책임의 무게를 비추는 동안 당신이 붙잡은 단어가 ‘변화’였고, 그 기억이 가장 정확합니다.
rows.en: Carrying a heavy load can transform you from the inside out. While the sky spotlighted tests and responsibility, you held onto the word ‘Change’, and your memory of the year is the one to trust.
rows.en_before_tone: Walking with a heavy load can change a person from the inside out. While this year's sky was lighting up the weight of tests and responsibility, the word you held on to was ‘Change,’ and that memory is the truest guide.

rows.ko: ‘변화’를 고를 만큼 많은 것이 달라진 한 해였다면, 그 감각이 무엇보다 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 문이 열리고 도움의 손길이 닿으며 조금 수월하게 넓어지는 흐름도 함께 그리고 있었어요.
rows.en: So much shifted this year that ‘Change’ became your answer, and that instinct is spot on. The sky also showed doors opening, help arriving, and growth coming a little more easily.
rows.en_before_tone: If so much changed this year that you chose ‘Change,’ that sense is truer than anything. Alongside it, the sky was also showing a flow where doors open, helping hands arrive, and things expand a little more easily.

rows.ko: 하늘의 그림에는 기회가 늘고 배울 거리가 넓어지는 순한 바람이 불고 있었어요. 그 바람 속에서 당신이 먼저 느낀 것이 ‘변화’였다면, 그 말이 올해를 가장 잘 아는 이름입니다.
rows.en: Your chart showed a gentler year, bringing new opportunities and more to learn. What you noticed first in all of it was ‘Change’, and that word knows this year best.
rows.en_before_tone: In the sky's picture, a gentle breeze was blowing, bringing more chances and more to learn. If what you felt first in that breeze was ‘Change,’ that word is the name that fits this year best.

rows.ko: 달라진 것이 많은 해는 겉으로 수월해 보여도 속으로는 분주하기 마련입니다. 하늘이 보여 준 확장과 도움의 흐름 곁에 ‘변화’라는 당신의 답을 나란히 놓으면 올해가 두 겹으로 읽혀요.
rows.en: A year full of change looks smooth on the surface and still feels hectic underneath. Set your answer, ‘Change’, beside the sky's growth and support, and the year reads on two levels at once.
rows.en_before_tone: A year when a lot changes may look easy on the outside but tends to be busy on the inside. Set your answer, ‘Change,’ beside the flow of growth and support the sky showed, and this year reads in two layers.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 익숙한 방식이 흔들리고 뜻밖의 제안이 찾아오는 새 국면으로 그리고 있었습니다. 당신이 고른 ‘변화’와 하늘의 그림이 같은 장면을 보고 있었던 셈이에요.
rows.en: The sky, too, framed this year as a new phase, with familiar routines wobbling and unexpected offers arriving at your door. Your answer, ‘Change’, and the stars were watching the very same scene.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, was picturing this year as a new phase where familiar ways wobble and unexpected offers arrive. The ‘Change’ you chose and the sky's picture were looking at the same scene.

rows.ko: 오래된 습관이 흔들리고 생각지 못한 문이 열린 한 해였다면, 하늘도 그 이야기를 하고 있었어요. 새 장으로 넘어가는 문턱에서 고른 ‘변화’라는 답이 무척 정확합니다.
rows.en: Old habits loosened and doors you never expected opened, and the sky was telling that same story. Chosen right on the threshold of a new chapter, ‘Change’ is exactly right.
rows.en_before_tone: If this was a year when old habits wobbled and doors you never expected opened, the sky was telling that story too. Your answer, ‘Change,’ chosen right at the threshold of a new chapter, is very accurate.

rows.ko: 하늘의 그림에는 판이 새로 짜이고 낯선 기회가 불쑥 등장하는 장면이 여럿 담겨 있었습니다. 그 한가운데를 직접 지나온 당신에게 ‘변화’만큼 잘 맞는 말은 없어 보여요.
rows.en: The sky's picture held plenty of moments when everything was rearranged and unfamiliar chances suddenly appeared. You walked straight through the middle of it, so no word fits you better than ‘Change’.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky's picture held many scenes of the board being reset and unfamiliar opportunities popping up out of nowhere. For you, having passed right through the middle of it, no word seems to fit better than ‘Change.’

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 오래 쥐고 있던 것을 내려놓고 자리를 비워 가는 해로 그리고 있었어요. 무언가 끝나고 흐려진 뒤에 찾아오는 ‘변화’라는 점에서, 당신의 답은 하늘과 같은 결입니다.
rows.en: Your chart drew this as a year for releasing what you'd held onto for a long time and clearing space. Your ‘Change’ is the kind that arrives after something ends and fades, so you and the sky are saying the same thing.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky was picturing this year as one of setting down what you'd held for a long time and clearing space. Since your ‘Change’ is the kind that comes after something ends and fades, your answer has the same feel as the sky.

rows.ko: ‘변화’에는 새로 생기는 것만큼 떠나보내는 것도 들어 있습니다. 올해 하늘도 끝맺음과 정리, 그리고 아직 모양이 다 잡히지 않은 흐릿한 시간을 함께 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: ‘Change’ holds as much farewell as it does arrival. This year's sky traced endings and clearing out too, along with a hazy stretch where nothing has fully taken shape yet.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Change’ holds as much letting go as it does new beginnings. This year's sky, too, was showing endings and clearing out, along with a hazy time when things haven't fully taken shape yet.

rows.ko: 익숙했던 것이 하나둘 손을 떠나던 한 해, 하늘에서도 같은 흐름이 보였어요. 흩어진 자리에 새 모양이 들어서기를 기다리는 그 시간을 ‘변화’라고 부른 당신의 감각이 정확합니다.
rows.en: One by one, familiar things slipped from your hands this year, and the sky showed the same pattern. You named that wait for something new to fill the empty space ‘Change’, and your instinct is exactly right.
rows.en_before_tone: This was a year when familiar things slipped from your hands one by one, and the sky showed the same flow. You called that time of waiting for something new to take shape in the empty space ‘Change,’ and your sense of it is exactly right.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 지나온 일을 되짚고 미뤄진 것을 다시 꺼내 보는 느린 해로 그리고 있었어요. 그 사이에도 무언가 달라졌다고 느꼈다면 ‘변화’라는 당신의 답이 먼저입니다.
rows.en: This year's transits pointed to a slow stretch of retracing your steps and revisiting what had been put off. You still felt something shift along the way, so your answer, ‘Change’, takes the lead.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky painted this year as a slow one, for retracing what you'd been through and revisiting things that had been put off. If you still felt something shift along the way, your answer, ‘Change,’ matters most.

rows.ko: ‘변화’를 고른 마음 안에는 달라진 자신을 알아본 눈이 있습니다. 하늘은 거기에 잠시 멈춰 서서 같은 길을 한 번 더 살피는 되돌아보기의 흐름도 보태고 있었어요.
rows.en: Choosing ‘Change’ shows you recognized the new person you've become. The sky added a pause to that picture: stopping to take one more look at the road you've traveled.
rows.en_before_tone: Choosing ‘Change’ shows that you noticed how you yourself had changed. The sky also added a flow of looking back, a chance to pause for a moment and walk the same road once more.

rows.ko: 같은 자리를 몇 번씩 돌아본 끝에 달라지는 것도 있어요. 하늘이 다시 보기와 미뤄짐의 흐름을 비추던 해에 당신은 ‘변화’를 고르셨고, 직접 겪은 그 감각이 가장 정확한 기록입니다.
rows.en: Some changes only arrive after you've walked the same ground a few times. In a year when the sky favored second looks and delays, you chose ‘Change’, and what you lived through is the truest record.
rows.en_before_tone: Some things change only after you've circled back to the same place a few times. In a year when the sky lit up review and delay, you chose ‘Change,’ and what you lived through firsthand is the truest record.

rows.ko: 올해 하늘은 비교적 고요해서 크게 방향을 트는 흐름이 드물었어요. 그럼에도 달라진 것을 느꼈다면, ‘변화’는 당신이 자기 삶 안에서 직접 일으키고 겪어 낸 움직임입니다.
rows.en: The stars stayed fairly still this year, with few sharp turns. Yet you felt things change, which makes ‘Change’ momentum you set in motion and lived through yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was fairly quiet, with few flows that made a sharp turn. If you still felt things change, then ‘Change’ is something you set in motion and lived through in your own life.

rows.ko: ‘변화’라는 답은 하늘보다 당신의 삶이 먼저 들려준 이야기입니다. 잔잔한 하늘 아래에서도 무언가가 움직이고 달라졌다면, 그 공은 다른 곳이 아닌 고스란히 당신에게 돌아가요.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Change’, is a story your life told before the stars did. Things moved and shifted even under a calm sky, and the credit goes to you alone.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Change,’ is a story your life told before the sky did. If something moved and shifted even under a calm sky, the credit goes to you and no one else.

rows.ko: 하늘이 잠잠하다고 삶까지 잠잠한 건 아니에요. 큰 사건 없는 올해 하늘 아래에서 나온 ‘변화’라는 답은, 당신 스스로 만든 움직임을 가장 정직하게 담고 있습니다.
rows.en: A quiet sky doesn't mean a quiet life. Under this year's uneventful stars, ‘Change’ is the most honest name for the momentum you built yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: A quiet sky doesn't mean a quiet life. Because it came in a year when the sky was uneventful, your answer, ‘Change,’ is the most honest record of the movement you created yourself.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 책임이 무겁게 얹히고 일이 더디게 풀리는 해로 보여 주고 있었습니다. 그 무게 앞에서 잠시 걸음을 세운 ‘멈춤’은 하늘과 같은 이야기를 하고 있어요.
rows.en: The sky showed a year of heavy responsibilities and slow-moving progress. You stopped to catch your breath under that weight, and your ‘Pause’ tells the very same story.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky showed this year as one where responsibility sat heavy and things were slow to come together. Your ‘Pause,’ stopping for a moment under that weight, tells the same story as the sky.

rows.ko: 짐이 무거우면 저절로 걸음이 늦춰지는 때가 있습니다. 올해 하늘도 시험대에 선 듯한 시간과 내 틀을 다시 다지는 흐름을 그리고 있었으니, ‘멈춤’이라는 답이 꼭 맞아요.
rows.en: When the load grows heavy, your pace slows on its own. This year's sky also traced a season of testing and rebuilding your foundations, so ‘Pause’ fits perfectly.
rows.en_before_tone: When the load is heavy, there are times your steps slow down on their own. This year's sky also drew a stretch that felt like being tested, along with a flow of rebuilding your own framework, so ‘Pause’ fits perfectly.

rows.ko: 하늘이 그린 올해는 짐을 다시 꾸리느라 잠시 길가에 선 모습에 가까웠어요. 쌓인 책임을 정리하고 기준을 새로 세우던 그 시간을 ‘멈춤’이라 부른 것은 정확한 이름입니다.
rows.en: In the sky's version, this year looked like stepping to the roadside to repack a heavy bag. You sorted through piled-up responsibilities and set new standards, and ‘Pause’ names that time exactly.
rows.en_before_tone: The year the sky drew looked a lot like stopping by the roadside for a while to repack your bags. Calling that time of sorting through piled-up responsibilities and setting new standards a ‘Pause’ is exactly the right name.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’이라고 느낀 그 마음이 올해를 가장 정확하게 담고 있습니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 새 문이 열리고 도움의 손길이 닿으며 시야가 넓어지는 확장의 흐름도 함께 보여 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: Nothing captures this year better than your sense of ‘Pause’. Alongside it, the sky revealed a season of growth: new doors opening, helping hands reaching you, and your view widening.
rows.en_before_tone: The feeling you named ‘Pause’ captures this year most accurately. Alongside it, the sky also showed a flow of expansion, where new doors open, helping hands reach you, and your view widens.

rows.ko: 하늘의 그림에는 기회가 넓어지고 일이 조금 수월해지는 바람이 불고 있었어요. 그래도 마음이 쉬어 갈 자리를 먼저 원했다면, ‘멈춤’이라는 답이 당신에게는 올해의 정확한 이름입니다.
rows.en: Your chart showed options widening and your path getting easier. You wanted a place to rest first, though, and that makes ‘Pause’ the right name for your year.
rows.en_before_tone: In the sky's picture, a breeze was blowing that widened opportunities and made things a little easier. Even so, if your heart wanted a place to rest first, then ‘Pause’ is this year's true name for you.

rows.ko: 주변이 넓어지고 분주해질 때 오히려 잠시 서고 싶어지는 마음도 있습니다. 올해 하늘이 비춘 확장과 도움의 흐름 곁에서 ‘멈춤’을 고른 그 선택을 그대로 믿으셔도 돼요.
rows.en: When life grows bigger and busier, part of you longs to stand still for a moment. The sky showed growth and support this year, but trust your choice of ‘Pause’ just as it is.
rows.en_before_tone: Sometimes, when everything around you grows wider and busier, you feel like standing still for a moment instead. Even alongside the expansion and support the sky lit up this year, you can trust your choice of ‘Pause’ just as it is.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해 익숙한 방식이 흔들리고 뜻밖의 제안이 이어지는 새 국면을 그리고 있었습니다. 그 소란 속에서 당신이 ‘멈춤’을 원했다면, 그 마음이야말로 올해를 가장 정확하게 말해 줘요.
rows.en: This year your chart sketched a new phase, with familiar routines shaken up and surprise offers arriving. All that commotion made you crave a ‘Pause’, and that feeling says more about your year than anything else.
rows.en_before_tone: This year the sky drew a new phase, with familiar ways shaken and unexpected offers coming one after another. If you wanted a ‘Pause’ in the middle of all that noise, that wish says the most about your year.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’을 고른 한 해, 그 쉼의 감각을 무엇보다 먼저 존중합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 낡은 틀이 바뀌고 뜻밖의 제안과 함께 새 장이 열리는 전환의 흐름도 비추고 있었어요.
rows.en: You chose ‘Pause’ this year, and that need for rest deserves respect above all. Meanwhile, the sky was marking a turning point: old structures changing and a new chapter opening with unexpected offers.
rows.en_before_tone: In a year when you chose ‘Pause,’ we respect that sense of rest above all. Alongside it, the sky was also lighting up a turning-point flow, where old frames change and a new chapter opens with unexpected offers.

rows.ko: 갑작스러운 일들이 몰려오면 몸보다 마음이 먼저 브레이크를 걸기도 해요. 하늘이 보여 준 전환의 기운과 당신이 고른 ‘멈춤’은 서로 다른 쪽에서 같은 해를 비추고 있습니다.
rows.en: When sudden changes pile up, your feelings often hit the brakes before your body does. The sky's turning points and your ‘Pause’ illuminate the same year from two different angles.
rows.en_before_tone: When sudden things pile up, sometimes your heart hits the brakes before your body does. The turning-point energy the sky showed and the ‘Pause’ you chose light up the same year from different sides.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’이라는 답 속에는 잠시 서서 숨을 고른 시간이 담겨 있어요. 하늘은 같은 시기에 오래된 것을 내려놓고 흐려진 자리가 새 모양을 기다리는 정리의 흐름도 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Pause’ holds every moment you stopped to catch your breath. Over the same stretch, the sky was tracing a time of clearing out, with old things set down and an open space waiting for something new.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Pause,’ holds a time of stopping to catch your breath. During the same period, the sky also drew a flow of clearing, where old things are set down and blurred spaces wait for a new shape.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 무언가 끝나고 흩어지며 놓아주는 해로 보여 주고 있었습니다. 그 끝자락에서 걸음을 세운 당신의 ‘멈춤’도, 하늘과 다른 쪽에서 올해를 정확하게 비추는 말이에요.
rows.en: The sky showed a year of endings, scattering, and release. You came to a stop at the end of it all, and your ‘Pause’ captures the year just as truly, from another angle.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky showed this year as one where things end, scatter, and are let go. Your ‘Pause,’ stopping at the tail end of it all, also captures this year accurately, just from a different side than the sky.

rows.ko: 떠나보내는 것들 앞에서는 잠시 그 자리에 서 있고 싶어지기도 합니다. 올해 하늘이 정리와 내려놓기를 비추는 동안, ‘멈춤’이라는 당신의 답은 그 마음을 가장 솔직하게 지켜 주고 있었어요.
rows.en: When you're saying goodbye to things, you naturally want to stand still for a while. As this year's sky spoke of clearing out and letting go, your answer, ‘Pause’, honored that feeling with complete honesty.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're letting things go, you may want to stand still for a while. While this year's sky lit up clearing and letting go, your answer, ‘Pause,’ was keeping that feeling safe in the most honest way.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 앞으로 나아가기보다 지나온 길을 되짚고 숨을 고르는 해로 그리고 있었어요. 미뤄진 일과 다시 꺼내 본 마음들 사이에서 고른 ‘멈춤’이 하늘의 흐름과 그대로 겹칩니다.
rows.en: Your chart, too, drew this as a year to retrace your steps and catch your breath rather than push ahead. Chosen amid delayed plans and feelings you took out for a second look, ‘Pause’ mirrors the sky's rhythm exactly.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, drew this year as one for retracing the road behind you and catching your breath rather than pushing ahead. The ‘Pause’ you chose, amid postponed tasks and feelings you revisited, overlaps exactly with the sky's flow.

rows.ko: ‘멈춤’이라는 답과 올해 하늘은 같은 속도로 걷고 있었습니다. 계획이 한 번씩 늦춰지고 이미 지나간 질문을 다시 들여다보는 장면이 하늘에도 여러 번 그려져 있었어요.
rows.en: Your ‘Pause’ and this year's transits moved at the same speed. Again and again, the sky showed plans being pushed back and old questions surfacing for another look.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Pause,’ and this year's sky were walking at the same pace. The sky, too, showed again and again scenes of plans being pushed back and of revisiting questions you thought had already passed.

rows.ko: 되돌아가 다시 보는 일이 많았던 한 해, 하늘의 그림도 그랬습니다. 서두르지 않고 지난 것을 하나씩 살피며 숨을 고른 그 시간을 ‘멈춤’이라 부른 당신의 감각이 정확해요.
rows.en: This year you kept going back for second looks, and the sky's picture matched. You took your time, sorted through the past piece by piece, and caught your breath, so ‘Pause’ is exactly right.
rows.en_before_tone: It was a year of going back and looking again, and the sky's picture was the same. You called that time of not rushing, examining past things one by one, and catching your breath a ‘Pause,’ and your sense of it is accurate.

rows.ko: 올해 하늘은 큰 사건 없이 비교적 고르게 흘러갔어요. 그런데도 ‘멈춤’이 필요했다면, 그건 하늘이 아니라 당신의 삶과 마음이 직접 보낸 신호이니 그대로 귀 기울일 만합니다.
rows.en: Few major events marked this year's chart; it moved along evenly. Still, you needed a ‘Pause’, and that signal came from your own life and feelings, not the sky. Listen to it.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky flowed fairly evenly, without big events. If you still needed a ‘Pause,’ that's a signal sent straight from your life and heart, not the sky, and it's worth listening to as it is.

rows.ko: ‘이별’이라는 답은 당신이 겪은 한 해를 가장 정확하게 담은 말이에요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 지난 일을 다시 떠올리고 잠시 걸음을 멈추는 되돌아보기의 흐름도 함께 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Farewell’ captures the year you lived more truly than any other word. Next to it, the sky traced a reflective stretch of remembering the past and pausing for a moment.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Farewell,’ is the word that most accurately holds the year you lived. Alongside it, the sky was also drawing a flow of looking back, recalling past events and pausing for a while.

rows.ko: 하늘에는 지나간 일을 다시 꺼내 보고 마음이 자꾸 뒤를 돌아보는 장면이 담겨 있었어요. 그 흐름과 별개로 ‘이별’을 겪은 당신의 시간은 당신만의 속도로 흘러가도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: Your chart showed the past resurfacing and a part of you that kept glancing back. Whatever the sky was doing, let the time after your ‘Farewell’ move at your own pace.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky held scenes of revisiting things that had passed and a heart that keeps looking back. Apart from that flow, your time going through ‘Farewell’ can move at its own pace.

rows.ko: 떠난 것을 몇 번이고 다시 떠올리는 일은 자연스러운 마음의 움직임입니다. 하늘은 되짚기와 쉼의 흐름을 비추고 있었지만, ‘이별’이라는 당신의 말이 먼저이니 그 마음은 서두르지 않고 곁에 둘게요.
rows.en: Returning again and again to what's gone is simply how hearts heal. The sky spoke of reflection and rest, but your word, ‘Farewell’, comes first, so keep that feeling close and give it all the time it needs.
rows.en_before_tone: Recalling what's gone again and again is a natural movement of the heart. The sky was lighting up a flow of retracing and rest, but your word, ‘Farewell,’ comes first, so we'll keep that feeling close without rushing it.

rows.ko: 올해 하늘에는 눈에 띄는 큰 흐름이 많지 않았습니다. 그러니 ‘이별’이라는 말은 하늘이 아닌 당신의 삶에서 온 것이고, 그 마음을 무엇보다 소중하게 받아 둘게요.

rows.en_before_tone: There weren't many big, noticeable flows in this year's sky. So the word ‘Farewell’ came from your life, not the sky, and we'll hold that feeling with the greatest care.

rows.ko: ‘이별’은 하늘이 정해 준 것이 아니라 당신이 직접 지나온 시간의 이름입니다. 잔잔했던 하늘과 달리 마음은 많이 흔들렸을 수 있으니, 그 흔들림을 있는 그대로 인정해 주셔도 돼요.

rows.en_before_tone: Even in a year when the sky flowed quietly, big things can pass through the heart. That's why we'll take our time listening to the word you chose this year, ‘Farewell,’ as the story your life is telling.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 책임이 한꺼번에 몰리고 쉬어 갈 틈이 적은 해로 그리고 있었어요. 그 무게를 매일 짊어진 사람의 말이 ‘고생’이었다는 것, 하늘의 그림과 그대로 겹칩니다.

rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, drew this year as one where responsibilities came all at once and there was little room to rest. That someone who carried that weight every day would choose the word ‘Hardship’ matches the sky's picture exactly.

rows.en: ‘Letting go’ carries a decision to stop pushing yourself so hard. Rest properly first; the new phase and surprise offers the sky showed will still be there when you're ready.
rows.en_before_tone: The words ‘Letting go’ hold a decision not to push yourself any further. It's not too late to look slowly at the new phase and unexpected offers the sky showed, after your heart has had plenty of rest.

rows.ko: 흔들리는 땅 위에서 계속 균형을 잡다 보면 누구라도 힘이 빠집니다. 하늘이 전환과 새 출발의 기운을 비추던 올해, ‘그만하자’를 고른 그 마음을 지금은 그대로 두셔도 돼요.
rows.en: Keeping your balance on shifting ground for so long would drain anyone. In a year charged with turning points and fresh starts, let the part of you that chose ‘Letting go’ simply be, for now.
rows.en_before_tone: Anyone would run out of strength after trying to keep their balance on shifting ground for so long. In a year when the sky was lighting up turning points and fresh starts, it's okay to leave the part of you that chose ‘Letting go’ just as it is for now.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 손에 쥔 것을 하나씩 풀어 놓고 조용히 끝맺는 해로 그리고 있었어요. ‘그만하자’라는 말이 나올 만큼 지친 마음이 그 흐름과 가만히 맞닿아 있습니다.
rows.en: Your chart, too, pictured a year of loosening your grip one thing at a time and quietly bringing it all to a close. You're tired enough to say ‘Letting go’, and your word sits naturally with that picture.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, drew this year as one for loosening your grip on things one by one and quietly bringing them to a close. A heart tired enough to say ‘Letting go’ quietly meets that flow.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’는 포기의 말이라기보다 오래 애쓴 사람의 솔직한 말입니다. 올해 하늘에도 끝맺음과 흩어짐, 그리고 무언가 흐릿해지며 자리를 비우는 시간이 함께 그려져 있었어요.
rows.en: ‘Letting go’ isn't giving up; it's the honest word of someone who has tried hard for a long time. This year's sky also drew endings, drifting apart, and a season when things fade and leave space behind.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Letting go’ is less a word of giving up than an honest word from someone who has tried hard for a long time. This year's sky also drew endings and scattering, together with a time of things fading and leaving space.

rows.ko: 애써 붙들던 것들이 저절로 느슨해지던 한 해, 하늘의 그림도 그랬습니다. 새 모양을 서둘러 찾지 않아도 되는 그 정리의 시간 앞에서 ‘그만하자’를 고른 마음을 그대로 존중해요.
rows.en: Things you'd been clinging to loosened on their own this year, and your chart showed the same. In a season of clearing out, you don't have to hurry toward what's next, and your choice of ‘Letting go’ deserves full respect.
rows.en_before_tone: It was a year when the things you'd tried so hard to hold loosened on their own, and the sky's picture was the same. In this time of clearing, when you don't have to rush to find a new shape, we respect the heart that chose ‘Letting go’ just as it is.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’를 고른 마음 앞에서 하늘의 해석은 잠시 뒤로 미뤄 둘게요. 다만 하늘은 올해 지난 일을 되짚고 잠시 멈춰 서는 흐름도 보여 주고 있었다는 것을 조용히 적어 둡니다.
rows.en: Since you chose ‘Letting go’, let's set the chart reading aside for a moment. We'll simply note that this year's transits also pointed to a time of looking back and pausing.
rows.en_before_tone: For the heart that chose ‘Letting go,’ we'll set the sky's interpretation aside for a moment. We'll just quietly note that this year the sky also showed a flow of retracing past events and stopping for a while.

rows.ko: 하늘에는 일이 미뤄지고 같은 고민을 다시 마주하는 장면이 담겨 있었어요. 같은 자리를 맴도는 시간이 길어지면 지치는 것이 당연하니, ‘그만하자’라는 말을 그대로 믿으셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: The sky held scenes of delays and the same worries returning. Circling the same ground that long would tire anyone, so trust your words, ‘Letting go’.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky held scenes of things being postponed and facing the same worries again. When time spent circling the same place drags on, getting tired is only natural, so you can trust the words ‘Letting go’ as they are.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’는 이제 쉬고 싶다는 마음의 정직한 목소리입니다. 하늘이 비춘 되돌아보기와 쉼의 흐름은 그 곁에 가만히 놓아 두고, 지금은 그 목소리부터 들어 주세요.
rows.en: ‘Letting go’ is the honest voice of the part of you that's ready to rest. Set your chart's themes of reflection and rest gently to one side, and listen to that voice first.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Letting go’ is the honest voice of a heart that wants to rest now. It's okay to gently set the flow of looking back and rest that the sky lit up beside it, and for now, simply listen to that voice first.

rows.ko: 하늘이 잔잔했다고 해서 마음까지 잔잔했던 것은 아니었을 거예요. ‘그만하자’는 하늘이 아닌 당신의 삶이 보낸 신호이니, 그 말을 누구보다 먼저 믿어 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: The sky stayed calm, but that doesn't mean you did. ‘Letting go’ is a signal from your own life, not the stars, so trust it before anyone else does.
rows.en_before_tone: A calm sky doesn't mean your heart was calm too. ‘Letting go’ is a signal from your life, not the sky, so you can trust those words before anyone else.

rows.ko: ‘그만하자’라는 말은 당신이 견뎌 온 일상이 직접 꺼낸 말입니다. 올해 하늘에는 크게 출렁이는 흐름이 드물었으니, 이 지친 마음은 오롯이 당신이 짊어진 시간의 몫이에요.
rows.en: The words ‘Letting go’ came straight from the daily life you've been enduring. This year's sky barely stirred, so this tiredness belongs entirely to everything you carried.
rows.en_before_tone: The words ‘Letting go’ came straight from the everyday life you've endured. Since there were few big swells in this year's sky, this tiredness comes entirely from the time you carried.

rows.ko: 고른 하늘 아래에서도 사람은 충분히 지칠 수 있습니다. 그래서 올해 당신이 고른 ‘그만하자’에는 하늘의 이야기보다 당신이 지나온 하루들의 목소리가 더 크게 담겨 있어요.
rows.en: Even in a quiet year overhead, you can grow thoroughly tired. So the ‘Letting go’ you chose this year speaks more for the days you lived than for anything in your chart.
rows.en_before_tone: People can get thoroughly tired even under an even sky. That's why the ‘Letting go’ you chose this year holds the voices of the days you lived through more loudly than the sky's story.

rows.ko: ‘시작’이라는 답 속에는 무언가에 첫발을 내디딘 용기가 들어 있어요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 책임이 쌓이고 일이 더디게 풀리며 내 틀을 다시 세우는 무게도 함께 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: ‘Beginning’ holds the courage it took to set foot on something new. Alongside it, the sky also showed the year's weight: responsibilities building, slow progress, and you rebuilding your own framework.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Beginning,’ holds the courage of taking a first step into something. Alongside it, the sky also showed the weight of responsibilities piling up, things coming together slowly, and rebuilding your own framework.

rows.ko: 하늘에는 무거운 짐을 다시 꾸리고 차근차근 기초를 다지는 장면이 담겨 있었습니다. 그 와중에도 새로 손을 댄 것이 있다면, ‘시작’이라는 당신의 답이 올해를 가장 정확하게 기억하고 있어요.
rows.en: This year's chart held scenes of repacking a heavy load and laying the groundwork step by step. You still started something new in the middle of all that, and your answer, ‘Beginning’, remembers this year best.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky held scenes of repacking a heavy load and laying foundations step by step. If you still put your hand to something new in the middle of it, your answer, ‘Beginning,’ remembers this year most accurately.

rows.ko: 무거운 해일수록 작은 첫걸음 하나가 더 큰 의미를 가집니다. 하늘이 시험과 책임의 흐름을 비추던 올해, 당신이 고른 ‘시작’을 그 무게 곁에 또렷하게 적어 둘게요.
rows.en: The heavier the year, the more a small first step means. In a year when the sky spoke of tests and responsibility, write your ‘Beginning’ down clearly, right beside that weight.
rows.en_before_tone: The heavier the year, the more a small first step means. In this year, when the sky lit up a flow of tests and responsibility, we'll write the ‘Beginning’ you chose clearly beside that weight.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 문이 열리고 도와주는 사람이 곁에 서는 해로 보여 주고 있었습니다. 그 순풍을 타고 용기 내어 첫걸음을 뗀 당신의 ‘시작’이 하늘의 그림과 잘 어울려요.
rows.en: Your chart revealed a year of open doors and people stepping up to help. You found the courage to take your first step with that tailwind at your back, and your ‘Beginning’ fits that picture beautifully.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky showed this year as one where doors open and helpful people stand by your side. Your ‘Beginning,’ the first step you bravely took riding that tailwind, goes well with the sky's picture.

rows.ko: ‘시작’을 고른 한 해에 하늘도 넉넉한 확장의 기운을 보여 주고 있었어요. 새로 배우고 넓혀 가는 일이 평소보다 조금 수월하게 풀리고, 곁에서 돕는 손길도 이어지던 흐름이었습니다.
rows.en: In the year you chose ‘Beginning’, the sky poured out generous, expansive energy. Learning and branching out came easier than usual, and helping hands kept arriving along the way.
rows.en_before_tone: In the year you chose ‘Beginning,’ the sky also showed a generous energy of expansion. It was a flow where learning and growing went a little more smoothly than usual, and helping hands kept coming.

rows.ko: 처음 해 보는 일이 생각보다 순조롭게 굴러간 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 하늘도 올해를 배움과 기회가 넓어지는 해로 그렸으니, ‘시작’이라는 답과 잘 맞닿아 있습니다.
rows.en: More than once, something you tried for the first time went more smoothly than you expected. The sky drew a year of widening chances to learn and grow, so it fits your ‘Beginning’ perfectly.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when something you tried for the first time went more smoothly than you expected. The sky also drew this year as one where learning and opportunities widen, so it connects well with your answer, ‘Beginning.’

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 익숙한 방식이 흔들리고 새 장이 열리는 해로 그리고 있었어요. 낯선 제안 앞에서 망설이면서도 첫발을 뗀 당신의 ‘시작’이 그 흐름과 정확히 겹칩니다.
rows.en: The sky, too, drew a year of familiar ways shaking loose and a new chapter opening. You hesitated before unfamiliar offers but stepped forward anyway, and your ‘Beginning’ matches that current exactly.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, drew this year as one where familiar ways shake and a new chapter opens. Your ‘Beginning,’ taking a first step even while hesitating when faced with unfamiliar offers, overlaps exactly with that flow.

rows.ko: ‘시작’이라는 답은 올해 하늘이 보여 준 장면과 같은 쪽을 보고 있습니다. 뜻밖의 기회가 불쑥 나타나고 오래된 틀이 바뀌며 새 국면으로 넘어가는 흐름이 하늘에 짙었어요.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Beginning’, faces the same direction as this year's sky. The stars were charged with surprise opportunities, old structures changing, and a move into a new phase.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Beginning,’ looks in the same direction as the scenes this year's sky showed. The sky was full of a flow where unexpected chances pop up, old frames change, and things move into a new phase.

rows.ko: 예정에 없던 문이 갑자기 열린 한 해, 하늘의 그림도 그랬습니다. 흔들림 속에서도 새 페이지를 넘긴 그 순간을 ‘시작’이라 부른 당신의 감각이 정확하고 반가워요.
rows.en: Doors you never planned on swung open this year, and the sky's picture said the same. You turned a new page amid all the upheaval and called it ‘Beginning’, a name that is exactly right and a joy to hear.
rows.en_before_tone: It was a year when an unplanned door suddenly opened, and the sky's picture was the same. You called the moment you turned a new page, even amid the shaking, a ‘Beginning,’ and your sense of it is accurate and lovely to see.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 오래된 것이 끝나고 흐려지며 자리를 비워 가는 해로 그리고 있었어요. 그 비워진 자리 곁에서 당신이 먼저 느낀 것이 ‘시작’이었다면, 그 감각이 가장 정확합니다.
rows.en: The sky drew a year of old things ending, fading, and clearing space. What you felt first beside that empty space was ‘Beginning’, and that sense is the truest one.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky drew this year as one where old things end, blur, and make room. If what you felt first beside that empty space was a ‘Beginning,’ that sense is the most accurate.

rows.ko: 새로 손에 쥔 것이 있었기에 ‘시작’이라는 말이 먼저 떠올랐을 거예요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 오래된 무언가를 내려놓고 끝맺는 정리의 흐름도 조용히 비추고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Something new landed in your hands, which is why ‘Beginning’ came to mind first. At the same time, the sky was quietly lighting up a season of clearing out, setting down something old and wrapping it up.
rows.en_before_tone: The word ‘Beginning’ probably came to mind first because you had something new in your hands. Alongside it, the sky was also quietly lighting up a flow of clearing, setting down something old and bringing it to a close.

rows.ko: 끝나는 것과 열리는 것은 종종 같은 해에 나란히 찾아옵니다. 하늘이 놓아주기와 흩어짐을 비추는 동안 당신이 붙잡은 단어는 ‘시작’이었고, 그 기록을 그대로 믿으셔도 돼요.
rows.en: Endings and openings often arrive side by side in the same year. While the sky lit up letting go and drifting apart, you reached for ‘Beginning’, so trust that record just as it is.
rows.en_before_tone: Endings and openings often arrive side by side in the same year. While the sky lit up letting go and scattering, the word you held on to was ‘Beginning,’ and you can trust that record as it is.

rows.ko: 무언가를 새로 열어 본 한 해였다면 ‘시작’이라는 답이 정확합니다. 하늘은 그 곁에서 잠시 걸음을 늦추고 예전 계획을 다시 펼쳐 보는 흐름도 함께 그리고 있었어요.
rows.en: You opened something new this year, which makes ‘Beginning’ the right answer. Next to it, the sky traced a slower stretch of easing your pace and unfolding old plans for another look.
rows.en_before_tone: If this was a year when you opened up something new, the answer ‘Beginning’ is exactly right. Alongside it, the sky was also drawing a flow of slowing down for a while and taking another look at old plans.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 지나온 길을 되짚고 일정이 몇 번씩 늦춰지는 해로 그리고 있었습니다. 그 느린 흐름 속에서도 첫발을 뗀 것이 있다면, ‘시작’은 당신이 직접 겪은 한 해의 정확한 이름이에요.
rows.en: Schedules slipped more than once in the sky's picture of a year spent retracing your steps. You still took a first step in that slow current, and ‘Beginning’ is the true name for the year you lived.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky drew this year as one for retracing the road behind you, with schedules pushed back a few times. If you still took a first step somewhere in that slow flow, ‘Beginning’ is the accurate name of the year you lived.

rows.ko: 다시 들여다본 끝에야 보이는 출발선도 있어요. 하늘이 비춘 되짚기와 미뤄짐의 흐름 곁에, 당신이 그 사이에서 직접 그은 ‘시작’의 선을 올해의 기록으로 함께 적어 둡니다.
rows.en: Some starting lines only appear after a second look. Beside the sky's reflection and delays, record the ‘Beginning’ you drew yourself as part of this year's story.
rows.en_before_tone: Some starting lines only appear after you've looked again. Next to the flow of retracing and delay the sky lit up, we'll also note the line of ‘Beginning’ you drew yourself in the middle of it all, as part of this year's record.

rows.ko: 하늘이 길을 크게 열어 주지 않은 해에 무언가를 새로 꺼냈다면, 그건 순전히 당신의 힘입니다. 올해 하늘은 비교적 잔잔했으니 ‘시작’은 당신이 스스로 고른 출발로 읽혀요.
rows.en: You started something new in a year when the stars didn't clear the path for you, and that took your own strength. Your chart stayed mostly quiet, so ‘Beginning’ reads as a start you chose on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: If you started something new in a year when the sky didn't throw the road wide open, that's purely your own strength. This year's sky was fairly calm, so ‘Beginning’ reads as a start you chose for yourself.

rows.ko: ‘시작’이라는 답은 하늘이 아니라 당신의 결심에서 나온 말입니다. 고요한 하늘 아래에서 스스로 그은 출발선이기에, 그 첫걸음은 더욱 당신다운 기록으로 오래 남아요.
rows.en: ‘Beginning’ came from your own decision, not the sky. You drew that starting line yourself under a quiet sky, so your first step endures as something truly yours.
rows.en_before_tone: Your answer, ‘Beginning,’ came from your own decision, not the sky. Because it's a starting line you drew yourself under a quiet sky, that first step will stay with you as a record that's all the more yours.

rows.ko: 잔잔한 하늘은 무언가를 대신 정해 주거나 등을 떠밀어 주지 않아요. 그런 해에 당신이 고른 ‘시작’은 오롯이 당신의 마음과 삶이 먼저 움직여서 만들어 낸 결과입니다.
rows.en: A calm sky won't make decisions for you or give you a push. In a year like that, your ‘Beginning’ happened because you took the first step yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: A calm sky doesn't decide things for you or give you a push. In a year like that, the ‘Beginning’ you chose is the result of your own heart and life moving first.

rows.ko: 가슴 뛰는 순간을 기억한다는 것, 그 자체가 올해의 소중한 기록이에요. 하늘은 그 ‘설렘’ 곁에서 책임이 쌓이고 걸음이 느려지며 내 틀을 다시 다지는 무게도 함께 보여 주고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Remembering the moments that made your heart race is a precious record of this year in itself. Alongside those ‘Butterflies’, the sky also showed some weight: responsibilities stacking up, a slower pace, and the work of rebuilding your foundations.
rows.en_before_tone: Remembering moments that made your heart race is itself a precious record of this year. Next to that ‘Excitement,’ the sky also showed the weight of responsibilities piling up, steps slowing, and rebuilding your own framework.

rows.ko: 하늘에는 맡은 몫이 커지고 하나씩 시험받는 듯한 장면이 담겨 있었어요. 그 무게 속에서도 마음이 반짝인 순간이 있었다면, ‘설렘’은 당신만이 알아본 올해의 정확한 얼굴입니다.
rows.en: In the sky's picture, your workload grew and every turn felt like a test. You still lit up in the middle of it all, and ‘Butterflies’ is the true face of this year, one only you could spot.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky held scenes of your share growing and of feeling tested one thing at a time. If there were moments your heart sparkled even under that weight, ‘Excitement’ is the true face of this year that only you noticed.

rows.ko: 무거운 날들 사이에 끼어 있던 작은 기쁨은 더 오래 빛나기도 합니다. 하늘이 시험과 책임의 흐름을 비추던 올해, 당신이 먼저 떠올린 ‘설렘’을 그대로 믿으셔도 돼요.
rows.en: Small joys tucked between heavy days shine all the longer. This year carried tests and responsibility, so trust the ‘Butterflies’ that came to mind first.
rows.en_before_tone: Small joys tucked between heavy days can shine even longer. In this year, when the sky lit up a flow of tests and responsibility, you can trust the ‘Excitement’ that came to your mind first.

rows.ko: 하늘도 올해를 새로운 문이 열리고 반가운 도움이 이어지는 해로 그리고 있었어요. 마음이 들뜨던 순간들을 ‘설렘’이라 부른 당신의 답이 그 흐름과 무척 닮았습니다.
rows.en: Overhead, new doors opened and welcome help arrived one after another this year. You named those thrilling moments ‘Butterflies’, and your answer mirrors that current beautifully.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky, too, drew this year as one where new doors open and welcome help keeps coming. Calling those buoyant moments ‘Excitement’ fits that flow beautifully.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’이라는 답에서 넓어지는 세상을 마주한 사람의 밝은 표정이 보여요. 올해 하늘에도 배울 거리가 늘고 막혔던 일이 한결 순하게 풀리는 확장의 기운이 넉넉했습니다.
rows.en: In ‘Butterflies’, you see the bright face of someone watching their world open up. This year's sky brimmed with expansive energy too, with more to learn and stuck situations finally loosening.
rows.en_before_tone: In your answer, ‘Excitement,’ we can see the bright face of someone meeting a widening world. This year's sky was also rich with an energy of expansion, with more to learn and stuck things easing up.

rows.ko: 누군가 먼저 손을 내밀어 주거나 기다리던 기회가 찾아온 한 해였을 수 있어요. 하늘도 그런 넓어짐의 흐름을 보여 주고 있었으니, ‘설렘’은 하늘과 같은 온도의 말입니다.
rows.en: Someone reaching out first, a long-awaited opportunity finally knocking: that is the kind of year ‘Butterflies’ describes. The sky showed the same expansion, so your word shares its warmth.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when someone reached out first, or a chance you'd been waiting for arrived. The sky showed that kind of widening flow too, so ‘Excitement’ is a word with the same warmth as the sky.

rows.ko: 하늘은 올해를 익숙한 틀이 흔들리고 뜻밖의 제안이 날아드는 새 국면으로 그리고 있었습니다. 낯선 것 앞에서 가슴이 뛰었다면, ‘설렘’이라는 답이 그 장면과 그대로 맞닿아요.
rows.en: The sky drew a new phase this year, with familiar structures shaken and surprise offers flying in. Unfamiliar things set your heart racing, and your answer, ‘Butterflies’, matches that scene.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky drew this year as a new phase, with familiar frames shaken and unexpected offers flying in. If new things made your heart race, your answer, ‘Excitement,’ matches that scene exactly.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’과 올해 하늘은 같은 바람을 맞고 있었어요. 예상 밖의 길이 열리고 익숙한 틀이 흔들리며 새 장으로 넘어가는 전환의 기운이 하늘에 짙게 그려져 있었습니다.
rows.en: Your ‘Butterflies’ and this year's sky were catching the same wind. Turning-point energy ran thick overhead: unexpected paths opening, familiar structures wobbling, and a move into a new chapter.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Excitement’ and this year's sky were facing the same wind. The sky was full of turning-point energy, with unexpected paths opening, familiar frames shaking, and a move into a new chapter.

rows.ko: 달라지는 것들이 두렵기보다 궁금하게 느껴진 한 해였다면, 하늘도 그 이야기를 하고 있었어요. 판이 새로 짜이는 흐름 속에서 고른 ‘설렘’이 올해를 무척 잘 담고 있습니다.
rows.en: Change felt more intriguing than frightening this year, and the sky was telling the same story. Chosen as the board was being reset, ‘Butterflies’ captures your year beautifully.
rows.en_before_tone: If this was a year when changes felt more intriguing than frightening, the sky was telling that story too. The ‘Excitement’ you chose while everything was being rearranged captures this year beautifully.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’이라고 답한 마음이 올해를 가장 정확하게 기억하고 있어요. 하늘은 같은 시기에 오래된 것을 내려놓고 흐려진 자리를 비워 가는 정리의 흐름도 함께 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Your answer, ‘Butterflies’, remembers this year best. Over the same stretch, the sky traced a season of clearing out, setting old things down and emptying the spaces that had faded.
rows.en_before_tone: The heart that answered ‘Excitement’ remembers this year most accurately. During the same period, the sky was also drawing a flow of clearing, setting down old things and emptying out blurred spaces.

rows.ko: 하늘에는 손에서 놓여 가는 것들과 아직 형태가 흐릿한 시간이 담겨 있었습니다. 그 사이로 새어 든 ‘설렘’을 먼저 알아본 건 당신이니, 그 감각을 올해의 이름으로 지켜 주세요.
rows.en: The sky held things slipping from your hands and a stretch where nothing had a clear shape yet. You were the first to notice the ‘Butterflies’ stirring in between, so keep that feeling as the name for your year.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky held things slipping from your hands and a time when shapes were still blurry. You were the first to notice the ‘Excitement’ that seeped in between, so it's worth holding on to that feeling as the name of this year.

rows.ko: 비워진 자리에는 뜻밖의 기대가 스며들기도 해요. 하늘이 정리와 내려놓기, 흐려짐의 흐름을 비추는 동안 당신은 ‘설렘’을 골랐고, 직접 느낀 그 감각이 가장 정확합니다.
rows.en: Unexpected hope often slips into the space left behind. While the sky lit up clearing out, letting go, and fading, you chose ‘Butterflies’, and what you felt firsthand is the truest guide.
rows.en_before_tone: Unexpected hope can seep into empty spaces. While the sky lit up a flow of clearing, letting go, and blurring, you chose ‘Excitement,’ and that feeling you lived firsthand is the most accurate.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’을 고른 한 해라면 마음이 앞으로 기울던 순간이 많았겠지요. 하늘은 그 곁에서 지난 일을 다시 들여다보고 잠시 쉬어 가는 되돌아보기의 흐름도 함께 그리고 있었습니다.
rows.en: Choosing ‘Butterflies’ means you leaned toward what's ahead again and again this year. Next to it, the sky traced a reflective stretch of looking back and taking a breather.
rows.en_before_tone: If you chose ‘Excitement’ this year, there were probably many moments when your heart leaned forward. Alongside it, the sky was also drawing a flow of looking back, revisiting past events and resting for a while.

rows.ko: 하늘에는 오래된 연락이 다시 닿거나 접어 둔 계획을 다시 펼쳐 보는 장면이 담겨 있었어요. 그런 흐름 속에서도 마음이 들떴다면, ‘설렘’은 당신이 직접 느낀 올해의 정확한 온도입니다.
rows.en: Old friends got back in touch and shelved plans unfolded again in this year's chart. Your spirits still lifted in that current, and ‘Butterflies’ is the true temperature of your year, just as you felt it.
rows.en_before_tone: The sky held scenes of old contacts getting back in touch or folded-up plans being unfolded again. If your heart still felt buoyant in that flow, ‘Excitement’ is the true temperature of the year you felt firsthand.

rows.ko: 느리게 흐르는 해에도 마음은 얼마든지 두근거릴 수 있습니다. 하늘이 되짚기와 쉼의 흐름을 비추던 올해, 당신이 고른 ‘설렘’을 누구보다 먼저 믿어 주셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: Even in a slow-moving year, your heart is free to race. Your chart pointed to reflection and rest, yet you can trust your ‘Butterflies’ before anyone else's take.
rows.en_before_tone: Even in a slow-moving year, your heart can flutter as much as it likes. In this year, when the sky lit up a flow of retracing and rest, you can trust the ‘Excitement’ you chose before anyone else does.

rows.ko: 올해 하늘은 큰 흐름 없이 비교적 고요했어요. 그런데도 ‘설렘’을 느꼈다면, 그 두근거림은 하늘이 건넨 것이 아니라 당신의 삶이 스스로 찾아내고 만들어 낸 것입니다.
rows.en: No big currents stirred the sky this year. You felt ‘Butterflies’ anyway, so that thrill wasn't a gift from the stars; your own life went looking for it and made it happen.
rows.en_before_tone: This year's sky was fairly quiet, without big flows. If you still felt ‘Excitement,’ that flutter wasn't handed to you by the sky; your own life found it and made it.

rows.ko: ‘설렘’은 당신이 일상 속에서 직접 찾아내고 정성껏 키워 온 마음입니다. 하늘이 잔잔했던 해였기에, 그 반짝임은 온전히 당신의 하루하루에서 피어난 것으로 읽혀요.
rows.en: ‘Butterflies’ is a feeling you found in your everyday life and nurtured with care. Because the sky stayed calm this year, that spark bloomed entirely out of your own days.
rows.en_before_tone: ‘Excitement’ is a feeling you found in your everyday life and lovingly nurtured yourself. Because the sky was calm this year, that sparkle reads as something that bloomed entirely from your own days.

rows.ko: 조용한 하늘 아래에서 가슴 뛰는 일을 발견하는 건 꽤 멋진 재주예요. 올해 당신이 고른 ‘설렘’은 그래서 더욱 당신다운 한 해, 당신이 직접 빚은 표정으로 남습니다.
rows.en: Finding something that makes your heart race under a quiet sky is a rare gift. That's why the ‘Butterflies’ you chose this year feel so much like you, a radiance you created all on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: Finding something that makes your heart race under a quiet sky is a pretty wonderful talent. That's why the ‘Excitement’ you chose this year remains all the more yours, an expression you shaped yourself.

A12d.name: 2026 회고 — 단어 × 고민 영역
A12d.used_in: 3번 섹션(2026 회고) 전환점(A18) 뒤 한 문단. Q2 단어 × Q1 고민 영역 칸에서 출생정보 해시로 3개 중 하나

rows.ko: 맡은 일을 쉽게 내려놓지 못하고 출근길마다 이번 하루만 넘기자며 마음을 다잡은 날이 많았을 수 있어요. 그렇게 자리를 지킨 시간 덕분에 내가 어디까지 감당할 수 있는지도 조금 더 알게 되었을 겁니다.
rows.en: Many mornings, you couldn't set your workload down, and on the commute you told yourself, "Just get through today." Showing up like that, day after day, taught you how much you can truly carry.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have had many days when you couldn't easily put your work down and steadied yourself on the way in, telling yourself to just get through today. Thanks to the time you held your ground like that, you probably learned a little more about how much you can handle.

rows.ko: 회의에서 하고 싶은 말을 삼키고 메신저 알림에 마음을 졸이며 하루를 넘긴 날이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 견디는 데 쓴 힘도 일의 일부였다는 것을 스스로 알아주셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: You bit your tongue in meetings and spent whole days bracing for the next ping from work chat. Give yourself credit: the strength it took to endure was part of the job, too.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you swallowed what you wanted to say in meetings and got through the day on edge over every message notification. It's okay to give yourself credit: the strength you spent enduring was part of the work too.

rows.ko: 계속 남을지 다른 길을 찾을지 고민하면서도 일단은 자리를 지키며 한 해를 건너왔을 수 있어요. 결정을 미룬 것이 아니라 내 마음이 준비될 때를 기다린 시간이었을 수도 있습니다.
rows.en: All year, you weighed staying against moving on, and still you held your ground for now. You weren't dodging a decision. You were waiting until you were ready, and that takes its own kind of wisdom.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have made it through this year holding your ground for now, while wondering whether to stay or look for another path. Rather than putting off a decision, you may have been waiting until your heart was ready.

rows.ko: 준비하던 공부나 시험이 생각만큼 속도가 나지 않아도 책상 앞을 떠나지 않으려 애쓴 날들이 있었을 수 있습니다. 진도가 느린 날에도 자리를 지켰다는 것 자체가 하나의 실력이에요.
rows.en: Your studies or exam prep moved slower than you hoped, yet you kept yourself at the desk anyway. Holding steady on the slow days is a skill in its own right.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days when the studying or exam you were preparing for didn't move as fast as you hoped, yet you tried not to leave your desk. Staying put even on slow days is a skill in itself.

rows.ko: 주변이 하나둘 길을 정해 가는 것처럼 보여 조급해질 때도 내 방향을 놓지 않으려 애썼을지도 몰라요. 남의 속도 대신 내 걸음을 기준으로 올해를 돌아보면 꽤 멀리 온 것이 보일 수 있습니다.
rows.en: As the people around you seemed to settle on their paths one by one, the rush pressed in, and still you kept hold of your own direction. Measure this year by your own steps, not anyone else's pace, and you'll see how far you've come.
rows.en_before_tone: When it seemed like people around you were settling on their paths one by one and you felt rushed, you may have tried hard not to lose your own direction. If you look back on this year by your own steps instead of someone else's pace, you may see how far you've come.

rows.ko: 무엇을 해야 할지 뚜렷하지 않은 채로 하루의 할 일만 붙들고 지낸 시간이 길었을 수 있어요. 답이 늦게 오는 질문일수록 그 시간을 견딘 경험이 다음 선택의 바탕이 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: For a long stretch, the next step stayed blurry, so you held on to each day's to-do list. The questions that answer slowest reward the waiting most: what you endured now grounds your next choice.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have spent a long time holding on to just the day's to-do list without a clear sense of what to do. When a question's answer is slow to come, the experience of getting through that wait can become the ground for your next choice.
rows.note: 원문 맥락상 '답이 늦게 오는 질문일수록'을 의역함

rows.ko: 마음이 엇갈리는 순간에도 관계를 놓지 않으려 먼저 연락하고 기다린 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 지키고 싶은 마음만큼 그 안에서 내 마음이 편안한지도 함께 살펴볼 만합니다.
rows.en: Even when you two weren't on the same page, you texted first and waited, because you weren't ready to let go. Protect what matters to you, and ask yourself just as honestly whether you feel at ease in it.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you reached out first and waited, so as not to let the relationship go, even when your feelings didn't line up. As much as you want to protect it, it's worth checking whether your own heart feels at ease in it too.

rows.ko: 누군가를 향한 마음이나 혼자인 시간을 조용히 견디며 아무렇지 않은 척한 밤이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그런 밤을 조용히 지나온 내 마음에도 스스로 건네는 다정한 말 한마디가 필요해요.
rows.en: Some nights you quietly carried feelings for someone, or the weight of being alone, and acted like everything was fine. You made it through those nights, so offer yourself a kind word tonight.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been nights you quietly endured feelings for someone, or time alone, while pretending everything was fine. Your heart, which came quietly through those nights, needs a kind word from you too.
