rows.ko: 바쁜 일상에 밀려 연애에 대한 고민은 뒤로 미뤄 두고 하루하루를 넘기는 데 집중했을 수도 있어요. 그 시간을 놓친 시간이 아니라 관계보다 나를 먼저 챙긴 시간이었다고 이름 붙여도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: Life got so full that you shelved your love life and focused on getting through each day. Don't call that lost time. Call it the season you put yourself before a relationship.
rows.en_before_tone: Pushed by a busy daily life, you may have set aside thoughts about love and focused on getting through each day. It's okay to see that not as lost time, but as time you chose to take care of yourself before a relationship.

rows.ko: 집안의 걱정거리를 혼자 짊어지고 아무렇지 않은 얼굴로 하루를 보낸 날들이 있었을 수 있습니다. 가족을 지키느라 애쓴 만큼 나를 쉬게 할 틈도 조금씩 만들어 주세요.
rows.en: You carried your family's worries on your own and still wore a brave face. You've worked hard to protect them; now carve out small pockets of rest for yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you carried family worries alone and went about your day with a face that said everything was fine. As much as you've worked to look after your family, it's worth making a little room, bit by bit, for yourself to rest too.

rows.ko: 가족과의 대화가 자꾸 어긋나도 서운함을 삼키고 식탁에 다시 앉은 날이 있었을지도 몰라요. 모든 마음을 맞추지 못했어도 그 자리를 지키려 한 노력은 가족 안에 조용히 남아 있습니다.
rows.en: Family conversations kept going wrong, and still you held back the hurt and came back to the table. You couldn't make everyone feel understood, but your steadfast presence left its mark on your family.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days when conversations with your family kept going sideways, yet you swallowed your hurt and sat back down at the table. Even if not every feeling lined up, your effort to keep your place there quietly remains within the family.

rows.ko: 명절이나 안부 전화처럼 마음이 무거워지는 순간들을 한 번씩 넘기며 올해를 지나왔을 수 있어요. 가족과의 거리를 내가 감당할 만큼으로 정해 보는 것도 나를 지키는 방법입니다.
rows.en: This year meant getting through one heavy moment after another, from holiday gatherings to dutiful check-in calls. Set the distance from family that you can truly manage. That is how you look after yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have come through this year by getting past, one by one, the moments that weigh on your heart, like holidays or check-in calls. Setting your distance from family at a level you can handle is also a way of protecting yourself.
rows.note: 명절(설·추석)은 'holidays'로 일반화함

rows.ko: 불편한 모임이나 단톡방에서도 분위기를 깨지 않으려 웃으며 자리를 지킨 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 모든 관계를 같은 힘으로 붙들지 않아도 괜찮다는 것을 기억해 두셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: You smiled your way through awkward get-togethers and group chats to keep the peace. Remember this: not every relationship needs the same tight grip.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you smiled and stayed in uncomfortable gatherings or group chats so as not to spoil the mood. It's worth remembering that you don't have to hold on to every relationship with the same strength.
rows.note: 단톡방 → group chats

rows.ko: 부탁을 거절하지 못해 내 일은 뒤로 미루면서까지 사람들 사이에서 애써 왔을지도 모릅니다. 내 몫을 지키는 작은 거절 하나를 연습해 보는 것도 관계를 오래 편안하게 지키는 방법이에요.
rows.en: You bent over backwards for the people around you, pushing your own tasks aside because you couldn't say no. Practice one small "no" that protects your time; that is how friendships stay comfortable for the long haul.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have worked hard to keep things good between people, even pushing your own tasks back because you couldn't say no. Practicing one small "no" that protects your share is also a way to keep relationships comfortable for the long run.

rows.ko: 마음 나눌 사람이 곁에 없다고 느끼면서도 혼자서 하루를 꾸려 간 시간이 있었을 수 있어요. 그 시간을 지나온 나에게 가장 먼저 안부를 물어 주는 사람이 되어 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Even when no one seemed close enough to confide in, you kept your days running on your own. Now be the first to ask yourself how you're really doing.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been times you felt there was no one nearby to share your heart with, yet you kept your days going on your own. You can be the first person to ask how you're doing, after all you've been through.

rows.ko: 늘어나는 생활비 앞에서 사고 싶은 것을 몇 번씩 내려놓으며 한 달 한 달을 꾸려 왔을 수 있습니다. 아껴 온 날들이 쌓여 내가 지키고 싶은 생활의 기준도 조금 더 또렷해졌을 거예요.
rows.en: As living costs climbed, you put wish-list items back on the shelf again and again and steered through month after month. All those careful days sharpened your sense of the life you want to protect.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have managed month after month by putting back things you wanted to buy, again and again, in the face of rising living costs. As those careful days added up, your sense of the kind of life you want to protect has probably grown a little clearer.

rows.ko: 통장 잔고를 확인할 때마다 마음이 조여 와도 내색하지 않고 일상을 이어 간 날이 있었을지도 몰라요. 불안을 혼자 품기보다 지출의 리듬을 한 번 적어 보는 것만으로도 숨이 조금 트일 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Your stomach dropped every time you checked your bank balance, yet you kept going without letting it show. Don't hold that worry alone: write down your spending rhythm once, and give yourself room to breathe.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days your chest tightened every time you checked your bank balance, yet you kept your daily life going without showing it. Rather than holding that worry alone, just writing down the rhythm of your spending once may help you breathe a little easier.

rows.ko: 갑작스러운 지출이 생길 때마다 계획을 다시 짜며 생활의 균형을 붙들고 있었을 수 있어요. 처음 세운 계획을 완벽하게 지키는 것보다 흔들려도 다시 맞추는 힘이 생활을 오래 지켜 줍니다.
rows.en: Each surprise expense sent you back to rework your plans and keep life in balance. Following the first plan perfectly matters less than the strength to readjust when things wobble, and you're building exactly that.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have been holding on to the balance of daily life, redoing your plans every time a sudden expense came up. More than following your first plan perfectly, the strength to readjust even when things wobble is what keeps your life steady over time.

rows.ko: 새로 맡은 일이나 낯선 업무 앞에서 모르는 것을 묻고 하나씩 익혀 가며 한 해를 보냈을 수 있어요. 처음엔 서툴던 일이 어느새 손에 익었다면 그것이 올해 쌓은 가장 또렷한 기록입니다.
rows.en: New responsibilities and unfamiliar tasks filled your year, and you met them by asking questions and learning one step at a time. Work that once felt clumsy is now second nature, the clearest record of what you built this year.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have spent the year asking about what you didn't know and learning things one by one as you took on a new role or unfamiliar tasks. If work that felt clumsy at first has become second nature, that's the clearest record you built this year.

rows.ko: 실수나 아쉬운 피드백을 겪으며 일하는 방식을 조금씩 고쳐 간 순간들이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그때 익힌 것은 다음 자리에서도 나를 도와주는 나만의 요령으로 남을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Mistakes and tough feedback pushed you to refine how you work, bit by bit. What you learned there becomes your own know-how, and it travels with you wherever you go next.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when you gradually adjusted how you work after mistakes or disappointing feedback. What you learned then can stay with you as your own know-how, helping you in your next role too.

rows.ko: 함께 일하는 사람들을 보며 일을 대하는 태도나 말하는 법을 새로 익힌 한 해였을 수 있어요. 올해 닮고 싶었던 모습 하나를 적어 두면 내년의 일하는 방식을 고르는 기준이 됩니다.
rows.en: Watching the people you work with, you picked up new ways to approach the job and to speak up. Write down one quality you admired this year, and let it guide how you work next year.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when you picked up new attitudes toward work or ways of speaking by watching the people you work with. If you write down one quality you wanted to emulate this year, it becomes a guide for choosing how you'll work next year.

rows.ko: 강의나 책, 자격증 준비처럼 시간을 내어 무언가를 새로 익힌 날들이 꽤 있었을 수 있습니다. 끝까지 다 하지 못했더라도 시작해 본 공부는 이미 내 안에 흔적을 남겼어요.
rows.en: Classes, books, certification prep: you made time to learn something new on more days than you realize. Even the studies you didn't finish have already left their mark on you.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been quite a few days you made time to learn something new, like classes, books, or preparing for a certification. Even if you didn't finish, the studying you started has already left its mark on you.

rows.ko: 계획대로 되지 않은 일을 겪으면서 오히려 내가 무엇을 좋아하고 잘하는지 조금씩 알게 되었을지도 몰라요. 실패처럼 보였던 순간도 진로를 좁혀 준 소중한 공부였을 수 있습니다.
rows.en: When plans fell through, you started discovering what you love and what you're good at. Even the moments that looked like failures were valuable lessons that narrowed your path.
rows.en_before_tone: Going through things that didn't go as planned, you may have actually started to learn, little by little, what you like and what you're good at. Even moments that looked like failure may have been valuable lessons that narrowed down your path.

rows.ko: 남들이 정한 길보다 내게 맞는 속도와 방식을 찾는 법을 익힌 해였을 수 있어요. 무엇을 알게 되었는지만큼 내가 어떤 방식으로 배우는 사람인지 알게 된 것도 올해의 큰 수확입니다.
rows.en: Instead of following someone else's map, you learned to find the pace and approach that suit you. Knowing what kind of learner you are is as big a harvest as anything you studied.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when you learned to find a pace and approach that suits you, rather than a path others set. As much as what you learned, discovering what kind of learner you are is one of this year's big gains too.

rows.ko: 누군가와 가까워지거나 멀어지는 과정에서 내가 관계에서 무엇을 바라는지 새삼 알게 되었을 수 있어요. 그 깨달음은 다음에도 나를 더 편안하게 지켜 주는 기준이 되어 줄 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Growing close to someone, or drifting apart, showed you once more what you truly want from a relationship. Carry that insight forward; it keeps you at ease the next time around.
rows.en_before_tone: In the process of growing closer to or apart from someone, you may have realized anew what you want in a relationship. That realization can become a guide that keeps you more at ease next time, too.

rows.ko: 마음을 표현하는 방식이나 서운함을 전하는 말투를 고민하며 조금씩 다르게 해 본 순간이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 서툴러도 다르게 시도해 본 그 한 번이 관계를 익혀 가는 큰 걸음이에요.
rows.en: You rethought how you show your feelings and how you voice hurt, and you tried it a new way. Awkward or not, that one attempt is a big step in learning the art of love.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when you thought about how you express your feelings or how you voice hurt, and tried doing it a little differently. Even if it was clumsy, that one time you tried something different is a big step in learning how relationships work.

rows.ko: 혼자인 시간이든 함께인 시간이든, 연애 안에서 나를 잃지 않는 법을 익혀 간 한 해였을 수 있어요. 좋아하는 마음과 나를 아끼는 마음은 함께 갈 수 있다는 것을 기억해 두셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Single or partnered, you learned this year how to love without losing yourself. Remember: caring for someone and caring for yourself go hand in hand.
rows.en_before_tone: Whether in time alone or time together, this may have been a year of learning not to lose yourself in love. It's worth remembering that caring for someone and caring for yourself can go together.

rows.ko: 가족의 말 한마디에 예전처럼 상처받기보다 그 뒤에 숨은 마음을 헤아려 보려 한 순간이 있었을 수 있습니다. 서로를 조금 다르게 바라보게 된 것만으로도 가족 안에서 많은 것을 알게 된 해예요.
rows.en: Instead of getting stung by a family member's words the way you used to, you tried to hear the feeling underneath. Seeing each other differently is a real lesson, and this year taught it to you.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when, rather than getting hurt by a family member's remark the way you used to, you tried to understand the feeling behind it. Simply coming to see each other a little differently makes this a year you learned a lot within your family.

rows.ko: 가족 중 누군가를 한 사람으로서 새롭게 바라보게 된 장면이 있었을지도 몰라요. 가족도 저마다의 사정을 가진 사람이라는 이해는 내 마음의 짐을 조금 덜어 주기도 합니다.
rows.en: At some point, you saw someone in your family in a new light, as a person in their own right. Knowing that each of them carries their own story lifts some of the weight from your shoulders.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you came to see someone in your family freshly, as a person in their own right. Understanding that family members are people with their own circumstances can lighten the load on your heart a little.

rows.ko: 가족 안에서 내가 맡아 온 역할을 돌아보며 어디까지가 내 몫인지 알아 간 시간이었을 수 있어요. 모든 것을 내가 해결하지 않아도 된다는 깨달음도 소중한 수확입니다.
rows.en: Looking back at the role you've played in your family, you began to see where your part ends. Realizing you don't have to fix everything is a precious harvest of its own.
rows.en_before_tone: It may have been a time to look back on the role you've played in your family and learn where your share ends. Realizing you don't have to solve everything yourself is something valuable you've gained, too.

rows.ko: 새로운 모임이나 사람들 속에서 나와 다른 생각을 듣고 시야가 넓어진 순간들이 있었을 수 있어요. 올해 기억에 남는 대화 하나를 떠올려 보면 그 사람이 내게 남긴 것이 보일지도 모릅니다.
rows.en: New groups and new faces brought you perspectives unlike your own, and your world grew wider. Recall one conversation that stayed with you this year, and notice what that person gave you.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when you heard ideas different from yours in new groups or among new people, and your view widened. If you recall one conversation that stayed with you this year, you might see what that person left you.

rows.ko: 오래된 관계 안에서 거리를 조절하는 법이나 서운함을 말하는 법을 조금씩 익혔을지도 모릅니다. 관계는 한 번에 잘 해내는 것보다 서로를 계속 알아 가는 과정에 더 가까워요.
rows.en: In long-standing friendships, you slowly learned to adjust the distance and to say when something hurt. Relationships are less about getting it right the first time and more about getting to know each other, again and again.
rows.en_before_tone: Within long-standing relationships, you may have gradually learned how to adjust distance or how to say when you're hurt. Relationships are less about getting it right in one go and more about continuing to get to know each other.

rows.ko: 거절하거나 부탁하는 일이 어색했지만 한 번씩 해 보며 나를 표현하는 법을 익힌 해였을 수 있어요. 작게 해 본 그 경험들이 사람들 사이에서 나를 지키는 힘이 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: Saying no and asking for help felt awkward, but you tried each one here and there and learned to speak up for yourself. Those small wins add up to the strength that keeps you grounded among people.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when saying no or asking for help felt awkward, but you tried it now and then and learned how to express yourself. Those small experiences become the strength that protects you among people.

rows.ko: 가계부를 쓰거나 지출을 들여다보며 내 돈이 어디로 흘러가는지 차분히 살펴본 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 숫자보다 내 생활의 습관이 보이기 시작했다면 그것만으로도 의미 있는 공부입니다.
rows.en: Calmly and honestly, you kept a budget or sat down to see where your money really goes. Once you see the everyday habits behind the numbers, you've learned something that matters.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when you kept a budget or looked over your spending and calmly checked where your money goes. If you started to see your life habits more than the numbers, that alone is meaningful learning.

rows.ko: 예상하지 못한 지출을 겪으며 생활에 여유분을 남겨 두는 것이 왜 중요한지 몸으로 알게 되었을지도 모릅니다. 그 경험이 만든 나만의 기준은 앞으로의 생활을 조금 더 단단하게 받쳐 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: An unexpected expense or two taught you firsthand why a cushion matters. The personal rules you drew from it give your life a steadier footing from here on.
rows.en_before_tone: Going through unexpected expenses, you may have felt firsthand why it matters to keep a cushion in your life. The personal standards that experience created can support your life a little more firmly from here on.
rows.note: 건강·재정 약속 표현은 피함

rows.ko: 무엇에 돈을 쓸 때 마음이 편하고 무엇에 쓸 때 후회가 남는지 알게 된 한 해였을 수 있어요. 나에게 맞는 소비의 기준을 찾아가는 것도 생활을 안정시키는 중요한 공부입니다.
rows.en: This year showed you which purchases feel good and which leave regret behind. Finding spending rules that fit you is an essential part of building a steadier life.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when you learned what spending feels comfortable and what leaves regret. Finding spending standards that suit you is also important learning for a steadier life.

rows.ko: 맡은 역할이나 함께 일하는 사람이 바뀌면서 익숙하던 하루의 흐름이 달라졌을 수 있어요. 낯선 자리에 적응해 온 시간은 생각보다 많은 것을 해낸 시간이기도 합니다.
rows.en: A new role, or a shift in who you work with, reshaped the familiar rhythm of your days. Adapting to unfamiliar ground takes real strength, and you accomplished more than you give yourself credit for.
rows.en_before_tone: As your role or the people you work with changed, the familiar flow of your day may have shifted. The time you spent adjusting to an unfamiliar place is also time you accomplished more than you think.

rows.ko: 자리를 옮길지 고민하거나 실제로 옮기며 일의 방향을 다시 그려 본 한 해였을지도 모릅니다. 바뀐 것과 그대로인 것을 나란히 적어 보면 내가 일에서 지키고 싶은 것이 보이기도 해요.
rows.en: Whether you weighed a job change or actually made the move, you spent this year redrawing where your work is headed. List what changed and what stayed the same side by side, and you'll see what you want to protect in your work.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when you redrew the direction of your work, wondering whether to move on, or actually moving. Listing what changed and what stayed side by side can show you what you want to protect in your work.

rows.ko: 겉으로는 같은 일을 하고 있어도 일을 대하는 마음이나 기대가 조용히 달라졌을 수 있어요. 마음이 달라진 것도 충분히 의미 있는 움직임이니, 그 방향을 천천히 따라가 보셔도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: On the surface, the job looks the same, but your feelings and expectations about it have quietly shifted. A change of heart is real movement, so follow where it leads, at your own pace.
rows.en_before_tone: Even if you're doing the same work on the outside, your feelings and expectations about it may have quietly changed. A change of heart is a meaningful movement too, so it's okay to slowly follow where it leads.

rows.ko: 오래 생각해 온 진로를 다시 고민하거나 전혀 다른 분야에 관심이 생긴 순간이 있었을 수 있습니다. 방향이 바뀌는 것은 길을 잃은 것이 아니라 나를 더 알게 되었다는 신호일 수 있어요.
rows.en: You began rethinking a path you'd planned on for years, or felt drawn toward a completely different field. Changing direction doesn't mean you're lost. It means you know yourself better now.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when you reconsidered a path you'd thought about for a long time, or became interested in a completely different field. Changing direction isn't getting lost; it can be a sign that you've come to know yourself better.

rows.ko: 공부하는 방식이나 하루를 쓰는 습관을 바꿔 보며 나에게 맞는 리듬을 찾아갔을지도 몰라요. 작은 습관 하나가 바뀐 것도 올해가 내 하루에 남긴 분명하고 소중한 흔적입니다.
rows.en: You switched up how you study and how you spend your days until you found a rhythm that fits. Even one small habit that changed is a clear, precious mark this year left on your life.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have found a rhythm that suits you by changing how you study or how you spend your days. Even one small habit changing is a clear and precious mark this year left on your days.

rows.ko: 예전에는 중요했던 목표가 조금 덜 중요해지고 새로운 바람이 자리를 잡아 간 한 해였을 수 있어요. 지금의 나에게 맞게 목표를 고쳐 쓰는 것은 포기가 아니라 자라는 모습의 하나입니다.
rows.en: Goals that once felt huge loosened their hold this year, and new hopes moved into their place. Rewriting your goals to fit who you are now isn't giving up. It's what growing looks like.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when goals that used to matter became a little less important, and new hopes settled in. Rewriting your goals to fit who you are now isn't giving up; it's one way of growing.

rows.ko: 관계의 모양이나 서로를 대하는 거리가 달라지면서 마음이 여러 번 흔들렸을 수 있어요. 달라진 자리에서도 내 마음이 편안해지는 속도와 거리를 먼저 찾아보는 것이 좋습니다.
rows.en: As the shape of your relationship and the closeness between you changed, your heart wavered more than once. Wherever things stand now, first find the pace and distance that let you feel at ease.
rows.en_before_tone: As the shape of your relationship or the distance between you changed, your heart may have wavered many times. Even in this changed place, it's good to first find the pace and distance that let your heart feel at ease.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 사람의 기준이나 연애에서 바라는 모습이 예전과 달라졌다는 것을 느꼈을지도 모릅니다. 바뀐 기준은 지금의 나를 더 잘 비춰 주는 거울이 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your type, or what you want from love, isn't what it used to be, and you've noticed. Those new standards work like a mirror, showing you more clearly who you are today.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have felt that your idea of who you like, or what you want from love, has changed from before. Those changed standards can become a mirror that reflects who you are now more clearly.

rows.ko: 연애가 삶에서 차지하는 자리가 커지기도 하고 작아지기도 하며 마음의 무게중심이 옮겨 갔을 수 있어요. 어느 쪽이든 지금의 내가 고른 균형이라면 그 자체로 존중받을 만합니다.
rows.en: Love took up more room in your life at some moments and less at others, shifting your center of gravity. If you chose that balance yourself, honor it just as it is.
rows.en_before_tone: The place love holds in your life may have grown and shrunk, shifting your heart's center of gravity. Either way, if it's a balance the present you has chosen, it deserves respect as it is.

rows.ko: 이사나 독립처럼 함께 지내는 방식이 달라지는 일이 있었다면 집의 풍경이 꽤 낯설게 느껴졌을 수 있어요. 새 풍경에 마음이 익숙해지는 데에는 시간이 걸린다는 것을 너그럽게 받아 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: A move, or getting your own place, changed the way you live with family, and home felt unfamiliar for a while. Go easy on yourself; a new normal takes time to settle in.
rows.en_before_tone: If something changed how you live together, like moving or becoming independent, home may have felt quite unfamiliar. It's okay to be gentle with yourself: it takes time for your heart to get used to a new scene.

rows.ko: 가족 안에서 내가 맡는 역할이 바뀌거나 돌봄의 무게가 옮겨 오며 마음이 분주했을지도 모릅니다. 바뀐 역할에 맞춰 나를 챙기는 방법도 함께 새로 만들어 가 보세요.
rows.en: Your role in the family shifted, or more of the caregiving landed on you, and you felt stretched thin. As your role changes, build new ways to look after yourself, too.
rows.en_before_tone: Your role in the family may have changed, or the weight of caregiving may have shifted to you, keeping your heart busy. It may help to create new ways to look after yourself that fit your changed role, too.

rows.ko: 가족을 바라보는 내 마음이 조금씩 달라지면서 예전과 다른 거리에서 서로를 보게 되었을 수 있어요. 가까워졌든 조금 멀어졌든, 지금의 거리에도 나름의 이유가 있다는 것을 기억해 두셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Your feelings about family slowly shifted, and you began to see each other from a new distance. Closer or a little farther apart, trust that where things stand now has its reasons.
rows.en_before_tone: As your feelings toward your family gradually changed, you may have come to see each other from a different distance than before. Whether you grew closer or a little further apart, it's worth remembering that the distance you have now has its own reasons.

rows.ko: 자주 만나던 사람들과는 뜸해지고 새로운 얼굴들이 곁에 들어오며 관계의 지도가 바뀌었을 수 있어요. 관계가 바뀌는 것은 자연스러운 흐름이니 지금 곁에 있는 사람들을 천천히 알아 가도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: Some familiar faces faded from your days while new ones arrived. That ebb and flow is natural, so take your time getting to know the people around you now.
rows.en_before_tone: The people you used to see often may have faded away while new faces came near, changing your map of relationships. Relationships changing is a natural flow, so it's okay to slowly get to know the people by your side now.

rows.ko: 환경이 바뀌면서 새 모임이나 동료들 사이에 다시 자리를 잡아야 했던 시간이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 처음부터 편하지 않아도 괜찮으니 한 사람과의 대화부터 쌓아 가 보세요.
rows.en: A change of scene had you finding your place all over again in a new group or among new coworkers. Comfort doesn't have to come right away. Start with one conversation, with one person, and build from there.
rows.en_before_tone: As your surroundings changed, there may have been a time when you had to find your place again among a new group or coworkers. It's okay if it isn't comfortable from the start; you might begin by building things up from a conversation with just one person.

rows.ko: 사람을 대하는 나의 방식이 달라져 예전처럼 모든 연락에 바로 답하지 않게 되었을 수 있어요. 그 달라짐이 나를 지키기 위한 것이었다면 미안해하기보다 그대로 인정해 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: You changed how you deal with people, and you no longer answer every message the second it arrives. If that change protects you, there's nothing to apologize for. Own it.
rows.en_before_tone: Your way of relating to people may have changed, so you no longer reply to every message right away as you used to. If that change was to protect yourself, you can simply accept it rather than feeling sorry.

rows.ko: 생활 환경이 바뀌면서 매달 나가는 돈의 흐름이나 지출의 우선순위가 달라졌을 수 있어요. 바뀐 생활에 맞는 새 기준을 하나씩 세워 가는 중이라고 생각하면 마음이 조금 편해질 수 있습니다.
rows.en: A change in your living situation reshuffled your monthly bills and spending priorities. Treat it as setting new ground rules, one at a time, for the life you have now.
rows.en_before_tone: As your living situation changed, the flow of money going out each month or your spending priorities may have shifted. Thinking of it as setting new standards, one by one, that fit your changed life may ease your mind a little.

rows.ko: 예전에는 아무렇지 않던 소비가 부담스럽게 느껴지거나 반대로 나를 위한 지출을 허락하게 되었을지도 모릅니다. 돈을 대하는 마음이 달라졌다면 그 안에 지금 내가 원하는 생활이 담겨 있을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Spending you never thought twice about suddenly felt like a lot, or the reverse: you finally started spending on yourself. Your shifting feelings about money point straight to the life you want right now.
rows.en_before_tone: Spending that used to feel like nothing may now feel like a burden, or on the contrary, you may have started allowing yourself to spend on you. If your feelings about money have changed, they may hold the kind of life you want right now.

rows.ko: 한 달의 지출 리듬이 흔들리며 생활의 안정감을 다시 찾느라 애쓴 한 해였을 수 있어요. 흔들린 뒤에 다시 세운 기준은 이전보다 내 생활에 더 잘 맞을 때가 많습니다.
rows.en: When your monthly spending got thrown off, you worked hard to regain solid ground. The rules you rebuild after a shake-up often fit your life better than the old ones did.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when your monthly spending rhythm wobbled and you worked hard to regain a sense of stability. Standards you rebuild after a wobble often fit your life better than before.

rows.ko: 쉬어 가는 시기를 보내거나 하던 일이 잠시 멈추면서 일의 시계가 느려진 한 해였을 수 있어요. 멈춰 있는 동안 내가 일에서 정말 원하는 것을 들여다본 시간도 소중한 준비입니다.
rows.en: Whether you stepped away or a project stalled, your career clock slowed down this year. Use that pause to ask what you truly want from work; it's valuable groundwork for what comes next.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when your work clock slowed, as you took a break or your work paused for a while. Time spent looking into what you really want from work while things stood still is valuable preparation too.

rows.ko: 바쁘게 일하면서도 마음만은 앞으로 나아가지 못하고 제자리에 서 있는 느낌이 들었을지도 모릅니다. 그 정체감은 지금의 방식을 한번 점검해 보라는 마음의 신호일 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your calendar stayed packed, yet part of you felt like you were standing still. That stuck feeling is your intuition asking you to take a fresh look at how you do things.
rows.en_before_tone: Even while working busily, you may have felt that, inside, you were standing still rather than moving forward. That sense of being stuck may be your heart's signal to check in on how you're doing things now.

rows.ko: 기대했던 기회나 다음 단계가 생각보다 더디게 움직여 기다리는 시간이 길었을 수 있어요. 기다리는 동안 손에 익힌 것들은 다시 걸음을 뗄 때 나를 받쳐 줄 바탕이 됩니다.
rows.en: The opportunity or next step you hoped for arrived slower than expected, and the wait felt long. Everything you sharpened in the meantime backs you up when the momentum returns.
rows.en_before_tone: The chance or next step you'd hoped for may have moved more slowly than expected, making the wait long. What you got good at while waiting becomes the ground that supports you when you start walking again.

rows.ko: 하려던 공부나 계획을 잠시 내려놓고 아무것도 정하지 않은 채 지낸 시간이 있었을 수 있습니다. 그렇게 쉬어 간 시간도 다음 걸음을 위해 힘을 모으는 중요한 과정이었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: At some point you moved your studies and plans to the back burner and simply let things be. That downtime was part of recharging for your next step.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a time you set aside studies or plans you'd meant to do and lived without deciding anything. That time of resting may also have been an important process of gathering strength for your next step.

rows.ko: 무엇을 하고 싶은지 잘 모르겠어서 선택을 미루고 한동안 그대로 머물러 있었을지도 몰라요. 답을 서두르지 않은 그 시간이 오히려 나를 더 정확히 알아 가는 시간이었을 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Unsure of what you wanted, you held off on big choices and stayed put for a while. By not rushing to an answer, you came to understand yourself more clearly.
rows.en_before_tone: Not quite knowing what you wanted, you may have put off choices and stayed where you were for a while. That time of not rushing an answer may actually have been time spent getting to know yourself more accurately.

rows.ko: 열심히 하던 자기계발 루틴이 끊기고 다시 시작할 힘이 나지 않는 날들이 이어졌을 수 있어요. 끊긴 자리에서 아주 작은 것 하나만 다시 이어 가도 지금은 충분하다는 것을 기억해 두셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: The self-improvement routine you'd built came apart, and some days you couldn't find the energy to start over. For now, pick up one tiny thing where you left off. That's enough.
rows.en_before_tone: The self-improvement routine you'd worked hard at may have broken off, followed by days when you couldn't find the energy to start again. It's worth remembering that, for now, picking up just one tiny thing where you left off is enough.

rows.ko: 연애에 대한 고민을 잠시 내려놓고 나에게 집중하는 시간을 보냈을 수 있어요. 관계에서 한 발 물러나 나를 먼저 돌본 그 시간도 소중한 하나의 방식이었을 수 있습니다.
rows.en: You pressed pause on your love life for a while to focus on yourself. Stepping back from dating to care for you first is a meaningful choice in its own right.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have set aside thoughts about love for a while and spent time focusing on yourself. Stepping back from relationships to care for yourself first may have been a valuable choice in its own right.

rows.ko: 누군가를 향한 마음이나 지금의 관계가 한동안 같은 자리에 머무는 것처럼 느껴졌을지도 모릅니다. 움직이지 않는 시간에도 내 마음이 무엇을 바라는지는 조용히 또렷해질 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your feelings for someone, or the relationship you're in, stayed in the same place for a long while. Even when nothing seems to move, what you truly want comes into focus on its own.
rows.en_before_tone: Your feelings for someone, or your current relationship, may have felt like they were staying in the same place for a while. Even in times when nothing moves, what your heart wants can quietly grow clearer.

rows.ko: 누군가 다가올 때 바로 마음을 열기보다 한 걸음 멈춰 서서 지켜본 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 마음의 준비가 될 때까지 천천히 기다려 보는 것도 나를 존중하는 하나의 선택입니다.
rows.en: When someone tried to get closer, you hit pause and watched before opening up. Taking your time until you feel ready is a way of honoring yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when someone came closer and, instead of opening your heart right away, you paused and watched. Slowly waiting until your heart is ready is also a choice that respects yourself.

rows.ko: 가족과의 대화가 한동안 뜸해지거나 서로 말을 아끼며 조용히 지낸 시기가 있었을 수 있어요. 그 사이에도 마음은 정리되고 있었을지 모르니 조급하게 풀려고 하지 않아도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: For a stretch, you and your family barely talked, or everyone kept their thoughts to themselves. Feelings were sorting themselves out in the quiet, so don't rush to fix anything.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a stretch when conversations with your family grew sparse, or you kept quiet, holding back your words. Your feelings may have been sorting themselves out in the meantime, so it's okay not to rush to resolve things.

rows.ko: 가족 일로 내 계획을 잠시 미뤄 두고 집안을 먼저 챙기느라 걸음을 멈춘 시간이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그때 내려놓았던 나의 일들도 조금씩 다시 꺼내 볼 자리를 마련해 주세요.
rows.en: A family matter asked you to put your own plans on hold and tend to home first. Now start making room, little by little, for what you set aside for yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a time you put your own plans on hold to look after things at home first because of a family matter. It's worth making room, little by little, to pick back up the things of your own you set down back then.

rows.ko: 오래 이어 온 가족 안의 고민을 잠시 내려놓고 거리를 둔 채 숨을 골랐을 수 있어요. 잠시 멈춰 선 것이 외면이 아니라 나를 지키기 위한 쉼이었다고 생각해도 됩니다.
rows.en: You set a long-running family issue aside and stepped back to catch your breath. That pause wasn't turning away. It was rest you needed to protect yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have set aside a long-running family concern for a while and caught your breath at a distance. You can think of that pause not as turning away, but as rest to protect yourself.

rows.ko: 모임이나 약속을 줄이고 혼자 있는 시간을 늘리며 관계에서 한 발 물러나 있었을 수 있어요. 사람들 사이에서 잠시 쉬어 간 시간은 다시 만날 힘을 모으는 시간이기도 합니다.
rows.en: Fewer get-togethers, fewer plans, more time alone: you stepped back from your social life this year. Time away from people is your chance to recharge before you reconnect.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have stepped back from relationships, cutting down on gatherings and plans and spending more time alone. Time spent resting from people is also time spent gathering strength to meet them again.

rows.ko: 연락을 먼저 하기도 받기도 버거워 메시지를 한참 열어 두기만 한 날들이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 답장이 늦어진 마음에도 이유가 있었다는 것을 스스로 알아주셔도 돼요.
rows.en: Some days, reaching out, or even being reached, felt like too much, and messages sat unanswered for a long time. Cut yourself some slack. Those slow replies had their reasons.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days when reaching out first, or even being reached, felt like too much, so you just left messages open for a long time. It's okay to acknowledge to yourself that there was a reason behind your slow replies, too.

rows.ko: 넓혀 가던 관계를 잠시 멈추고 지금 곁에 있는 몇 사람에게만 마음을 쓴 해였을 수 있어요. 넓고 많은 관계보다 편안한 관계 몇이 더 큰 힘이 되어 줄 때도 있습니다.
rows.en: Instead of widening your circle, you paused and poured your energy into the few people closest to you. A handful of easy, comfortable bonds often gives you more strength than a crowd.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when you paused on widening your circle and put your heart only into the few people by your side now. Sometimes a few comfortable relationships give you more strength than many wide ones.

rows.ko: 큰 지출이나 계획을 잠시 미뤄 두고 생활을 최소한으로 꾸리며 숨을 고른 시간이 있었을 수 있어요. 잠시 멈춰 서서 지출을 살핀 경험은 다음 생활의 기준을 세우는 바탕이 됩니다.
rows.en: You held off on big purchases and plans, kept life to the basics, and caught your breath. That pause to review your spending gives you solid ground for setting your next money rules.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a time when you put big expenses or plans on hold, kept life to the basics, and caught your breath. The experience of pausing to look at your spending becomes the ground for setting your next standards.

rows.ko: 저축이나 돈 관리 계획이 생각처럼 앞으로 나아가지 않아 제자리걸음처럼 느껴졌을지도 모릅니다. 제자리를 지킨 것만으로도 생활이 흔들리지 않게 붙든 시간이었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your savings and money plans didn't advance the way you hoped, and it felt like running in place. Yet holding steady is exactly what kept your life from wobbling.
rows.en_before_tone: Your savings or money plans may not have moved forward as you'd hoped, so it felt like running in place. Simply holding steady may have been what kept your life from wobbling.

rows.ko: 돈 이야기를 떠올리기만 해도 마음이 무거워 한동안 들여다보지 않고 미뤄 둔 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 준비가 되었을 때 한 달 지출 하나만 가볍게 살펴보는 것부터 시작해도 충분합니다.
rows.en: Money weighed so heavily that you avoided looking at it for a while. When you're ready, start by glancing over a single month of spending. That's plenty.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days when just thinking about money felt heavy, so you put off looking at it for a while. When you're ready, it's enough to start by lightly looking over just one month of spending.

rows.ko: 오래 붙들고 있던 프로젝트를 마무리하거나 맡은 일을 끝까지 해낸 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 결과만큼 그 과정을 지나온 나의 방식과 끈기도 함께 기억해 두면 다음 일에도 힘이 됩니다.
rows.en: You finally wrapped up a project you'd carried for ages, or saw an assignment all the way through. Remember how you worked and the grit it took, not just the result; that memory carries you into the next one.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you wrapped up a project you'd held on to for a long time, or saw a task through to the end. If you remember your way of working and your persistence through the process, as much as the result, it will give you strength for the next task too.

rows.ko: 주변의 인정이나 새로운 역할처럼 그동안의 노력이 눈에 보이는 모양으로 돌아온 장면이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그 기쁨을 누군가와 나누며 한 번 더 축하해 보셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: Your hard work paid off in a way others could see, through recognition or a new role. Share the win with someone and celebrate it one more time.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when your efforts came back in a visible form, like recognition from others or a new role. Feel free to share that joy with someone and celebrate it once more.

rows.ko: 눈에 띄는 성과는 아니어도 일하는 방식이 단단해지고 실수가 줄어든 것을 스스로 느꼈을 수 있어요. 남이 알아주지 않는 결실도 나에게는 분명히 의미 있는 한 걸음입니다.
rows.en: It didn't make headlines, but you noticed yourself working more steadily and making fewer mistakes. Progress no one else sees is still a real step forward.
rows.en_before_tone: Even if it wasn't a standout achievement, you may have felt for yourself that your way of working grew steadier and you made fewer mistakes. Even results others don't notice are a clearly meaningful step for you.

rows.ko: 준비해 온 시험이나 자격, 배움의 과정을 하나 끝까지 마친 순간이 있었을 수 있습니다. 올해 해낸 것을 작은 것까지 하나씩 적어 보면 생각보다 긴 목록이 될지도 몰라요.
rows.en: You saw an exam, a certification, or a course through to the very end. List everything you accomplished this year, small stuff included, and watch the list grow longer than you expect.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you saw an exam, certification, or course of learning you'd prepared for all the way through. If you list what you accomplished this year, down to the small things, it may turn out to be a longer list than you think.

rows.ko: 미뤄 두던 일을 시작하고 꾸준히 이어 간 것 자체가 올해의 보람으로 느껴졌을지도 모릅니다. 작은 꾸준함이 쌓인 시간은 다음 도전을 받쳐 주는 든든한 바닥이 되어 줘요.
rows.en: Finally starting something you'd put off, and sticking with it, was one of this year's biggest rewards. Small, steady effort lays a solid floor for whatever challenge comes next.
rows.en_before_tone: Starting something you'd been putting off and keeping it going may itself have felt like this year's reward. Time built from small, steady effort becomes a solid floor that supports your next challenge.

rows.ko: 내가 무엇을 하고 싶은지 조금 더 분명해진 것이 올해 가장 큰 수확이었을 수 있어요. 방향을 찾은 것도 눈에 보이는 결과물만큼 값진 열매라는 것을 기억해 두셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Your biggest win this year was getting clearer about what you truly want to do. Finding your direction is as valuable as any result you can point to.
rows.en_before_tone: Getting a little clearer on what you want to do may have been the biggest thing you gained this year. It's worth remembering that finding your direction is just as valuable as any visible result.

rows.ko: 마음을 솔직하게 표현하거나 오래 품었던 이야기를 꺼내는 데 용기를 낸 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 결과와 상관없이 그 용기를 낸 나를 한 번 칭찬해 주셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: You worked up the courage to say how you really feel, or finally voiced something you'd kept inside for a long time. However it turned out, honor yourself for being that brave.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you found the courage to express your feelings honestly or bring up something you'd held inside for a long time. Whatever the outcome, it's okay to give yourself some praise for that courage.

rows.ko: 누군가와 서로의 다름을 이해하며 지내는 법을 찾아갔다면 그것도 작은 결실처럼 느껴졌을 수 있어요. 편안한 관계는 저절로 생기지 않으니 그동안 들인 마음을 스스로 알아주셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: You and someone found a way to get along while making room for your differences, a quiet but real win. Comfortable relationships don't just happen, so recognize the care you've poured in.
rows.en_before_tone: If you found ways to get along with someone while understanding your differences, that may have felt like a small reward too. Comfortable relationships don't happen on their own, so it's okay to acknowledge the care you've put in.

rows.ko: 혼자인 시간이 있었다면 그 시간을 외롭게만 두지 않고 나를 아끼는 법을 익힌 것도 올해의 결실일 수 있어요. 나와 잘 지내는 힘은 어떤 관계에서도 나를 지켜 주는 바탕이 됩니다.
rows.en: Time on your own taught you to treat yourself well instead of simply feeling lonely, one of the gifts this year gave you. Getting along with yourself keeps you grounded in any relationship.
rows.en_before_tone: If you had time alone, learning to care for yourself instead of leaving that time only lonely may be one of the things this year gave you. Being able to get along well with yourself is the ground that protects you in any relationship.

rows.ko: 가족에게 하고 싶던 말을 꺼내거나 오래 어색했던 사이에 먼저 손을 내민 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 작은 한마디였더라도 그 용기는 가족 안에 오래 남는 움직임이 될 수 있습니다.
rows.en: You finally said what you'd been meaning to tell your family, or made the first move to mend a bond that had felt awkward for years. A few small words like that ripple through a family for a long time.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you said something you'd wanted to tell your family, or reached out first in a relationship that had been awkward for a long time. Even if it was a small word, that courage can leave a lasting ripple in your family.

rows.ko: 가족을 위해 마련하고 싶던 것을 해내거나 집안의 일을 무사히 마무리한 장면이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 가족을 챙긴 만큼 그 과정에서 애쓴 나에게도 고마움을 전해 주세요.
rows.en: You gave your family something you'd long wanted to give, or saw a family matter safely through to the end. You took such good care of them; now thank yourself for all the effort it took.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you managed to provide something you'd wanted for your family, or safely wrapped up a family matter. As much as you looked after your family, please thank yourself too for the effort you put in along the way.

rows.ko: 가족과의 사이에서 내 마음을 지키는 선을 정하고 지켜 낸 것이 올해의 결실이었을 수 있어요. 겉으로 드러나지 않아도 나를 지킨 그 선택은 충분히 크고 의미 있는 걸음입니다.
rows.en: Drawing a line with family that protects your peace, and holding it, was this year's real accomplishment. Seen by others or not, choosing to protect yourself is a big, meaningful step.
rows.en_before_tone: Setting a line that protects your heart with your family, and keeping it, may have been this year's quiet achievement. Even if it doesn't show on the outside, that choice to protect yourself is a big and meaningful step.

rows.ko: 새로운 모임에 먼저 발을 들이거나 낯선 사람들 사이에서 내 자리를 만든 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 용기 내어 다가간 그 한 걸음이 올해 관계의 지도를 넓혀 주었을지도 모릅니다.
rows.en: You were the first to walk into a new group, or you found your place among strangers. That one brave step widened your social world this year.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you stepped into a new group first, or made a place for yourself among strangers. That one brave step toward others may have widened your map of relationships this year.

rows.ko: 함께하는 사람들과 무언가를 같이 해내며 혼자서는 느끼기 어려운 뿌듯함을 맛보았을지도 모릅니다. 그때 곁에 있던 사람들에게 고맙다는 말을 짧게 전해 보셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: Pulling something off with the people around you gave you a pride that's hard to feel alone. Send a quick thank-you to everyone who was there with you.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have accomplished something together with the people around you and tasted a pride that's hard to feel alone. Feel free to send a short thank-you to the people who were by your side then.

rows.ko: 불편한 관계에서 내 생각을 차분히 말하거나 정중하게 거절해 낸 것이 작은 결실이었을 수 있어요. 그런 경험이 쌓일수록 사람들 사이에서도 나답게 지낼 수 있는 힘이 자랍니다.
rows.en: You calmly spoke your mind in an uncomfortable relationship, or turned someone down with grace: a small but real win. Collect more of those moments, and being yourself around others gets easier each time.
rows.en_before_tone: Calmly saying what you think in an uncomfortable relationship, or politely saying no, may have been a small achievement. The more of those experiences you build up, the more strength you grow to be yourself among people.

rows.ko: 세워 둔 저축 목표를 채우거나 생활비를 계획한 만큼 지켜 낸 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 스스로 정한 약속을 지켜 낸 경험은 내 생활에 대한 믿음을 조금씩 키워 줍니다.
rows.en: You hit a savings goal you'd set, or kept your living costs within budget. Every promise you keep to yourself builds confidence that you can take care of your own life.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you reached a savings goal you'd set, or kept your living costs within your plan. Keeping a promise you made to yourself gradually grows your trust in your own life.

rows.ko: 미뤄 두던 돈 정리를 해내거나 꼭 필요한 곳과 아닌 곳을 구분하게 된 것이 보람으로 느껴졌을지도 모릅니다. 내 생활의 기준을 세운 것만으로도 막연한 불안이 조금은 가벼워질 수 있어요.
rows.en: Getting your finances in order, or learning to tell what you truly need from what you don't, felt deeply rewarding. Clear rules of your own take the edge off that vague, nagging worry.
rows.en_before_tone: Finally sorting out your finances, or learning to tell what's truly necessary from what isn't, may have felt rewarding. Simply setting standards for your life can make vague worries a little lighter.

rows.ko: 여유가 넉넉하지 않은 달에도 생활의 균형을 무너뜨리지 않고 한 해를 꾸려 온 것 자체가 결실이었을 수 있어요. 겉으로 보이지 않는 그 꾸준함을 스스로 먼저 알아주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Even in tight months, you kept things balanced and made it through the year, an achievement in itself. That kind of steadiness doesn't show on the outside, so be the first to recognize it.
rows.en_before_tone: Getting through the year without losing your balance, even in months without much to spare, may itself have been an achievement. You can be the first to recognize that steadiness that doesn't show on the outside.

rows.ko: 익숙한 일터나 함께하던 동료와 작별한 순간이 있었다면, 한 시기를 마무리하는 마음이 생각보다 오래 남았을 수 있어요. 떠나온 자리에서 쌓은 것들은 여전히 내 안에 남아 다음 걸음을 함께해 줍니다.
rows.en: You said goodbye to a familiar workplace or to coworkers this year, and the sense of closing that chapter lingered longer than you expected. What you built there lives on in you and travels with you into whatever comes next.
rows.en_before_tone: If there was a moment you said goodbye to a familiar workplace or coworkers, the feeling of closing a chapter may have lingered longer than you expected. What you built in the place you left still remains within you and walks with you into your next step.

rows.ko: 오래 그려 온 일의 방향이나 꿈과 조용히 거리를 두게 된 마음이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 내려놓은 것을 아쉬워하는 마음도 그만큼 진심이었다는 뜻이니 천천히 떠나보내셔도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Quietly, you let go of a career path or dream you'd pictured for years. Missing it shows how much it meant, so release it at your own pace.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have quietly found yourself stepping back from a work direction or dream you'd pictured for a long time. Missing what you set down shows how much it truly meant to you, so it's okay to let it go slowly.

rows.ko: 일에 대한 예전의 기대나 열정과 작별하는 듯한 허전함을 느낀 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 그 허전함을 억지로 메우기보다 지금은 마음을 쉬게 하는 시간으로 그대로 두셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Some days felt hollow, as if you were saying farewell to the hope and passion you once had for your work. Don't rush to fill that emptiness. Let it be a time to rest, at least for now.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you felt an emptiness, as if saying goodbye to the expectations or passion you used to have for your work. Rather than forcing yourself to fill that emptiness, it's okay to leave it as time for your heart to rest for now.

rows.ko: 오래 붙들고 있던 목표나 진로를 내려놓으며 마음 한쪽이 허전해진 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 놓아 준 목표에도 그동안 쏟은 마음이 담겨 있으니, 그 시간을 실패라고 부르지 않아도 됩니다.
rows.en: Letting go of a goal or path you'd held for a long time left a hollow feeling. Everything you poured into it still counts, so don't call that time a failure.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when part of your heart felt empty as you let go of a goal or path you'd held on to for a long time. The goals you released hold all the heart you poured in, so you don't have to call that time a failure.

rows.ko: 예전의 나와 작별하듯 익숙한 습관이나 생각을 떠나보낸 시간이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 낯선 나를 맞이하는 데에는 시간이 걸리니 서두르지 말고 천천히 익숙해져도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Almost like bidding farewell to your old self, you released familiar habits and ways of thinking. Getting to know the new you takes time, so settle in slowly; there's no rush.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a time you let go of familiar habits or ways of thinking, as if saying goodbye to your old self. It takes time to welcome a new you, so there's no need to rush; it's okay to get used to it slowly.

rows.ko: 함께 공부하거나 꿈을 나누던 사람과 각자의 길로 흩어지며 아쉬움이 남았을 수 있어요. 함께했던 시간과 나눈 이야기는 서로의 길이 달라져도 내 안에서 사라지지 않습니다.
rows.en: Watching someone you studied or dreamed alongside head down a different road stung a little. The time and conversations you shared stay with you, even as your paths split.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have felt a pang as you and someone you studied with or shared dreams with went separate ways. The time you spent together and the conversations you shared stay with you, even as your paths go different ways.

rows.ko: 누군가를 향하던 마음을 정리하거나 한 관계의 계절을 떠나보낸 일이 있었다면, 그 여운이 생각보다 오래 머물렀을 수 있어요. 정리하는 데 걸리는 시간은 사람마다 다르니 내 마음의 속도를 그대로 존중해 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: You worked through your feelings for someone, or let a chapter of a relationship close, and the feelings lingered longer than you expected. Everyone heals at their own speed, so honor yours.
rows.en_before_tone: If you sorted out feelings for someone or let a season of a relationship go, those feelings may have lingered longer than you expected. The time it takes to move on differs for everyone, so it's okay to honor your own heart's pace.

rows.ko: 관계 안에서 예전 같은 기대와 작별하는 듯한 쓸쓸함을 느낀 순간이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그런 마음이 드는 것은 잘못이 아니며, 지금 내게 필요한 것이 무엇인지 천천히 살펴볼 신호일 수 있어요.
rows.en: A quiet loneliness settled in, as though you were saying goodbye to what you once expected from love. Nothing is wrong with that feeling. Treat it as a cue to look closely at what you need right now.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you felt a loneliness, as if saying goodbye to the expectations you used to have in a relationship. Feeling that way isn't wrong; it may be a signal to slowly look at what you need right now.

rows.ko: 연애에 대한 오래된 기대나 정해 둔 모습과 작별하며 마음이 한결 가벼워졌을 수도 있어요. 떠나보낸 기대의 자리에 지금의 나에게 맞는 바람이 천천히 들어설 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Letting go of old expectations about love, the picture of how it was "supposed" to look, left you lighter. In the space they leave behind, hopes that fit who you are now move in, one by one.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have felt a lot lighter after saying goodbye to old expectations about love or a picture you'd fixed in your mind. In the space left by those expectations, hopes that fit who you are now can slowly settle in.

rows.ko: 가족과 떨어져 지내게 되거나 함께하던 일상이 달라지며 집이 조금 낯설게 느껴진 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 거리가 생겨도 마음을 잇는 방법은 여러 가지이니, 짧은 안부 하나로 마음을 전해 보셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Living apart from family, or watching your shared routine change, made home feel a little unfamiliar at times. Distance doesn't mean disconnection: send a quick "thinking of you" text and let it go a long way.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when home felt a little unfamiliar as you came to live apart from family or your shared daily life changed. Even with distance, there are many ways to stay connected, so you might send a short check-in to let them know you're thinking of them.

rows.ko: 가족 중 누군가와 마음의 거리가 멀어진 것 같아 말없이 서운함을 품은 날들이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그 거리를 당장 좁히지 못해도 괜찮으니, 지금은 서운했던 내 마음부터 다독여 주세요.
rows.en: Some days you quietly nursed a hurt, sensing that you and someone in your family were drifting apart. You don't have to close that gap right away. Start by tending gently to your own hurt.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you silently held on to hurt, feeling the emotional distance grow between you and someone in your family. It's okay if you can't close that distance right away; for now, it's okay to start by comforting your own hurt feelings.

rows.ko: 소중한 존재를 떠나보내거나 익숙한 집의 풍경과 작별하는 일이 있었다면, 그 빈자리가 문득문득 크게 느껴졌을 수 있어요. 그리움에는 정해진 기한이 없으니 천천히 기억하며 마음을 추스를 시간을 허락해 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Saying goodbye to someone precious, or to a home you knew so well, left an empty space that hit you without warning. Grief keeps no schedule, so give yourself time to remember slowly and recover.
rows.en_before_tone: If you said goodbye to someone precious or to a familiar home, that empty space may have felt huge at unexpected moments. Missing someone has no set deadline, so it's okay to give yourself time to remember slowly and gather yourself.
rows.note: '소중한 존재'는 사람·반려동물 모두 가능해 'someone precious'로 옮김

rows.ko: 가깝던 친구와 자연스럽게 연락이 뜸해지며 관계가 멀어지는 것을 지켜본 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 모든 관계에는 저마다의 계절이 있고, 함께했던 시간이 사라지는 것은 아닙니다.
rows.en: A close friendship slowly drifted as you naturally fell out of touch. Every bond has its seasons, and the time you shared never simply disappears.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you watched a close friendship drift as you naturally stopped being in touch as often. Every relationship has its own seasons, and the time you shared doesn't disappear.

rows.ko: 오래 함께한 모임이나 무리와 멀어지는 일이 있었다면 생각보다 큰 허전함이 남았을지도 모릅니다. 그 자리를 아쉬워하는 마음도 그 시간이 소중했다는 증거이니 그대로 두셔도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: Growing apart from a group you'd belonged to for years left a bigger hole than you expected. Missing it proves how much that time meant, so let the feeling be.
rows.en_before_tone: If you grew apart from a group or circle you'd been with for a long time, it may have left a bigger emptiness than you expected. Missing that place is proof that the time was precious, so it's okay to leave that feeling as it is.

rows.ko: 나를 지치게 하던 관계와 조용히 거리를 두며 마음속으로 작별을 고한 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 나를 지키기 위한 거리였다면 미안함보다 나를 아낀 선택으로 기억해 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: You quietly put distance between yourself and a relationship that kept draining you, and said your goodbyes privately. If that distance protected you, remember it as self-care, not as something to feel guilty about.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you quietly put distance between yourself and a relationship that wore you out, saying goodbye in your heart. If that distance was to protect yourself, you can remember it as a choice made out of care for yourself rather than with guilt.

rows.ko: 익숙한 집이나 동네를 떠나 생활의 기반을 새로 꾸려야 했던 순간이 있었다면 마음이 꽤 분주했을 수 있어요. 새 생활의 기준은 한 번에 세우지 않아도 되니 하나씩 자리를 잡아 가셔도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: Leaving a familiar home or neighborhood and rebuilding your daily life from scratch kept your mind racing. You don't need every rule for your new life at once. Settle in one piece at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: If there was a time you had to leave a familiar home or neighborhood and rebuild your everyday life from scratch, your mind may have been quite busy. You don't have to set the standards for a new life all at once, so it's okay to settle in one thing at a time.

rows.ko: 아끼던 물건을 정리하거나 오래 이어 온 소비 습관과 작별하며 아쉬운 마음이 들었을지도 모릅니다. 떠나보낸 것들 덕분에 지금 내게 정말 필요한 것이 더 또렷하게 보이기도 해요.
rows.en: Clearing out things you loved, or breaking long-held spending habits, came with a pang of regret. Letting them go brings what you truly need right now into sharper focus.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have felt a pang as you cleared out things you cherished or said goodbye to long-held spending habits. Thanks to what you let go, what you truly need now may come into clearer view.

rows.ko: 기대했던 생활의 모습이나 세워 둔 계획과 작별하며 마음이 한동안 불안했을 수 있어요. 계획을 다시 쓰는 것은 실패가 아니니, 지금 지킬 수 있는 작은 기준 하나부터 다시 세워 봐도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: Saying goodbye to the life you'd pictured and the plans you'd made left you uneasy for a while. Rewriting a plan isn't failing. Begin again with one small rule you can keep right now.
rows.en_before_tone: Your mind may have been uneasy for a while as you said goodbye to the life you'd hoped for or the plans you'd made. Rewriting a plan isn't failure, so it's okay to rebuild starting with one small standard you can keep right now.

rows.ko: 늘어난 업무와 늦은 퇴근이 이어지며 몸도 마음도 쉴 틈 없이 달려온 날들이 많았을 수 있어요. 그만큼 애쓴 나에게 오늘 하루는 해야 할 일보다 쉼을 먼저 건네주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: As the workload grew and late nights piled up, you spent many days running on empty, body and mind. You pushed hard, so today, put rest ahead of the to-do list.
rows.en_before_tone: As more work and late nights kept piling up, you may have had many days of running without a break, body and mind. After working that hard, it's okay to give yourself rest today before your to-do list.

rows.ko: 인정받지 못한다는 느낌이나 일터의 관계 때문에 겉으로 말하지 못한 힘듦을 혼자 삼켰을지도 모릅니다. 힘들었던 이야기를 믿을 만한 사람에게 조금만 털어놓아도 마음의 짐이 나뉠 수 있어요.
rows.en: Feeling overlooked and navigating tension at work, you kept your struggles to yourself because you couldn't say them out loud. Open up, even a little, to someone you trust, and let them share the load.
rows.en_before_tone: Because of feeling unrecognized or tensions at work, you may have quietly swallowed struggles you couldn't voice. Sharing even a little of what was hard with someone you trust can help lighten the weight on your heart.

rows.ko: 익숙하지 않은 일을 맡아 하나하나 부딪히며 배우느라 유난히 고된 한 해였을 수 있어요. 그 서툰 날들을 지나온 것만으로도 충분히 애썼다고 스스로 인정해 주셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Unfamiliar work and lessons learned the hard way made this an especially tough year. Getting through those clumsy early days proves how hard you worked, so give yourself that credit.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been an especially tough year, taking on unfamiliar work and learning everything by running into it head-on. It's okay to acknowledge that just getting through those clumsy days shows how hard you've worked.

rows.ko: 일과 공부를 함께 해내느라 잠을 줄이고 주말까지 쏟아부은 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 지친 몸과 마음을 쉬게 하는 것도 목표를 향해 가는 과정에서 빼놓을 수 없는 일부입니다.
rows.en: Juggling work and study, you cut back on sleep and gave up your weekends. Resting your tired body and mind isn't a detour. It's an essential stretch of the road to your goals.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you cut back on sleep and poured in even your weekends to keep up with both work and studies. Resting your tired body and mind is also an essential part of the journey toward your goals.

rows.ko: 노력한 만큼 결과가 따라오지 않아 같은 자리를 맴도는 것 같은 고단함을 느꼈을지도 모릅니다. 결과와 상관없이 애쓴 시간은 사라지지 않으니, 오늘은 잠시 내려놓고 숨을 골라 보세요.
rows.en: When results didn't match your effort, you felt worn down, like spinning your wheels. The hours you put in never vanish, whatever the outcome, so set it all down for today and catch your breath.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have felt the weariness of circling the same place because results didn't match your effort. Time spent trying doesn't disappear, whatever the results, so today it's okay to set it down for a while and catch your breath.

rows.ko: 진로를 혼자 고민하고 결정해야 해서 마음이 유난히 무겁고 외로웠던 한 해였을 수 있어요. 고민을 함께 나눌 수 있는 사람에게 조금 기대어 보는 것도 길을 찾는 좋은 방법입니다.
rows.en: Mapping your path and making the call all on your own made this year feel heavy and lonely. Lean on someone you can talk things through with; that's a wise way to find your direction, too.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when your heart felt especially heavy and lonely because you had to think through and decide your path alone. Leaning a little on someone you can share your worries with is also a good way to find your way.

rows.ko: 누군가와의 관계를 지키려 내 마음보다 상대의 마음을 먼저 살피느라 지친 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 애써 온 만큼 이제는 내 마음이 쉬어 갈 자리도 함께 챙겨 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: You put the other person's feelings ahead of your own to keep the relationship going, and some days it left you exhausted. You've tried so hard; now make sure you get some rest, too.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you wore yourself out caring for the other person's feelings before your own to protect a relationship. After trying so hard, it's okay to make sure your own heart has a place to rest, too.

rows.ko: 마음처럼 풀리지 않는 감정 때문에 혼자 속을 끓이며 잠 못 든 밤들이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 그런 밤을 지나온 나를 탓하기보다 따뜻하게 다독여 주는 시간이 필요해요.
rows.en: Sleepless nights came when you stewed alone over feelings that wouldn't settle. Instead of blaming yourself for those nights, be kind to the person who made it through them.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been sleepless nights when you stewed alone over feelings that wouldn't settle the way you wanted. You need time to comfort yourself warmly for coming through those nights, rather than blaming yourself.

rows.ko: 연애에 대한 고민으로 이리저리 마음이 오가며 일상까지 흔들려 유난히 고단했던 한 해였을 수 있어요. 무거운 마음은 가까운 사람에게 조금 나눠 들어 달라고 해도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: Going back and forth over your love life shook even your daily routine, making this an especially draining year. Ask someone close to help you carry some of that weight.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been an especially tiring year, with your heart going back and forth over love worries until even your daily life wobbled. It's okay to ask someone close to help carry a bit of that heavy heart.

rows.ko: 가족을 돌보거나 집안일을 챙기느라 내 시간은 늘 뒤로 밀려난 날들이 많았을 수 있어요. 가족을 챙긴 만큼 나 역시 돌봄을 받아도 되는 사람이라는 것을 기억해 두셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Between caring for family and keeping up at home, your own time kept slipping to the back of the line. You give your family so much care. Remember: you deserve care, too.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have had many days when your own time always got pushed back while you cared for family or kept up with things at home. It's worth remembering that, as much as you cared for your family, you deserve care too.

rows.ko: 가족 사이의 갈등 한가운데에서 중재하고 달래느라 마음이 쉴 틈 없이 고단했을지도 모릅니다. 모든 갈등을 내가 풀지 않아도 괜찮으니, 조금은 한 발 물러나 쉬어 가셔도 돼요.
rows.en: Caught in the middle of family conflicts, playing peacemaker and calming everyone down, you had little room to breathe. You don't have to settle every argument yourself. Step back and rest.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have been worn out without a break, mediating and soothing in the middle of family conflicts. You don't have to resolve every conflict yourself, so it's okay to step back a little and rest.

rows.ko: 가족의 기대에 맞추려 애쓰면서도 내 마음은 말하지 못해 속으로 지친 한 해였을 수 있어요. 기대에 다 맞추지 못해도 충분히 애썼다는 것을 스스로 먼저 알아주셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: You worked to meet your family's expectations without ever voicing your own feelings, and it wore you down inside. Even if you couldn't meet every one, be the first to honor how hard you tried.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year of growing tired inside, trying to meet your family's expectations without being able to voice your own feelings. Even if you couldn't meet every expectation, you can be the first to recognize how hard you tried.

rows.ko: 부탁을 들어주고 분위기를 챙기느라 정작 내 마음은 돌보지 못하고 지친 날들이 있었을 수 있어요. 남을 챙긴 만큼 이제는 내가 기댈 수 있는 사람에게도 조금씩 기대어 보셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Doing favors and keeping everyone's spirits up wore you out, leaving no time to look after yourself. You've shown up for so many people; let yourself lean on the ones you can count on.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been days you wore yourself out doing favors and keeping the mood up, without actually tending to your own heart. As much as you've looked after others, it's okay to start leaning a little on people you can rely on, too.

rows.ko: 오해나 서운함이 생긴 관계를 풀어 보려 애쓰며 마음을 많이 썼을지도 모릅니다. 모든 관계를 다 붙잡지 않아도 괜찮으니, 지금은 지친 마음부터 쉬게 해 주셔도 돼요.
rows.en: You put a lot of yourself into mending relationships after misunderstandings and hurt feelings. You don't have to hold on to every one of them. For now, let yourself rest first.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have put a lot of heart into trying to mend relationships where misunderstandings or hurt had come up. You don't have to hold on to every relationship, so for now, it's okay to let your tired heart rest first.

rows.ko: 새로운 환경에서 사람들과 어울리느라 매일 긴장한 채로 하루를 보낸 시간이 길었을 수 있어요. 낯선 관계 속에서 애써 온 만큼 혼자 편히 쉬는 시간도 넉넉히 챙겨 주셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: In a new environment, you spent a long stretch on edge every day, working hard to fit in. You've given so much effort to new people; now make plenty of time to unwind on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have spent a long time going through your days tense, trying to fit in with people in a new environment. As much as you've worked hard in unfamiliar relationships, it's okay to make plenty of time to rest comfortably on your own.

rows.ko: 빠듯한 생활비를 맞추느라 하고 싶은 것을 미루고 마음 편히 쉬지 못한 날들이 많았을 수 있어요. 아끼며 지나온 시간을 스스로 인정해 주는 것만으로도 마음이 조금 풀릴 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Stretching a tight budget meant putting off what you wanted and never fully relaxing. Acknowledge how carefully you've managed, and let some of the tension go.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have had many days when you put off what you wanted and couldn't rest easy, trying to make a tight budget work. Simply acknowledging the time you spent being careful with money can help your heart loosen a little.

rows.ko: 예상치 못한 지출이 이어지며 매달 계획을 다시 짜느라 마음이 쉬지 못했을지도 모릅니다. 돈 걱정은 혼자 품을수록 무거워지니, 믿을 만한 사람과 조금 나눠 이야기해 보셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: One unexpected expense after another had you redoing your budget every month, with no break from it. Money worries grow heavier the longer you carry them alone, so talk them over with someone you trust.
rows.en_before_tone: As unexpected expenses kept coming, your mind may have had no rest from redoing your plans every month. Money worries get heavier the more you hold them alone, so it might help to talk a little with someone you trust.

rows.ko: 생활을 지키기 위해 몸이 지쳐도 쉬지 않고 움직여야 했던 한 해였을 수 있어요. 그렇게 애쓴 만큼 작은 휴식 하나를 일정에 먼저 넣어 두는 것도 생활을 지키는 일입니다.
rows.en: To keep your life afloat, you kept going even when your body begged for a break. You've worked so hard: pencil in one small break before anything else. That, too, is how you protect your life.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when you had to keep going without rest to keep your life afloat, even when your body was tired. After working that hard, putting one small break into your schedule first is also a way of protecting your life.

rows.ko: 쌓여 가는 일과 기대 속에서 이제는 좀 내려놓고 싶다는 생각이 여러 번 스쳤을 수 있어요. 그 마음은 결정을 재촉하는 신호라기보다 쉼이 필요하다는 신호일 수 있으니, 오늘 할 일의 양부터 조금 덜어 보셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: With work and expectations piling up, the thought of setting it all down crossed your mind more than once. That's less a call for a big decision than a call for rest, so trim today's to-do list a little.
rows.en_before_tone: Amid piling work and expectations, the thought that you'd like to set things down for a while may have crossed your mind many times. That feeling may be less a signal to rush a decision than a signal that you need rest, so you could start by lightening today's workload a little.

rows.ko: 퇴근 후에도 머릿속에서 일이 떠나지 않아 이 생각만큼은 멈추고 싶다고 느낀 밤이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 퇴근 뒤에는 업무 메신저를 잠시 닫아 두는 것처럼 일과 나 사이에 작은 선을 그어 보셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: Some nights, work followed you home and you just wanted to switch your brain off. Draw a small line between work and the rest of your life: mute work chat for a while after hours.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been nights when work wouldn't leave your head even after hours, and you wished you could at least switch that off. You might try drawing a small line between work and yourself, like closing your work messenger for a while after hours.

rows.ko: 모든 일을 잘 해내려는 마음이 버거워져 완벽하려는 노력만큼은 내려놓고 싶었을 수 있어요. 조금 덜 잘해도 괜찮다는 허락을 스스로에게 건네는 것도 나를 지키는 방법입니다.
rows.en: The pressure to get everything right grew too heavy, and you wanted, at the very least, to stop chasing perfection. Give yourself permission to do things a little less perfectly. That's how you protect yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: The urge to do everything well may have become too much, so you wanted to set down at least the effort to be perfect. Giving yourself permission to do a little less well is also a way of protecting yourself.

rows.ko: 쉬지 않고 나를 다그치던 자기계발에 지쳐 이제는 좀 쉬고 싶다는 마음이 들었을 수 있어요. 잠시 멈추는 것은 포기가 아니라 숨 고르기이니, 쉬는 시간을 계획에 먼저 넣어 두셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Worn out from pushing yourself to improve nonstop, you simply wanted a break. Pausing isn't quitting; it's catching your breath, so schedule rest into your plans first.
rows.en_before_tone: Worn out by self-improvement that kept pushing you without rest, you may have felt that you'd like to rest for a while now. Pausing isn't giving up; it's catching your breath, so it's okay to put rest time into your plans first.

rows.ko: 남들과 나를 견주며 조급해하는 마음만큼은 이제 내려놓고 싶었을지도 모릅니다. 견주기를 멈추고 싶은 그 마음이 잃어버린 내 속도를 되찾는 첫걸음이 되어 줄 수 있어요.
rows.en: Above all, you wanted to drop the restless habit of measuring yourself against others. That wish to stop comparing is your first step toward finding your own pace again.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have wanted to finally set down at least the restless feeling of comparing yourself with others. That wish to stop comparing can be the first step toward getting back the pace you'd lost.

rows.ko: 답이 나지 않는 진로 고민을 오래 붙들다가 이 고민은 잠시 ‘그만하자’고 스스로 말해 본 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 고민을 잠시 서랍에 넣어 두는 것도 나를 돌보는 방법이니, 여유가 생기면 그때 다시 꺼내 봐도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: After wrestling for a long time with a career question that had no clear answer, you finally told yourself it was time to try ‘Letting go’ of it for a while. Tucking a worry away in a drawer is a way of caring for yourself, and you can take it back out whenever you have more room.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when, after holding on for a long time to a career worry with no answer, you told yourself it was time to try ‘Letting go’ of it for a while. Putting a worry in a drawer for a while is also a way of caring for yourself, so it's okay to take it out again when you have more room.
rows.note: 문장 속 ‘그만하자’를 Q2 키워드 ‘Letting go’로 맞춰 녹여 넣음

rows.ko: 상대의 마음을 계속 짐작하며 애태우는 일을 이제는 멈추고 싶다고 느낀 순간이 있었을 수 있어요. 그 마음은 관계에 대한 결론이라기보다 내 마음도 돌봐 달라는 신호일 수 있습니다.
rows.en: At some point you wanted to stop anxiously guessing what the other person felt. That's less a verdict on the relationship than a signal that your own heart needs care, too.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you felt you wanted to stop the anxious guessing about the other person's feelings. That feeling may be less a conclusion about the relationship than a signal asking you to care for your own heart, too.

rows.ko: 연애에 대한 걱정이나 기대를 혼자 오래 품다 보니 그 생각만큼은 잠시 쉬고 싶었을지도 모릅니다. 연애 고민을 하루쯤 내려 두고 좋아하는 일에 마음을 써 보는 것도 괜찮아요.
rows.en: After carrying hopes and worries about love on your own for so long, you just wanted a break from thinking about it. Set your love life aside for a day and pour your energy into something you enjoy.
rows.en_before_tone: After holding worries or hopes about love alone for a long time, you may have wanted to rest from those thoughts, at least, for a while. It's okay to set love worries down for a day and put your heart into something you enjoy.

rows.ko: 관계에서 늘 내가 먼저 맞추고 참는 일을 이제는 내려놓고 싶다는 마음이 올라온 날이 있었을 수 있어요. 무엇을 바꿀지 정하기 전에, 내가 편안하게 지킬 수 있는 작은 선이 무엇인지부터 살펴보셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Some days you felt done with always being the one who bends and stays quiet in a relationship. Before deciding what to change, name one small boundary you can comfortably hold.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a day when you felt ready to stop always being the one who adjusts and holds back in a relationship. Before deciding what to change, it's okay to first look at what small line you can comfortably keep.

rows.ko: 가족을 위해 애쓰고 맞춰 주는 일에 지쳐 이제는 좀 내려놓고 싶다는 생각이 들었을 수 있어요. 그런 마음이 든다고 가족을 덜 아끼는 것은 아니니, 나를 위한 쉼의 시간을 조금 만들어 주셔도 됩니다.
rows.en: Tired of always working so hard for your family and bending to their needs, you wanted to set it all down for a while. That feeling doesn't mean you love them any less, so carve out a little time to rest for yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: Tired of working hard for your family and accommodating them, you may have thought you'd like to set it down for a while. Feeling that way doesn't mean you care for your family any less, so it's okay to make a little time to rest for yourself.

rows.ko: 같은 문제로 반복되는 다툼이나 서운함에 이 이야기만큼은 멈추고 싶다고 느낀 날이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 당장 풀지 못해도 괜찮으니, 잠시 거리를 두고 마음을 쉬게 하는 것을 스스로에게 허락해 주세요.
rows.en: The same arguments and hurt feelings kept circling back, and some days you just wanted that topic to be over. You don't have to sort it out right now. Take a little distance and give yourself a rest.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a day when, over fights or hurt that kept repeating around the same issue, you wished that one topic could just stop. It's okay if you can't resolve it right away; you can let yourself take some distance and rest your heart for a while.

rows.ko: 가족 안에서 늘 괜찮은 척하는 역할을 이제는 내려놓고 싶었을 수 있어요. 힘들 때는 힘들다고 말해도 된다는 것을 가족보다 먼저 나 자신에게 다정하게 들려주셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: You wanted to finally stop playing the one who's always fine. Before you tell your family, tell yourself first: when things are hard, you're allowed to say so.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have wanted to finally set down the role of always pretending to be fine in your family. You can gently tell yourself, before telling your family, that it's okay to say it's hard when it's hard.

rows.ko: 모든 모임과 연락에 응하느라 지쳐 이제는 좀 신경을 덜 쓰고 싶다는 마음이 들었을 수 있어요. 당분간 꼭 필요한 약속만 남겨 두는 것도 관계를 쉬게 하는 편안한 방법입니다.
rows.en: Saying yes to every get-together and answering every message wore you out, and you wanted to care a little less. For a while, keep only the plans that truly matter, and give your social life a rest.
rows.en_before_tone: Worn out from saying yes to every gathering and message, you may have wanted to care a little less now. For a while, keeping only the plans that really matter is also a comfortable way to let relationships rest.

rows.ko: 다른 사람의 눈치를 보며 나를 맞추는 일만큼은 멈추고 싶다고 느낀 순간이 있었을지도 모릅니다. 작은 부탁 하나를 정중히 미뤄 보는 것부터 내 선을 지키는 연습을 해 보셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: You wanted, at the very least, to stop tiptoeing around others and bending yourself to fit in. Practice your boundaries: politely put off one small favor.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you wanted to at least stop reading the room and bending yourself to fit others. You might practice holding your line, starting by politely putting off one small favor.

rows.ko: 애써 이어 가던 관계 앞에서 이제는 그만 애쓰고 싶다는 생각이 스쳤을 수 있어요. 관계를 어떻게 할지 정하기보다, 지금은 내가 쓸 수 있는 힘만큼만 마음을 쓰셔도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: With a relationship you'd worked hard to keep alive, you caught yourself wanting to stop trying so hard. You don't have to decide anything yet. For now, give only as much as you truly have energy for.
rows.en_before_tone: With a relationship you'd been working hard to keep going, the thought of no longer trying so hard may have crossed your mind. Rather than deciding what to do with the relationship, for now it's okay to give only as much heart as you have strength for.

rows.ko: 매달 돈 걱정에 마음을 졸이는 일을 이제는 멈추고 싶다는 생각이 들었을 수 있어요. 걱정을 내려놓고 싶은 그 마음이 생활의 기준을 다시 세워 볼 계기가 되어 줄 수도 있습니다.
rows.en: Fretting over money every single month left you wanting it to stop. That very wish to set the worry down is your chance to rethink the ground rules of your daily life.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have thought you'd like to stop worrying about money every month. That wish to set your worries down may become a chance to reset the standards of your daily life.

rows.ko: 아끼고 또 아끼는 생활에 지쳐 나를 위한 작은 것까지 참는 일은 내려놓고 싶었을지도 모릅니다. 생활의 균형 안에서 나를 위한 작은 몫을 정해 두는 것도 오래 지치지 않는 방법이에요.
rows.en: After so long scrimping and saving, you grew tired of denying yourself even the small things. Set aside a little something for yourself within a balanced budget; that's how you keep from burning out.
rows.en_before_tone: Tired of a life of saving and saving again, you may have wanted to stop holding back even on small things for yourself. Setting aside a small share for yourself within a balanced budget is also a way not to burn out over time.

rows.ko: 다른 사람과 내 생활을 견주며 불안해하는 마음만큼은 내려놓고 싶었을 수 있어요. 남의 기준 대신 내가 편안한 생활의 기준을 하나씩 적어 보는 것부터 시작해도 괜찮습니다.
rows.en: More than anything, you wanted to release the anxiety that comes from comparing your life to other people's. Start by writing down, one by one, what a comfortable life looks like by your own standards.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have wanted to set down at least the anxiety of comparing your life with other people's. It's okay to start by writing down, one by one, standards for a life you're comfortable with, instead of someone else's.

rows.ko: 새 직장이나 새 역할에서 첫 출근길의 긴장을 안고 낯선 하루를 열었을 수 있어요. 처음의 어색함과 긴장을 하루하루 지나온 것만으로도 이미 많은 것을 해낸 셈입니다.
rows.en: Starting a new job or role, you walked into those first unfamiliar days with a case of first-day jitters. Getting through the early awkwardness, one day at a time, means you've already done a lot.
rows.en_before_tone: At a new job or in a new role, you may have started unfamiliar days carrying first-day nerves on your commute. Just getting through the early awkwardness and nerves day after day means you've already accomplished a lot.

rows.ko: 미뤄 두던 공부를 드디어 펼치며 책상 앞에 앉은 첫날의 두근거림이 있었을 수 있어요. 처음 마음이 흐려지는 날이 와도 괜찮으니, 그날의 마음을 한 줄로 적어 두셔도 좋습니다.

rows.ko: 독립이나 이사처럼 가족과의 생활 방식이 달라지는 새 출발이 있었다면 기대와 낯섦이 함께였을 수 있어요. 새로운 거리에서 가족과 안부를 나누는 나만의 리듬을 천천히 만들어 가셔도 좋습니다.
