rows.en: Buying something you'd saved up for, or hitting a small goal, gave you a real thrill. Hold on to that joy and let it warm your everyday rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments your heart lifted as you bought something you'd long saved for, or reached a small goal. Remembering that joy gives you warm strength to keep up your rhythm of life ahead.

rows.ko: 생활이 조금씩 정돈되며 앞으로의 계획을 세우는 일이 전보다 즐겁게 느껴졌을지도 모릅니다. 막연한 불안 대신 기대로 생활을 바라보게 된 그 마음을 소중히 간직해 두셔도 좋아요.
rows.en: As life gradually fell into place, planning for the future started to feel fun. Treasure that shift, from vague worry to looking ahead with hope.
rows.en_before_tone: As your life gradually fell into order, making plans for the future may have felt more enjoyable than before. It's worth treasuring that feeling of looking at your life with hope instead of vague worry.

rows.ko: 나를 위한 작은 소비가 생활에 기분 좋은 활력을 더해 준 해였을 수 있어요. 나를 기쁘게 하는 지출과 마음을 편안하게 하는 저축 사이에서 나만의 균형을 찾아가셔도 좋습니다.
rows.en: Little treats for yourself added a bright spark to your everyday life this year. Find your own balance between spending that makes you happy and saving that gives you peace of mind.
rows.en_before_tone: This may have been a year when small treats for yourself added a pleasant spark to your life. You can find your own balance between spending that makes you happy and saving that puts your mind at ease.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 책임의 별 토성이 양자리로 옮겨 와 {{하우스영역}}에 머물기 시작했습니다. 이 영역에서 무엇을 맡고 무엇을 새로 세울지 묻는 긴 점검의 출발선이에요. 무겁게 느껴졌다면 그만큼 오래 쓸 기반을 다지기 시작한 것일 수 있습니다.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, moved into Aries and settled into {{하우스영역}}. This marks the starting line of a long review: what you take on in this part of life, and what you build from the ground up. If it has felt heavy, that weight is the sign you have begun laying a foundation built to last for years.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, moved into Aries and began to settle in {{하우스영역}}. It's the starting line of a long check-in, asking what you'll take on and what you'll build anew in this area. If it felt heavy, it may mean you've started laying a foundation you'll use for a long time.
rows.note: {{하우스영역}}은 영어에서 "your home & roots area"처럼 관사·소유격이 포함된 값이 들어가야 자연스러움

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 책임의 별 토성이 시작의 별자리인 양자리로 옮겨 왔습니다. 모두에게 '무엇을 새로 책임지고 시작할까'를 묻는 흐름이 열린 날이에요. 올해 유난히 해야 할 일이 무겁게 느껴졌다면 이 흐름과 맞닿아 있을 수 있어요.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, entered Aries, the sign of beginnings. Since that day, Saturn has asked all of us, 'What new responsibility am I ready to take on, and what do I want to start?' If your to-do list felt unusually heavy this year, you were feeling this shift.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, moved into Aries, the sign of beginnings. It marked the start of a flow that asks all of us, 'What new responsibility will I take on, and what will I begin?' If your to-dos felt especially heavy this year, it may be connected to this flow.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 꿈과 영감의 별 해왕성이 양자리로 들어와 {{하우스영역}}에 오래 머물기 시작했어요. 이 영역에서 막연했던 바람이 새로운 그림으로 떠오르는 출발점입니다. 아직 흐릿하게 느껴져도 천천히 모양을 갖춰 가는 흐름이라 서두를 필요는 없어요.
rows.en: Neptune, the planet of dreams, entered Aries on {{날짜}} and began a long stay in {{하우스영역}}. Hopes that once felt vague in this area start rising into a new vision. If it still looks hazy, trust the pace: this transit takes shape slowly, and nothing here needs rushing.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, entered Aries and began a long stay in {{하우스영역}}. It's the starting point where vague hopes in this area rise up as a new picture. Even if it still feels blurry, this flow takes shape slowly, so there's no need to rush.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 꿈과 영감의 별 해왕성이 양자리로 옮겨 오며 긴 여정을 시작했습니다. '나는 무엇을 꿈꾸며 시작하고 싶은가'를 조용히 묻는 흐름이에요. 마음이 붕 뜨거나 방향이 흐릿했던 순간이 있었다면 새 그림을 그리기 전의 여백이었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, crossed into Aries and set off on a long journey. Quietly, it asks, 'What am I dreaming of, and what do I want to begin?' Those moments when you felt adrift or unsure of your direction were the blank canvas before a new picture.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, moved into Aries and began a long journey. It's a flow that quietly asks, 'What do I dream of, and what do I want to begin?' If there were moments you felt unmoored or your direction was blurry, it may have been the blank space before drawing a new picture.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 변화의 별 천왕성이 쌍둥이자리로 들어와 {{하우스영역}}에 머물기 시작했어요. 이 영역에서 익숙한 방식이 흔들리는 동시에 뜻밖의 제안이나 새로운 길이 열릴 수 있는 출발선입니다. 앞으로 몇 해에 걸쳐 조금씩 모양을 바꿔 갈 흐름이에요.
rows.en: When Uranus, the planet of change, entered Gemini on {{날짜}}, it began its stay in {{하우스영역}}. Familiar routines in this area start to shake loose, and at the same time, surprise offers and new paths open up. Over the next few years, expect this part of life to reinvent itself, bit by bit.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, entered Gemini and began to settle in {{하우스영역}}. It's a starting line where familiar ways in this area may shake, while unexpected offers or new paths may open at the same time. It's a flow that will gradually change shape over the next few years.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 변화의 별 천왕성이 소통과 배움의 별자리인 쌍둥이자리로 옮겨 왔습니다. 배우고 말하고 연결되는 방식이 빠르게 달라지는 흐름이 모두에게 시작된 때예요. 낯선 도구나 새로 만난 사람이 생각보다 큰 문을 열어 줄 수 있습니다.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, moved into Gemini, the sign of communication and learning. For all of us, the way we learn, talk, and connect began changing fast. Say yes to the unfamiliar tool or the new face: either one can open a bigger door than you expect.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, moved into Gemini, the sign of communication and learning. It marked the start of a time, for everyone, when the ways we learn, talk, and connect change quickly. An unfamiliar tool or someone new you meet may open a bigger door than you'd expect.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 확장의 별 목성이 사자자리로 들어와 {{하우스영역}}에 머물기 시작했습니다. 이 영역에서 나답게 드러내고 즐기는 일에 순풍이 불어온 때예요. 하반기에 반가운 일이 있었다면 이 흐름과 이어져 있을 수 있어요.
rows.en: With Jupiter, the planet of expansion, entering Leo on {{날짜}}, a tailwind began blowing through {{하우스영역}}. You gained momentum for showing up as yourself and enjoying life your way here. If something good came along in the second half of the year, it connects to this shift.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Jupiter, the planet of expansion, entered Leo and began to settle in {{하우스영역}}. It's when a tailwind began to blow for showing yourself and enjoying things in your own way in this area. If something happy happened in the second half of the year, it may be tied to this flow.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}, 확장의 별 목성이 자기표현의 별자리인 사자자리로 옮겨 왔어요. 나를 드러내고 즐거움을 되찾는 일에 순풍이 불기 시작한 날입니다. 하반기에 작은 자신감이 붙었다면 이 바람을 탄 것일 수 있어요.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, Jupiter, the planet of expansion, moved into Leo, the sign of self-expression. From that day, Jupiter opened the way toward being seen and finding your joy again. That spark of confidence you felt later in the year? You were riding that breeze.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Jupiter, the planet of expansion, moved into Leo, the sign of self-expression. It's the day a tailwind began to blow for showing who you are and rediscovering joy. If you gained a little confidence in the second half of the year, you may have been riding this breeze.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 변화의 별 천왕성이 상승궁 별자리인 {{별자리}}에 들어와 오래 머물기 시작했습니다. '나는 어떤 사람인가'에 대한 답과 나를 보여 주는 방식이 서서히 바뀌어 가는 출발선이에요. 낯선 내 모습이 어색할 수 있지만, 새로운 나를 시험해 볼 긴 시간이 열린 셈이기도 합니다.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, entered {{별자리}}, your rising sign, and settled in for a long stay. Your answer to 'Who am I?' and the way you present yourself begin a slow transformation. The new version of you feels unfamiliar at first, but you now have a long, open stretch to try it on.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, entered {{별자리}}, your Ascendant sign, and began a long stay. It's the starting line where your answer to 'Who am I?' and the way you show yourself slowly begin to change. An unfamiliar side of yourself may feel awkward, but it also means a long stretch has opened for trying out a new you.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 책임의 별 토성이 상승궁 별자리인 {{별자리}}에 들어왔어요. 나를 보여주는 방식과 몸의 리듬에 책임의 무게가 실리기 시작한 때입니다. 무겁게 느껴질 수 있지만, 나에게 맞는 모습만 남기고 단단히 다시 서는 시간이기도 해요.
rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, entered {{별자리}}, your rising sign, on {{날짜}}. Since then, the way you present yourself and your body's rhythms carry new weight. Heavy as it feels, this is your chance to keep only what truly suits you and stand up again, steadier than before.
rows.en_before_tone: On {{날짜}}, Saturn, the planet of responsibility, entered {{별자리}}, your Ascendant sign. It's when the weight of responsibility began to settle on how you present yourself and on your body's rhythms. It may feel heavy, but it's also a time to keep only what truly suits you and stand firmly again.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 토성이 태어날 때의 자리로 처음 돌아오는 토성 리턴의 고비가 있었습니다. 서른 무렵 '무엇을 책임지며 살 것인가'를 묻는 큰 점검이에요. 흔들렸던 만큼 나에게 맞는 삶의 뼈대를 다시 세우는 시간이기도 합니다.
rows.en: Around {{날짜}}, you reached your first Saturn return, the threshold where Saturn comes back to the spot it held when you were born. Arriving around age 30, it is a major life review that asks, 'What am I willing to take responsibility for?' However much it shook you, it also hands you the chance to rebuild your life on a framework that truly fits.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, there was a turning point called the Saturn return, when Saturn came back for the first time to where it was when you were born. It's a big check-in around age 30 that asks, 'What will I take responsibility for in my life?' If it shook you, it's also a time to rebuild a life framework that fits you.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 토성이 태어날 때의 자리로 두 번째로 돌아오는 토성 리턴의 고비가 있었어요. 그동안 쌓아 온 것 가운데 무엇을 지키고 무엇을 내려놓을지 묻는 점검입니다. 서두르기보다 앞으로의 시간을 어떻게 쓰고 싶은지 차분히 정리하기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Your second Saturn return arrived around {{날짜}}, as Saturn came back to its birth position once more. It reviews everything you've built so far: what to hold on to, and what to set down. Skip the rush. Take this time to map out, calmly, how you want to spend the years ahead.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, there was a turning point called the second Saturn return, when Saturn came back a second time to where it was when you were born. It's a check-in that asks what to keep and what to set down from all you've built so far. Rather than rushing, it's a good time to calmly sort out how you want to spend the time ahead.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 확장의 별 목성이 태어날 때의 자리로 돌아오는 목성 리턴이 있었습니다. 열두 해에 한 번꼴로 찾아오는, 새로운 확장의 주기가 시작되는 때예요. 이즈음 시작한 일이나 들어온 기회가 다음 몇 해의 씨앗이 될 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Around {{날짜}}, Jupiter, the planet of expansion, came home to the spot it held at your birth: your Jupiter return. Roughly once every twelve years, this return opens a fresh cycle of growth. What you started and the opportunities that arrived around then are seeds for the next few years, so tend them well.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, there was a Jupiter return, when Jupiter, the planet of expansion, came back to where it was when you were born. It comes around about once every twelve years and marks the start of a new cycle of growth. Things you started or opportunities that came in around this time may become seeds for the next few years.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 변화의 별 천왕성이 태어날 때의 자리와 마주 보는 자리에 섰어요. 마흔 무렵 찾아오는, 삶의 다음 장을 어떻게 살지 묻는 큰 전환의 신호입니다. 익숙한 것이 흔들렸다면 그만큼 미뤄 둔 나다움을 꺼낼 기회가 열린 때이기도 해요.
rows.en: Around {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, reached the point directly opposite where it sat when you were born. Arriving around age 40, this transit signals a major turning point and asks how you want to live your next chapter. Where familiar things got shaken, a door opened to the parts of yourself you had put on hold.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, Uranus, the planet of change, stood opposite where it was when you were born. Arriving around age 40, it's a signal of a big turning point that asks how you'll live the next chapter of your life. If familiar things were shaken, it may also have opened a chance to bring out the parts of yourself you'd put on hold.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 꿈과 영감의 별 해왕성이 태어날 때의 자리와 긴장하는 각도를 이뤘습니다. 그동안 믿어 온 목표가 흐릿해지고 '정말 원하던 게 이것이었나' 하고 묻기 쉬운 때예요. 길을 잃은 느낌이 들었다면 더 나에게 맞는 꿈을 다시 그리는 과정이었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Around {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, formed a tense angle to its place in your birth chart. Goals you believed in for years start to blur, and you catch yourself asking, 'Is this really what I wanted?' If you felt lost, you were redrawing a dream that fits you better.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, Neptune, the planet of dreams, formed a tense angle to where it was when you were born. It's a time when goals you've long believed in can blur, and it's easy to ask, 'Is this really what I wanted?' If you felt lost, it may have been part of redrawing a dream that fits you better.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 키론이 태어날 때의 자리로 돌아왔어요. 키론은 오래된 아픔과 그것을 돌보는 힘을 상징하는 작은 천체입니다. 쉰 무렵 찾아오는 이 시기는 지나온 상처를 탓하기보다 그 경험이 남긴 다정함을 알아보기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Around {{날짜}}, Chiron returned to where it was when you were born. Chiron is a small body in the sky that symbolizes old wounds and our power to tend them. Arriving around age 50, this season invites you to tend old hurts and notice the strength and tenderness they grew in you.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, Chiron returned to where it was when you were born. Chiron is a small celestial body that symbolizes old wounds and the strength to tend them. Arriving around age 50, this period is a good time to recognize the tenderness your experiences left behind, rather than blaming past hurts.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}의 일식이 태어날 때의 {{행성}} 자리 위에서 일어났습니다. 일식은 새로운 시작의 문을 여는 하늘의 신호로 읽혀요. 이 무렵 {{행성:이/가}} 맡은 영역에서 시작된 일이 있다면 오래 이어질 씨앗일 수 있습니다.
rows.en: The solar eclipse on {{날짜}} fell right on your natal {{행성}}. Astrologers read solar eclipses as cosmic signals that open the door to new beginnings. Whatever began around then in the part of life {{행성}} rules is a seed with a long life ahead of it.
rows.en_before_tone: The solar eclipse on {{날짜}} took place right on your birth {{행성}}. A solar eclipse is read as a sign from the sky that opens a door to new beginnings. If something began around this time in the area {{행성}} looks after, it may be a seed that lasts a long time.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}의 월식이 태어날 때의 {{행성}} 자리 위에서 일어났어요. 월식은 무언가가 한 단락을 맺고 정리되는 때를 상징합니다. 이 무렵 {{행성:이/가}} 맡은 영역에서 끝맺은 일이 있다면 새 자리를 비우는 과정이었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: On {{날짜}}, a lunar eclipse landed right on your natal {{행성}}. Lunar eclipses mark the moments when a chapter closes and loose ends get tied up. If something ended around then in the part of life {{행성}} rules, it was clearing space for what comes next.
rows.en_before_tone: The lunar eclipse on {{날짜}} took place right on your birth {{행성}}. A lunar eclipse symbolizes a time when something closes a chapter and gets sorted out. If something came to an end around this time in the area {{행성}} looks after, it may have been a process of making room for something new.

rows.ko: {{날짜}}에는 느리게 움직이는 별 하나가 태어날 때의 {{행성}} 자리 위에서 멈춘 듯 방향을 바꿨습니다. 하늘의 기운이 한 지점에 오래 머물러 그 영역의 주제가 유난히 또렷해지는 때예요. 이 무렵 마음에 오래 남은 일이 있다면 올해의 숙제가 무엇이었는지 알려 주는 단서일 수 있어요.
rows.en: Around {{날짜}}, a slow-moving planet stationed right on your natal {{행성}}, appearing to stand still before it changed direction. When a planet lingers on one point like this, the themes of that area come into sharp focus. Whatever stayed with you from that time is a clue to what this year was really asking of you.
rows.en_before_tone: Around {{날짜}}, a slow-moving planet seemed to stand still right on your birth {{행성}} and changed direction. It's a time when the sky's energy lingers on one point, making that area's themes especially clear. If something stayed on your mind for a long time around then, it may be a clue to what this year's homework was.

rows.ko: 올해는 큰 별들이 내 차트의 중요한 자리를 세게 건드리지 않은, 하늘이 조용했던 해입니다. 바깥에서 밀어붙이는 힘이 적었던 만큼 내가 속도를 정할 수 있었던 해이기도 해요. 그래서 올해 해낸 것과 쉬어 간 것 모두 나의 선택에 가까웠다고 볼 수 있습니다.
rows.en: The sky stayed quiet for you this year: the big planets made no strong contact with the key points in your chart. With less pressure from outside, you set your own pace. What you accomplished and when you chose to rest were, in large part, your own choices.
rows.en_before_tone: This was a quiet year in the sky, when the big planets didn't strongly touch the key points of your chart. With less pressure pushing from outside, it was also a year when you could set your own pace. So both what you achieved and where you rested this year can be seen as closer to your own choices.

rows.en_before_tone: Jupiter-Sun conjunction

rows.ko: 확장의 별이 나의 중심에 겹치는 자리 — 나를 넓게 펼치고 싶은 마음이 커져요
rows.en: Jupiter, the planet of expansion, lands right on your core — your urge to spread your wings grows stronger

rows.en: Uranus puts pressure on your core — you start asking whether your current role still fits

rows.en_before_tone: A time to tell impulse apart from what you really want, and choose what to change and what to keep.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 나의 중심과 긴장하는 각도를 이루면, 계획이 틀어지거나 지금의 역할이 갑자기 답답하게 느껴지기 쉽습니다. 그 답답함은 내가 원하는 방향이 달라졌다는 신호일 수 있어요. 당장 뒤집기보다 무엇이 나를 조이는지 적어 보면, 바꿀 것과 지킬 것이 구분되기 시작합니다.
rows.en: Uranus forms a challenging angle to your Sun, so plans change unexpectedly or your current role suddenly feels suffocating. rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with your core, plans can go sideways or your current role can suddenly feel stifling. That feeling may be a sign that the direction you want has changed. Instead of overturning everything right away, it can help to write down what's holding you in; you may start to see what to change and what to keep.

rows.en: The planet of change meets your emotional center — the things you leaned on emotionally begin to shift
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change meets your emotional center — what your heart leaned on starts to shift

rows.ko: 집이나 생활 환경처럼 마음이 기대던 곳에 예상 밖의 변화가 있었을 거예요.
rows.en: Something you leaned on emotionally, like your home or living situation, changed in ways you didn't see coming.
rows.en_before_tone: There were likely unexpected changes in places your heart relied on, like your home or living situation.

rows.ko: 새로운 생활 리듬 속에서 나만의 안정 기준을 다시 세우는 때예요.
rows.en: Within a new daily rhythm, define what stability means to you now.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to set new standards for your own sense of stability within a new daily rhythm.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 감정의 별과 겹치면 마음이 쉽게 들뜨거나 갑자기 가라앉는 등 기복이 커질 수 있습니다. 이사나 생활 방식의 변화처럼 마음의 기반이 움직이는 일도 이 흐름과 함께 오곤 해요. 낯선 변화 속에서도 매일 지키는 작은 루틴 하나가 마음의 닻이 되어 줍니다.
rows.en: When Uranus crosses your Moon, the planet of feelings, your moods swing wider, from easily excited to suddenly low. Changes that shift your emotional ground, like moving house or changing how you live, often arrive with this transit. Amid the unfamiliar, keep one small daily routine: it becomes your anchor.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change meets the planet of feelings, your emotions may swing more, lifting easily or suddenly sinking. Changes that move your emotional footing, like a move or a new lifestyle, often come with this flow. Even amid unfamiliar change, one small routine you keep every day can be an anchor for your heart.

rows.en: A new kind of stability
rows.en_before_tone: Resetting stability

rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Moon harmony

rows.en: Uranus gently awakens your feelings — you get room to breathe
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change gently wakes your feelings — your heart gets room to breathe

rows.ko: 답답하던 감정에 숨통이 트이거나, 새로운 공간에서 마음이 가벼워진 순간이 있었을 거예요.
rows.en: Pent-up feelings finally found air, or a new space made you feel lighter.
rows.en_before_tone: There were likely moments when stuck feelings found some air, or your heart felt lighter in a new space.

rows.ko: 생활 공간이나 습관을 조금 바꿔 마음에 새 공기를 넣기 좋은 시기예요.
rows.en: Refresh your mood by switching up your space or habits a little.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to bring fresh air to your heart by changing your space or habits a little.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 돕는 각도로 감정의 자리에 닿으면, 오래 묵은 감정이 자연스럽게 풀리기 쉽습니다. 방 배치를 바꾸거나 낯선 동네를 걸어 보는 작은 변화가 의외로 큰 환기가 돼요. 마음이 편해지는 새 방법을 발견하기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: As Uranus makes a supportive angle to your Moon, long-held emotions loosen on their own. Small changes, like rearranging your room or wandering an unfamiliar neighborhood, bring a surprisingly big refresh. Explore new ways to feel at ease; you find them easily now.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change reaches your feelings from a supportive angle, long-held emotions can loosen naturally. rows.en_before_tone: A refresh for the heart

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change puts tension on your feelings — familiar stability wavers for a while

rows.en: The places where you usually find rest, like home or close relationships, felt shaky for a while.
rows.en_before_tone: Places where your heart used to rest, like your home or close relationships, may have felt unsteady for a while.

rows.en: Even while things feel unsettled, build safe places to return to, one by one.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to build places to come back to, one by one, even while things feel unsteady.

rows.en: With Uranus at a challenging angle to your Moon, unexpected changes pop up in your living situation or in how close you are to people. Some days you feel restless for no clear reason. That restlessness makes you question whether your usual ways of feeling secure still work, so set aside a deliberate time and place to rest.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with the planet of feelings, unexpected changes can come up in your living situation or in how close you are to people. You may also have more days when your heart feels restless for no clear reason. That unsteadiness makes you look again at whether your current way of finding stability still works for you, so it helps to deliberately set a time and place for rest.

rows.en: Shifting ground

rows.en: Uranus–Mercury conjunction

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change meets the planet of thought — flashes of insight pour in

rows.en: Unexpected ideas and news kept rolling in, and your mind stayed busy.
rows.en_before_tone: Unexpected ideas or news likely came in one after another, keeping your mind busy.

rows.en: Stretch your thinking by embracing new knowledge and skills.

rows.en: Uranus crosses your Mercury, the planet of thought and speech, so your mind speeds up and fresh ideas arrive easily. rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change sits on the planet of thought and speech, your mind speeds up and unfamiliar ideas come easily. New studies, information from other fields, or unexpected messages can shift the direction of your thinking. Rather than voicing every idea right away, it can help to jot them down, so the useful ones are easier to spot.

rows.en: A surprising answer came to a problem you'd been stuck on, or welcome news arrived.
rows.en_before_tone: An unexpected answer may have come to a problem you were stuck on, or you may have heard welcome news.

rows.en: Shake up how you work a little, with new tools or new skills.
rows.en_before_tone: A good flow for making small changes to the way you work, with new tools or new learning.

rows.ko: 계획이 갑자기 바뀌거나 말이 엇갈려 정신없이 지나간 날들이 있었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Some days rushed by in a blur of sudden plan changes and crossed wires.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been hectic days with sudden changes of plan or crossed wires.

rows.ko: 급한 결론보다 한 번 더 확인하며 생각을 정리하는 때입니다.
rows.en: Double-check and sort out your thoughts instead of jumping to conclusions.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to double-check and sort your thoughts rather than jump to conclusions.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 생각의 별과 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 머릿속이 어수선해지고, 갑작스러운 일정 변경이나 연락 착오가 생기기 쉽습니다. 머리가 바쁜 만큼 말이 먼저 나가기도 해요. 중요한 말과 결정은 한 번 적어 보고 다시 읽는 습관이 이 시기의 속도를 다루는 방법입니다.
rows.en: Uranus forms a challenging angle to your Mercury. Your head feels cluttered, last-minute schedule changes and miscommunications multiply, and with so much going on, words slip out before you've thought them through. Write down important points and decisions, then read them over: that is how you stay in step with this fast-moving season.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with the planet of thought, your mind can feel cluttered, and sudden schedule changes or mix-ups in communication are more likely. With your mind so busy, words may come out before you've thought them through. Writing down what you want to say and the decisions that matter, then reading them again, is one way to handle the speed of this time.

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change meets the planet of what you love — what draws you starts to change

rows.en: Explore new tastes and new ways of loving with an open, curious heart.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to explore new tastes and new ways of relating with an open mind.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 좋아하는 것의 별과 겹치면 예전에 좋던 것이 시들해지고 전혀 다른 것에 끌리기 쉽습니다. 관계에서도 더 자유롭고 솔직한 방식을 바랄 수 있어요. 갑자기 큰돈을 쓰거나 관계를 서둘러 바꾸기보다, 새로 끌리는 것이 나에게 무엇을 말하는지 먼저 살펴보세요.

rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change meets the planet of what you love, things you used to enjoy may lose their spark, and you may be drawn to something completely different. rows.en: New people and new hobbies brought you joy you never saw coming.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely found unexpected joy in new people or hobbies.

rows.ko: 익숙한 관계에 새로운 활동을 더해 활력을 찾기 좋은 시기예요.
rows.en: Bring a new activity into a familiar relationship and rekindle the spark.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to bring new energy to familiar relationships by adding new activities.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 돕는 각도로 좋아하는 것의 별에 닿으면, 일상에 신선한 즐거움이 자연스럽게 들어옵니다. 처음 가 보는 장소나 새로운 모임, 다른 스타일이 기분을 환하게 바꿔 줄 수 있어요. 가까운 사람과도 늘 하던 것 대신 새로운 것을 함께 해 보기 좋은 때입니다.

rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Venus tension

rows.en_before_tone: In relationships or spending, the question 'Is this really what I want?' may have suddenly come up.

rows.ko: 관계와 돈에서 내가 진짜 원하는 거리와 균형을 찾아보는 때입니다.
rows.en: Find the closeness and balance you truly want, in love and with money.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to find the distance and balance you truly want in relationships and money.

rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with the planet of what you love, you may want more freedom in relationships, or feel as if your feelings have suddenly cooled. This unsteadiness is less a sign to end a relationship and more a sign that the distance and balance you want have changed, so it may help to let big decisions sit for a day or two first.

rows.en: Uranus–Mars conjunction

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 행동의 별과 겹치는 때 — 당장 움직이고 싶은 힘이 솟아요
rows.en: Uranus joins your Mars — a jolt of energy urges you to act now
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change meets the planet of action — a surge of energy makes you want to move right now

rows.ko: 갑자기 무언가를 시작하거나 그만두고 싶은 강한 충동이 들었을 거예요.
rows.en: A sudden, powerful urge to start something new, or to quit something, took hold of you.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely felt a strong urge to suddenly start something or quit something.

rows.ko: 솟아오르는 추진력을 새로운 도전 한 가지에 모아 쓰는 때예요.
rows.en: Pour this surge of drive into one new challenge, not ten.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to channel your rising drive into one new challenge.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 행동의 별과 겹치면 가만히 있기 어려울 만큼 에너지가 솟고, 결단도 빨라집니다. 새 프로젝트를 시작하거나 오래 참던 일에서 벗어날 용기가 생기기도 해요. 힘이 큰 만큼 여러 곳에 흩어지기 쉬우니, 한 가지 목표에 모아 쓰면 좋습니다.
rows.en: With Uranus on your Mars, energy surges until sitting still feels impossible, and your decisions come faster. You find the nerve to launch a new project or walk away from something you've tolerated too long. Energy this strong scatters easily, so aim it at a single goal.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change meets the planet of action, energy surges so much that it's hard to sit still, and your decisions come faster. You may find the courage to start a new project or step away from something you've put up with for a long time. Because this energy is so strong, it can scatter easily, so it helps to focus it on one goal.

rows.ko: 돌파 에너지
rows.en: Breakthrough energy

rows.ko: 천왕성-화성 조화
rows.en: Uranus–Mars trine/sextile (harmony)
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Mars harmony

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 의욕을 돕는 각도 — 과감한 시도가 잘 풀려요
rows.en: Uranus backs your drive — bold moves pay off
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change supports your drive — bold moves tend to work out

rows.ko: 평소라면 망설였을 일에 과감히 뛰어들었고, 생각보다 잘 풀렸을 거예요.
rows.en: You took a leap you'd normally think twice about, and it worked out better than expected.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely jumped into something you'd normally hesitate over, and it went better than you expected.

rows.ko: 새로운 방식으로 움직여 보는 용기가 결과로 이어지기 쉬운 흐름이에요.
rows.en: Dare to do things differently; that courage turns into real results now.
rows.en_before_tone: A time when the courage to try new ways of doing things tends to pay off.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 돕는 각도로 행동의 별에 닿으면, 새로운 시도를 할 용기와 실행력이 함께 붙습니다. 운동 루틴을 바꾸거나 일하는 순서를 새로 짜는 것처럼 작은 혁신이 잘 맞아요. 망설이던 도전이 있다면 첫걸음을 떼기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Uranus forms a supportive angle to your Mars, pairing the courage to try something new with the drive to follow through. Small innovations suit you now: mix up your workout, or reshuffle the order of your day. Take the first step on that challenge you've been putting off.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change reaches the planet of action from a supportive angle, you get both the courage and the follow-through to try something new. Small innovations suit you now, like switching up your exercise routine or reorganizing how you work. If there's a challenge you've been hesitating over, it's a good time to take the first step.

rows.ko: 과감한 시도
rows.en: Bold moves

rows.ko: 천왕성-화성 긴장
rows.en: Uranus–Mars square/opposition (tension)
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Mars tension

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 행동에 긴장을 거는 각도 — 조급함과 부딪힘이 늘어요
rows.en: Uranus clashes with your Mars — impatience runs high and sparks fly
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change puts tension on your actions — impatience and clashes increase

rows.ko: 참을성이 바닥나 들이받고 싶거나, 계획을 뒤엎고 싶었던 순간이 있었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your patience ran out at times, and you wanted to push back hard or scrap your plans entirely.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been moments when your patience ran out and you wanted to push back hard or throw out your plans.

rows.ko: 급하게 움직이고 싶을 때 한 박자 쉬고 방향을 확인하는 때입니다.
rows.en: When the urge to rush hits, take a beat and check your direction.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to pause for a beat and check your direction when you feel the urge to rush.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 행동의 별과 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 답답함이 쌓이다 한순간에 터지기 쉽고, 서두르다 일이 꼬이기도 합니다. 그만큼 오래 묵은 상황을 바꿀 힘이 생겼다는 뜻이기도 해요. 행동하기 전에 몸을 먼저 움직여 들뜬 기운을 가라앉히고, 그다음에 결정해 보세요.
rows.en: Uranus squares off with your Mars, so frustration builds and then bursts all at once, and haste tangles things up. The same charge gives you the power to shake loose situations that have been stuck for ages. Before you act, move your body to burn off the restless energy, then make the call.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with the planet of action, frustration can build and then burst all at once, and rushing can tangle things up. It also means you now have the energy to change situations that have been stuck for a long time. Before you act, it can help to move your body first to settle that restless energy, and decide after that.

rows.ko: 조급함
rows.en: Impatience

rows.ko: 천왕성-상승궁 합
rows.en: Uranus–Ascendant conjunction

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리와 겹치는 때 — 보이는 내 모습이 바뀌어요
rows.en: Uranus crosses your Ascendant — the way you come across is changing
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change meets the point that shows who you are — the way you come across starts to change

rows.ko: 스타일이나 말투, 사람을 대하는 방식이 이전과 달라지기 시작했을 거예요.
rows.en: Your style, the way you speak, and how you treat people began to change.
rows.en_before_tone: Your style, the way you talk, or how you treat people likely started to change.

rows.ko: 새로운 나의 모습을 부담 없이 실험해 보는 시기예요.
rows.en: Try on a new version of yourself, no pressure attached.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to experiment freely with a new version of yourself.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리에 겹치면 사람들에게 보여 주는 나의 모습이 서서히, 때로는 눈에 띄게 바뀝니다. 새로운 환경이나 역할에 들어가며 첫인상이 달라졌다는 말을 듣기도 해요. 예전 모습을 지키려 애쓰기보다 지금 편한 모습을 따라가 보는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: As Uranus crosses your Ascendant, the self you show the world changes, sometimes slowly and sometimes in ways everyone notices. Stepping into a new setting or role, you hear that your first impression has changed. Don't cling to who you were; follow what feels comfortable now.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change sits on the point that shows who you are, the self you show others changes gradually, and sometimes noticeably. As you step into a new environment or role, people may tell you that your first impression has changed. Rather than working hard to hold on to how you used to be, it's okay to follow what feels comfortable now.

rows.ko: 새 얼굴
rows.en: A fresh face
rows.en_before_tone: A new face

rows.ko: 천왕성-상승궁 조화
rows.en: Uranus–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Ascendant harmony

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 나를 드러내는 방식을 돕는 각도 — 새 모습이 자연스러워요
rows.en: Uranus supports how you show up — a new side of you emerges with ease
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change supports the way you show yourself — a new side of you comes out naturally

rows.ko: 새로운 자리에서 평소와 다른 모습을 보여 줬는데 반응이 좋았을 거예요.
rows.en: You showed a different side of yourself somewhere new, and people loved it.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely showed a different side of yourself in a new setting, and people responded well.

rows.ko: 새로운 환경에서 나를 소개할 기회를 반갑게 맞기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Welcome every chance to introduce yourself in new circles.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to welcome chances to introduce yourself in a new environment.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 돕는 각도로 나를 드러내는 자리에 닿으면, 낯선 자리에서도 나답게 서는 것이 한결 쉬워집니다. 새 동료나 모임에서 의외의 매력을 알아봐 주는 사람이 생길 수 있어요. 작은 변신을 시도해도 무리 없이 받아들여지기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: Uranus's helpful angle to your Ascendant makes it far easier to be yourself, even in unfamiliar places. New coworkers or a new group spot a charm you didn't know you had. Go ahead with a small reinvention; people take to it easily.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change reaches the point that shows who you are from a supportive angle, it becomes much easier to be yourself even in unfamiliar settings. Someone among new colleagues or groups may notice a charm of yours you didn't expect. Even if you try a small makeover, it's likely to be received easily.

rows.ko: 가벼운 변신
rows.en: A light makeover

rows.ko: 천왕성-상승궁 긴장
rows.en: Uranus–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Ascendant tension

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리에 긴장을 거는 각도 — 지금의 내가 어색해져요
rows.en: Uranus pushes against your Ascendant — your current self starts to feel like a bad fit
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change puts tension on the point that shows who you are — your current self starts to feel awkward

rows.ko: 익숙한 내 모습이 어색하게 느껴지거나, 주변의 시선이 갑자기 신경 쓰였을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your familiar self started to feel awkward, and you grew suddenly self-conscious about how others saw you.
rows.en_before_tone: Your familiar self may have started to feel awkward, or you may have suddenly become self-conscious about how others saw you.

rows.ko: 남이 기대하는 나와 내가 원하는 나 사이의 거리를 좁혀 보는 때입니다.
rows.en: Close the gap between who others expect you to be and who you want to be.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to close the gap between the you others expect and the you that you want to be.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리와 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 지금까지의 내 모습이 꽉 끼는 옷처럼 느껴지기 쉽습니다. 주변의 기대와 내가 원하는 모습이 부딪히며 생활 리듬도 들쑥날쑥해질 수 있어요. 한꺼번에 다 바꾸기보다 하나씩 바꿔 보면, 어색함이 새 모습으로 자리 잡을 여유가 생깁니다.
rows.en: Uranus pushes against your Ascendant, and the way you've always been starts to feel like clothes you've outgrown. As other people's expectations collide with who you want to be, your daily rhythm turns uneven. Change one thing at a time, not everything at once, and the awkwardness settles into a new you.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with the point that shows who you are, the way you've been can feel like clothes that are too tight. As others' expectations clash with who you want to be, your daily rhythm may also become uneven. Rather than changing everything at once, you might try changing one thing at a time; that gives the awkwardness room to settle into a new you.

rows.ko: 어색한 옷
rows.en: Outgrown clothes
rows.en_before_tone: Clothes that don't fit

rows.ko: 천왕성-천정 합
rows.en: Uranus–Midheaven conjunction

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 커리어 자리와 겹치는 때 — 일의 방향에 새 길이 열려요
rows.en: Uranus reaches your Midheaven — a new path opens in your work life
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change meets your career point — a new path opens in your work direction

rows.ko: 일에서 예상 못 한 제안이나 역할 변화가 들어왔을 거예요.
rows.en: An unexpected offer or a shift in your role at work came your way.
rows.en_before_tone: Unexpected offers or changes in your role at work likely came your way.

rows.ko: 새로운 분야나 일하는 방식을 진지하게 검토해 볼 만한 때예요.
rows.en: Give a new field or a new way of working a serious look.
rows.en_before_tone: A time when it's worth seriously considering a new field or a new way of working.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 커리어의 자리에 겹치면 일과 사회적 방향에 뜻밖의 전환점이 찾아오기 쉽습니다. 갑작스러운 조직 변화일 수도, 다른 분야에서 들어온 제안일 수도 있어요. 그것이 지금 하는 일과 어떻게 이어지는지부터 따져 보면 변화를 내 길로 만들기가 수월해집니다.
rows.en: Uranus reaches your Midheaven and brings an unexpected turning point to your career and public direction. It arrives as a sudden shake-up at work, or as an offer from a completely different field. Ask first how it connects to what you do now, and you make the change your own.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change sits on your career point, an unexpected turning point can arrive in your work and your direction in the world. It might be a sudden change in your organization, or an offer from a different field. If you first look at how it connects with what you do now, it becomes easier to turn the change into your own path.

rows.ko: 커리어 전환점
rows.en: A career turning point

rows.ko: 천왕성-천정 조화
rows.en: Uranus–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Midheaven harmony

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 커리어를 돕는 각도 — 새로운 역할이 순조롭게 열려요
rows.en: Uranus boosts your career — new roles open up smoothly
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change supports your career — new roles open up smoothly

rows.ko: 일에서 새 프로젝트나 다른 역할을 맡을 기회가 자연스럽게 왔을 거예요.
rows.en: Chances to take on a new project or a different role came to you naturally.
rows.en_before_tone: Chances to take on a new project or a different role at work likely came naturally.

rows.ko: 새로운 역할이나 일하는 방식을 먼저 제안해 보기 좋은 흐름이에요.
rows.en: Be the first to pitch a new role or a better way of working.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to be the first to suggest a new role or a new way of working.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 돕는 각도로 커리어의 자리에 닿으면, 일에서의 새로운 시도가 큰 마찰 없이 받아들여지기 쉽습니다. 새 기술을 익히거나 다른 팀과 협업할 기회가 길을 넓혀 줄 수 있어요. 해 보고 싶던 일이 있다면 먼저 손을 들어 볼 만한 때입니다.
rows.en: A flowing angle from Uranus to your Midheaven means your new ideas at work land with little pushback. Learning a new skill or teaming up with another group widens your path. If there's something you've wanted to try, raise your hand now.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change reaches your career point from a supportive angle, new attempts at work tend to be accepted without much friction. Learning a new skill or collaborating with another team could widen your path. If there's something you've wanted to try, it's worth raising your hand first.

rows.ko: 새 역할
rows.en: A new role

rows.ko: 천왕성-천정 긴장
rows.en: Uranus–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus–Midheaven tension

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 커리어 방향에 긴장을 거는 각도 — 지금의 길을 다시 묻게 해요
rows.en: Uranus challenges your career direction — you start questioning the path you're on
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of change puts tension on your career direction — it makes you question your current path

rows.ko: 일의 방향이 흔들리거나, 지금 하는 일을 계속해도 될지 고민이 커졌을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your career direction felt shaky, and the question of whether to stay in your current job grew louder.
rows.en_before_tone: Your work direction may have felt shaky, or you may have wondered more and more whether to keep doing what you do.

rows.ko: 당장 바꾸기보다 원하는 일의 모습을 구체적으로 그려 보는 때입니다.
rows.en: Before you change anything, sketch in detail what the work you want actually looks like.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to picture the work you want in concrete detail rather than changing things right away.

rows.ko: 변화의 별이 커리어의 자리와 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 조직 개편이나 갑작스러운 업무 변화로 일의 방향이 흔들리기 쉽습니다. ‘당장 바꿔야겠다’는 충동도 강해질 수 있어요. 다만 이 흐름은 예상 못 한 제안이나 새 역할로 나타나기도 하니, 결정은 한 박자 늦추고 들어오는 기회를 차분히 따져 보세요.
rows.en: Uranus at odds with your Midheaven brings reorganizations or sudden shifts at work that throw your direction off course. The urge to 'just change everything now' grows strong, too. This transit also delivers unexpected offers and new roles, so slow your decisions by a beat and weigh each opportunity with a clear head.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of change forms a tense angle with your career point, restructuring or sudden changes at work can shake your direction. The urge to 'change everything now' may also grow strong. But this flow can also show up as an unexpected offer or a new role, so it can help to slow your decisions down a beat and calmly weigh the opportunities that come in.

rows.ko: 길 다시 묻기
rows.en: Rethinking your path
rows.en_before_tone: Questioning your path

rows.ko: 해왕성-태양 합
rows.en: Neptune–Sun conjunction

rows.ko: 꿈의 별이 나의 중심과 겹치는 때 — 나다움의 윤곽이 잠시 흐려져요
rows.en: Neptune, the planet of dreams, meets your Sun — your sense of who you are softens at the edges for a while
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of dreams meets your core — the outline of who you are blurs for a while

rows.ko: 내가 무엇을 원하는지 잘 모르겠다는 느낌이 들거나, 마음이 먼 곳을 향했을 거예요.
rows.en: You weren't sure what you wanted, and your mind kept drifting somewhere far away.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely felt unsure of what you wanted, or your heart was drawn somewhere far away.

rows.ko: 정답을 서두르지 않고, 끌리는 것을 천천히 따라가 보는 때예요.
rows.en: Don't rush for answers; follow what draws you in, one slow step at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to slowly follow what draws you, without rushing to find the right answer.

rows.ko: 흐릿함의 별이 나의 중심에 겹치면 목표가 안개 속에 있는 것처럼 흐려지고, 자신감도 들쭉날쭉하기 쉽습니다. 대신 예술이나 돌봄, 의미 있는 일처럼 마음 깊이 끌리는 것이 선명해지기도 해요. 지금은 큰 결론을 내리기보다 끌리는 것을 기록하며 나를 다시 알아 가는 시기입니다.
rows.en: Neptune, the planet of haze, sits on your Sun, and your goals drift into a fog while your confidence ebbs and flows. At the same time, what truly calls to you, like art, caregiving, or meaningful work, comes into sharper focus. Hold off on big conclusions: keep notes on what draws you and get reacquainted with yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of haze sits on your core, your goals can blur as if wrapped in fog, and your confidence can go up and down. On the other hand, what deeply draws you, like art, caregiving, or meaningful work, may become clearer. For now, rather than reaching big conclusions, it's a time to get to know yourself again by noting down what draws you.

rows.ko: 안개 속 나
rows.en: Lost in the fog
rows.en_before_tone: Yourself in the fog

rows.ko: 해왕성-태양 조화
rows.en: Neptune–Sun trine/sextile (harmony)
rows.en_before_tone: Neptune–Sun harmony

rows.ko: 영감의 별이 나의 중심을 돕는 각도 — 감수성이 힘이 돼요
rows.en: Neptune inspires your Sun — your sensitivity becomes a strength
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of inspiration supports your core — your sensitivity becomes a strength

rows.en: Music, writing, and other people's stories moved you more than usual.

This transit shows you what truly fulfills you, so when emotions run high, write things down before you decide anything.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation forms a tense angle with the planet of what you love, feelings of jealousy or control can come up in relationships, or tension can build around money. The tighter you hold on to something, the more suffocating it can feel. This time helps you sort out what truly fills you, so when emotions run high, it can help to write things down before making any decisions.

rows.ko: 붙잡음과 놓음
rows.en: Holding on and letting go

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 행동의 별과 겹치는 때 — 강한 의지가 깨어나요
rows.en: Pluto meets your Mars — a powerful will wakes up
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth meets the planet of action — a strong will awakens

rows.ko: 무언가를 끝까지 해내고 싶은 강한 의지로 밀어붙였을 거예요.
rows.en: You pushed ahead with a strong will to see something all the way through.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely pushed forward with a strong will to see something all the way through.

rows.ko: 강해진 의지를 오래 갈 목표 하나에 깊이 쏟는 때예요.
rows.en: Channel your stronger will into one long-term goal and go all in.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to pour your strengthened will deeply into one long-term goal.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 행동의 별에 겹치면 한번 마음먹은 일을 끝까지 밀고 가는 집념이 커집니다. 그 힘은 큰일을 이루게 하지만, 쉬지 않고 몰아붙이면 지치기도 쉬워요. 강도 높게 움직인 만큼 회복 시간도 일정에 같이 넣어 두는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: Pluto sits on your Mars, and once you set your mind on something, you see it through. That drive helps you accomplish big things, but pushing nonstop without a break burns you out. The harder you go, the more you need recovery time built into your schedule.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation sits on the planet of action, your determination to see things through once you've made up your mind grows. That strength can help you achieve big things, but if you push without rest, you can wear out easily. It helps to schedule recovery time alongside the intense effort.

rows.ko: 집념
rows.en: Sheer determination
rows.en_before_tone: Determination

rows.ko: 명왕성-화성 조화

rows.en_before_tone: Pluto–Mars harmony

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 행동을 돕는 각도 — 끈기와 회복력이 붙어요
rows.en: Pluto backs your Mars — you gain grit and resilience
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth supports your actions — persistence and resilience grow

rows.ko: 포기하고 싶던 일을 끝까지 버텨 결과를 냈을 거예요.
rows.en: You stuck with something you'd wanted to give up on and saw real results.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely stuck with something you wanted to give up on and saw it through to results.

rows.ko: 오래 걸리는 도전이나 습관 바꾸기를 시작하기 좋은 흐름이에요.
rows.en: Take on a long-haul challenge, or start changing a habit.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to start a long challenge or change a habit.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 돕는 각도로 행동의 별에 닿으면, 오래 버티는 힘과 다시 일어서는 힘이 함께 붙습니다. 운동 루틴을 다시 세우거나 큰 목표를 긴 계획으로 나눠 보기 좋아요. 꾸준히 쌓은 노력이 눈에 띄는 변화로 이어지기 쉬운 때입니다.
rows.en: With Pluto forming a helpful angle to your Mars, you gain both staying power and the ability to bounce back. Rebuild your workout routine, or break a big goal into a longer plan. Slow and steady effort now turns into visible change.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation reaches the planet of action from a supportive angle, you gain both staying power and the ability to bounce back. It's a good time to rebuild your exercise routine or break a big goal into a long-term plan. Steady effort is more likely to lead to visible change now.

rows.ko: 끈기

rows.en_before_tone: Persistence

rows.en_before_tone: Pluto–Mars tension

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 행동에 긴장을 거는 각도 — 힘과 힘이 부딪쳐요
rows.en: Pluto clashes with your Mars — it's force against force
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth puts tension on your actions — strength clashes with strength

rows.ko: 누군가와 주도권을 두고 부딪히거나, 화를 삼키느라 힘들었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: You butted heads with someone over who was in charge, and swallowing your anger took real effort.
rows.en_before_tone: You may have clashed with someone over who was in charge, or had a hard time holding your anger in.

rows.ko: 부딪히는 에너지를 바꾸고 싶은 일 하나에 돌려 쓰는 때입니다.
rows.en: Take that clashing energy and redirect it into one thing you want to change.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to redirect clashing energy into one thing you want to change.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 행동의 별과 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 주도권을 둘러싼 갈등이 생기고, 억눌린 화가 커지기 쉽습니다. 밀어붙일수록 반발도 커지는 시기예요. 그 강한 에너지를 운동이나 오래 미룬 정리처럼 바꾸고 싶은 일에 쓰면, 갈등이 변화의 동력이 될 수 있습니다.
rows.en: Pluto pushes hard against your Mars, so power struggles flare up and pent-up anger builds. The harder you push, the more pushback you get. Channel that intense energy into something you want to change, like a new workout or a long-overdue declutter, and the conflict becomes fuel for change.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation forms a tense angle with the planet of action, conflicts over who's in charge can arise, and pent-up anger can grow. It's a time when the harder you push, the more pushback you get. If you channel that strong energy into something you want to change, like exercise or a long-overdue cleanup, conflict can become fuel for change.

rows.ko: 주도권 갈등
rows.en: Power struggles
rows.en_before_tone: Struggles for control

rows.ko: 명왕성-상승궁 합
rows.en: Pluto–Ascendant conjunction

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리와 겹치는 때 — 존재감이 깊어져요
rows.en: Pluto crosses your Ascendant — your presence grows deeper
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth meets the point that shows who you are — your presence deepens

rows.ko: 겉모습이나 사람을 대하는 태도가 이전과 확연히 달라졌을 거예요.
rows.en: Your look, and the way you carry yourself with people, changed in a big way.
rows.en_before_tone: Your appearance or the way you treat people likely changed noticeably.

rows.ko: 보여 주고 싶은 나를 깊이 고민하며 새 모습으로 거듭나는 때예요.
rows.en: Think deeply about the self you want to show, and grow into someone new.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to think deeply about the self you want to show, and to grow into a new version of yourself.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리에 겹치면 사람들에게 강하고 깊은 인상을 주며, 존재감이 묵직해집니다. 나를 보여 주는 방식이 껍질을 벗듯 바뀌는 긴 과정이 시작되기도 해요. 서두르지 않고 새 모습이 자라도록 두면, 이전보다 단단한 내가 드러나기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: As Pluto crosses your Ascendant, you make a strong, lasting impression, and your presence carries more weight. A long process begins in which the way you present yourself changes, like a snake shedding its skin. Give your new self time to grow, and a stronger you emerges.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation sits on the point that shows who you are, you leave a strong, deep impression on people, and your presence grows weightier. A long process may begin in which the way you present yourself changes, like shedding a skin. If you let your new self grow without rushing, a stronger you is likely to emerge.

rows.ko: 탈피
rows.en: Shedding your skin

rows.ko: 명왕성-상승궁 조화
rows.en: Pluto–Ascendant trine/sextile (harmony)
rows.en_before_tone: Pluto–Ascendant harmony

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 나를 드러내는 방식을 돕는 각도 — 깊은 신뢰감을 줘요
rows.en: Pluto supports how you show up — people find you deeply trustworthy
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth supports the way you show yourself — you inspire deep trust

rows.ko: 말수가 적어도 믿음직한 사람으로 보여 중요한 일을 맡았을 거예요.
rows.en: Even without saying much, you came across as dependable and were trusted with important things.
rows.en_before_tone: Even without saying much, you likely came across as reliable and were trusted with important tasks.

rows.ko: 내 영향력을 차분히 키우며 신뢰를 쌓아 가기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: Grow your influence calmly and keep building trust.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to calmly grow your influence and build trust.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 돕는 각도로 나를 드러내는 자리에 닿으면, 꾸미지 않아도 믿음이 가는 분위기가 생깁니다. 어려운 상황에서 침착함이 돋보여 사람들이 기대 오기도 해요. 그 신뢰를 바탕으로 맡고 싶은 역할을 분명히 말해 보기 좋은 시기입니다.
rows.en: With Pluto in a helpful angle to your Ascendant, you give off a trustworthy air without even trying. Your calm stands out when things get tough, and people lean on you. Use that trust as a springboard: say clearly which role you want to take on.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation reaches the point that shows who you are from a supportive angle, you give off a trustworthy air without trying. Your calm stands out in hard situations, and people may come to lean on you. With that trust as your base, it's a good time to say clearly which role you'd like to take on.

rows.ko: 묵직한 신뢰
rows.en: Solid trust

rows.ko: 명왕성-상승궁 긴장
rows.en: Pluto–Ascendant square/opposition (tension)
rows.en_before_tone: Pluto–Ascendant tension

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리와 긴장하는 각도 — 맞지 않는 가면을 벗게 해요
rows.en: Pluto presses on your Ascendant — it's time to take off a mask that doesn't fit
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth is in tension with the point that shows who you are — it asks you to take off a mask that doesn't fit

rows.ko: 익숙한 모습으로는 더 버티기 어렵다고 느낀 순간이 있었을 수 있어요.
rows.en: At some point, you felt you couldn't keep going as the person you'd always been.
rows.en_before_tone: There may have been a moment when you felt you couldn't keep going as your familiar self.

rows.ko: 남을 위한 모습 대신 진짜 나로 서는 연습을 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: Practice showing up as your real self, not a version made to please others.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to practice standing as your real self instead of a version made for others.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 나를 드러내는 자리와 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 주변의 압박이나 관계의 갈등 속에서 지금까지의 모습을 유지하기 어려워지기 쉽습니다. 무리해서 버틴 만큼 생활 리듬도 흐트러질 수 있어요. 이 압박은 맞지 않는 가면을 벗게 하니, 쉬는 시간을 먼저 지키며 진짜 나의 모습을 조금씩 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: Pluto clashes with your Ascendant, and pressure from the people around you or friction in relationships makes it hard to keep being who you've been. Pushing yourself to hold it together throws your daily rhythm off, too. This pressure is helping you take off a mask that no longer fits, so protect your downtime first and let the real you come out little by little.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation forms a tense angle with the point that shows who you are, pressure from those around you or conflict in relationships can make it hard to keep up the way you've been. Pushing yourself to hold on can also throw off your daily rhythm. This pressure helps you take off a mask that doesn't fit, so it can help to protect your rest time first and let your real self come out little by little.

rows.ko: 가면 벗기
rows.en: Taking off the mask

rows.ko: 명왕성-천정 합
rows.en: Pluto–Midheaven conjunction

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 커리어 자리와 겹치는 때 — 일의 판이 크게 바뀌어요
rows.en: Pluto reaches your Midheaven — the whole game changes at work
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth meets your career point — the whole landscape of your work shifts

rows.ko: 일에서 한 단계가 끝나고 전혀 다른 단계가 시작되는 전환을 지났을 거예요.
rows.en: One chapter of your work ended, and a completely different one began.
rows.en_before_tone: You likely went through a transition where one stage of your work ended and a completely different one began.

rows.ko: 사회에서 맡고 싶은 역할을 근본부터 다시 그려 보는 때예요.
rows.en: Rethink, from the ground up, the role you want to play in the world.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to redraw, from the ground up, the role you want to play in the world.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 커리어의 자리에 겹치면 일이 한 시기를 마무리하고 새로운 판으로 넘어가기 쉽습니다. 더 큰 책임이나 영향력 있는 자리가 주어질 수도, 지금의 일을 근본부터 다시 보게 될 수도 있어요. 끝나는 것을 아쉬워하기보다 무엇을 새로 세울지에 힘을 모으는 편이 좋습니다.
rows.en: Pluto reaches your Midheaven, and your work life closes one chapter and moves onto a whole new playing field. You may be handed bigger responsibilities or a more influential role, or you rethink your work from the ground up. Don't dwell on what's ending; put your energy into what you want to build next.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation sits on your career point, your work can close one chapter and move into a whole new landscape. You may be given bigger responsibilities or a more influential position, or you may find yourself rethinking your current work from the ground up. Rather than dwelling on what's ending, it can help to focus your energy on what you'd like to build next.

rows.ko: 커리어 재편
rows.en: A career overhaul
rows.en_before_tone: Career reshaping

rows.ko: 명왕성-천정 조화
rows.en: Pluto–Midheaven trine/sextile (harmony)
rows.en_before_tone: Pluto–Midheaven harmony

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 커리어를 돕는 각도 — 영향력이 단단히 자라요

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth supports your career — your influence grows steadily

rows.ko: 일에서 실력을 인정받아 더 큰 권한이나 책임을 맡았을 거예요.
rows.en: Your skills won recognition at work, bringing you more authority or responsibility.
rows.en_before_tone: Your skills were likely recognized at work, and you took on more authority or responsibility.

rows.ko: 전문성을 깊게 다지며 영향력을 키우기 좋은 흐름이에요.
rows.en: Deepen your expertise and let your influence grow.
rows.en_before_tone: A good time to deepen your expertise and grow your influence.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 돕는 각도로 커리어의 자리에 닿으면, 꾸준히 쌓아 온 실력이 영향력으로 바뀌기 쉽습니다. 구조를 바꾸거나 어려운 문제를 푸는 역할에서 진가가 드러나요. 긴 호흡의 커리어 목표를 세우고 한 걸음씩 다지기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: As Pluto forms a flowing angle to your Midheaven, the skills you've built over time turn into real influence. You shine in roles that restructure systems or solve tough problems. Set long-range career goals and work toward them one step at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation reaches your career point from a supportive angle, the skills you've built steadily can turn into influence. Your true worth shows in roles that change structures or solve hard problems. It's a good time to set long-term career goals and build toward them one step at a time.

rows.en: Influence

rows.ko: 명왕성-천정 긴장
rows.en: Pluto–Midheaven square/opposition (tension)
rows.en_before_tone: Pluto–Midheaven tension

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별이 커리어 방향과 긴장하는 각도 — 일의 구조가 흔들려요
rows.en: Pluto challenges your career direction — the ground shifts under your work
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of rebirth is in tension with your career direction — the structure of your work is shaken

rows.ko: 조직의 변화나 윗사람과의 긴장 속에서 내 자리를 다시 생각했을 수 있어요.
rows.en: Amid changes at work or tension with higher-ups, you rethought where you stand.
rows.en_before_tone: Amid changes in your organization or tension with those above you, you may have rethought your place.

rows.ko: 힘의 흐름을 읽고, 내가 지킬 일의 가치를 분명히 하는 때입니다.
rows.en: Read how the power is shifting, and get clear on what you value in your work and want to protect.
rows.en_before_tone: A time to read how power is shifting and get clear on the value of the work you want to protect.

rows.ko: 깊은 변형의 별이 커리어의 자리와 긴장하는 각도를 이루면 조직 개편이나 권한 다툼처럼 내 힘으로 어쩔 수 없는 변화가 일에 밀려오기 쉽습니다. 버티기 힘든 압박으로 느껴질 수 있어요. 다만 이 흐름은 낡은 구조를 정리하고 새 자리로 옮겨 갈 계기도 되니, 내가 지키고 싶은 일의 가치를 먼저 분명히 해 두세요.
rows.en: Pluto at odds with your Midheaven sends changes beyond your control, like restructuring or power struggles, crashing into your work. The pressure feels hard to bear. Yet this transit also clears out old structures and moves you somewhere new, so first get clear on what you value in your work and want to protect.
rows.en_before_tone: When the planet of deep transformation forms a tense angle with your career point, changes beyond your control, like restructuring or power struggles, can sweep into your work. It may feel like pressure that's hard to bear. But this flow can also be a chance to clear out old structures and move to a new place, so it can help to first get clear on the value of the work you want to protect.

rows.ko: 힘의 재배치
rows.en: A shift in power
rows.en_before_tone: Power shifting

rows.en: River Otter
rows.en_before_tone: Otter

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 마음이 허전하면 내가 먼저 친구에게 연락해 약속을 잡아요. 답이 늦게 오면 휴대폰을 자꾸 들여다보며 마음이 급해집니다.
rows.en: These days, when I feel lonely, I'm the one texting friends to make plans. If they're slow to answer, I keep checking my phone and get antsy.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when I feel empty, I'm the one who reaches out to friends to make plans. If they're slow to reply, I keep checking my phone and start to feel anxious.

rows.ko: 해달
rows.en: Sea Otter
rows.en_before_tone: Sea otter

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 힘든 날에도 상대의 하루부터 묻고 이야기를 들어 주는 편이에요. 정작 내 이야기는 꺼내지 못한 채 대화가 끝나곤 합니다.
rows.en: Even on my own rough days, I usually ask how the other person is doing and just listen. Lately, conversations often end before I've said a word about myself.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, even on hard days, I tend to ask about the other person's day first and listen to them. Conversations often end before I've shared anything about myself.

rows.ko: 물범
rows.en: Seal
rows.note: 물범(Seal)과 물개(Fur seal, CHAR_13) 구분 위해 영어명 다르게 둠

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 힘든 일이 있어도 괜찮다고 말하고 혼자 조용히 추스르는 편입니다. 다 정리된 뒤에야 가까운 사람에게 지나간 일처럼 짧게 털어놓아요.
rows.en: Lately, when things get hard, I say I'm fine and pull myself together on my own. Only once it's all sorted do I mention it to someone close, briefly, like old news.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, even when something's hard, I tend to say I'm fine and quietly pull myself together alone. Only after it's all sorted do I briefly tell someone close, as if it's already in the past.

rows.ko: 비버
rows.en: Beaver

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 속상한 날일수록 할 일 목록을 정리하며 몸을 바쁘게 움직여요. 마음을 털어놓기보다 함께할 일과 계획부터 챙기는 쪽입니다.
rows.en: The more upset I am these days, the busier I keep myself, reworking my to-do list. Instead of opening up, I tend to focus on plans and things we can do together.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, the more upset I am, the more I keep busy by organizing my to-do list. Rather than opening up, I tend to focus first on plans and things we can do together.

rows.ko: 원앙
rows.en: Mandarin Duck
rows.en_before_tone: Mandarin duck

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 가까운 사람의 마음이 궁금하면 직접 찾아가 확인하고 싶어져요. 괜찮다는 대답을 듣고도 며칠 뒤 다시 묻고 싶어지곤 합니다.
rows.en: When I wonder how someone close to me is really feeling, I want to go see them and check. Lately, even after they say they're fine, I catch myself wanting to ask again a few days later.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when I wonder how someone close to me feels, I want to go and check in person. Even after hearing 'I'm fine,' I often want to ask again a few days later.

rows.ko: 펭귄
rows.en: Penguin

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 사이가 틀어질까 봐 서운한 일도 그냥 넘기고 상대 뜻을 따르는 편이에요. 함께 있는 자리가 편안하면 그걸로 됐다고 스스로를 달랩니다.
rows.en: Lately I let little hurts slide and go along with what the other person wants, because I don't want things to turn sour. If we're comfortable together, I tell myself that's enough.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, afraid of things going sour, I tend to let hurts slide and go along with what the other person wants. If being together feels comfortable, I tell myself that's enough.

rows.ko: 왜가리
rows.en: Heron

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 새로 가까워지는 사람을 한동안 멀찍이서 지켜보는 편입니다. 마음을 맡겨도 될지 혼자 충분히 가늠한 다음에야 한 걸음 다가가요.
rows.en: With someone new in my life, I tend to watch from a distance for a while these days. I only move closer once I've decided for myself that I can trust them.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, I tend to watch people I'm just getting close to from a distance for a while. I only take a step closer after I've weighed, on my own, whether I can trust them with my heart.

rows.ko: 백조
rows.en: Swan

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 겉으로는 아무렇지 않은 척하면서 속으로는 관계가 틀어지지 않게 계획을 짜요. 불안한 마음은 말하지 않고 혼자 대비책을 세워 둡니다.
rows.en: On the outside I act like everything's fine, but lately I'm quietly planning how to keep the relationship from falling apart. I keep my worries to myself and line up backup plans.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, I act as if nothing's wrong on the outside, while inside I'm making plans to keep the relationship from falling apart. I don't talk about my anxiety; I quietly prepare backup plans on my own.

rows.ko: 복어
rows.en: Pufferfish

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 누가 선을 넘는다 싶으면 그 자리에서 바로 불편하다고 말해요. 말하고 나서 말투가 생각보다 셌던 것 같아 마음에 걸리기도 합니다.
rows.en: These days, if someone crosses a line, I tell them on the spot that I'm not okay with it. Afterward, I sometimes worry I came across harsher than I meant to.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when I feel someone has crossed a line, I tell them right then that I'm uncomfortable. Afterward, it sometimes bothers me that my tone may have been sharper than I meant.

rows.ko: 소라게
rows.en: Hermit crab

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 거절하고 싶은 부탁도 상대 표정을 보면 결국 들어주고 말아요. 내 시간이 줄어드는 걸 알면서도 싫다는 말이 잘 나오지 않습니다.
rows.en: Lately, even when I want to turn down a favor, one look at their face and I end up saying yes. I know it's eating into my time, but 'no' just won't come out.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, even when I want to say no to a request, one look at the other person's face and I end up saying yes. I know it eats into my time, but the word 'no' just doesn't come out easily.

rows.ko: 거북
rows.en: Turtle

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 누가 내 영역에 불쑥 들어오면 말없이 연락을 줄이고 혼자 있는 시간으로 물러나요. 불편하다는 말 대신 조용히 자리를 비켜 숨을 고르는 쪽입니다.
rows.en: When someone barges into my space these days, I quietly text less and retreat into time alone. Instead of saying it bothers me, I slip away and catch my breath.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when someone suddenly steps into my space, I quietly reach out less and retreat into time alone. Instead of saying I'm uncomfortable, I tend to step aside quietly and catch my breath.

rows.ko: 조개
rows.en: Clam

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 사람마다 어디까지 보여 줄지 상황을 따져 보며 정하는 편입니다. 부탁을 받으면 들어줄 수 있는 만큼을 가늠한 뒤에 조건을 붙여 답해요.
rows.en: I've been deciding how much to show each person based on the situation. When someone asks for a favor, I first figure out how much I can give, then say yes with conditions.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, I tend to decide how much to show each person by weighing the situation. When someone asks me for something, I figure out how much I can do first, then answer with conditions.

rows.ko: 물개
rows.en: Fur seal
rows.note: 물범(CHAR_03 Seal)과 구분하기 위해 Fur seal 사용

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 하고 싶은 말이 생기면 바로 꺼내야 마음이 편해요. 급하게 말해 놓고 돌아서서 그 말을 다시 곱씹기도 합니다.
rows.en: Lately, if something's on my mind, I have to say it right away or I can't relax. Sometimes I blurt it out, then replay it in my head afterward.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when I have something to say, I need to get it out right away to feel at ease. Sometimes I blurt something out and then keep chewing it over afterward.

rows.ko: 돌고래
rows.en: Dolphin

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 대화에서 분위기를 살리는 맞장구는 잘 치지만 내 진짜 생각은 잘 꺼내지 않아요. 모임이 끝나고 나서야 하고 싶었던 말이 떠오르곤 합니다.
rows.en: In conversations these days, I'm great at chiming in to keep the mood up, but I rarely say what I actually think. It's often on the way home that I remember what I wanted to say.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, I'm good at reacting in ways that keep the conversation lively, but I rarely share what I really think. It's often only after the gathering that I remember what I wanted to say.

rows.ko: 혹등고래
rows.en: Humpback whale

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 할 말을 머릿속으로 여러 번 다듬느라 말할 때를 자주 놓쳐요. 메시지를 써 두고 한참 고친 뒤에야 보내는 날이 많습니다.
rows.en: I keep rehearsing what to say in my head, and lately I often miss my moment. Many days I draft a message and tweak it forever before I hit send.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, I often miss my chance to speak because I keep polishing what I want to say in my head. On many days, I write a message and revise it for a long time before sending it.

rows.ko: 개구리
rows.en: Frog

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 중요한 이야기는 상대 기분과 상황이 괜찮은 때를 골라 꺼내려고 합니다. 더 좋은 때를 기다리다 다음으로 미뤄 둔 말이 몇 가지 있어요.
rows.en: Lately, I try to save important talks for when the other person's mood and timing seem right. There are a few things I've put off, still waiting for a better moment.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, I try to bring up important things only when the other person's mood and situation seem right. There are a few things I've put off, waiting for a better moment.

rows.ko: 문어
rows.en: Octopus

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 누군가와 서먹해지면 그날 안에 먼저 연락해 풀고 싶어져요. 상대에게 생각할 시간이 필요해 보여도 답을 기다리기가 쉽지 않습니다.
rows.en: These days, if things get awkward with someone, I want to reach out and clear the air that same day. Even when they seem to need time to think, waiting for a reply is hard for me.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when things get awkward with someone, I want to reach out first and smooth things over that same day. Even when the other person seems to need time to think, it's hard for me to wait for a reply.

rows.ko: 해파리
rows.en: Jellyfish

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 다툼이 생기면 내가 먼저 웃으며 분위기를 풀고 넘어가요. 서운했던 마음은 말하지 않은 채 그냥 흘려보내는 편입니다.
rows.en: When we argue lately, I'm the first to crack a smile, lighten the mood, and move on. Whatever hurt I felt, I usually just let it go unsaid.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when an argument comes up, I'm the first to smile, ease the mood, and move on. I tend to let my hurt feelings drift away without saying anything.

rows.ko: 가오리
rows.en: Stingray

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 말다툼이 생기면 일단 자리를 피해 마음이 가라앉을 때까지 혼자 시간을 가져요. 다시 이야기할 준비가 되기까지 생각보다 오래 걸리기도 합니다.
rows.en: Lately, when an argument breaks out, I step away and take time alone until I've cooled down. Sometimes it takes longer than I expect before I'm ready to talk again.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when an argument starts, I step away first and take time alone until I've calmed down. Sometimes it takes longer than I expect before I'm ready to talk again.

rows.ko: 불가사리
rows.en: Starfish

rows.ko: 요즘 나는 사이가 어긋나면 무엇이 문제였는지 정리하고 해결책부터 찾으려 해요. 상대는 위로를 바랐는데 방법부터 말해 버린 적도 있습니다.
rows.en: When things go off track with someone these days, I try to pin down what went wrong and find a fix. More than once, they just wanted comfort and I jumped straight to solutions.
rows.en_before_tone: Lately, when things go wrong between me and someone, I try to sort out what the problem was and look for a solution first. There have been times when the other person wanted comfort, but I jumped straight to fixes.

B8.name: 고민 영역(Q1) 안내
B8.used_in: 연말·2027 파트 도입 연결, 고민 영역 이벤트 없을 때

rows.ko: 직업·커리어를 고르셨기에 차트에서 커리어와 사회적 역할을 맡는 자리, 그리고 매일의 업무와 루틴을 맡는 자리를 먼저 살폈어요. 일의 방향을 비추는 천정과 책임의 별 토성이 받는 흐름도 함께 읽었습니다.
rows.en: You picked Work & career, so we started with the part of your chart that rules career and your public role, plus the part that covers daily work and routines. We also read the transits to your Midheaven, which points to your work direction, and to Saturn, the planet of responsibility.
rows.en_before_tone: Since you chose Work & career, we first looked at the area of your chart for career and your role in the world, and the area for daily work and routines. We also looked at what's happening around your Midheaven, which lights up your work direction, and Saturn, the planet of responsibility.

rows.ko: 지금 일의 자리에는 큰 하늘의 움직임이 없는 편입니다. 바깥 흐름에 떠밀리지 않는 만큼 일의 속도와 다음 목표를 내가 정해 볼 수 있는 시기예요.
rows.en: No major transits touch your work area right now. With nothing outside pushing you, you set your own pace and choose your next goal.
rows.en_before_tone: There isn't much big movement in the sky over your work area right now. Since outside currents aren't pushing you along, it's a time when you can set your own work pace and next goal.

rows.ko: 진로·자기계발을 고르셨기에 넓은 배움과 신념을 맡는 자리, 그리고 가까운 배움과 말을 맡는 자리를 먼저 살펴보았습니다. 확장과 기회의 별 목성, 생각과 배움을 맡는 수성의 흐름도 함께 읽었어요.
rows.en: Because you chose Direction & growth, we looked first at the area for higher learning and beliefs, and the one for everyday learning and communication. We also tracked Jupiter, the planet of expansion and opportunity, and Mercury, which rules thinking and learning.
rows.en_before_tone: Since you chose Direction & growth, we first looked at the area for higher learning and beliefs, and the area for everyday learning and communication. We also looked at what's happening with Jupiter, the planet of expansion and opportunity, and Mercury, which rules thinking and learning.

rows.ko: 지금 배움의 자리에는 큰 하늘의 움직임이 없는 편이에요. 서두르라는 신호가 없는 만큼 무엇을 언제 배울지 내 리듬대로 고를 수 있는 시기입니다.
rows.en: Not much is stirring over your learning area right now. Nothing tells you to hurry, so choose what to learn, and when, in your own rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: There isn't much big movement in the sky over your learning area right now. With no signal to hurry, it's a time when you can choose what to learn, and when, at your own pace.

rows.ko: 연애를 고르셨기에 즐거움과 설렘을 맡는 자리, 그리고 가까운 일대일 관계를 맡는 자리를 먼저 살폈습니다. 좋아하는 것과 관계를 맡는 금성, 마음을 행동으로 옮기는 화성의 흐름도 함께 봤어요.
rows.en: For Love, we started with the area of joy and romance and the area of close one-on-one relationships. We also looked at Venus, which governs what you love and how you connect, and Mars, which turns feelings into action.
rows.en_before_tone: Since you chose Love, we first looked at the area for joy and romance, and the area for close one-on-one relationships. We also looked at what's happening with Venus, which rules what you love and relationships, and Mars, which turns feelings into action.

rows.ko: 지금 연애의 자리에는 큰 하늘의 움직임이 없는 편이에요. 하늘이 재촉하지 않는 만큼 관계의 속도와 거리를 내 마음에 맞춰 정해 볼 수 있는 때입니다.
rows.en: Your love area is quiet in the sky right now. No one's rushing you, so let your heart decide how fast and how close you want to get.
rows.en_before_tone: There isn't much big movement in the sky over your love area right now. Since the sky isn't rushing you, it's a time when you can set the pace and closeness of your relationships to suit your heart.

rows.ko: 가족을 고르셨기에 집과 가족, 마음의 뿌리를 맡는 자리를 먼저 살폈어요. 감정과 마음의 안정을 맡는 달이 어디에 있고 어떤 흐름을 받는지도 함께 읽었습니다.
rows.en: Since Family is your focus, we began with the area for home, family, and emotional roots. We also checked where your Moon, the planet of feelings and emotional security, sits and what's influencing it right now.
rows.en_before_tone: Since you chose Family, we first looked at the area for home, family, and emotional roots. We also looked at where your Moon, which rules feelings and emotional stability, sits and what's currently affecting it.

rows.ko: 지금 집과 가족의 자리에는 큰 하늘의 움직임이 없는 편입니다. 크게 흔드는 힘이 없는 만큼 가족과의 거리와 안부를 나누는 리듬을 내가 정할 수 있는 시기예요.
rows.en: Little is moving over your home and family area at the moment. With nothing big shaking things up, you decide how close to stay and how often to check in.
rows.en_before_tone: There isn't much big movement in the sky over your home and family area right now. With no strong forces shaking things up, it's a time when you can set your own rhythm for how close you stay to family and how you keep in touch.

rows.ko: 교우·사회관계를 고르셨기에 사람들과 공동체를 맡는 자리, 그리고 가까운 이웃과 말을 맡는 자리를 먼저 살펴보았습니다. 연락과 말을 맡는 수성, 뜻밖의 전환을 맡는 천왕성의 흐름도 함께 읽었어요.
rows.en: With Friends & social life as your pick, we looked first at the area for friends and community, and the area for neighbors and everyday communication. We also followed Mercury, which governs messages and conversation, and Uranus, the planet of unexpected turns.
rows.en_before_tone: Since you chose Friends & social life, we first looked at the area for community and friendships, and the area for neighbors and everyday communication. We also looked at what's happening with Mercury, which rules messages and conversation, and Uranus, which rules unexpected turns.

rows.ko: 지금 사람들의 자리에는 큰 하늘의 움직임이 없는 편이에요. 관계를 넓힐지 줄일지 바깥 흐름보다 내 기준으로 정할 수 있는 시기입니다.
rows.en: Things are calm in the sky over your social area for now. Whether you widen your circle or pull it in is up to you, not outside forces.
rows.en_before_tone: There isn't much big movement in the sky over your social area right now. It's a time when you can decide whether to widen or narrow your circle by your own standards rather than by outside currents.

rows.ko: 재정·생활안정을 고르셨기에 돈과 내 것, 자기가치를 맡는 자리, 그리고 함께 나누는 자원을 맡는 자리를 먼저 살폈습니다. 돈의 감각을 맡는 금성과 구조를 세우는 토성의 흐름도 함께 봤어요.
rows.en: You chose Money & stability, so we first looked at the area for money, possessions, and self-worth, along with the area for shared resources. We also read Venus, which shapes your sense of money, and Saturn, which builds structure.
rows.en_before_tone: Since you chose Money & stability, we first looked at the area for money, possessions, and self-worth, and the area for shared resources. We also looked at what's happening with Venus, which rules your sense of money, and Saturn, which builds structure.

rows.ko: 지금 돈과 생활의 자리에는 큰 하늘의 움직임이 없는 편입니다. 바깥에서 흔드는 힘이 적은 만큼 지출과 저축의 리듬을 내 속도로 다져 볼 수 있는 시기예요.
rows.en: Right now the sky over your money and everyday life is still. With little outside pressure, build a spending and saving rhythm that suits you.
rows.en_before_tone: There isn't much big movement in the sky over your money and daily-life area right now. With few outside forces shaking things, it's a time when you can firm up your spending and saving rhythm at your own pace.

A16.name: 행성·각도·하우스 뜻 (용어 사전)
A16.used_in: 시기별 표 접힌 근거의 ‘뜻 한 줄’ 조립 · 출생차트 휠 탭 시트

rows.ko: 나의 중심
rows.en: Your core

rows.ko: 내가 어떤 사람으로 살고 싶은지, 삶의 중심과 자아를 보여 줘요.
rows.en: Your sense of self, and the kind of person you want to be at heart.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows the kind of person you want to be — the center of your life and your sense of self.

rows.ko: 태양은 나를 움직이는 가장 큰 힘과 자아의 방향을 상징합니다. 태양이 놓인 별자리와 자리는 내가 빛나고 싶은 방식을 알려 줘요.
rows.en: The Sun represents your core drive and the direction your sense of self is heading. Its sign and house show how you want to shine.
rows.en_before_tone: The Sun symbolizes the greatest force that moves you and the direction of your sense of self. The sign and area where your Sun sits show the way you want to shine.

rows.ko: 감정의 별
rows.en: The planet of feelings

rows.ko: 마음이 편해지는 조건과 감정의 리듬을 보여 줍니다.
rows.en: What helps you feel at ease, and how your emotions ebb and flow.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows what helps your heart feel at ease and the rhythm of your emotions.

rows.ko: 달은 감정과 마음의 안정을 맡는 별이에요. 어떤 때 마음이 놓이고 어떤 때 흔들리는지 돌아보게 해 줍니다.
rows.en: The Moon rules your feelings and emotional security. It shows you what makes you feel safe and what throws you off balance.
rows.en_before_tone: The Moon rules feelings and emotional stability. It helps you look at when your heart feels settled and when it wavers.

rows.ko: 생각·말의 별
rows.en: The planet of thought and speech

rows.ko: 생각하고 말하고 연락하는 방식을 보여 줘요.
rows.en: How you think, talk, and stay in touch.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows how you think, speak, and keep in touch.

rows.ko: 수성은 생각과 말, 배움과 연락을 맡는 별입니다. 내가 정보를 받아들이고 마음을 말로 옮기는 방식을 비춰 줘요.
rows.en: Mercury governs thinking, speaking, learning, and communication. It shows how you take in information and put your thoughts into words.
rows.en_before_tone: Mercury rules thinking and speech, learning and communication. It lights up how you take in information and put your feelings into words.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것·관계의 별
rows.en: The planet of pleasure and relationships

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것, 관계를 맺는 방식, 돈을 대하는 감각을 보여 줍니다.
rows.en: What you love, how you connect with people, and how you handle money.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows what you love, how you form relationships, and how you relate to money.

rows.ko: 금성은 좋아하는 것과 관계, 돈의 감각을 맡는 별이에요. 무엇에서 기쁨을 느끼고 어떤 관계에서 편안함을 느끼는지 살펴보게 합니다.
rows.en: Venus governs what you love, your relationships, and your sense of money. It helps you see what brings you joy and which relationships feel like home.
rows.en_before_tone: Venus rules what you love, relationships, and your sense of money. It helps you look at what brings you joy and what kinds of relationships feel comfortable.

rows.ko: 추진력의 별
rows.en: The planet of drive
rows.note: 원문 '추진력의 별'(A8 본문은 '의욕의 별'). 둘 다 'the planet of drive'로 통일

rows.ko: 의욕이 생기는 계기와 그것을 행동으로 옮기는 방식을 보여 줘요.
rows.en: What fires you up, and how you turn that energy into action.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows what sparks your motivation and how you turn it into action.

rows.ko: 화성은 의욕과 행동, 추진력을 맡는 별입니다. 내가 무언가를 시작하고 밀고 나갈 때의 힘과 속도를 보여 줘요.
rows.en: Mars governs motivation, action, and drive. It shows how much force and speed you bring when you start something and push it forward.
rows.en_before_tone: Mars rules motivation, action, and drive. It shows the strength and speed you bring when you start something and push it forward.

rows.ko: 확장의 별
rows.en: The planet of expansion

rows.ko: 넓어지고 기회가 열리는 방향을 보여 주는 별입니다.
rows.en: Where your world opens up and opportunities come your way.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows the direction in which things widen and opportunities open up.

rows.ko: 목성은 확장과 기회를 상징하는 별이에요. 목성이 지나는 자리는 마음과 경험이 넓어지기 쉬운 영역으로 읽습니다.
rows.en: Jupiter stands for growth and opportunity. Wherever it travels in your chart, your outlook and experiences expand.
