rows.en_before_tone: Jupiter symbolizes expansion and opportunity. The areas it passes through are read as places where your heart and experience can grow wider.

rows.ko: 책임의 별
rows.en: The planet of responsibility

rows.ko: 삶의 구조와 책임을 점검하게 하는 별이에요.
rows.en: Asks you to take stock of the structure and responsibilities in your life.
rows.en_before_tone: Helps you review the structure and responsibilities of your life.

rows.ko: 토성은 책임과 구조, 시험을 상징하는 별입니다. 토성이 지나는 동안에는 무게가 느껴지지만, 그만큼 단단한 기반이 남기도 해요.
rows.en: Saturn stands for responsibility, structure, and tests. Its transits feel weighty, and they leave you standing on firmer ground.
rows.en_before_tone: Saturn symbolizes responsibility, structure, and tests. While it passes through, things can feel weighty, but it can also leave a solid foundation behind.

rows.ko: 변화의 별
rows.en: The planet of change

rows.ko: 뜻밖의 전환과 새로운 가능성을 불러오는 별입니다.
rows.en: Brings surprise turns and fresh possibilities.
rows.en_before_tone: Brings unexpected turns and new possibilities.

rows.ko: 천왕성은 갑작스러운 변화와 전환을 상징하는 별이에요. 흔들림과 함께 새로운 제안이나 역할, 다른 길이 열리는 계기가 되기도 합니다.
rows.en: Uranus stands for sudden change and turning points. It shakes things up, and it also opens the door to new offers, new roles, or a different path.
rows.en_before_tone: Uranus symbolizes sudden change and turning points. Along with the shake-up, it can also open the way to new offers, new roles, or a different path.

rows.ko: 흐릿함·꿈의 별
rows.en: The planet of haze and dreams
rows.note: 용어집은 '꿈과 영감의 별 = the planet of dreams'. 여기선 '흐릿함·꿈의 별'이라 haze and dreams로 번역. A8 본문에서도 꿈의 별/영감의 별/흐릿함의 별을 dreams/inspiration/haze로 구분함

rows.ko: 꿈과 영감을 주지만 방향을 잠시 흐릿하게 만드는 별이에요.
rows.en: Brings dreams and inspiration, but can make the way forward feel foggy for a while.
rows.en_before_tone: Brings dreams and inspiration, but can blur your sense of direction for a while.

rows.ko: 해왕성은 꿈과 영감, 흐릿함을 상징하는 별입니다. 상상력이 커지는 만큼 현실의 경계가 흐려질 수 있어, 확인하며 가는 태도가 도움이 돼요.
rows.en: Neptune stands for dreams, inspiration, and haze. As your imagination grows, the line between fantasy and reality can blur, so double-check things as you go.
rows.en_before_tone: Neptune symbolizes dreams, inspiration, and haze. As your imagination grows, the line between dream and reality can blur, so it helps to check things as you go.

rows.ko: 재탄생의 별
rows.en: The planet of rebirth

rows.ko: 깊은 곳에서 오래 걸려 일어나는 변형을 상징합니다.
rows.en: Deep, slow-burning transformation from the inside out.
rows.en_before_tone: Symbolizes transformation that happens deep down, over a long time.

rows.ko: 명왕성은 깊은 변형과 재탄생을 상징하는 별이에요. 천천히, 그러나 깊게 무언가를 정리하고 새로 태어나게 하는 흐름으로 읽습니다.
rows.en: Pluto stands for deep transformation and rebirth. Its influence is slow but profound, clearing out the old so something new can emerge.
rows.en_before_tone: Pluto symbolizes deep transformation and rebirth. It's read as a slow but deep process that clears things away and helps something new be born.
rows.note: A8 본문의 '깊은 변형의 별'은 'the planet of deep transformation'으로 번역함

rows.ko: 첫인상의 자리
rows.en: Your first impression
rows.en_before_tone: Your first-impression point

rows.ko: 나를 드러내는 방식과 첫인상, 몸의 리듬을 보여 줘요.
rows.en: How you come across, the first impression you make, and your body's natural rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows how you present yourself, your first impression, and your body's rhythm.

rows.ko: 상승궁은 태어난 순간 동쪽 지평선에 떠오르던 별자리입니다. 사람들이 나를 처음 만났을 때 느끼는 분위기와 내가 세상에 다가가는 방식을 보여 줘요.
rows.en: Your Ascendant is the sign that was rising on the eastern horizon when you were born. It shows the aura people sense when they first meet you and how you approach the world.
rows.en_before_tone: The Ascendant is the sign that was rising on the eastern horizon at the moment you were born. It shows the vibe people sense when they first meet you and the way you approach the world.

rows.ko: 커리어의 방향
rows.en: Your career direction

rows.ko: 일과 사회적 역할이 향하는 방향을 보여 줍니다.
rows.en: Where your work and public role are headed.
rows.en_before_tone: Shows the direction your work and role in the world are heading.

rows.ko: 천정은 태어난 순간 하늘의 가장 높은 곳에 있던 지점이에요. 내가 사회에서 어떤 역할로 알려지고 싶은지, 일의 방향을 비춰 줍니다.
rows.en: The Midheaven is the highest point in the sky at the moment you were born. It points to what you'd like to be known for and where your work is headed.
rows.en_before_tone: The Midheaven is the point that was highest in the sky at the moment you were born. It lights up the role you want to be known for in the world and the direction of your work.

rows.ko: 겹치는 자리
rows.en: meeting point
rows.en_before_tone: Meeting point

rows.ko: 두 행성이 겹쳐 서로의 힘이 가장 강하게 섞이는 각도예요.
rows.en: Two planets sit together, and their energies blend at full strength.
rows.en_before_tone: An angle where two planets overlap and their energies blend most strongly.

rows.ko: 합은 두 행성이 거의 같은 자리에서 만나는 각도입니다. 힘이 가장 강하고, 어떤 성격이 될지는 만나는 행성에 따라 달라져요.
rows.en: A conjunction happens when two planets meet at nearly the same point. It's the strongest aspect, and how it plays out depends on which planets are involved.
rows.en_before_tone: A conjunction is an angle where two planets meet at almost the same spot. It's the most powerful angle, and its character depends on which planets are meeting.

rows.ko: 자연스럽게 돕는 각도
rows.en: helping hand
rows.en_before_tone: A naturally supportive angle
rows.note: TERM_TRINE과 별칭 동일(원문도 동일)

rows.ko: 두 행성이 가볍게 손을 잡고 기회를 열어 주는 각도입니다.
rows.en: Two planets team up lightly and open doors for you.
rows.en_before_tone: An angle where two planets lightly join hands and open up opportunities.

rows.ko: 육분은 두 행성이 서로를 부드럽게 돕는 각도예요. 내가 조금만 움직이면 그 도움이 더 잘 살아나는 흐름으로 읽습니다.
rows.en: In a sextile, two planets give each other a friendly boost. The help is real, but it works best when you meet it halfway.
rows.en_before_tone: A sextile is an angle where two planets gently support each other. It's read as support that comes alive more fully when you make a little effort.

rows.ko: 긴장하는 각도
rows.en: friction
rows.en_before_tone: A tense angle

rows.ko: 두 행성이 부딪혀 압박을 주지만 그만큼 움직이게 만드는 각도예요.
rows.en: Two planets clash and create pressure, but that pressure gets you moving.
rows.en_before_tone: An angle where two planets clash and create pressure, but also push you to move.

rows.ko: 사각은 두 행성의 힘이 서로 엇갈리는 각도입니다. 불편함과 압박이 느껴지기 쉽지만, 그 긴장이 변화와 성장의 계기가 되기도 해요.
rows.en: A square forms when two planets pull in different directions. It feels uncomfortable at times, but that friction sparks change and growth.
rows.en_before_tone: A square is an angle where the energies of two planets cross each other. It can easily feel uncomfortable or pressured, but that tension can also spark change and growth.

rows.ko: 자연스럽게 돕는 각도
rows.en: easy flow
rows.en_before_tone: A naturally supportive angle

rows.ko: 두 행성이 같은 결로 흐르며 일을 순조롭게 돕는 각도입니다.
rows.en: Two planets are in sync, helping things run smoothly.
rows.en_before_tone: An angle where two planets flow in the same direction and help things go smoothly.

rows.ko: 삼분은 두 행성이 같은 원소의 결로 이어져 자연스럽게 돕는 각도예요. 힘을 들이지 않아도 흐름이 순하게 이어지기 쉬운 관계로 읽습니다.
rows.en: In a trine, two planets share the same element and support each other naturally. Things tend to flow with little effort on your part.
rows.en_before_tone: A trine is an angle where two planets are linked through the same element and naturally support each other. It's read as a relationship where things tend to flow easily without much effort.

rows.ko: 마주 보는 자리
rows.en: tug-of-war
rows.en_before_tone: Facing each other

rows.ko: 두 행성이 정반대에서 마주 보며 균형을 묻는 각도예요.
rows.en: Two planets face off from opposite sides, asking you to find your balance.
rows.en_before_tone: An angle where two planets face each other from opposite sides and ask you to find balance.

rows.ko: 충은 두 행성이 하늘의 정반대 쪽에서 마주 보는 각도입니다. 두 방향 사이에서 줄다리기가 느껴질 수 있고, 그만큼 균형을 찾는 연습이 돼요.
rows.en: An opposition forms when two planets sit on opposite sides of the sky. You feel pulled in two directions, and that tug-of-war teaches you to find balance.
rows.en_before_tone: An opposition is an angle where two planets face each other from opposite sides of the sky. You may feel a tug-of-war between two directions, and that becomes practice in finding balance.

rows.ko: 나 자신의 자리
rows.en: The self

rows.ko: 나 자신과 첫인상, 나를 드러내는 방식을 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: Who you are, the first impression you make, and how you show up in the world.
rows.en_before_tone: The area of your chart that covers who you are, your first impression, and how you present yourself.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 나라는 사람 자체와 몸의 리듬, 첫인상을 다룹니다. 행성이 이곳을 지나면 나를 보는 눈이나 보여 주는 방식이 달라지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: This house is all about you: your identity, your body's rhythm, and the impression you make. When a planet passes through, the way you see yourself and come across shifts.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers who you are, your body's rhythm, and your first impression. When a planet passes through, the way you see yourself or show yourself can easily change.

rows.ko: 돈·내 것의 자리
rows.en: Money & possessions

rows.ko: 돈과 내가 가진 것, 스스로를 얼마나 귀하게 여기는지를 다룹니다.
rows.en: Money, the things you own, and how much you value yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: Covers money, what you own, and how much you value yourself.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 돈과 소유, 자기가치를 다루는 곳이에요. 행성이 지나면 무엇을 가치 있게 여기는지, 돈을 대하는 기준은 어떤지 돌아보기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: This house rules money, possessions, and self-worth. When a planet passes through, you rethink what truly matters to you and how you handle money.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers money, possessions, and self-worth. When a planet passes through, it's easier to look back at what you value and how you approach money.

rows.ko: 배움·말의 자리
rows.en: Learning & communication

rows.ko: 배움과 말, 가까운 이웃과 형제를 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: Learning, communication, neighbors, and siblings.
rows.en_before_tone: The area that covers learning, communication, neighbors, and siblings.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 일상의 배움과 대화, 가까운 사람과의 연락을 다룹니다. 행성이 지나면 생각을 나누고 새로 배우는 일이 활발해지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: This house covers everyday learning, conversation, and keeping in touch with the people around you. When a planet passes through, ideas tend to flow and learning picks up.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers everyday learning, conversations, and keeping in touch with people close to you. When a planet passes through, sharing ideas and learning new things tend to become more active.

rows.ko: 집·뿌리의 자리
rows.en: Home & roots

rows.ko: 집과 가족, 마음의 뿌리를 다룹니다.
rows.en: Covers home, family, and your emotional roots.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 집과 가족, 마음이 돌아가 쉬는 곳을 다뤄요. 행성이 지나면 생활 공간이나 마음의 안정에 대한 생각이 깊어지기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: This house covers home, family, and wherever you go to recharge. When a planet passes through, you think more deeply about your living space and what makes you feel secure.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers home, family, and the place your heart returns to rest. When a planet passes through, your thoughts about your living space and emotional stability tend to deepen.

rows.ko: 즐거움·창작의 자리
rows.en: Joy & creativity

rows.ko: 즐거움과 연애, 창작처럼 마음이 설레는 일을 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: Fun, romance, creativity, and anything that gives you butterflies.
rows.en_before_tone: The area that covers things that make your heart flutter, like fun, romance, and creativity.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 놀이와 취미, 창작, 연애처럼 나를 즐겁게 하는 일을 다룹니다. 행성이 지나면 무엇이 나를 신나게 하는지 다시 살펴보기 좋아요.
rows.en: This house is about what lights you up: play, hobbies, creative projects, and romance. When a planet passes through, it's a great time to rediscover what gets you excited.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers what brings you joy, like play, hobbies, creativity, and romance. When a planet passes through, it's a good time to look again at what excites you.

rows.ko: 일상·루틴의 자리
rows.en: Daily routines

rows.ko: 매일의 업무와 루틴, 몸을 돌보는 습관을 다룹니다.
rows.en: Your daily work, routines, and habits that keep your body well.
rows.en_before_tone: Covers daily work, routines, and habits of caring for your body.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 반복되는 일과 생활 습관, 몸 관리를 다루는 곳이에요. 행성이 지나면 하루의 리듬과 일하는 방식을 정비하게 되기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: This house rules the day-to-day: regular tasks, habits, and taking care of your body. When a planet passes through, you fine-tune your daily rhythm and the way you work.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers recurring tasks, daily habits, and looking after your body. When a planet passes through, you may find yourself reworking your daily rhythm and the way you work.

rows.ko: 일대일 관계의 자리
rows.en: One-on-one relationships

rows.ko: 가까운 일대일 관계와 파트너를 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: Close one-on-one relationships and partnerships.
rows.en_before_tone: The area that covers close one-on-one relationships and partners.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 동료나 짝처럼 마주 보는 관계를 다룹니다. 행성이 지나면 관계에서 주고받는 균형을 돌아보게 되기 쉬워요.
rows.en: This house covers one-on-one relationships, from close colleagues to romantic partners. When a planet passes through, you start weighing the give-and-take in your relationships.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers face-to-face relationships, like colleagues or partners. When a planet passes through, you may find yourself looking at the balance of give-and-take in your relationships.

rows.ko: 깊은 유대의 자리
rows.en: Deep bonds

rows.ko: 깊은 유대와 함께 나누는 자원, 마음 깊은 곳의 변화를 다룹니다.
rows.en: Deep bonds, shared resources, and profound inner change.
rows.en_before_tone: Covers deep bonds, shared resources, and changes deep in your heart.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 깊이 신뢰하는 관계와 함께 쓰는 자원, 내면의 변형을 다뤄요. 행성이 지나면 오래 묻어 둔 마음을 정리하는 계기가 되기도 합니다.
rows.en: This house covers relationships built on deep trust, shared resources, and inner transformation. A planet passing through gives you the chance to work through feelings you've kept buried for a long time.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers deeply trusting relationships, shared resources, and inner transformation. When a planet passes through, it can become a chance to sort through feelings you've long kept buried.

rows.ko: 넓은 배움·여행의 자리
rows.en: Higher learning & travel

rows.ko: 넓은 배움과 여행, 내가 믿는 가치를 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: Higher learning, travel, and the values you live by.
rows.en_before_tone: The area that covers higher learning, travel, and the values you believe in.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 먼 곳으로 떠나는 여행과 깊은 공부, 삶의 신념을 다룹니다. 행성이 지나면 시야를 넓히고 싶은 마음이 커지기 쉬워요.
rows.en: This house covers long-distance travel, in-depth study, and your outlook on life. When a planet passes through, you feel a stronger pull to broaden your horizons.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers travel to faraway places, deep study, and your beliefs about life. When a planet passes through, your wish to broaden your horizons tends to grow.

rows.ko: 일·커리어의 자리
rows.en: Career

rows.ko: 커리어와 사회적 역할, 일의 방향을 다룹니다.
rows.en: Your career, public role, and where your work is headed.
rows.en_before_tone: Covers your career, your role in the world, and the direction of your work.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 사회에서 맡는 역할과 일의 성과를 다루는 곳이에요. 행성이 지나면 커리어의 방향이나 책임에 대한 고민이 커지기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: This house covers your public role and what you achieve at work. When a planet passes through, questions about your career path or responsibilities tend to come up.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers the role you play in the world and what you achieve at work. When a planet passes through, questions about your career direction or responsibilities tend to grow.

rows.ko: 사람들·미래의 자리
rows.en: Community & future

rows.ko: 사람들과 공동체, 미래의 목표를 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: Your people, your community, and your hopes for the future.
rows.en_before_tone: The area that covers people, community, and future goals.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 친구와 모임, 함께 꿈꾸는 미래를 다룹니다. 행성이 지나면 어떤 사람들과 어디로 가고 싶은지 돌아보기 좋아요.
rows.en: This house covers friends, groups, and the future you're building together. When a planet passes through, it's a good time to think about who you want by your side and where you want to go.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers friends, groups, and the future you dream of together. When a planet passes through, it's a good time to reflect on who you want to be with and where you want to go.

rows.ko: 쉼·내면의 자리
rows.en: Rest & inner life

rows.ko: 쉼과 내면, 보이지 않는 곳에서의 정리를 다룹니다.
rows.en: Rest, your inner world, and the work that happens behind the scenes.
rows.en_before_tone: Covers rest, your inner life, and the sorting that happens out of sight.

rows.ko: 이 자리는 혼자만의 시간과 쉼, 마음속 정리를 다뤄요. 행성이 지나면 겉으로 드러나지 않게 다음을 준비하는 시기가 되기 쉽습니다.
rows.en: This house covers time alone, rest, and inner processing. When a planet passes through, you quietly prepare for what's next, away from the spotlight.
rows.en_before_tone: This area covers time alone, rest, and sorting things out inside. When a planet passes through, it can become a time of quietly preparing for what's next, out of view.

rows.ko: 거꾸로 가는 듯한 때
rows.en: When things seem to go backward
rows.en_before_tone: A time that seems to run backward

rows.ko: 행성이 뒤로 가는 것처럼 보이는 기간으로, 그 행성의 일을 다시 돌아보게 해요.
rows.en: When a planet appears to move backward, a cue to revisit the parts of life it rules.
rows.en_before_tone: A period when a planet appears to move backward, inviting you to look again at the things that planet governs.

rows.ko: 역행은 지구에서 볼 때 행성이 잠시 거꾸로 움직이는 것처럼 보이는 현상입니다. 그 행성이 맡은 일을 새로 벌이기보다 다시 살피고 고치기 좋은 때로 읽어요.
rows.en: A planet goes retrograde when, seen from Earth, it seems to move backward for a while. It's better for reviewing and fixing what that planet rules than for starting anything new.
rows.en_before_tone: Retrograde is when a planet, seen from Earth, briefly appears to move backward. We read it as a good time to review and fix what that planet looks after, rather than starting something new.

rows.ko: 제자리로 돌아오는 때
rows.en: Coming full circle
rows.en_before_tone: A time of coming full circle

rows.ko: 지금 하늘의 행성이 태어날 때의 자리로 돌아와 한 주기를 점검하게 합니다.
rows.en: A planet comes back to where it was when you were born, a moment to look back over a full cycle.
rows.en_before_tone: A planet in today's sky returns to where it was when you were born, inviting you to look back over a whole cycle.

rows.ko: 리턴은 행성이 한 바퀴를 돌아 내 출생차트의 같은 자리로 돌아오는 때예요. 그 행성이 맡은 영역에서 지난 주기를 정리하고 다음을 준비하는 계기로 읽습니다.
rows.en: A return happens when a planet completes its orbit and comes back to the same spot in your birth chart. It's a chance to wrap up the last cycle in that area of life and get ready for the next one.
rows.en_before_tone: A return is when a planet completes its circuit and comes back to the same spot in your birth chart. We read it as a chance to wrap up the last cycle in that planet's area of life and get ready for the next.

rows.ko: 지금 하늘의 행성
rows.en: Planets in today's sky

rows.ko: 지금 하늘을 지나는 행성이 내 출생차트의 자리를 건드리는 흐름이에요.
rows.en: When planets moving through today's sky activate points in your birth chart.
rows.en_before_tone: The flow created when planets moving through today's sky touch points in your birth chart.

rows.ko: 트랜짓은 지금 실제 하늘에서 움직이는 행성이 태어날 때의 행성과 각도를 이루는 것을 말합니다. 시기별 흐름은 대부분 이 트랜짓을 바탕으로 읽어요.
rows.en: A transit is when a planet in the actual sky right now forms an angle with a planet in your birth chart. Most timing in your reading is based on transits.
rows.en_before_tone: A transit is when a planet moving in the real sky right now forms an angle with a planet from your birth. Most timing readings are based on these transits.

rows.ko: 새 별자리로 넘어가는 때
rows.en: Moving into a new sign

rows.ko: 행성이 다음 별자리로 넘어가 분위기가 바뀌는 때입니다.
rows.en: A planet crosses into the next sign, and the mood shifts.
rows.en_before_tone: The moment a planet crosses into the next sign and the mood shifts.

rows.ko: 별자리 이동은 행성이 한 별자리를 지나 다음 별자리로 들어서는 순간이에요. 느린 행성일수록 그 뒤로 오랫동안 이어질 분위기가 시작되는 출발선으로 읽습니다.
rows.en: An ingress is the moment a planet leaves one sign and enters the next. The slower the planet, the longer the new mood it sets in motion.
rows.en_before_tone: A sign change (ingress) is the moment a planet leaves one sign and enters the next. The slower the planet, the more we read it as a starting line for a mood that lasts a long while.

rows.ko: 새 출발의 신호
rows.en: A signal for fresh starts
rows.en_before_tone: A sign of fresh starts

rows.ko: 해가 가려지는 날로, 새로 시작할 것을 떠올려 보게 하는 상징이에요.
rows.en: The day the Sun goes dark, a cue to think about what you'd like to begin.
rows.en_before_tone: The day the Sun is hidden from view, a symbol that invites you to think about what you'd like to begin.

rows.ko: 일식은 달이 해를 가리는 날로, 점성술에서는 새 장을 여는 신호로 읽습니다. 무언가를 서두르기보다 앞으로 키우고 싶은 것을 차분히 적어 보기 좋은 때예요.
rows.en: A solar eclipse happens when the Moon blocks the Sun, and in astrology it marks the start of a new chapter. Instead of rushing into anything, take time to jot down what you'd like to grow from here.
rows.en_before_tone: A solar eclipse is the day the Moon covers the Sun, and astrology reads it as a signal that a new chapter is opening. Rather than rushing anything, it's a good time to calmly write down what you'd like to grow from here.

rows.ko: 마무리의 신호
rows.en: A signal for closure
rows.en_before_tone: A sign of closure

rows.ko: 달이 가려지는 날로, 정리하고 마무리할 것을 돌아보게 하는 상징입니다.
rows.en: The day the Moon goes dark, a cue to look at what you're ready to wrap up.
rows.en_before_tone: The day the Moon is hidden from view, a symbol that invites you to look at what you're ready to wrap up and close.

rows.ko: 월식은 지구의 그림자가 달을 가리는 날로, 점성술에서는 한 단락을 정리하는 신호로 읽어요. 놓아줄 것과 계속 가져갈 것을 나눠 보기 좋은 때입니다.
rows.en: A lunar eclipse happens when Earth's shadow falls across the Moon, and in astrology it marks the close of a chapter. Use it to sort out what to let go of and what to keep.
rows.en_before_tone: A lunar eclipse is the day Earth's shadow covers the Moon, and astrology reads it as a signal to close a chapter. It's a good time to sort out what to let go of and what to keep carrying.

B1a.name: 행성 × 별자리 (수성·금성·화성·목성·토성)
B1a.used_in: 출생차트 휠 행성 탭 시트(태양·달·상승궁 외 행성; 무료는 첫 문장만, 나머지 블러)

rows.ko: 생각이 떠오르면 바로 말로 꺼내는 빠르고 솔직한 머리를 가졌어요.
rows.en: Your mind is quick and candid: the moment a thought sparks, it's out of your mouth.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a quick, honest mind that puts thoughts into words the moment they arrive.

rows.ko: 결론을 먼저 말하고 이유는 나중에 붙이는 편입니다. 회의 중에 좋은 생각이 스치면 손이 먼저 올라가기도 해요. 짧고 분명한 대화에서 실력이 가장 잘 드러납니다.
rows.en: You lead with the bottom line and fill in the reasons later. When a good idea strikes mid-meeting, your hand shoots up before you've even thought it through. Keep conversations short and direct; that's where you're sharpest.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to give the conclusion first and add the reasons later. When a good idea flashes by in a meeting, your hand might go up before you know it. Your skills shine brightest in short, clear conversations.

rows.ko: 천천히 생각하고 한번 이해한 것은 오래 붙잡아 두는 머리입니다.
rows.en: You think things over at your own steady pace, and once an idea clicks, it stays with you for good.
rows.en_before_tone: You think things through slowly, and once you understand something, you hold on to it for a long time.

rows.ko: 새로운 정보를 들으면 바로 답하기보다 곱씹어 본 뒤에 말하는 편이에요. 설명서를 처음부터 끝까지 읽고 나서야 기계를 켜는 모습이 익숙할 수 있습니다. 느려 보여도 한번 내린 판단은 쉽게 흔들리지 않아요.
rows.en: When you hear something new, you'd rather mull it over than answer on the spot. You're the type who reads the whole manual before switching anything on. You can look slow to decide, but once you've made up your mind, you rarely waver.
rows.en_before_tone: When you hear something new, you'd rather chew on it before you answer. Reading the manual cover to cover before switching on a machine may feel very familiar. You may seem slow, but once you make a call, it doesn't waver easily.

rows.ko: 여러 생각을 빠르게 잇고 말로 풀어내는 데 재능이 있어요.
rows.en: You link ideas at lightning speed and put them into words with ease.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a gift for linking ideas quickly and putting them into words.

rows.ko: 대화 주제가 바뀌어도 금세 따라가고, 서로 다른 이야기에서 연결점을 찾아냅니다. 메신저 창을 여러 개 띄워 놓고도 답장이 막히지 않는 쪽이에요. 배우는 것 자체가 즐거움이라 새 분야에도 겁 없이 발을 들입니다.
rows.en: You keep up easily when a conversation jumps around, and you spot links between completely different stories in a flash. Juggling several chats at once without missing a reply is second nature. Learning is its own reward for you, so dive into new subjects without a second thought.
rows.en_before_tone: You keep up easily when the topic changes, and you spot connections between very different stories. You're the type who can juggle several chat windows without missing a reply. Learning is a joy in itself, so you step into new fields without fear.

rows.ko: 마음이 담긴 기억과 분위기로 생각하고 말하는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Feelings, memories, and the mood in the room shape how you think and speak.
rows.en_before_tone: You think and speak through heartfelt memories and the mood of a moment.

rows.ko: 들은 말의 내용보다 그 말을 할 때의 표정과 공기를 더 오래 기억하는 편이에요. 친구가 예전에 털어놓은 고민을 기억해 두었다가 조용히 안부를 묻는 장면이 자연스럽습니다. 편안한 사람 앞에서 말이 훨씬 술술 나와요.
rows.en: Long after the exact words fade, you remember the look on someone's face and the feeling in the air. You're the friend who recalls a worry shared months ago and quietly checks in. Around people who feel safe, your words flow freely.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to remember the expression and the atmosphere around something said longer than the words themselves. Remembering a worry a friend once shared and quietly checking in on them later comes naturally to you. Around people you feel at ease with, the words flow much more freely.

rows.ko: 생각을 이야기로 만들어 생생하게 전하는 힘이 있어요.
rows.en: You turn ideas into stories and bring them vividly to life.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a talent for turning thoughts into stories and telling them vividly.

rows.ko: 같은 내용도 내 식대로 맛을 살려 말할 때 사람들의 시선이 모이는 편입니다. 발표 자료를 만들 때 표 한 장보다 장면 하나를 먼저 떠올리기도 해요. 자신 있는 주제 앞에서는 목소리에 절로 힘이 실립니다.
rows.en: Even familiar material grabs attention when you tell it your way, with your own flair. Building a presentation, you picture a scene before you ever reach for a spreadsheet. Get going on a topic you believe in, and your voice carries naturally.
rows.en_before_tone: When you tell even familiar things in your own flavorful way, people's eyes tend to turn to you. When you're making a presentation, you might picture a scene before you'd ever think of a table. On topics you feel sure about, your voice naturally gains strength.

rows.ko: 작은 차이를 알아보고 생각을 차곡차곡 정리하는 머리입니다.
rows.en: Your mind catches the subtle differences and files every thought neatly in its place.
rows.en_before_tone: Your mind notices small differences and sorts thoughts neatly into place.

rows.ko: 흩어진 정보를 보면 자연스럽게 순서를 세우고 빠진 부분을 찾아내요. 동료가 놓친 오타나 일정의 빈틈을 먼저 발견하는 쪽이 당신일 때가 많습니다. 이런 꼼꼼함이 쌓여 믿고 맡길 수 있는 사람이라는 인상을 남겨요.
rows.en: Hand you a jumble of information, and you put it in order and spot what's missing. You're the first to catch a typo or a scheduling gap everyone else missed. Over time, that eye for detail earns you a reputation as someone people can count on.
rows.en_before_tone: When you see scattered information, you naturally put it in order and find what's missing. You're often the first to catch a typo or a gap in the schedule that a coworker missed. Over time, this care leaves people feeling they can trust you with things.

rows.ko: 여러 입장을 저울질해 보며 부드럽게 말을 고르는 편이에요.
rows.en: Before you speak, you weigh every side and choose your words with care.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to weigh different viewpoints and choose your words gently.

rows.ko: 한쪽 이야기만 듣고 결론 내리기보다 반대편의 사정도 궁금해하는 편입니다. 친구 둘이 다툴 때 양쪽 말을 차분히 정리해 주는 역할을 자주 맡기도 해요. 말투 하나에도 상대를 배려하는 감각이 묻어납니다.
rows.en: Rather than jumping to conclusions after hearing one side, you want the other person's story too. When two friends clash, you're the one who calmly lays out both points of view. Even your tone shows how much you consider the people you're talking to.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than deciding after hearing only one side, you're curious about the other side's story too. When two friends argue, you often end up calmly summing up both sides. Even your tone of voice carries a sense of consideration for others.

rows.ko: 겉말보다 속뜻을 읽어 내는 깊고 날카로운 생각을 가졌습니다.
rows.en: Deep and sharp, your mind is always reading between the lines.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a deep, sharp mind that reads the meaning beneath the words.

rows.ko: 궁금한 것이 생기면 겉에서 멈추지 않고 끝까지 파고드는 편이에요. 대화 중 상대가 말하지 않은 부분을 먼저 알아채고 조용히 질문을 던지기도 합니다. 꼭 필요한 말만 골라 하기에 한마디의 무게가 커요.
rows.en: Once something sparks your curiosity, you skip the surface and dig until you reach the bottom of it. In conversation, you sense what someone leaves unsaid and gently ask about it. You don't waste words, so when you speak, people listen.
rows.en_before_tone: When something makes you curious, you don't stop at the surface; you dig all the way down. In conversation, you may notice what someone hasn't said and quietly ask about it. Because you say only what truly needs saying, each word you speak carries weight.

rows.ko: 작은 사실보다 큰 그림과 의미를 먼저 보는 생각의 결이에요.
rows.en: You see the big picture and what it means long before you get to the details.
rows.en_before_tone: Your way of thinking sees the big picture and its meaning before the small facts.

rows.ko: 세세한 정보를 하나하나 따지기보다 ‘그래서 이게 어디로 이어질까’를 먼저 묻는 편입니다. 여행 책자를 펼치면 일정표보다 그곳 사람들의 이야기에 먼저 눈이 가기도 해요. 솔직하고 시원한 말투가 주변에 활기를 줍니다.
rows.en: Instead of picking apart every detail, your first question is, "So where is this going?" Flip through a travel guide, and you skip the itinerary for stories about the people who live there. Your frank, upbeat way of talking lifts the energy in any room.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than weighing every detail, you tend to ask first, "So where does this lead?" When you open a travel guide, the stories of the local people may catch your eye before the itinerary. Your honest, refreshing way of speaking brings energy to those around you.

rows.ko: 실제로 쓸모 있는 생각을 차근차근 쌓아 가는 머리입니다.
rows.en: Step by step, your mind builds ideas that hold up in the real world.
rows.en_before_tone: Your mind builds up genuinely useful ideas, one step at a time.

rows.ko: 말하기 전에 이것이 현실에서 가능한지 한 번 더 따져 보는 편이에요. 회의가 길어질 때 ‘그럼 누가 언제까지 할까요?’ 하고 정리하는 사람이 당신일 수 있습니다. 시간을 들여 익힌 지식은 오래도록 든든한 자산이 돼요.
rows.en: Before you speak up, you check one more time that an idea is realistic. When a meeting goes in circles, you're the one who wraps it up with, "Okay, who's doing what, and by when?" Whatever you take the time to learn becomes a solid, lasting asset.
rows.en_before_tone: Before you speak, you tend to double-check whether something is actually doable. When a meeting drags on, you might be the one who wraps it up with, "So who's doing what, and by when?" Knowledge you've taken the time to learn becomes a lasting, reliable asset.

rows.ko: 남들이 놓친 각도에서 생각을 비틀어 보는 독창적인 머리예요.
rows.en: Your original mind flips ideas around to find the angles others overlook.
rows.en_before_tone: You have an original mind that turns ideas around to find angles others miss.

rows.ko: 익숙한 방식에 ‘꼭 이렇게 해야 할까?’라는 질문을 던지는 편입니다. 모두가 같은 방법을 고를 때 새 도구나 다른 길을 찾아보는 모습이 자연스러워요. 감정보다 원리를 따라갈 때 생각이 가장 맑아집니다.
rows.en: You're the one asking, "Does it really have to be done this way?" When everyone else reaches for the usual method, you go hunting for a new tool or a different route. Your thinking runs clearest when you follow logic and principle rather than feeling.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to ask of familiar ways, "Does it really have to be done like this?" When everyone picks the same method, looking for a new tool or a different path comes naturally to you. Your thinking is clearest when you follow principles rather than feelings.

rows.ko: 말보다 느낌과 이미지로 먼저 이해하는 섬세한 생각의 결입니다.
rows.en: Sensitive and intuitive, your mind grasps things through feelings and images before the words arrive.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a sensitive way of thinking: you often grasp things through feelings and images before words.

rows.ko: 논리로 설명하기 전에 ‘왠지 그럴 것 같다’는 감이 먼저 오는 편이에요. 음악을 들으며 걷다가 막혔던 생각의 실마리가 풀리기도 합니다. 떠오른 생각을 메모로 붙잡아 두면 흐릿함이 영감으로 바뀌어요.
rows.en: Long before you can explain something logically, you simply sense it. A stuck idea comes loose while you're out walking with music in your ears. Jot those passing thoughts down; what feels hazy now becomes real inspiration.
rows.en_before_tone: Before you can explain it logically, you tend to get a hunch that "somehow, this feels right." While walking with music on, the thread of a stuck thought may suddenly come loose. When you catch your ideas in a quick note, the haziness turns into inspiration.

rows.ko: 마음이 끌리면 망설이지 않고 먼저 다가가는 솔직한 애정이에요.
rows.en: When you like someone, you don't play it cool. You make the first move, honestly and without hesitation.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection is honest: when you feel drawn to someone, you reach out first without hesitating.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음을 오래 숨기기보다 표현할 때 관계가 살아난다고 느끼는 편입니다. 끌리는 물건을 보면 한참 고민하기보다 그 자리에서 고르는 모습도 익숙해요. 설렘이 있는 관계와 새로운 즐거움이 마음에 불을 지핍니다.
rows.en: Love comes alive for you when you say how you feel instead of sitting on it. If something catches your eye in a store, you grab it on the spot rather than agonize. Relationships with a spark and fresh kinds of fun are what truly light you up.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel a relationship comes alive when you express your feelings rather than hiding them for long. When something catches your eye, choosing it on the spot instead of agonizing may feel familiar. Relationships with a spark and fresh kinds of fun light a fire in your heart.

rows.ko: 손에 닿는 편안함과 오래가는 아름다움을 사랑하는 사람입니다.
rows.en: You love comfort you can touch and beauty that stands the test of time.
rows.en_before_tone: You love comfort you can touch and beauty that lasts.

rows.ko: 좋은 재료로 만든 음식, 촉감 좋은 옷처럼 감각으로 느끼는 즐거움에 마음이 열려요. 마음에 드는 머그잔 하나를 오래 아끼며 쓰는 모습이 당신과 잘 어울립니다. 사랑도 돈도 천천히 쌓아 가는 쪽에서 안정감을 느껴요.
rows.en: Sensory pleasures win you over: a meal made with good ingredients, clothes that feel wonderful against your skin. Cherishing one favorite mug for years is very you. In love and in money alike, you feel safest building slowly and steadily.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart opens to pleasures you feel through the senses, like food made with good ingredients or clothes that feel soft on the skin. Treasuring one favorite mug for years suits you well. In love and in money alike, you feel secure building things up slowly.

rows.ko: 대화가 통하는 사람과 가벼운 즐거움에 마음이 끌려요.
rows.en: You fall for people you can really talk to, and for fun that keeps things light.
rows.en_before_tone: You're drawn to people you can really talk with and to light, easy fun.

rows.ko: 함께 웃고 이야기 나눌 수 있는 관계에서 애정이 자라는 편입니다. 긴 통화나 밤늦게 이어지는 메시지가 무엇보다 설렐 때도 있어요. 새로운 취미를 시도하거나 작은 물건을 이것저것 써 보는 데서 즐거움을 찾습니다.
rows.en: Your affection blooms in relationships full of laughter and good conversation. A long phone call or a text thread that runs past midnight can be the most thrilling thing of all. You get a kick out of new hobbies and all kinds of playful little experiments.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection tends to grow in relationships where you can laugh and talk together. Sometimes a long phone call or messages that run late into the night are the most exciting thing of all. You find joy in trying new hobbies and testing out all sorts of little things.

rows.ko: 곁을 지켜 주고 챙겨 주는 방식으로 마음을 전하는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your love shows up as presence: being there and looking after the people who matter to you.
rows.en_before_tone: You show your love by staying close and taking care of people.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 사람이 끼니를 거르면 신경이 쓰이고, 작은 간식이라도 건네고 싶어지는 편이에요. 집처럼 편안한 공간과 익숙한 사람들 곁에서 가장 행복을 느낍니다. 돈도 소중한 사람들을 위해 쓸 때 보람이 커져요.
rows.en: If someone you love skips a meal, it nags at you until you hand them something, even just a snack. You're happiest in a cozy, homey space surrounded by familiar faces. Money feels best when you spend it on the people you cherish.
rows.en_before_tone: When someone you love skips a meal, it bothers you, and you want to hand them something, even just a small snack. You feel happiest in a cozy, homelike space with familiar people around you. Spending money on the people who matter to you feels especially rewarding.

rows.ko: 아낌없이 표현하고 함께 빛나는 순간을 좋아하는 애정이에요.
rows.en: You love out loud and generously, and you live for moments when you both get to shine.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection is generous and expressive, and you love moments when you shine together.

rows.ko: 마음을 주면 화끈하게 주고, 상대가 그 마음을 알아봐 줄 때 기쁨이 커지는 편입니다. 친구 생일에 작은 깜짝 선물이라도 준비하며 설레는 모습이 자연스러워요. 즐거움에 쓰는 돈은 나를 빛나게 해 주는 선물처럼 느껴지기도 합니다.
rows.en: When you give your heart, you go all in, and you're thrilled when the other person notices. Planning a little surprise for a friend's birthday excites you. Money spent on joy feels like a gift that lets you shine.
rows.en_before_tone: When you give your heart, you give it wholeheartedly, and your joy grows when the other person recognizes it. Getting excited while preparing even a small surprise gift for a friend's birthday comes naturally to you. Money spent on fun can feel like a gift that helps you shine.

rows.ko: 작은 배려와 꼼꼼한 손길로 사랑을 보여 주는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Thoughtful gestures and care in the little things are your love language.
rows.en_before_tone: You show love through small acts of care and an attentive touch.

rows.ko: 말로 크게 표현하기보다 상대에게 필요한 것을 조용히 챙겨 두는 편이에요. 함께 여행을 가면 준비물 목록을 먼저 만드는 쪽이 당신일 수 있습니다. 쓸모 있고 잘 만든 물건에서 은근한 즐거움을 느껴요.
rows.en: Instead of grand declarations, you quietly make sure the other person has what they need. On a trip together, you're the one who writes the packing list first. Useful, well-made things bring you a quiet, steady joy.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than making big declarations, you tend to quietly take care of what the other person needs. On a trip together, you might be the one who makes the packing list first. You find a quiet pleasure in useful, well-made things.

rows.ko: 조화로운 분위기와 서로 존중하는 관계에서 마음이 편해져요.
rows.en: You flourish in a harmonious atmosphere and in relationships built on mutual respect.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel at ease in a harmonious atmosphere and in relationships built on mutual respect.

rows.ko: 아름다운 공간, 균형 잡힌 대화처럼 어우러짐이 느껴질 때 기분이 좋아지는 편입니다. 약속 장소를 고를 때 음식 맛만큼 조명과 음악도 챙겨 보는 모습이 익숙해요. 관계에서는 주고받는 마음의 균형을 소중히 여깁니다.
rows.en: Things that come together beautifully, like a lovely space or a well-balanced conversation, lift your mood. When you choose a place to meet, the lighting and music matter almost as much as the food. In love, you keep the give-and-take even.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel good when things blend well, like a beautiful space or a balanced conversation. When choosing where to meet, checking the lighting and music as much as the food may feel familiar. In relationships, you value balance in the care you give and receive.

rows.ko: 한번 마음을 주면 깊고 진하게 오래 품는 애정입니다.
rows.en: Once you give your heart, your love runs deep, intense, and long.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you give your heart, your affection runs deep, strong, and long.

rows.ko: 가벼운 호감보다 속마음까지 나눌 수 있는 관계에 끌리는 편이에요. 여럿과 두루 어울리기보다 소수의 사람과 밤늦게 깊은 이야기를 나눌 때 마음이 채워집니다. 좋아하는 것에 한번 빠지면 끝까지 파고드는 진심이 있어요.
rows.en: A casual crush does little for you; you're drawn to relationships where you can share what's really going on inside. Rather than mingling with a crowd, you feel most fulfilled talking late into the night with a few kindred souls. When you fall for something, you go all in and explore every corner of it.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be drawn to relationships where you can share what's truly inside, more than to light attraction. Your heart feels full when you talk deeply late into the night with a few people, rather than mixing with many. Once you fall for something, you have the sincerity to explore it all the way.

rows.ko: 함께 넓은 세상을 경험할 때 애정과 즐거움이 커지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Love and joy grow for you when you explore the world with someone.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection and joy grow when you explore the wider world with someone.

rows.ko: 서로를 묶어 두기보다 각자의 자유를 존중하는 관계에서 마음이 편한 편입니다. 낯선 동네를 걷거나 처음 가 보는 식당에 들어서는 순간이 작은 설렘이 돼요. 물건보다 경험에 돈을 쓸 때 만족이 오래갑니다.
rows.en: You're most at ease in relationships where you each keep your freedom instead of tying each other down. Wandering an unfamiliar neighborhood or walking into a new restaurant gives you a little thrill. Spend on experiences rather than things; that happiness lasts longer.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel at ease in relationships that respect each other's freedom rather than tying each other down. Walking through an unfamiliar neighborhood or stepping into a restaurant for the first time becomes a small thrill. Spending on experiences rather than things leaves you satisfied for longer.

rows.ko: 시간이 지나도 변함없는 믿음으로 사랑을 보여 주는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your love shows up as steady loyalty that holds strong over the years.
rows.en_before_tone: You show love through steady trust that doesn't change with time.

rows.ko: 처음에는 조심스럽지만, 한번 신뢰가 쌓이면 묵묵히 곁을 지키는 편이에요. 유행하는 물건보다 오래 쓸 수 있는 좋은 물건을 고르는 안목이 있습니다. 돈과 즐거움 모두 계획 안에서 누릴 때 마음이 놓여요.
rows.en: You take it slow at first, but once trust is built, you stay by someone's side through thick and thin. You have an eye for quality that lasts rather than whatever's trending. You relax most when both your spending and your fun fit into a plan.
rows.en_before_tone: You're careful at first, but once trust is built, you tend to stay by someone's side quietly and faithfully. You have an eye for good things that last rather than whatever is trendy. You feel most at ease when both spending and fun fit within a plan.

rows.ko: 친구 같은 편안함과 서로의 개성을 지켜 주는 관계를 좋아해요.
rows.en: You like relationships that feel like friendship, where each of you gets to stay your own person.
rows.en_before_tone: You like relationships with friend-like ease, where each person's individuality is respected.

rows.ko: 가까워져도 각자의 시간과 생각을 존중받을 때 애정이 더 오래가는 편입니다. 남들이 잘 모르는 취향이나 독특한 물건을 발견하면 괜히 신이 나기도 해요. 같은 관심사로 모인 사람들 사이에서 즐거움이 넓어집니다.
rows.en: Even as you grow close, your affection lasts longer when your own time and ideas are respected. Stumbling on an obscure interest or a quirky find delights you. Your fun multiplies among people who share your passions.
rows.en_before_tone: Even as you grow close, your affection tends to last longer when your own time and thoughts are respected. Discovering a little-known taste or a quirky find can make you oddly excited. Your joy expands among people who gather around shared interests.

rows.ko: 경계 없이 스며드는 다정함으로 사랑하는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your love is tender and boundless, slipping past walls without even trying.
rows.en_before_tone: You love with a tenderness that flows in gently, without walls.

rows.ko: 상대의 기분을 말하지 않아도 알아채고, 그 마음에 조용히 맞춰 주는 편이에요. 좋아하는 영화를 보다 눈물이 맺히는 순간에도 마음이 채워지는 걸 느낍니다. 음악이나 그림처럼 마음을 적시는 아름다움에서 큰 위로를 얻어요.
rows.en: You sense how someone feels without a word and quietly tune in to them. Even tearing up during a favorite movie leaves you feeling full rather than drained. Beauty that stirs you, like music or art, is one of your deepest comforts.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to sense how someone feels without being told and quietly attune yourself to them. Even when tears well up during a favorite movie, you feel your heart being filled. You find deep comfort in beauty that moves the heart, like music or art.

rows.ko: 하고 싶은 일이 생기면 몸이 먼저 움직이는 추진력이에요.
rows.en: Once you want something, you're already moving before you've finished the thought.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a drive that gets your body moving the moment you want to do something.

rows.ko: 시작하는 순간의 열기가 가장 큰 연료가 되는 편입니다. 운동을 결심하면 그날 저녁 바로 운동화를 꺼내 신는 쪽이에요. 화가 나도 금방 표현하고 금방 털어 내는 시원함이 있습니다.
rows.en: The rush of beginning is your best fuel. Decide to get in shape, and you're lacing up your sneakers that same evening. Your anger flares fast and blows over just as fast.
rows.en_before_tone: The heat of getting started tends to be your biggest fuel. Once you decide to work out, you're the type who laces up your sneakers that very evening. Even when you get angry, you have a breezy way of expressing it quickly and shaking it off just as fast.

rows.ko: 천천히 시동이 걸리지만 한번 움직이면 끝까지 밀고 가는 힘입니다.
rows.en: You're slow to get started, but once you're moving, there's no stopping you.
rows.en_before_tone: Your energy takes a while to get going, but once it moves, it pushes all the way through.

rows.ko: 급하게 몰아붙이기보다 내 속도로 꾸준히 해 나갈 때 의욕이 오래가는 편이에요. 남들이 지쳐 그만둘 즈음에도 묵묵히 같은 일을 이어 가는 모습이 익숙합니다. 화는 쉽게 내지 않지만, 쌓이기 전에 조금씩 꺼내 두면 마음이 한결 가벼워져요.
rows.en: You stay motivated longest at a steady pace, not a sprint. When others burn out and quit, you're still there, quietly plugging away. You're slow to anger, so let frustrations out little by little before they pile up; it takes a real weight off.
rows.en_before_tone: Your motivation tends to last longer when you keep going steadily at your own pace rather than rushing. Quietly carrying on with the same task when others have tired and quit feels familiar. You don't anger easily, but letting it out bit by bit before it builds up can make your heart feel much lighter.

rows.ko: 궁금증과 대화가 의욕에 불을 붙이는 재빠른 추진력이에요.
rows.en: Curiosity and good conversation fire you up.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a quick drive, and curiosity and conversation are what spark your motivation.

rows.ko: 한 가지만 오래 붙잡기보다 여러 일을 오가며 할 때 오히려 힘이 나는 편입니다. 누군가와 아이디어를 주고받다 보면 어느새 실행 계획이 세워져 있기도 해요. 화가 나면 말이 빨라지기 쉬우니, 한 박자 쉬고 꺼내면 더 잘 전해집니다.
rows.en: Bouncing between several projects energizes you more than sticking with one. Trade ideas with someone for a while, and you've already sketched out a plan. When you're upset, your words rush out, so take a beat first and let your point land.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel more energized moving between several tasks than holding on to just one. While bouncing ideas off someone, you may find an action plan has already taken shape. When you're upset, your words can speed up, so taking a beat before you speak helps you get your point across.

rows.ko: 소중한 사람과 공간을 지키려 할 때 가장 큰 힘이 나오는 사람입니다.
rows.en: You're at your strongest when you're protecting the people and places you love.
rows.en_before_tone: Your greatest strength comes out when you're protecting the people and places you love.

rows.ko: 나 자신만을 위해서보다 아끼는 사람을 위해 움직일 때 의욕이 커지는 편이에요. 친구가 곤란한 일을 겪으면 누구보다 먼저 달려가는 모습이 떠오릅니다. 서운함은 속에 담아 두기 쉬우니, 작은 말로라도 일찍 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: You find more drive acting for the people you care about than for yourself alone. When a friend is in trouble, you're the first one at their door. Hurt feelings tend to stay bottled up, so voice them early, even in just a few words.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel more motivated acting for the people you care about than for yourself alone. It's easy to picture you rushing over before anyone else when a friend is in trouble. Hurt feelings can be easy to keep inside, so you might try sharing them early, even in just a few words.

rows.ko: 인정받고 싶은 마음이 뜨거운 열정으로 바뀌는 추진력이에요.
rows.en: Your wish to be seen and appreciated burns as a fiery drive.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive turns the wish to be recognized into burning passion.

rows.ko: 내가 맡은 일이 빛날 수 있다고 느끼면 몇 배의 에너지를 쏟는 편입니다. 팀 프로젝트에서 앞에 나서 분위기를 끌어올리는 역할이 잘 어울려요. 자존심이 상하면 화가 크게 올라오기도 하지만, 금방 너그러워지는 따뜻함도 있습니다.
rows.en: When your work has a chance to shine, you throw in twice the energy. In group projects, you naturally step up front and rally everyone. A bruised ego makes your temper flare, but you warm up and let it go just as quickly.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel your work can shine, you tend to pour in several times the energy. Stepping up to lift the team's mood in a group project suits you well. When your pride is hurt, anger can flare up big, but you also have a warmth that quickly softens into generosity.

rows.ko: 정확하게 해내고 싶은 마음에서 의욕이 솟는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Nothing motivates you like the chance to get something exactly right.
rows.en_before_tone: Your motivation springs from wanting to get things exactly right.

rows.ko: 막연한 목표보다 할 일 목록이 분명할 때 손이 훨씬 빨라지는 편이에요. 책상 정리부터 해야 일에 집중이 잘되는 모습이 익숙합니다. 화는 크게 터지기보다 작은 지적으로 먼저 나오기 쉬워요.
rows.en: A clear to-do list gets you moving far faster than a fuzzy goal. You need a tidy desk before you can truly focus. Rather than blowing up, your irritation slips out first as a small critical comment.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to work much faster with a clear to-do list than with a vague goal. Needing to tidy your desk before you can focus may feel familiar. Rather than bursting out, your anger is more likely to show up first as a small critical remark.

rows.ko: 함께하는 사람과 호흡이 맞을 때 추진력이 살아나요.
rows.en: Your drive kicks in when you're in sync with the people around you.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive comes alive when you're in sync with the people beside you.

rows.ko: 혼자 밀어붙이기보다 누군가와 의견을 나누며 움직일 때 힘이 나는 편입니다. 갈등이 생기면 바로 맞서기보다 분위기를 살피며 때를 고르는 모습이 익숙해요. 참아 둔 불만은 차분한 말로 일찍 꺼낼수록 관계도 나도 편해집니다.
rows.en: You'd rather move forward by talking things through with someone than by pushing ahead alone. When conflict arises, you read the room and wait for the right moment instead of confronting it head-on. Voice the frustrations you've been holding in, calmly and sooner rather than later, and both you and the relationship breathe easier.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel energized moving forward while sharing ideas with someone, rather than pushing on alone. When conflict comes up, reading the room and choosing your moment instead of confronting it head-on feels familiar. The sooner you calmly voice frustrations you've been holding in, the easier it gets for both you and the relationship.

rows.ko: 겉으로는 조용해도 속에서 깊고 끈질기게 타오르는 의지입니다.
rows.en: On the surface you look calm, but underneath, your willpower burns deep and never quits.
rows.en_before_tone: You may seem quiet on the outside, but your will burns deep and steady inside.

rows.ko: 한번 마음먹은 목표는 쉽게 내려놓지 않고 끝까지 파고드는 편이에요. 아무도 모르게 오래 준비해 온 일을 어느 날 조용히 해내는 장면이 잘 어울립니다. 화는 오래 품기 쉬우니, 믿는 사람에게 털어놓거나 몸을 움직여 풀어 주면 좋아요.
rows.en: Once you've set your sights on a goal, you rarely let go; you see it through to the very end. Working quietly on something for ages and then one day simply pulling it off is classic you. Anger lingers with you, so talk to someone you trust or work it off through exercise.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you set your mind on a goal, you tend not to let it go easily and see it through to the end. It's easy to picture you quietly pulling off, one day, something you've been preparing for a long time without anyone knowing. Anger can be easy for you to hold on to, so it can help to talk to someone you trust or move your body to release it.

rows.ko: 더 넓은 곳을 향한 기대감이 의욕을 끌어올리는 추진력이에요.
rows.en: The promise of wider horizons is what gets you going.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive is lifted by the excitement of heading somewhere wider.

rows.ko: 의미 있는 목표나 새로운 경험이 걸려 있을 때 몸이 가볍게 움직이는 편입니다. 계획이 생기면 일단 비행기표부터 검색해 보는 모습이 낯설지 않아요. 화가 나도 오래 담아 두지 않고 솔직하게 말한 뒤 툭 털어 냅니다.
rows.en: A meaningful goal or a new adventure puts a spring in your step. When a plan starts to take shape, you're already looking up flights. Even when you're angry, you don't stew; you say what's on your mind and move on.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to move with a light step when a meaningful goal or a new experience is on the line. Searching for plane tickets the moment a plan forms may feel familiar. Even when you're angry, you don't hold on to it for long; you say it honestly and brush it off.

rows.ko: 목표를 정하면 한 계단씩 꾸준히 올라가는 단단한 추진력입니다.
rows.en: Once you set a goal, you climb toward it steadily, one rung at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive is solid: once you set a goal, you climb steadily, one step at a time.

rows.ko: 당장의 기분보다 멀리 있는 결과를 보며 움직일 때 의욕이 오래가는 편이에요. 남들이 쉬는 주말에도 계획한 분량을 조용히 해 두는 모습이 자연스럽습니다. 화가 나도 감정을 다스리며 해결책부터 찾는 침착함이 있어요.
rows.en: You stay motivated longest when you keep your eye on the long-term payoff rather than your mood of the moment. While others take the weekend off, you quietly finish what you planned. Even when angry, you keep a cool head and look for a solution first.
rows.en_before_tone: Your motivation tends to last when you move with the long-term result in mind rather than your mood of the moment. Quietly finishing your planned amount of work on a weekend while others rest comes naturally to you. Even when you're angry, you have the calm to manage your feelings and look for a solution first.

rows.ko: 내가 옳다고 믿는 방향이 있을 때 힘이 솟는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You get a surge of energy when you're heading in a direction you believe in.
rows.en_before_tone: Your energy surges when there's a direction you believe is right.

rows.ko: 남이 정해 준 방식보다 내 방식으로 해 볼 수 있을 때 의욕이 커지는 편입니다. 모두가 익숙한 길을 갈 때 새로운 방법을 시험해 보는 모습이 잘 어울려요. 화가 나면 감정보다 논리로 정리해 말하는 쪽이라, 마음이 상한 부분도 함께 전하면 더 잘 닿습니다.
rows.en: You're most motivated when you do things your way, not the way someone else laid out. While everyone sticks to the familiar road, you're the one testing a new method. When you're angry, you explain it with logic rather than feelings, so name what actually hurt and let your words land.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel more motivated when you can try things your own way rather than a way set by others. Testing out a new method while everyone takes the familiar road suits you well. When you're angry, you tend to explain it with logic rather than feelings, so sharing the part that hurt as well helps your words land better.

rows.ko: 마음이 움직이는 일 앞에서 조용히 큰 힘을 내는 사람입니다.
rows.en: When something truly moves you, you find a deep, quiet strength.
rows.en_before_tone: You quietly find great strength for things that move your heart.

rows.ko: 억지로 밀어붙이는 일보다 공감이 가는 일에 훨씬 오래 몰입하는 편이에요. 누군가를 돕는 일이라면 피곤한 줄도 모르고 시간을 쏟는 장면이 떠오릅니다. 화를 삼키기 쉬우니, 글로 적거나 음악을 들으며 흘려보내는 시간이 도움이 돼요.
rows.en: You stay absorbed far longer in work you believe in than in anything you have to force yourself through. When you're helping someone, hours pass before you notice you're tired. You tend to swallow your anger, so write it down or let it drift away with music.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to stay absorbed far longer in work you feel for than in something you have to force. It's easy to picture you pouring in time, not even noticing you're tired, when it's to help someone. You may tend to swallow your anger, so time spent writing it down or letting it flow away with music can help.

rows.ko: 먼저 시작하는 용기 속에서 운이 트이는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Doors of opportunity open when you have the courage to go first.
rows.en_before_tone: Luck opens up for you through the courage to go first.

rows.ko: 망설이던 일에 첫발을 내디딜 때 생각지 못한 기회가 따라오기 쉽습니다. 아무도 나서지 않던 일을 먼저 맡았다가 새로운 인연이 이어지는 장면이 어울려요. 내 열정이 다른 사람에게도 용기가 될 때 마음의 품이 넓어집니다.
rows.en: When you finally take the first step on something you've been putting off, unexpected opportunities follow. Volunteer for the task no one else wanted, and a new connection finds you. When your enthusiasm gives other people courage, your own world grows bigger too.
rows.en_before_tone: When you take the first step on something you've been hesitating over, unexpected chances often follow. You might take on a task no one else stepped up for and find it leads to a new connection. Your heart grows bigger when your passion gives others courage too.

rows.ko: 천천히 쌓은 것이 열매가 되며 운이 커지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your luck grows as the things you've built slowly begin to pay off.
rows.en_before_tone: Your luck grows as what you've built slowly begins to bear fruit.

rows.ko: 급하게 키우기보다 꾸준히 가꾼 것에서 복이 늘어나는 편이에요. 오래 다닌 단골 가게에서 뜻밖의 좋은 소식을 듣듯, 익숙한 자리에서 기회가 찾아오기도 합니다. 넉넉한 마음으로 나누는 습관이 삶을 더 풍요롭게 해 줘요.
rows.en: Good fortune grows from what you nurture patiently rather than rush. Opportunities show up in familiar places, like surprising good news at a spot where you've been a regular for years. Share generously, and your life grows richer still.
rows.en_before_tone: Good fortune tends to grow from what you've tended steadily rather than rushed. Like hearing unexpected good news at a shop you've visited for years, opportunities may find you in familiar places. A habit of sharing generously makes your life even richer.

rows.ko: 배우고 묻고 연결하는 과정에서 기회가 늘어나는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Every time you learn, ask, or connect, more doors open for you.
rows.en_before_tone: Opportunities multiply for you through learning, asking, and connecting.

rows.ko: 다양한 사람과 이야기 나눌수록 새로운 문이 열리기 쉬운 편입니다. 우연히 들은 강의 하나가 다음 길의 실마리가 되는 일도 낯설지 않아요. 아는 것을 기꺼이 나눌 때 운도 함께 커집니다.
rows.en: The more people you chat with, the more chances come your way. A talk you happen to catch points you toward your next path. Share what you know freely; that's how your luck multiplies.
rows.en_before_tone: The more people you talk with, the more new doors tend to open. One lecture you happened to catch might even become the clue to your next path. When you gladly share what you know, your luck grows along with it.

rows.ko: 마음을 나누고 돌보는 자리에서 운이 크게 열리는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Good fortune flows to you wherever you share and care for others.
rows.en_before_tone: Luck opens wide for you in places where you share and care.

rows.ko: 누군가를 따뜻하게 챙긴 일이 시간이 지나 좋은 흐름으로 돌아오기 쉬워요. 반찬을 나누던 이웃과 오래 서로 돕는 사이가 되는 장면이 잘 어울립니다. 편안한 소속감을 느끼는 곳에서 성장의 힘도 커져요.
rows.en: Kindness you show someone comes back to you down the road. Picture sharing home cooking with a neighbor and ending up looking out for each other for years. You grow the most in places where you truly belong.
rows.en_before_tone: Kindness you've shown someone often comes back to you as a good turn over time. You might swap side dishes with a neighbor and end up helping each other for years. Your power to grow also gets stronger in places where you feel a comfortable sense of belonging.
rows.note: 반찬 나누기는 한국적 이웃 문화 — 'swapped side dishes'로 직역, 필요 시 'shared home cooking'으로 현지화 가능

rows.ko: 나를 당당히 드러낼 때 기회가 따라오는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Opportunities find you when you confidently show the world who you are.
rows.en_before_tone: Opportunities follow you when you show yourself with confidence.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것을 숨기지 않고 표현할수록 주변에서 응원이 모이는 편입니다. 취미로 올린 작은 작업물이 뜻밖의 제안으로 이어지는 장면을 떠올려 보세요. 다른 사람이 빛나는 순간도 기꺼이 칭찬해 줄 때 너그러움이 한층 깊어집니다.
rows.en: The more openly you share what you love, the more people rally behind you. Imagine a little project you posted just for fun turning into an unexpected offer. Cheer others on in their moments to shine, and your generosity runs deeper still.
rows.en_before_tone: The more openly you express what you love, the more support tends to gather around you. Picture a small piece you posted as a hobby leading to an unexpected offer. When you gladly praise others in their moments to shine, your generosity grows even deeper.

rows.ko: 작은 일을 정성껏 해내는 과정에서 운이 트이는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Luck finds you as you tend the small things with care.
rows.en_before_tone: Luck opens up for you as you do small things with care.

rows.ko: 눈에 띄지 않는 일도 꼼꼼히 챙길 때 신뢰가 쌓이고 기회가 찾아오기 쉬워요. 동료를 도와 정리한 자료가 나중에 큰 일의 발판이 되는 경우가 있습니다. 실질적인 도움을 건네는 방식으로 너그러움을 표현하는 사람이에요.
rows.en: When you take care with even the behind-the-scenes tasks, trust builds and opportunities follow. Notes you helped a coworker organize become a stepping stone to something big. Your generosity shows up as practical, hands-on help.
rows.en_before_tone: When you take care with even unnoticed tasks, trust builds and opportunities often follow. Notes you helped a coworker organize can later become a stepping stone to something big. You're someone who shows generosity by offering practical help.

rows.ko: 좋은 사람들과 손잡을 때 운이 커지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Teaming up with good people is how your luck grows.
rows.en_before_tone: Your luck grows when you join hands with good people.

rows.ko: 혼자 애쓰기보다 협력하고 조율할 때 일이 술술 풀리기 쉽습니다. 친구의 소개로 알게 된 사람과 함께 새 일을 꾸려 보는 장면이 어울려요. 서로 존중하는 관계 속에서 마음의 품도 함께 넓어집니다.
rows.en: Things fall into place when you collaborate and find common ground instead of struggling alone. A new venture can begin with someone you met through a friend. In relationships built on mutual respect, you grow more open and generous too.
rows.en_before_tone: Things tend to flow smoothly when you cooperate and coordinate rather than struggling alone. You might start something new with someone you met through a friend. In relationships built on mutual respect, your heart grows wider too.

rows.ko: 깊이 파고들고 함께 나누는 자리에서 운이 커지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your luck deepens when you go all the way in and share closely with others.
rows.en_before_tone: Your luck grows in places where you dig deep and share closely.

rows.ko: 한 분야를 끝까지 탐구할 때 남들이 보지 못한 기회를 발견하기 쉬운 편이에요. 오래 믿어 온 사람과 힘을 모아 무언가를 이루는 장면이 잘 어울립니다. 어려운 시간을 지나며 얻은 통찰이 다른 사람을 돕는 힘이 돼요.
rows.en: When you explore one field all the way down, you find opportunities others miss. Joining forces with someone you've trusted for years suits you beautifully. The insight you earn by getting through hard times becomes a way to help others.
rows.en_before_tone: When you explore one field all the way, you tend to discover opportunities others don't see. Joining forces with someone you've trusted for years to achieve something suits you well. Insights you gain from going through hard times can become a strength that helps others.

rows.ko: 더 넓은 세상을 향해 나아갈 때 운이 크게 열리는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Luck opens wide for you when you set out toward a bigger world.
rows.en_before_tone: Luck opens wide for you as you head out toward a wider world.

rows.ko: 새로운 배움과 낯선 경험 속에서 생각지 못한 길이 열리기 쉽습니다. 훌쩍 떠난 여행에서 나눈 대화가 다음 목표의 씨앗이 되는 장면이 어울려요. 믿는 것을 기꺼이 나누는 낙관이 주변까지 밝혀 줍니다.
rows.en: New learning and unfamiliar experiences open paths you never expected. A conversation on a last-minute trip plants the seed for your next goal. Your optimism, and the joy with which you share what you believe in, brightens everyone around you.
rows.en_before_tone: Unexpected paths tend to open through new learning and unfamiliar experiences. A conversation on a spur-of-the-moment trip might become the seed of your next goal. Your optimism, and the way you gladly share what you believe, brightens those around you.

rows.ko: 현실적인 목표를 꾸준히 쌓을 때 운도 단단해지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your luck turns rock solid as you work steadily toward realistic goals.
rows.en_before_tone: Your luck becomes solid as you steadily build toward realistic goals.

rows.ko: 한 번의 큰 행운보다 차근차근 올린 실력이 결국 기회를 불러오는 편이에요. 오랫동안 꾸준히 준비한 자격이 어느 날 새로운 자리로 이어지는 장면이 떠오릅니다. 약속을 지키는 모습이 신뢰라는 복으로 돌아와요.
rows.en: Opportunities come your way less through one big lucky break than through skills built step by step. Picture a certification you prepared for patiently opening the door to a new role one day. You keep your word, and people repay it with trust, which is its own kind of luck.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than one big stroke of luck, skills you've built step by step tend to bring opportunities in the end. It's easy to picture a qualification you prepared for patiently leading to a new position one day. The way you keep your promises comes back to you as the blessing of trust.

rows.ko: 뜻이 맞는 사람들과 새로운 시도를 할 때 운이 트이는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Your luck kicks in when you try something new with like-minded people.
rows.en_before_tone: Luck opens up for you when you try new things with like-minded people.

rows.ko: 남들과 다른 생각을 용기 있게 꺼낼 때 오히려 기회가 찾아오기 쉬운 편입니다. 온라인 모임에서 만난 사람들과 작은 프로젝트를 시작하는 장면이 잘 어울려요. 모두에게 이로운 방향을 고민하는 마음이 성장의 동력이 됩니다.
rows.en: Ideas that go against the grain are exactly what bring opportunities your way, so speak up. Kicking off a small project with people you met in an online community suits you well. Caring about what's good for everyone fuels your growth.
rows.en_before_tone: Opportunities often find you when you bravely voice ideas that differ from everyone else's. Starting a small project with people you met in an online group suits you well. Caring about what benefits everyone becomes the engine of your growth.

rows.ko: 다정한 마음과 직관을 믿을 때 운이 트이는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Things go your way when you trust your kindness and your gut.
rows.en_before_tone: Luck opens up for you when you trust your kind heart and your intuition.

rows.ko: 계산보다 마음이 이끄는 쪽을 따랐을 때 좋은 흐름을 만나기 쉬운 편이에요. 대가 없이 건넨 작은 도움이 돌고 돌아 반가운 소식이 되어 오기도 합니다. 쉬어 가며 마음을 비우는 시간 속에서 새 영감도 자라요.
rows.en: Good things come when you follow your heart instead of calculating. A small kindness you offered expecting nothing returns to you as welcome news. Rest and let your mind go quiet; that's where new inspiration grows.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to find a good flow when you follow your heart rather than calculation. A small kindness you offered expecting nothing may come back around as welcome news. New inspiration grows during times when you rest and clear your mind.

rows.ko: 내 의지를 끈기 있게 이어 가는 법을 배우며 단단해지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Learning to stick with what you start is what makes you strong.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by learning to carry your will forward with patience.

rows.ko: 시작하는 힘을 끝까지 이어 가는 과정에서 시험을 만나기 쉬운 편입니다. 서두르고 싶은 마음을 다독이며 하나를 마무리해 본 경험이 큰 자신감으로 남아요. 시간이 지날수록 용기와 인내를 함께 쓰는 사람이 되어 갑니다.
rows.en: Your challenge is carrying that burst of starting energy all the way to the finish line. Rein in the urge to rush and see just one thing through; real confidence follows. Over time, you learn to wield courage and patience together.
rows.en_before_tone: Tests often come up as you try to carry the energy of a start all the way to the finish. Calming the urge to rush and seeing one thing through leaves you with great confidence. Over time, you become someone who uses courage and patience together.

rows.ko: 돈과 안정을 내 힘으로 쌓아 가며 단단해지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: You find your footing by building money and security with your own two hands.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by building money and stability through your own efforts.

rows.ko: 내 것을 지키고 가꾸는 일에서 책임과 시험을 만나기 쉬운 편이에요. 적은 금액이라도 꾸준히 모아 온 통장을 보며 스스로를 믿게 되는 순간이 있습니다. 서두르지 않고 쌓은 안정은 쉽게 무너지지 않아요.
rows.en: Your responsibilities and tests show up around protecting and growing what's yours. One look at savings you've built bit by bit, however small, and you start believing in yourself. Security built without rushing doesn't crumble easily.
rows.en_before_tone: Responsibilities and tests often show up around protecting and growing what's yours. There may be moments when looking at savings you've built up steadily, even in small amounts, helps you believe in yourself. Stability built without rushing doesn't crumble easily.

rows.ko: 생각을 정리하고 말에 책임지는 법을 익히며 깊어지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You mature as you learn to organize your thoughts and stand behind your words.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow deeper by learning to organize your thoughts and stand behind your words.

rows.ko: 배우고 전하는 일에서 ‘내가 충분히 알고 있나’를 스스로 묻는 순간이 많은 편입니다. 발표를 앞두고 몇 번이고 원고를 고쳐 쓰는 모습이 익숙할 수 있어요. 그렇게 다듬은 말과 지식은 시간이 갈수록 믿음직한 무기가 됩니다.
rows.en: Whenever you learn or explain something, you catch yourself asking, "Do I really know this well enough?" You're the type who rewrites your notes again and again before a presentation. Words and knowledge polished this way become an ever more reliable tool.
rows.en_before_tone: When learning or sharing, you often find yourself asking, "Do I know this well enough?" Rewriting your script again and again before a presentation may feel familiar. Words and knowledge polished this way become an ever more reliable tool over time.

rows.ko: 마음의 안식처를 스스로 만들어 가며 단단해지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Creating your own safe place to land makes you stronger over time.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by creating your own safe haven for the heart.

rows.ko: 기대고 기대받는 가까운 관계 안에서 책임을 느끼는 순간이 많은 편이에요. 편히 쉴 수 있는 방 한 칸을 정성껏 꾸며 가는 일이 생각보다 큰 의미가 되기도 합니다. 시간이 지나며 남을 돌보는 만큼 나를 돌보는 힘도 길러져요.
rows.en: In close relationships where people lean on each other, you feel the weight of responsibility. Lovingly set up even one room where you can truly unwind; it means more than you'd expect. Over time, you learn to care for yourself as much as you care for others.
rows.en_before_tone: You often feel a sense of responsibility in close relationships where people lean on each other. Lovingly decorating a single room where you can truly rest may mean more than you'd expect. Over time, you build the strength to care for yourself as much as you care for others.

rows.ko: 나를 드러내는 용기를 시간을 들여 키워 가는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Over time, you build the courage to let people see who you really are.
rows.en_before_tone: You take time to grow the courage to show who you are.

rows.ko: 스스로를 표현하고 인정받는 일에서 시험을 만나기 쉬운 편입니다. 무대에 오르기 전 여러 번 연습하며 떨림을 다독이는 장면을 떠올려 보세요. 남의 박수보다 내 기준으로 빛나는 법을 익히며 단단한 자신감이 쌓입니다.
rows.en: Self-expression and recognition are where life tests you most. Picture yourself rehearsing again and again before going on stage, calming your nerves a little more each time. As you learn to shine by your own standards instead of waiting for applause, real confidence takes root.
rows.en_before_tone: Tests often come up around expressing yourself and being recognized. Picture yourself rehearsing again and again before stepping on stage, calming your nerves. As you learn to shine by your own standards rather than others' applause, solid confidence builds up.

rows.ko: 일상의 루틴과 일의 완성도를 다듬으며 단단해지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: You build real strength by fine-tuning your daily routines and the quality of your work.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by refining your daily routines and the quality of your work.

rows.ko: 매일 해내는 일과 몸을 돌보는 습관에서 책임을 크게 느끼는 편이에요. 아침마다 같은 시간에 일어나 하루 계획을 적는 작은 습관이 든든한 뼈대가 되기도 합니다. 완벽보다 꾸준함을 택할 때 마음의 짐도 한결 가벼워져요.
rows.en: You feel a strong sense of responsibility for your daily tasks and for caring for your body. A small habit, like rising at the same time every morning and writing down your plan, becomes the backbone of your day. Choose consistency over perfection, and much of the pressure lifts.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel a strong sense of responsibility for your daily tasks and your habits of caring for your body. A small habit like getting up at the same time each morning and writing down your plan can become a reliable backbone. When you choose consistency over perfection, the weight on your heart gets much lighter.

rows.ko: 공정하고 균형 잡힌 관계를 지켜 가며 깊어지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You grow by keeping your relationships balanced, so both sides feel respected.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow deeper by keeping your relationships fair and balanced.

rows.ko: 가까운 관계에서 약속과 책임의 무게를 진지하게 받아들이는 편입니다. 서로의 몫을 분명히 나누고 지켜 갈 때 마음이 편해지는 모습이 익숙해요. 시간을 들여 쌓은 신뢰는 어떤 관계에서도 단단한 기둥이 됩니다.
rows.en: In close relationships, you take promises and commitments seriously. You feel at ease when everyone's share is clear and each person holds up their end. Trust built over time becomes a steadfast foundation in any relationship.
rows.en_before_tone: In close relationships, you tend to take the weight of promises and responsibility seriously. Feeling at ease when each person's share is clearly divided and honored may feel familiar. Trust you've built over time becomes a solid pillar in any relationship.

rows.ko: 깊은 신뢰와 감정을 다루는 법을 익히며 단단해지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Learning to handle deep trust and intense emotions gives you staying power.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by learning to handle deep trust and strong feelings.

rows.ko: 마음을 깊이 나누는 관계에서 신중함과 책임을 함께 배우는 편이에요. 쉽게 마음을 열지 않다가 오랜 시간 끝에 믿을 사람을 알아보는 모습이 떠오릅니다. 감정을 정직하게 바라보는 연습이 시간이 지나 내면의 힘이 돼요.
rows.en: In close relationships where you open up deeply, you learn both caution and responsibility. You're slow to open up, and after a long while you know exactly who you can trust. Be honest with yourself about your feelings; over time, that honesty becomes inner strength.
rows.en_before_tone: In relationships where hearts are shared deeply, you tend to learn both caution and responsibility. It's easy to picture you being slow to open up, then, after a long time, recognizing who you can truly trust. Practicing looking honestly at your feelings becomes an inner strength over time.

rows.ko: 내가 믿는 가치를 스스로 세워 가며 깊어지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You come into your own by working out for yourself what you truly believe.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow deeper by building the values you believe in for yourself.

rows.ko: 배움과 신념의 영역에서 ‘나는 무엇을 믿는가’를 진지하게 묻는 순간을 만나는 편입니다. 한 분야를 오래 공부하며 나만의 관점을 다듬어 가는 모습이 잘 어울려요. 시간을 들여 세운 생각은 쉽게 흔들리지 않는 나침반이 됩니다.
rows.en: In learning and belief, you face moments of seriously asking yourself, "What do I actually believe?" Studying one subject for years and sharpening your own perspective suits you well. Beliefs you take the time to build become a compass that doesn't spin easily.
rows.en_before_tone: In learning and belief, you tend to meet moments when you seriously ask, "What do I believe?" Studying one field for a long time and refining your own perspective suits you well. Ideas you've taken time to build become a compass that doesn't sway easily.

rows.ko: 시간을 들여 쌓아 올린 것으로 자신을 증명하는 사람입니다.
rows.en: You prove yourself through what you've built, year after year.
rows.en_before_tone: You prove yourself through what you've built up over time.

rows.ko: 일과 사회적 역할에서 책임을 무겁게 느끼며 차근차근 계단을 오르는 편이에요. 맡은 일을 끝까지 해내다 보면 어느새 믿고 맡기는 사람이 되어 있습니다. 쌓아 온 시간이 그대로 실력과 단단함으로 남아요.
rows.en: You feel the weight of responsibility in your work and public roles, and you climb the ladder one step at a time. As you keep seeing things through, you become the person everyone counts on. All the time you've put in stays with you as skill and resilience.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel the weight of responsibility in your work and social roles, and you climb step by step. As you see each task through, you find you've become someone people trust with things. The time you've put in stays with you as skill and steadiness.

rows.ko: 함께하는 공동체 안에서 나만의 원칙을 세워 가는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You shape your own principles while staying part of a community.
rows.en_before_tone: You build your own principles within the community you're part of.

rows.ko: 사람들 속에서 나다움을 지키면서도 책임을 다하는 법을 배우는 편입니다. 모임의 규칙을 정리하거나 오래가는 체계를 만드는 역할을 자주 맡을 수 있어요. 시간이 지날수록 생각이 분명하고 믿음직한 사람으로 자리 잡습니다.
rows.en: You're learning to stay true to yourself in a group while still pulling your weight. You're often the one who sets a group's ground rules or builds systems that last. Over time, people come to see you as clear-headed and dependable.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to learn how to stay true to yourself among people while still doing your part. You may often take on roles like setting a group's rules or creating systems that last. Over time, you settle into being someone clear-minded and dependable.

rows.ko: 흐릿한 마음에 형태를 주는 법을 배우며 단단해지는 사람입니다.
rows.en: You get stronger as you learn to give shape to feelings that are hard to pin down.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by learning to give shape to hazy feelings.

rows.ko: 감정과 상상이 넘칠 때 그것을 현실로 옮기는 과정에서 시험을 만나기 쉬운 편이에요. 막연한 꿈을 작은 일정으로 쪼개어 하나씩 지워 가는 장면이 떠오릅니다. 쉼과 경계를 스스로 정해 줄수록 섬세함이 힘으로 바뀌어요.
rows.en: When your feelings and imagination overflow, your challenge is turning them into something real. Break a fuzzy dream into small tasks and check them off one by one. Make room for rest and set clear boundaries, and your sensitivity becomes a strength.
rows.en_before_tone: When feelings and imagination overflow, tests often come up as you try to turn them into something real. It's easy to picture you breaking a vague dream into small tasks and checking them off one by one. The more you set your own rest and boundaries, the more your sensitivity turns into strength.

rows.ko: 스스로 길을 여는 일에 변화의 힘이 실리는 사람이에요.
rows.en: For you, change comes from blazing your own trail.
rows.en_before_tone: The power of change in you shows up in forging your own path.

rows.en: Your generation rebuilds personal willpower and courage from the ground up. In daily life, you carry a firm resolve to make it on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period that rebuilds personal will and courage from the ground up. In daily life, it may feel like a firm wish to stand on your own strength.

rows.ko: 가치와 소유의 의미를 깊이 바꾸는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're transforming what value and ownership really mean.
rows.en_before_tone: You deeply transform what value and ownership mean.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 돈과 물건, 가치의 의미를 근본부터 다시 묻는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 정말 소중한 것만 남기고 싶은 마음으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: People born in this era question the meaning of money, possessions, and value at the root. Day to day, you keep only what truly matters.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period that questions the meaning of money, things, and value from the ground up. In daily life, it may show up as wanting to keep only what truly matters.

rows.ko: 생각과 말의 방식을 깊이 바꾸는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're changing, at a deep level, how people think and talk.
rows.en_before_tone: You deeply transform the way people think and speak.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 배우고 말하고 정보를 다루는 방식을 근본부터 새롭게 하는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 말 한마디의 무게를 깊이 의식하는 감각으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: This generation renews, from the ground up, how we learn, speak, and handle information. You know keenly how much a single word can carry.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period that renews, from the ground up, how we learn, speak, and handle information. In daily life, it may show up as being keenly aware of the weight of a single word.

rows.ko: 가족과 뿌리의 의미를 다시 세우는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're rebuilding what family and roots mean.
rows.en_before_tone: You rebuild what family and roots mean.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 집과 가족, 나라와 뿌리의 의미가 크게 달라지는 흐름 속에서 자랐습니다. 일상에서는 마음 붙일 곳을 스스로 단단히 만들고 싶은 바람으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: You grew up as the meaning of home, family, country, and roots changed dramatically. In daily life, you set out to build a solid place to belong, on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: You grew up at a time when the meaning of home, family, country, and roots changed greatly. In daily life, it may show up as a wish to build a solid place for your heart on your own.

rows.ko: 자기표현의 힘을 새롭게 일깨운 사람이에요.
rows.en: You've reawakened the power of self-expression.
rows.en_before_tone: You reawaken the power of self-expression.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 개인의 표현과 창작이 힘을 얻고 크게 달라지는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 나를 온전히 드러내고 싶은 강한 마음으로 느껴질 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your generation saw personal expression and creativity gain power and change dramatically. Day to day, you feel a strong urge to show the world all of who you are.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period when personal expression and creativity gain power and change dramatically. In daily life, it may feel like a strong wish to show yourself fully.

rows.ko: 일과 생활의 방식을 깊이 고쳐 가는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're reworking, at a deep level, how people work and live.
rows.en_before_tone: You deeply rework the way you work and live.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 일하는 방식과 생활 습관, 몸을 돌보는 법이 근본부터 바뀌는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 작은 부분까지 다듬어 더 나은 상태로 만들고 싶은 마음으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: Born during this stretch, you carry a deep shift in how we work, our daily habits, and how we care for our bodies. In daily life, you fine-tune even the small details to make things better.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period when ways of working, daily habits, and caring for the body change from the ground up. In daily life, it may show up as wanting to refine even small details and make things better.

rows.ko: 관계와 공정함의 의미를 다시 세우는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're redefining what balance and fairness in relationships look like.
rows.en_before_tone: You rebuild what relationships and fairness mean.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 관계의 균형과 공정함이 무엇인지 깊이 다시 묻는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 가까운 사이일수록 서로 대등하기를 바라는 마음으로 느껴질 수 있어요.
rows.en: This generation takes a hard second look at what balance and fairness in relationships really mean. Day to day, you expect the people closest to you to meet you as equals.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period that deeply re-examines what balance and fairness in relationships really are. In daily life, it may feel like hoping that the closer you are to someone, the more equal you'll be.

rows.ko: 깊은 감정과 마주하며 단단해지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Facing your deepest feelings is what makes you strong.
rows.en_before_tone: You grow stronger by facing deep feelings.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 감춰 왔던 감정과 힘의 문제를 정면으로 마주하는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 쉽게 마음을 열지 않지만 한번 믿으면 깊이 이어지는 모습으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: People born in this era confront long-buried issues of emotion and power directly. In daily life, you're slow to open up, then form deep bonds once you trust someone.
