rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period that squarely faces long-hidden issues of emotion and power. In daily life, it may show up as being slow to open up, but forming deep bonds once you trust someone.

rows.ko: 믿음과 세계관을 새로 짓는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're building new beliefs and new ways of seeing the world.
rows.en_before_tone: You build new beliefs and worldviews.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 나라와 문화의 경계가 낮아지면서 믿음과 세계관을 새로 짓는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 진짜 의미 있는 것이 무엇인지 스스로 찾고 싶은 마음으로 느껴질 수 있어요.
rows.en: As borders between countries and cultures become easier to cross, your generation builds new beliefs and worldviews. Day to day, you insist on discovering for yourself what really matters.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period that builds new beliefs and worldviews as the borders between countries and cultures grow lower. In daily life, it may feel like wanting to discover for yourself what's truly meaningful.

rows.ko: 사회의 구조가 다시 세워지는 시기의 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're coming of age as society's foundations are being rebuilt.
rows.en_before_tone: You belong to a time when society's structures are being rebuilt.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 오래된 제도와 권위가 흔들리고 다시 세워지는 흐름 속에서 자라고 있습니다. 일상에서는 기존 틀을 그대로 따르기보다 오래 갈 기반을 스스로 다지고 싶은 마음으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: Your generation is growing up while old institutions and authority are shaken up and rebuilt. In daily life, you'd rather lay your own lasting foundation than just follow the existing playbook.
rows.en_before_tone: You're growing up at a time when old institutions and authority are being shaken and rebuilt. In daily life, it may show up as wanting to lay your own lasting foundation rather than simply following existing molds.

rows.ko: 연결과 공동체의 방식을 깊이 바꾸는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're transforming the way people connect and build communities.
rows.en_before_tone: You deeply transform how people connect and form communities.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 기술과 네트워크가 사람들의 관계와 힘의 모양을 근본부터 바꾸는 흐름 속에서 태어났습니다. 일상에서는 혼자보다 함께일 때 더 큰 변화를 만들 수 있다는 감각으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: This generation was born as technology and networks began reshaping relationships and power at the root. You carry a gut sense that bigger change happens together, not alone.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born at a time when technology and networks are reshaping relationships and power from the ground up. In daily life, it may show up as a sense that bigger change is possible together than alone.

rows.ko: 공감과 상상의 힘이 깊어지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Your capacity for empathy and imagination runs especially deep.
rows.en_before_tone: Your power of empathy and imagination runs deep.

rows.ko: 이 시기에 태어난 사람은 공감과 상상력, 보이지 않는 연결이 큰 힘을 갖는 흐름을 지닙니다. 일상에서는 남의 아픔에 깊이 공명하는 감수성으로 나타날 수 있어요.
rows.en: People born in this era see empathy, imagination, and invisible connections take on great power. Day to day, your sensitivity lets you feel other people's pain deeply.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born in a period when empathy, imagination, and unseen connections hold great power. In daily life, it may show up as a sensitivity that resonates deeply with others' pain.

B2a.name: 행성 × 하우스 (태양·달·수성·금성·화성)
B2a.used_in: 출생차트 휠 행성 탭 시트·태양/달 표의 하우스 문장 (정확도 A·B등급만)

rows.ko: 그 힘이 나 자신과 첫인상을 향해요.
rows.en: Your Sun's power points straight at you: who you are and the first impression you make.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward yourself and the first impression you make.

rows.ko: 처음 만난 자리에서도 존재감이 먼저 느껴지는 편이에요. 내가 어떤 사람인지 스스로 정하고 보여 줄 때 삶의 중심이 또렷해집니다. 남의 기대보다 내 방식을 고를 때 힘이 나요.
rows.en: People notice you right away, even at a first meeting. Life comes into focus when you decide who you are and show it. Choose your own way over what others expect; that's where your strength lives.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when meeting people for the first time, your presence tends to be felt right away. Your life feels more centered when you decide for yourself who you are and show it. You feel strong when you choose your own way over others' expectations.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 돈·내 것·나의 가치를 향해요.
rows.en: Here, that power flows into money, what you own, and your sense of self-worth.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward money, your possessions, and your sense of worth.

rows.ko: 내 손으로 번 것, 직접 고른 물건에서 나다움을 확인하는 편입니다. 무엇에 돈과 시간을 쓰는지가 곧 나를 보여 주는 말이 되기도 해요. 스스로 정한 기준이 설 때 마음도 단단해집니다.
rows.en: You find yourself in what you've earned with your own hands and the things you've chosen. How you spend your money and time says a lot about who you are. Set your own standards, and you feel grounded.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to find yourself in what you've earned with your own hands and the things you've chosen. What you spend your money and time on can say a lot about who you are. When your own standards are in place, your heart feels steady too.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 배움·말·가까운 사람들과의 대화를 향해요.
rows.en: You channel it into learning, talking, and staying connected with the people around you.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward learning, words, and conversations with people close to you.

rows.ko: 새로 알게 된 것을 바로 누군가에게 이야기하고 싶어지는 사람이에요. 동네 이웃이나 형제, 오랜 친구와 주고받는 말 속에서 내 생각이 자랍니다. 배우고 전하는 일이 삶의 중심을 밝혀 줘요.
rows.en: Learn something new, and you're itching to tell someone right away. Your ideas grow through chats with neighbors, siblings, or old friends. Learning and sharing are what light up your life.
rows.en_before_tone: When you learn something new, you tend to want to tell someone right away. Your thoughts grow through the words you trade with neighbors, siblings, or old friends. Learning and sharing light up the center of your life.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 집·가족·마음의 뿌리를 향해요.
rows.en: It points you home, toward family and the roots of who you are.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward home, family, and the roots of your heart.

rows.ko: 밖에서 무엇을 이루든 돌아갈 곳이 편안해야 힘이 나는 편이에요. 내 공간을 내 손으로 꾸리고 가까운 사람을 챙길 때 중심이 잡힙니다. 집은 쉬는 곳이면서 나를 다시 세우는 자리이기도 해요.
rows.en: Whatever you accomplish out in the world, you need a comfortable home base to feel strong. You feel centered when you set up your space your way and look after the people closest to you. Home is where you rest, and it's where you get back on your feet.
rows.en_before_tone: Whatever you achieve out in the world, you tend to feel strong only when the place you return to is comfortable. You feel centered when you shape your space with your own hands and look after the people close to you. Home is a place to rest, and also a place where you set yourself back on your feet.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 즐거움·연애·창작을 향해요.
rows.en: You pour it into fun, romance, and creative projects.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward joy, romance, and creativity.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 일을 할 때 얼굴부터 환해지는 사람입니다. 무언가를 만들고, 마음이 끌리는 대상을 표현할 때 나다움이 가장 잘 드러나요. 놀이처럼 즐기는 시간이 삶의 중심을 채워 줍니다.
rows.en: Your whole face lights up when you're doing something you love. Your truest self comes out when you're making something or expressing what you're drawn to. Make time for play; it's what makes your life feel full.
rows.en_before_tone: Your face lights up when you're doing what you love. Your true self shows most clearly when you make things or express what draws your heart. Time you spend simply playing and enjoying yourself fills the center of your life.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 매일의 일·루틴·몸의 리듬을 향해요.
rows.en: Your daily work, routines, and the rhythm of your body draw that power.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward daily work, routines, and your body's rhythm.

rows.ko: 하루를 잘 짜고 맡은 일을 꼼꼼히 해낼 때 보람을 느끼는 편이에요. 작은 습관이 쌓여 내가 된다는 감각이 큽니다. 다만 일이 많아지면 쉬는 시간까지 일정으로 채우기 쉬우니, 비워 두는 칸도 하나 남겨 두면 좋아요.
rows.en: Planning your day well and doing your tasks thoroughly gives you real satisfaction. You know in your bones that small habits add up to who you are. When work piles up, you're tempted to schedule even your downtime, so leave at least one slot empty.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel fulfilled when you plan your day well and handle your tasks carefully. You have a strong sense that small habits add up to who you are. When work piles up, though, it's easy to fill even your rest time with plans, so it helps to leave one slot open.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 일대일 관계와 파트너를 향해요.
rows.en: One-on-one relationships and partners are where that energy goes.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward one-on-one relationships and partners.

rows.ko: 혼자일 때보다 마주 앉은 한 사람과 이야기할 때 내가 더 선명해지는 편이에요. 동료든 친구든 짝이든, 함께 맞춰 가는 관계에서 삶의 중심을 확인합니다. 상대를 거울삼되 내 목소리도 함께 챙기면 좋아요.
rows.en: You see yourself more clearly sitting across from one other person than you do alone. Whether it's a coworker, a friend, or a partner, relationships where you find your rhythm together show you where you stand. Let others be your mirror, but keep making room for your own voice.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to see yourself more clearly when talking with one person across from you than when you're alone. Whether a coworker, friend, or partner, you find your center in relationships where you adjust to each other. It helps to use the other person as a mirror while still making room for your own voice.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 깊은 유대·함께 나누는 것·변화를 향해요.
rows.en: It draws you toward deep bonds, what you share with others, and transformation.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward deep bonds, what you share, and transformation.

rows.ko: 여러 사람과 얕게 만나기보다 한두 사람과 깊이 연결될 때 살아 있다고 느끼는 편입니다. 마음, 시간, 살림처럼 함께 나누는 것을 진지하게 여겨요. 삶의 큰 전환을 지나며 오히려 더 단단해지는 힘도 있습니다.
rows.en: Rather than knowing lots of people a little, you feel most alive when you're deeply connected to one or two. You take what you share seriously, whether it's feelings, time, or a household. Life's big turning points leave you stronger, not weaker.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel most alive when you connect deeply with one or two people rather than lightly with many. You take shared things seriously, such as feelings, time, and a household. You also have a strength that grows even firmer as you pass through life's big turning points.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 넓은 배움·여행·믿는 가치를 향해요.
rows.en: It reaches toward higher learning, travel, and the values you live by.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward higher learning, travel, and the values you believe in.

rows.ko: 낯선 곳에 가거나 새로운 생각을 만날 때 눈이 반짝이는 사람이에요. 무엇이 옳은지, 어떻게 살고 싶은지 스스로 묻고 답하는 시간이 중심을 세워 줍니다. 배움이 넓어질수록 나도 넓어져요.
rows.en: Your eyes light up when you travel somewhere new or come across a fresh idea. Taking time to ask what's right and how you want to live keeps you grounded. The wider your learning grows, the more you grow with it.
rows.en_before_tone: Your eyes light up when you go somewhere unfamiliar or meet a new idea. Time spent asking and answering what's right and how you want to live helps you find your center. As your learning grows wider, so do you.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 커리어와 사회 속 나의 역할을 향해요.
rows.en: Your career and the role you play in the world are where that light aims.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward your career and your role in the world.

rows.ko: 일터나 사회에서 어떤 역할을 맡는지가 나를 설명하는 중요한 말이 되는 편입니다. 목표를 세우고 한 걸음씩 올라갈 때 힘이 나요. 다만 성과만으로 나를 재지 않도록, 일 밖의 나도 함께 챙겨 주세요.
rows.en: The role you play at work and in society is a big part of how you see yourself. Setting goals and climbing toward them step by step energizes you. Just don't measure yourself by achievements alone; nurture the you outside of work too.
rows.en_before_tone: The role you take on at work or in society tends to become an important way of describing who you are. You feel energized when you set goals and climb step by step. Just try not to measure yourself by achievements alone; it helps to look after the you outside of work too.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 사람들·공동체·미래 목표를 향해요.
rows.en: That power flows toward your friends, communities, and goals for the future.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward people, community, and future goals.

rows.ko: 같은 뜻을 가진 사람들과 함께할 때 내 자리가 또렷해지는 편이에요. 모임이나 팀에서 앞으로의 그림을 이야기하며 힘을 얻습니다. 혼자 꾸는 꿈보다 같이 꾸는 꿈에 마음이 더 오래 머물러요.
rows.en: Your place in the world comes into focus among people who share your goals. Talking about the future with a group or team charges you up. Dreams you share with others outlast the ones you dream alone.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to see your place more clearly when you're with people who share your goals. You draw strength from talking about the future with a group or team. Your heart lingers longer on dreams you share than on dreams you dream alone.

rows.ko: 그 힘이 쉼·내면·보이지 않는 곳을 향해요.
rows.en: It turns inward, toward rest, your inner life, and the parts of you that stay out of sight.
rows.en_before_tone: That energy is directed toward rest, your inner life, and what goes unseen.

rows.ko: 앞에 나서기보다 조용한 곳에서 생각을 정리할 때 중심이 잡히는 편입니다. 혼자만의 시간은 도망이 아니라 다시 채우는 시간이에요. 겉으로 드러나지 않는 돌봄이나 정리에서 나다움이 빛나기도 해요.
rows.en: You find your center sorting through your thoughts somewhere quiet, away from the spotlight. Time alone isn't running away; it's how you recharge. Your true self shines in the behind-the-scenes care and organizing no one else sees.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel centered when you sort through your thoughts somewhere quiet rather than stepping into the spotlight. Time alone isn't running away; it's time to refill. Your true self may shine in care and tidying-up that no one else sees.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 나를 있는 그대로 드러낼 때 찾아와요.
rows.en: You feel most at peace when you can simply be yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: You find emotional calm when you show yourself just as you are.

rows.ko: 기분이 표정과 몸짓에 금방 비치는 편이에요. 감정을 숨기기보다 솔직하게 알아차릴 때 마음이 편안해집니다. 오늘 내 컨디션을 먼저 살피는 습관이 안정의 출발점이 돼요.
rows.en: Your mood shows on your face and in your body language almost instantly. You feel better when you're honest with yourself about your feelings instead of hiding them. Start each day by checking in on how you're really doing.
rows.en_before_tone: Your mood tends to show quickly in your face and body language. You feel at ease when you notice your feelings honestly instead of hiding them. A habit of checking in on how you feel today becomes the starting point of calm.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 돈·내 것·자기가치에서 와요.
rows.en: Financial security and a sense of your own worth help you feel emotionally safe.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from money, your possessions, and your sense of worth.

rows.ko: 생활의 바탕이 안정돼 있을 때 마음도 놓이는 편입니다. 아끼는 물건, 익숙한 내 것에 둘러싸이면 기분이 차분해져요. 나의 가치를 통장 잔고로만 재지 않는 연습도 함께하면 좋습니다.
rows.en: When life's basics are covered, you can finally relax. Surrounding yourself with things you love and know well calms you. Practice separating your worth from your bank balance.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel at ease when the basics of your life are stable. Being surrounded by things you treasure and know well helps you feel calm. It's also good to practice not measuring your worth by your bank balance alone.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 가까운 사람들과 나누는 말에서 와요.
rows.en: Talking things through with the people close to you brings you calm.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from talking with the people close to you.

rows.ko: 속상한 일이 생기면 누군가에게 이야기하며 마음을 푸는 편이에요. 짧은 메시지를 주고받거나 함께 동네를 걷는 가벼운 연결이 큰 위로가 됩니다. 생각을 글로 적어 보는 것도 마음을 가라앉히는 데 도움이 돼요.
rows.en: When something's bothering you, talking it out with someone helps you let it go. Small connections, like quick texts or a stroll around the neighborhood together, bring real comfort. Write your thoughts down, too; it calms your mind.
rows.en_before_tone: When something upsets you, you tend to ease your heart by talking it through with someone. Light connections, like trading short messages or taking a walk around the neighborhood together, bring great comfort. Writing your thoughts down also helps settle your mind.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 집·가족·나의 뿌리에서 와요.
rows.en: Home, family, and your roots are where you feel safe.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from home, family, and your roots.

rows.ko: 익숙한 공간과 가까운 사람이 곁에 있을 때 마음이 가장 편해지는 편입니다. 집이 정돈돼 있으면 하루의 감정도 정돈돼요. 나만의 쉴 자리를 하나 마련해 두면 흔들릴 때 돌아갈 곳이 됩니다.
rows.en: You're most at ease in familiar surroundings with the people you're close to. When your home is in order, your emotions follow. Keep a cozy corner that's all yours, a place to come back to when life feels shaky.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel most at ease in a familiar space with people close to you. When your home is in order, your feelings for the day fall into order too. Setting aside a resting spot of your own gives you somewhere to return when you feel shaken.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 즐겁게 몰입하는 시간에서 와요.
rows.en: Losing yourself in something you enjoy is how you find calm.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from time spent happily absorbed in something.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 취미에 빠져 있을 때 걱정을 잠시 내려놓는 편이에요. 그리기, 노래, 요리처럼 무언가를 만들어 내는 일이 마음을 채워 줍니다. 마음껏 웃는 시간이 생각보다 큰 안정이 돼요.
rows.en: Getting lost in a favorite hobby lets you set your worries aside for a while. Creating something, whether drawing, singing, or cooking, fills you up. Never underestimate a good laugh; it does wonders for your peace of mind.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're lost in a favorite hobby, you tend to set your worries down for a while. Making something, like drawing, singing, or cooking, fills your heart. Time spent laughing freely brings more calm than you might expect.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 매일의 루틴과 몸의 리듬에서 와요.
rows.en: Daily routines and your body's natural rhythm keep you on an even keel.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from daily routines and your body's rhythm.

rows.ko: 정해진 시간에 일어나고 할 일을 하나씩 지워 갈 때 마음이 놓이는 편입니다. 리듬이 흐트러지면 기분도 함께 출렁이기 쉬워요. 바쁜 날일수록 산책이나 차 한 잔 같은 작은 루틴 하나는 챙겨 보세요.
rows.en: Rising at the same time and checking off your tasks one by one helps you feel settled. When your rhythm gets thrown off, your mood rides the waves with it. On busy days especially, hold on to at least one small ritual, like a walk or a cup of tea.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel at ease when you get up at a set time and check off your tasks one by one. When your rhythm slips, your mood can easily rise and fall with it. On busy days especially, it can help to hold on to at least one small routine, like a walk or a cup of tea.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 곁에 있는 한 사람과의 관계에서 와요.
rows.en: Having one special person by your side gives you emotional security.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from your relationship with one person by your side.

rows.ko: 믿을 수 있는 한 사람과 마음을 나눌 때 가장 편안해지는 편이에요. 상대의 기분에 민감해서 분위기를 먼저 살피기도 합니다. 내 마음도 상대만큼 소중하다는 걸 기억하면 관계가 한결 가벼워져요.
rows.en: You feel most at ease when you can open up to one person you trust. You're sensitive to other people's moods and read the room first. Remember that your feelings matter just as much as theirs, and the relationship feels lighter.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel most at ease when you share your heart with one person you trust. Being sensitive to others' moods, you may read the room first. Remembering that your feelings matter as much as theirs makes the relationship feel much lighter.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 깊이 믿을 수 있는 유대에서 와요.
rows.en: Bonds you can trust completely are what make you feel safe.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from bonds you can trust deeply.

rows.ko: 겉도는 관계보다 속마음까지 나눌 수 있는 사이에서 마음이 놓이는 사람입니다. 감정을 깊이 느끼는 만큼 쉽게 털어놓지 않을 때도 있어요. 믿을 만한 한 사람에게 조금씩 꺼내 보는 것이 안정에 도움이 됩니다.
rows.en: Surface-level relationships don't do it for you; you feel safe with people who can hold your deepest feelings. Because you feel things so intensely, opening up doesn't always come easily. Share a little at a time with one person you trust, and you find your footing.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel at ease in relationships where you can share what's truly inside, not ones that stay on the surface. Because you feel things so deeply, you sometimes don't open up easily. Sharing a little at a time with one trustworthy person helps you feel steady.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 넓은 배움과 나만의 믿음에서 와요.
rows.en: Learning about the world and holding to your own beliefs bring you peace of mind.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from wide learning and your own beliefs.

rows.ko: 마음이 답답할 때 낯선 곳으로 떠나거나 새 책을 펼치면 숨통이 트이는 편이에요. 삶을 넓게 바라보는 관점이 생기면 작은 일에 덜 흔들립니다. 내가 믿는 가치를 한 문장으로 적어 두면 기댈 곳이 돼요.
rows.en: When you're feeling boxed in, a trip somewhere new or a fresh book helps you breathe again. Seeing life from a wider angle makes the small stuff easier to shrug off. Write down one value you believe in, in a single sentence, and lean on it.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel stuck, heading somewhere new or opening a new book tends to help you breathe again. Once you gain a wider view of life, small things shake you less. Writing down a value you believe in as a single sentence gives you something to lean on.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 일과 사회 속 내 자리에서 와요.
rows.en: Feeling secure in your work and your place in the world steadies you.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from your place at work and in the world.

rows.ko: 맡은 역할을 잘 해내고 인정받을 때 마음이 놓이는 편입니다. 일이 흔들리면 기분까지 함께 흔들리기 쉬워요. 일 밖에서도 나를 쉬게 하는 자리를 하나 두면 균형이 잡힙니다.
rows.en: You feel settled when you're doing your job well and getting recognized for it. When things are rocky at work, your mood takes a hit too. Keep one place outside of work where you can truly unwind; it keeps you balanced.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel at ease when you do your role well and are recognized for it. When work feels shaky, your mood can easily wobble too. Keeping one place outside of work where you can rest helps you find balance.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 함께하는 사람들과 공동체에서 와요.
rows.en: Being part of a community, among people you click with, helps you feel at home.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from the people and communities you're part of.

rows.ko: 마음 맞는 친구들이나 모임 안에 있을 때 편안함을 느끼는 편이에요. 같은 방향을 바라보는 사람들이 있다는 사실만으로도 든든해집니다. 혼자 버티기보다 내 사람들에게 기대는 것도 좋은 방법이에요.
rows.en: You're most comfortable among friends or groups you get along with. Just knowing others are heading in the same direction makes you feel supported. Don't tough it out alone; lean on your people.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel comfortable among like-minded friends or groups. Just knowing there are people looking in the same direction makes you feel supported. Leaning on your people, rather than holding on alone, is a good way to go too.

rows.ko: 마음의 안정이 혼자 쉬며 정리하는 시간에서 와요.
rows.en: Quiet time alone to rest and reset is what restores your calm.
rows.en_before_tone: Your emotional calm comes from time alone to rest and sort things out.

rows.ko: 사람들 속에서 쌓인 감정을 혼자 있는 시간에 천천히 풀어내는 편입니다. 조용한 음악이나 일기처럼 나만 아는 쉼이 마음을 다시 채워 줘요. 피곤할 때는 약속을 하나 줄이고 쉬는 것도 나를 돌보는 일입니다.
rows.en: Emotions that build up around other people unwind slowly once you have time to yourself. Your own private ways of resting, like quiet music or journaling, recharge you. When you're worn out, cancel a plan and rest; that's self-care too.
rows.en_before_tone: Feelings that build up when you're around people tend to unwind slowly once you have time on your own. Private ways of resting, like quiet music or journaling, refill your heart. When you're tired, cancelling one plan to rest is also a way of caring for yourself.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 나를 표현하는 방식으로 바로 드러나요.
rows.en: Your thoughts and words are front and center in how you come across.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words show up directly in the way you express yourself.

rows.ko: 머릿속에 떠오른 생각이 말과 표정으로 금방 나오는 편이에요. 첫 대화에서 재치 있고 똑똑하다는 인상을 주기 쉽습니다. 말하기 전에 한 박자 쉬어 가면 내 뜻이 더 정확히 전해져요.
rows.en: Whatever's on your mind shows up right away in your words and on your face. In a first conversation, you come across as quick-witted and smart. Take a beat before you speak, and you say exactly what you mean.
rows.en_before_tone: The thoughts in your head tend to come out quickly in your words and expressions. You easily come across as witty and smart in a first conversation. Taking a beat before you speak helps your meaning come through more clearly.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 돈·내 것·가치를 따지는 데 모여요.
rows.en: Money, possessions, and what things are really worth take up a lot of your mental energy.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words gather around weighing money, possessions, and value.

rows.ko: 무엇이 내게 쓸모 있고 값진지 꼼꼼히 따져 보는 편입니다. 가계부, 비교, 계획처럼 생각을 실제 살림에 연결하는 데 강해요. 말과 아이디어 자체가 나의 재산이 될 수도 있습니다.
rows.en: You think carefully about what's useful and worth it to you. You're good at putting ideas to work in real life: budgeting, comparing options, planning ahead. Your words and ideas can become valuable assets in their own right.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to carefully weigh what's useful and valuable to you. You're good at connecting ideas to real-life money matters, like budgeting, comparing, and planning. Your words and ideas themselves could even become one of your assets.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 배움과 가까운 사람들과의 대화로 향해요.
rows.en: Learning and chatting with the people around you is where your mind feels at home.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward learning and conversations with people close to you.

rows.ko: 궁금한 것이 생기면 바로 찾아보고 누군가와 나누고 싶어지는 사람이에요. 짧은 글, 메시지, 수다처럼 가볍게 오가는 말에 재능이 있습니다. 생각이 여러 갈래로 뻗을 때는 메모로 붙잡아 두면 좋아요.
rows.en: The moment you're curious about something, you look it up and want to share it. You have a gift for quick, easy communication, like short posts, texts, and casual chats. When your thoughts branch off in every direction, jot them down before they slip away.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're curious about something, you want to look it up right away and share it with someone. You have a gift for light back-and-forth words, like short posts, messages, and chatting. When your thoughts branch out in many directions, it helps to catch them in a note.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 집·가족·마음의 뿌리로 향해요.
rows.en: Home, family, and your roots are often on your mind.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward home, family, and the roots of your heart.

rows.ko: 집에서 편하게 나누는 대화에서 진짜 생각이 나오는 편이에요. 지난 기억을 곱씹으며 지금의 나를 이해하려는 마음이 큽니다. 가족이나 가까운 사람과 짧게 이야기를 주고받다 보면 생각이 정리돼요.
rows.en: Your real thoughts come out in relaxed conversations at home. You often revisit old memories to make sense of who you are now. Quick chats with family or close friends help you put your thoughts in order.
rows.en_before_tone: Your real thoughts tend to come out in relaxed conversations at home. You have a strong urge to understand who you are now by reflecting on past memories. Short chats with family or people close to you help put your thoughts in order.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 즐거움·놀이·창작으로 향해요.
rows.en: You think best when there's fun, play, or a creative project involved.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward joy, play, and creativity.

rows.ko: 말장난이나 엉뚱한 상상처럼 생각을 놀이로 바꾸는 데 능한 편입니다. 글, 영상, 기획처럼 아이디어를 표현하는 일에서 즐거움을 느껴요. 좋아하는 것을 이야기할 때 말에 생기가 돌아요.
rows.en: You turn ideas into play, whether it's wordplay or wild daydreams. Expressing ideas through writing, video, or planning projects is genuinely fun for you. Talk about something you love, and your words come alive.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be good at turning thoughts into play, with wordplay or quirky daydreams. You enjoy work that expresses ideas, like writing, video, or planning projects. When you talk about what you love, your words come alive.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 매일의 일과 루틴을 정리하는 데 모여요.
rows.en: You put your mind to organizing your daily work and routines.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words gather around organizing daily work and routines.

rows.ko: 할 일 목록을 만들고 순서를 정할 때 머리가 맑아지는 편이에요. 일의 작은 빈틈을 잘 찾아내고 고치는 데 강합니다. 생각이 쉬지 않을 때는 잠들기 전 메모로 머리를 비워 주면 좋아요.
rows.en: Making a to-do list and setting priorities clears your head. You're good at spotting and fixing the small gaps in your work. When your mind won't switch off, jot a few notes before bed and unload.
rows.en_before_tone: Your mind tends to clear when you make a to-do list and set priorities. You're good at finding and fixing small gaps in your work. When your thoughts won't rest, jotting a note before bed helps empty your mind.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 일대일 대화와 파트너와의 소통으로 향해요.
rows.en: Your best thinking happens in one-on-one conversations and in talking things over with a partner.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward one-on-one talks and communicating with a partner.

rows.ko: 혼자 고민하기보다 마주 앉은 한 사람과 이야기하며 생각을 정리하는 편입니다. 상대의 말을 잘 듣고 균형 있게 답하는 데 재능이 있어요. 중요한 결정일수록 믿는 사람과 한 번 의논해 보면 좋습니다.
rows.en: Instead of worrying things over alone, you sort out your thoughts by talking with one person face to face. You're a good listener with a gift for balanced, thoughtful replies. The bigger the decision, the more you gain from talking it over with someone you trust.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to sort out your thoughts by talking with one person across from you rather than worrying alone. You have a gift for listening well and responding in a balanced way. The bigger the decision, the more it helps to talk it over with someone you trust.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 깊은 속마음과 숨은 이유를 살피는 데 모여요.
rows.en: Your mind is drawn to what lies beneath: deep feelings and hidden motives.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words gather around exploring deep feelings and hidden reasons.

rows.ko: 겉으로 드러난 말보다 그 뒤에 있는 진짜 이유가 궁금한 사람이에요. 한 가지 주제를 깊이 파고드는 집중력이 좋습니다. 생각이 너무 깊어질 때는 가볍게 바람을 쐬며 머리를 식혀 주세요.
rows.en: You care less about what's said on the surface than about the real reason behind it. You have the focus to dig deep into a single subject. When your thoughts get too heavy, step outside for fresh air and give your mind a break.
rows.en_before_tone: You're curious about the real reason behind what's said, more than the words on the surface. You have great focus for digging deep into a single topic. When your thoughts get too deep, it can help to step outside for some fresh air and let your mind cool off.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 넓은 배움·여행·큰 질문으로 향해요.
rows.en: Higher learning, travel, and life's big questions capture your imagination.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward higher learning, travel, and big questions.

rows.ko: 작은 일보다 ‘왜 그럴까’ 같은 큰 질문에 마음이 끌리는 편이에요. 외국어, 철학, 여행 이야기처럼 시야를 넓히는 배움에서 생각이 자랍니다. 배운 것을 남에게 전할 때 말에 힘이 실려요.
rows.en: Big questions like "Why is it like that?" interest you far more than small details. Your thinking grows through learning that broadens your horizons, like foreign languages, philosophy, or travel stories. When you pass on what you've learned, your words carry real weight.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be drawn to big questions like "Why is that?" more than small matters. Your thinking grows through learning that widens your view, like foreign languages, philosophy, or travel stories. Your words gain strength when you pass on what you've learned.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 커리어와 사회 속 역할로 향해요.
rows.en: Your communication skills go to work for your career and your role in the world.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward your career and your role in the world.

rows.ko: 일터에서 말과 글로 능력을 보여 주는 편입니다. 기획, 설명, 발표처럼 생각을 정리해 전하는 역할에서 빛나기 쉬워요. 내 생각을 꾸준히 기록해 두면 일의 방향을 잡는 데 도움이 됩니다.
rows.en: At work, your speaking and writing show what you can do. You shine in roles where you organize and share ideas, like planning, explaining, and presenting. Keep a regular record of your ideas; it helps you steer the direction of your work.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to show your abilities at work through speaking and writing. You're likely to shine in roles where you organize and share ideas, like planning, explaining, and presenting. Keeping a steady record of your thoughts helps you set the direction of your work.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 사람들·공동체·미래 계획으로 향해요.
rows.en: People, community, and plans for the future keep your mind buzzing.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward people, community, and plans for the future.

rows.ko: 여러 사람과 아이디어를 주고받을 때 생각이 빠르게 굴러가는 편이에요. 모임이나 온라인 공동체에서 정보를 나누고 연결하는 역할을 맡기 쉽습니다. 앞으로의 계획을 말로 꺼내 보면 그림이 더 또렷해져요.
rows.en: Your mind speeds up when you're bouncing ideas around with lots of people. In groups or online communities, you end up being the one who shares information and connects people. Say your plans for the future out loud, and the picture comes into focus.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thinking tends to pick up speed when you trade ideas with many people. You often end up sharing information and connecting people in groups or online communities. Saying your future plans out loud helps the picture come into focus.

rows.ko: 생각과 말이 조용한 내면과 혼자만의 정리로 향해요.
rows.en: Your thoughts turn inward, toward quiet reflection and sorting things out on your own.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words turn toward your quiet inner world and private reflection.

rows.ko: 생각을 바로 말하기보다 속으로 오래 굴려 보는 편입니다. 혼자 있는 시간에 떠오르는 직관과 상상이 풍부해요. 마음속 생각을 일기나 메모로 꺼내 두면 머리가 한결 가벼워집니다.
rows.en: You mull things over long before you say them out loud. Alone, your intuition and imagination run rich and luminous. Pour your inner thoughts into a journal or a few quick notes, and feel your head clear.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to turn thoughts over inside for a long time rather than saying them right away. Intuition and imagination flow richly when you're on your own. Putting your inner thoughts into a journal or notes makes your mind feel much lighter.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 나를 꾸미고 드러내는 데서 피어나요.
rows.en: Your love of beauty blooms in how you dress, style, and present yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms in how you present and express yourself.

rows.ko: 부드럽고 호감 가는 첫인상을 주는 편이에요. 옷차림이나 말투처럼 나를 표현하는 방식에 나만의 취향이 담겨 있습니다. 스스로를 아끼는 마음이 관계의 분위기까지 밝혀 줘요.
rows.en: You make a soft, warm first impression, and people like you from the start. Your personal taste shines through how you show up, from your clothes to the way you speak. Treat yourself with care, and that glow brightens every relationship around you.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to make a soft, likable first impression. Your own taste shows in how you express yourself, like your clothes and your way of speaking. Caring for yourself brightens the mood of your relationships too.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 돈·내 것·나의 가치를 향해요.
rows.en: Venus draws your affection toward money, your possessions, and your own worth.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection turns toward money, your possessions, and your sense of worth.

rows.ko: 마음에 드는 물건을 고르는 안목이 좋은 편입니다. 아름답고 편안한 것에 돈을 쓸 때 만족이 커요. 나의 가치를 스스로 인정하는 만큼 생활도 넉넉하게 느껴집니다.
rows.en: You have a fine eye for choosing things you'll truly love. Spending on beauty and comfort brings you deep satisfaction. Own your worth, and your whole life feels richer.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to have a good eye for choosing things you love. You feel most satisfied when spending on things that are beautiful and comfortable. The more you recognize your own worth, the more abundant your life feels.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 말·배움·가까운 이웃과의 교류에서 피어나요.
rows.en: Kind words, learning, and neighborly chats bring your warmth to life.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms through words, learning, and time with people nearby.

rows.ko: 다정한 말 한마디로 분위기를 부드럽게 만드는 재주가 있어요. 가까운 친구나 형제, 동네 사람들과 편하게 어울리는 관계를 좋아합니다. 예쁜 문장이나 재미있는 배움에서 기쁨을 찾기도 해요.
rows.en: One kind word from you softens the whole room. You treasure easygoing ties with close friends, siblings, and neighbors. A beautifully turned phrase or a fun new subject lights up your day.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a knack for softening the mood with a single kind word. You enjoy easygoing relationships with close friends, siblings, and people in your neighborhood. You may also find joy in a lovely sentence or a fun thing to learn.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 집·가족·편안한 공간에서 피어나요.
rows.en: Home, family, and a space that feels like yours are where your affection blooms.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms at home, with family, and in cozy spaces.

rows.ko: 집을 내 취향으로 아늑하게 꾸밀 때 행복을 느끼는 편이에요. 가까운 사람을 집으로 초대해 함께 밥을 먹는 시간이 소중합니다. 편안한 공간이 곧 관계를 지키는 힘이 돼요.
rows.en: You feel happiest when you make your home cozy and fill it with what you love. Sharing a meal with close friends at your table is time you treasure. Your comfortable home becomes the steady ground your relationships stand on.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel happy making your home cozy and true to your taste. Time spent inviting people close to you over for a meal is precious. A comfortable space becomes the very thing that protects your relationships.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 즐거움·연애·창작에서 활짝 피어나요.
rows.en: Fun, romance, and creativity bring your loving nature into full bloom.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blooms fully in joy, romance, and creativity.

rows.ko: 사랑하고 즐기는 일에 마음을 아끼지 않는 사람입니다. 예술, 취미, 설레는 관계처럼 기쁨을 주는 것에 자연스럽게 끌려요. 좋아하는 것을 마음껏 즐기는 시간이 삶에 윤기를 더해 줍니다.
rows.en: When you love something, you give it your whole heart. Art, hobbies, and the thrill of a new crush pull you in naturally. Make time to savor what you love; that is what puts the sparkle in your life.
rows.en_before_tone: You give your heart freely to the things you love and enjoy. You're naturally drawn to what brings joy, like art, hobbies, and exciting relationships. Time spent fully enjoying what you love adds a glow to your life.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 매일의 일과 루틴을 가꾸는 데서 피어나요.
rows.en: You find joy in tending your everyday work and routines.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms in tending your daily work and routines.

rows.ko: 일하는 공간을 예쁘게 정돈하고 동료와 좋은 분위기를 만드는 편이에요. 일상 속 작은 즐거움이 하루를 버티게 하는 힘이 됩니다. 나를 돌보는 루틴도 즐거운 의식처럼 만들면 오래 이어 가기 쉬워요.
rows.en: You keep a neat, lovely workspace and build a warm atmosphere with your coworkers. Small everyday pleasures carry you through the day. Turn your self-care into a ritual you truly enjoy, and you'll keep it up for the long run.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to keep your workspace neat and pretty and create a good mood with coworkers. Small pleasures in daily life give you the strength to get through the day. If you turn your self-care routine into an enjoyable ritual, it's easier to keep it going.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 일대일 관계와 파트너십에서 피어나요.
rows.en: Your heart opens in partnerships and one-on-one bonds.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms in one-on-one relationships and partnerships.

rows.ko: 함께하는 한 사람과 조화롭게 지내는 것을 중요하게 여기는 편입니다. 상대를 배려하고 맞춰 주는 데 능해서 관계가 부드러워요. 다만 내가 원하는 것도 말로 꺼낼 때 관계가 더 오래 편안해집니다.
rows.en: Harmony with the one person beside you matters deeply to you. You're considerate and quick to meet people halfway, so your relationships run smoothly. Say what you want out loud, too; that keeps the peace for the long run.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to place great value on getting along harmoniously with the one person beside you. You're good at being considerate and accommodating, so your relationships run smoothly. Still, relationships stay comfortable longer when you also put what you want into words.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 깊은 유대와 함께 나누는 것을 향해요.
rows.en: Venus draws you toward deep bonds and a life truly shared.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection turns toward deep bonds and what you share together.

rows.ko: 가볍게 스치는 호감보다 깊고 진한 관계에 끌리는 편이에요. 마음뿐 아니라 시간과 살림까지 함께 나누는 사이를 소중히 여깁니다. 믿음이 쌓일수록 관계가 더 깊은 빛을 내요.
rows.en: Passing crushes rarely hold you; you crave relationships with real depth and intensity. You treasure bonds where you share not only feelings but your time and your daily life. As trust builds, those connections glow ever richer.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be drawn to deep, intense relationships rather than fleeting attraction. You treasure bonds where you share not only feelings but also time and a household. The more trust builds, the deeper your relationships glow.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 넓은 배움·여행·낯선 문화에서 피어나요.
rows.en: Faraway places, big ideas, and new cultures make your heart skip a beat.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms through higher learning, travel, and unfamiliar cultures.

rows.ko: 다른 나라의 음식, 음악, 풍경에서 설렘을 느끼는 편입니다. 생각이 넓고 배울 점이 있는 사람에게 마음이 가요. 여행이나 새로운 공부가 삶의 기쁨을 채워 주는 통로가 됩니다.
rows.en: Food, music, and landscapes from other countries thrill you. Open-minded people you can learn from win your heart. Travel and new studies open the widest channels for joy in your life.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel a thrill from the food, music, and scenery of other countries. Your heart goes out to open-minded people you can learn from. Travel and new studies become channels that fill your life with joy.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 커리어와 사회 속 역할로 이어져요.
rows.en: What you love flows into your career and your place in the world.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection flows into your career and your role in the world.

rows.ko: 일터에서 호감 가고 세련된 사람으로 기억되기 쉬워요. 아름다움, 사람, 조화를 다루는 일에서 재능이 빛나는 편입니다. 좋아하는 것을 일과 연결할 때 일하는 기쁨도 커져요.
rows.en: At work, people remember you as likable and polished. Your talents shine in fields of beauty, people, and harmony. Weave what you love into your work, and the work itself becomes a joy.
rows.en_before_tone: At work, you're likely to be remembered as someone likable and polished. Your talents tend to shine in work involving beauty, people, and harmony. When you connect what you love with your work, the joy of working grows too.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 친구·공동체·함께 꾸는 꿈에서 피어나요.
rows.en: Your warmth flourishes among friends, community, and shared dreams.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms among friends, community, and dreams you share.

rows.ko: 마음 맞는 친구들과 어울리는 시간이 큰 기쁨인 편이에요. 모임 안에서 사람들을 이어 주고 분위기를 부드럽게 만드는 역할을 맡기 쉽습니다. 함께 그리는 미래가 있을 때 관계가 더 깊어져요.
rows.en: Time with kindred spirits is one of your greatest joys. In any group, you're the one who connects people and smooths things over. Dream up a future together, and your friendships deepen.
rows.en_before_tone: Time spent with like-minded friends tends to be a great joy for you. In groups, you often end up connecting people and softening the mood. Relationships grow deeper when there's a future you're picturing together.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음이 조용한 쉼과 나만 아는 기쁨에서 피어나요.
rows.en: You find delight in quiet rest and private joys only you know.
rows.en_before_tone: Your affection blossoms in quiet rest and private joys only you know.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음을 겉으로 드러내기보다 조용히 간직하는 편입니다. 혼자 듣는 음악, 남몰래 하는 친절처럼 드러나지 않는 기쁨이 소중해요. 그 다정함을 나 자신에게도 나눠 주면 마음이 한결 채워집니다.
rows.en: You keep your affection close rather than wearing it on your sleeve. Hidden joys, like music you play just for yourself or kindnesses no one sees, are precious to you. Turn that tenderness toward yourself, too, and you feel more whole.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to keep your affection quietly to yourself rather than showing it outwardly. Hidden joys, like music you listen to alone or kindnesses you do in secret, are precious to you. When you turn that tenderness toward yourself too, your heart feels much fuller.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 나 자신을 앞세우는 쪽으로 곧장 향해요.
rows.en: Your drive charges straight into putting yourself out front.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions head straight toward putting yourself forward.

rows.ko: 마음먹으면 몸이 먼저 움직이는 편이에요. 활기차고 당당한 첫인상을 주기 쉽습니다. 속도가 빠른 만큼 가끔 숨을 고르며 방향을 확인하면 힘을 더 오래 쓸 수 있어요.
rows.en: Once you decide, your body is already moving. You come across as lively and confident. You move fast, so pause now and then to catch your breath and check your direction; that is how you go the distance.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you make up your mind, your body tends to move first. You easily give a lively, confident first impression. Because you move fast, pausing now and then to catch your breath and check your direction helps you use your energy for longer.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 돈을 벌고 내 것을 지키는 쪽으로 향해요.
rows.en: You channel your energy into earning money and guarding what's yours.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward earning money and protecting what's yours.

rows.ko: 원하는 것이 있으면 직접 벌어서 손에 넣으려는 추진력이 있습니다. 내 것과 내 기준을 지키는 일에 힘이 많이 실려요. 급하게 쓰고 싶을 때는 하루만 미뤄 보는 것도 좋은 방법입니다.
rows.en: When you want something, you have the drive to earn it and claim it yourself. You pour much of your energy into protecting what's yours and the standards you live by. When the urge to splurge hits, sleep on it for a day.
rows.en_before_tone: When you want something, you have the drive to earn it and get it yourself. A lot of your energy goes into protecting what's yours and your own standards. When you feel an urge to spend in a hurry, it can help to wait just one day.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 배움·말·가까운 사람들과의 소통으로 향해요.
rows.en: Your fire goes into learning, speaking up, and staying in touch with those around you.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward learning, words, and communicating with people close to you.

rows.ko: 할 말이 있으면 빠르고 분명하게 전하는 편이에요. 배우고 싶은 것이 생기면 바로 찾아 나서는 행동력이 있습니다. 말에 열기가 실릴 때는 단어를 한 번 고른 뒤 꺼내면 뜻이 더 잘 닿아요.
rows.en: When you have something to say, you say it quickly and clearly. The moment something sparks your interest, you're off to learn it. When a conversation heats up, choose your words before you speak, and your point lands.
rows.en_before_tone: When you have something to say, you tend to say it quickly and clearly. When you want to learn something, you have the get-up-and-go to seek it out right away. When your words get heated, taking a moment to choose them before you speak helps your meaning land.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 집·가족·내 공간을 가꾸는 쪽으로 향해요.
rows.en: You pour your energy into building up your home, family, and personal space.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward tending your home, family, and space.

rows.ko: 집을 고치고 정리하는 일에 힘을 쏟는 편입니다. 가까운 사람을 지키려는 마음이 강하고, 그만큼 집 안에서 감정이 뜨거워지기도 해요. 열이 오를 때는 몸을 움직여 풀고 나서 대화하면 좋습니다.
rows.en: You put real effort into fixing up and organizing your home. You fiercely protect the people close to you, and that same fire can make tempers run hot at home. When things heat up, burn off steam with a workout or a brisk walk first, then talk.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to put energy into fixing up and organizing your home. You feel strongly about protecting the people close to you, and feelings can run hot at home because of it. When things heat up, it helps to work off the heat by moving your body before you talk.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 즐거움·연애·창작으로 향해요.
rows.en: Fun, romance, and creative projects set you on fire.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward joy, romance, and creativity.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것이 생기면 열정적으로 뛰어드는 사람이에요. 운동, 게임, 창작처럼 몸과 마음을 다 쓰는 놀이에서 에너지가 살아납니다. 표현하고 싶은 마음을 망설이지 않는 용기가 있어요.
rows.en: When you find something you love, you throw yourself into it. Play that uses body and mind alike, like sports, games, or making things, charges you up. You have the courage to express yourself without holding back.
rows.en_before_tone: When you find something you love, you dive in with passion. Your energy comes alive in play that uses body and mind, like sports, games, or creating. You have the courage not to hold back when you want to express yourself.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 매일의 일과 몸의 리듬으로 향해요.
rows.en: You channel your drive into daily tasks and your body's rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward daily work and your body's rhythm.

rows.ko: 맡은 일을 빠르고 부지런하게 해치우는 편이에요. 몸을 움직이는 루틴이 있을 때 하루의 힘이 잘 돌아갑니다. 다만 쉬지 않고 달리기 쉬우니 피로가 쌓이기 전에 쉬는 시간을 일정에 넣어 두세요.
rows.en: You knock out your tasks quickly and diligently. Your days run best on a routine that keeps you physically active. You can run nonstop, so pencil in breaks before exhaustion catches up with you.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to get your tasks done quickly and diligently. Your day runs well when you have a routine that gets your body moving. Since it's easy for you to keep running without a break, it helps to schedule rest before fatigue builds up.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 일대일 관계와 파트너와의 협력으로 향해요.
rows.en: Your drive comes alive when you team up with a partner.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward one-on-one relationships and teaming up with a partner.

rows.ko: 혼자보다 함께 움직일 때 추진력이 붙는 편입니다. 관계 안에서 의견이 부딪히면 솔직하게 맞서기도 해요. 서로의 속도를 확인하며 같은 목표를 정하면 둘의 힘이 크게 모입니다.
rows.en: You gain momentum when you work alongside someone rather than alone. When you clash with someone close, you face it honestly and head-on. Sync your pace and agree on a shared goal, and the two of you become a powerful team.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive tends to pick up when you move with someone rather than alone. When opinions clash in a relationship, you may face it head-on and honestly. When you check each other's pace and set a shared goal, your combined strength really adds up.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 깊은 유대를 지키고 큰 변화를 헤쳐 가는 쪽으로 향해요.
rows.en: You fight for your deepest bonds and meet big changes head-on.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward protecting deep bonds and working through big changes.

rows.ko: 한번 마음을 정하면 끝까지 파고드는 집념이 있어요. 함께 나누는 것과 깊은 관계를 지키는 일에 강한 에너지를 씁니다. 큰 변화 앞에서도 물러서기보다 정면으로 마주하려는 편이에요.
rows.en: Once your mind is set, you dig in and see it through to the end. You pour serious energy into protecting your closest bonds and everything you share. When big changes arrive, you face them squarely instead of backing away.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you make up your mind, you have the determination to see it all the way through. You put strong energy into protecting what you share and your deep relationships. Even in the face of big change, you tend to meet it head-on rather than back away.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 넓은 배움·여행·믿는 가치로 향해요.
rows.en: Your drive heads for big learning, far-off places, and the causes you believe in.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward higher learning, travel, and the values you believe in.

rows.ko: 새로운 곳으로 떠나거나 큰 배움에 도전할 때 의욕이 솟는 편이에요. 내가 옳다고 믿는 것을 위해 적극적으로 나서기도 합니다. 신념이 뜨거울수록 다른 생각도 한 번 들어 보면 힘이 더 넓게 쓰여요.
rows.en: Setting off somewhere new or taking on an ambitious course of study sets your drive ablaze. You stand up boldly for what you believe is right. The stronger your convictions, the more you gain by hearing out other views, so let your energy reach further.
rows.en_before_tone: Your motivation tends to surge when you head somewhere new or take on a big learning challenge. You may also step up actively for what you believe is right. The stronger your convictions, the more it helps to hear other views too, so your energy reaches further.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 커리어와 목표를 이루는 쪽으로 향해요.
rows.en: You aim your drive squarely at your career and your goals.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward your career and reaching your goals.

rows.ko: 일에서 목표가 보이면 힘차게 달려 나가는 편입니다. 도전적인 역할을 맡을 때 오히려 힘이 나요. 성과를 향해 가는 만큼 쉼의 자리도 함께 챙겨 두면 좋습니다.
rows.en: The moment you spot a goal at work, you charge toward it. Challenging roles don't drain you; they fire you up. You push hard for results, so carve out room for rest as well.
rows.en_before_tone: When you see a goal at work, you tend to charge ahead with energy. Taking on challenging roles actually energizes you. As much as you push toward results, it helps to make room for rest as well.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 사람들과 함께 이루는 미래 목표로 향해요.
rows.en: You pour your energy into future goals you reach together with others.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions turn toward future goals you reach together with others.

rows.ko: 팀이나 모임에서 일을 앞장서 이끄는 편이에요. 같은 꿈을 가진 사람들과 함께할 때 행동력이 배가됩니다. 의견이 갈릴 때는 목표를 다시 꺼내 보면 힘을 한데 모으기 쉬워요.
rows.en: In teams and groups, you lead the charge. Around people who share your dream, your momentum doubles. When the group can't agree, bring everyone back to the shared goal and watch the energy pull together.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to take the lead in teams and groups. Your get-up-and-go doubles when you're with people who share the same dream. When opinions split, bringing the goal back into view makes it easier to pull everyone's energy together.

rows.ko: 의욕과 행동이 보이지 않는 곳에서 조용히 움직여요.
rows.en: Your drive works quietly, behind the scenes.
rows.en_before_tone: Your drive and actions move quietly, out of sight.

rows.ko: 앞에 나서기보다 뒤에서 묵묵히 일을 해내는 편입니다. 화나 의욕을 겉으로 드러내지 않고 속으로 삭이기도 해요. 혼자 하는 운동이나 정리처럼 조용히 힘을 쓰는 통로가 있으면 마음이 한결 가벼워집니다.
rows.en: You'd rather get things done behind the scenes than step into the spotlight. You tend to hold anger or ambition inside instead of showing it. Give that energy a quiet outlet, like a solo workout or a good tidy-up, and feel a weight lift from your mind.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to get things done quietly behind the scenes rather than in front. You may keep anger or drive inside instead of showing it. Having a quiet outlet for your energy, like solo exercise or tidying up, makes your heart feel much lighter.

B2b.name: 행성 × 하우스 (목성·토성·천왕성·해왕성·명왕성)
B2b.used_in: 출생차트 휠 행성 탭 시트 (정확도 A·B등급만)

rows.ko: 있는 그대로의 나를 너그럽게 내보이는 힘을 타고났어요.
rows.en: You were born with the gift of being openly, generously yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: You were born with the ability to show yourself, just as you are, with an open heart.

rows.ko: 처음 만난 자리에서도 표정이 열려 있어 사람들이 쉽게 말을 거는 편입니다. 낯선 곳에서도 금방 자리를 잡는 여유가 오래가는 강점이에요. 다만 기분이 좋을 때 약속을 선뜻 많이 잡기 쉬우니 내가 감당할 몫을 한 번 헤아려 보는 습관이 도움이 됩니다.
rows.en: Even with people you've just met, your open, friendly face invites conversation. You settle into new places quickly, a strength that serves you for life. When a good mood has you saying yes to every plan, pause and weigh how much you can truly take on.
rows.en_before_tone: Even when meeting people for the first time, your open expression tends to make it easy for them to talk to you. The ease with which you settle into new places is a lasting strength. Still, when you're in a good mood it's easy to say yes to lots of plans, so a habit of checking how much you can really handle will help.

rows.ko: 내가 가진 것의 쓸모를 넓게 알아보는 감각이 있습니다.
rows.en: You see the value in what you have, and all the ways to use it.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a knack for seeing the many uses of what you have.

rows.ko: 같은 재주로도 여러 쓰임새를 떠올리고, 그 가치를 자연스럽게 보여 주는 편이에요. 나에게 너그러운 만큼 남에게도 후하게 마음을 쓰는 자리입니다. 여유가 느껴지는 날일수록 씀씀이 기준을 하나 정해 두면 그 넉넉함이 오래 남아요.
rows.en: You find many uses for a single skill and naturally show what it's worth. You're as generous with others as you are with yourself. On days your wallet feels thicker, set one simple spending rule so that sense of plenty lasts.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to imagine many uses for the same skill and naturally show its value. This is a placement where you're as generous with others as you are with yourself. On days when you feel flush, setting one spending rule helps that abundance last.

rows.ko: 배우고 말하는 일에서 문이 잘 열리는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Learning and conversation open doors for you.
rows.en_before_tone: Doors open easily for you through learning and talking.

rows.ko: 짧은 대화 하나, 우연히 읽은 글 한 편에서 생각이 크게 뻗어 나가곤 합니다. 가까운 사람들에게 설명하고 이야기를 나누는 일이 자연스러운 즐거움이 되어 줘요. 관심이 여러 갈래로 퍼지기 쉬우니 끝까지 붙잡을 주제를 하나씩 고르면 배움이 깊어집니다.
rows.en: One quick chat or a chance read sends your mind off in exciting new directions. Explaining things and swapping stories with the people around you is a natural joy. Your interests branch out in every direction, so choose one topic at a time to stick with and let your learning deepen.
rows.en_before_tone: A single short conversation or a piece you happened to read can send your thoughts branching out widely. Explaining things and chatting with the people close to you becomes a natural joy. Your interests can spread in many directions, so choosing one topic at a time to stick with helps your learning grow deeper.

rows.ko: 집과 마음의 뿌리가 넉넉한 쉼터가 되기 쉬운 자리예요.
rows.en: Home and family become a warm, generous haven for you.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement makes home and the roots of your heart a generous refuge.

rows.ko: 내가 머무는 공간을 편안하게 꾸미고 사람을 들이는 일에서 힘을 얻는 편입니다. 돌아갈 곳이 든든하다는 감각이 바깥일을 버티는 바탕이 되어 줘요. 집에 관한 일은 기분이 앞서기 쉬우니 큰 결정 앞에서는 현실 조건을 먼저 살펴보세요.
rows.en: You draw strength from making your space comfortable and opening your door to others. Knowing you have a solid place to come home to carries you through everything out there. Feelings run ahead of you when it comes to home, so before any big decision, look at the practical side first.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to draw strength from making your space comfortable and welcoming people into it. Knowing you have a solid place to return to becomes the foundation that carries you through life outside. Feelings can run ahead in matters of home, so before big decisions it helps to look at the practical side first.

rows.ko: 즐거움과 창작에서 마음이 크게 피어나는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Fun and creativity are where you truly blossom.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart blooms fully through joy and creativity.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 일을 할 때 표정부터 달라지고, 그 기운이 주변까지 밝게 번지는 편이에요. 즐겁게 시작한 취미나 만들기가 뜻밖의 기회로 이어지기도 합니다. 재미있는 일이 너무 많아질 때는 정말 아끼는 것 몇 가지만 남겨 두면 좋아요.
rows.en: When you're doing what you love, your whole face lights up, and that glow spreads to everyone around you. A hobby or project you started just for fun can open an unexpected door. When the fun starts piling up, keep only the few things you truly cherish.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're doing what you love, your whole face changes, and that energy tends to brighten everyone around you. A hobby or project you started for fun may even lead to an unexpected opportunity. When the fun things start piling up, it helps to keep just the few you truly treasure.

rows.ko: 매일의 일과 루틴 속에서 운이 자라는 자리예요.
rows.en: Jupiter grows your luck through your daily work and routines.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement lets luck grow within your daily work and routines.

rows.ko: 일하는 방식을 조금씩 손보거나 동료를 돕는 과정에서 좋은 흐름이 생기는 편이에요. 몸을 돌보는 루틴도 즐겁게 습관으로 만드는 재주가 있습니다. 다만 해낼 수 있다는 마음에 일을 많이 떠맡기 쉬우니 하루에 빈칸을 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Good fortune flows your way when you fine-tune how you work or lend a hand to coworkers. You have a knack for turning self-care into habits you enjoy. Your can-do spirit tempts you to take on too much, so leave some open space in your day.
rows.en_before_tone: Good things tend to come from tweaking how you work or helping coworkers. You also have a knack for turning self-care routines into enjoyable habits. Still, the feeling that you can handle it all makes it easy to take on too much, so it helps to leave some blank space in your day.

rows.ko: 일대일로 만나는 사람들에게서 길이 넓어지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: The people you partner with widen your path.
rows.en_before_tone: Your path widens through the people you meet one-on-one.

rows.ko: 함께 일하거나 마주 앉아 의논하는 상대가 새로운 문을 열어 주기 쉽습니다. 상대의 좋은 점을 먼저 알아보는 너그러움이 관계를 오래 받쳐 줘요. 기대가 커질 때는 서로 바라는 몫을 말로 확인해 두면 그 따뜻함이 지켜집니다.
rows.en: Partners, and the people you sit down with to talk things through, open new doors for you. Your generosity in seeing the best in others keeps your relationships strong over the years. When expectations grow, spell out what each of you hopes for, and that warmth stays intact.
rows.en_before_tone: The people you work with or sit down to talk things over with often open new doors for you. Your generosity in seeing the good in others first supports your relationships for the long run. When expectations grow, confirming out loud what each of you hopes for keeps that warmth safe.

rows.ko: 깊이 믿는 사람과 나눌 때 더 넉넉해지는 자리입니다.
rows.en: Your life grows richer when you share it with people you deeply trust.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, life grows richer when you share it with people you deeply trust.

rows.ko: 속 이야기를 털어놓을 수 있는 관계에서 큰 힘을 얻고, 필요할 때 도움의 손길이 닿기 쉬운 편이에요. 막막해 보이던 순간을 지나며 오히려 마음이 넓어지는 경험도 이 자리의 몫입니다. 함께 쓰는 돈이나 약속은 넉넉한 마음만큼 기록도 꼼꼼히 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: You draw great strength from relationships where you can truly open up, and help arrives when you need it. You come out of seemingly hopeless moments more generous and open than before. With shared money or commitments, keep records as thorough as your generosity.
rows.en_before_tone: You draw great strength from relationships where you can open up, and help tends to reach you when you need it. This placement also brings the experience of finding your heart has grown wider after moments that once seemed hopeless. With shared money or commitments, it helps to keep records as careful as your heart is generous.

rows.ko: 넓은 세상과 큰 생각 앞에서 마음이 열리는 사람이에요.
rows.en: A wide world and big ideas set your spirit free.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart opens in the face of a wide world and big ideas.

rows.ko: 낯선 곳에 가거나 새로운 관점을 만나면 몸까지 가벼워지는 듯한 기분을 느끼기 쉬워요. 배운 것을 나만의 신념으로 엮어 내는 힘이 오래가는 강점입니다. 좋은 생각이 크게 부풀 때는 오늘 할 수 있는 작은 일 하나로 옮겨 보세요.
rows.en: A new place or a fresh perspective leaves you feeling lighter than air. You have a lasting gift for weaving what you learn into a personal philosophy. When a great idea starts to balloon, turn it into one small step you can take today.
rows.en_before_tone: When you go somewhere unfamiliar or meet a new perspective, you may feel almost physically lighter. Weaving what you've learned into your own beliefs is a lasting strength. When a good idea swells big, try turning it into one small thing you can do today.

rows.ko: 일과 사회적 역할에서 기회가 잘 닿는 자리예요.
rows.en: Opportunities find you through your work and public role.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement lets opportunities reach you through work and your role in the world.

rows.ko: 맡은 일을 넓게 보고 사람들을 이끄는 모습이 자연스럽게 눈에 띄는 편입니다. 제안이나 추천이 이어지기 쉬워 일의 폭이 시간과 함께 넓어져요. 다 해낼 수 있을 것 같은 날에는 우선순위부터 정해 두면 힘이 덜 흩어집니다.
rows.en: Your ability to see the big picture and lead others gets you noticed. Offers and referrals keep coming, so the scope of your work widens over time. On days you feel you could do it all, set your priorities first so your energy stays focused.
rows.en_before_tone: The way you see the big picture of your work and lead people tends to stand out naturally. Offers and recommendations come easily, so the scope of your work widens over time. On days when you feel you could do it all, setting priorities first keeps your energy from scattering.

rows.ko: 사람들과 어울리며 미래의 목표가 커지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Your goals for the future grow as you connect with others.
rows.en_before_tone: Your future goals grow bigger as you spend time with people.

rows.ko: 뜻이 맞는 모임에서 새로운 인연과 정보가 줄줄이 이어지기 쉬워요. 꿈을 말하면 도와주겠다는 사람이 나타나는 일이 드물지 않습니다. 모임이 많아질수록 나에게 정말 힘이 되는 자리를 골라 마음을 써 보세요.
rows.en: In like-minded groups, one new connection or tip leads to the next. Share a dream, and someone steps up to help more often than you'd expect. As your circles multiply, choose the ones that truly lift you up and invest your energy there.
rows.en_before_tone: In like-minded groups, new connections and information tend to keep coming one after another. When you share a dream, it's not unusual for someone to offer to help. As your groups multiply, it can help to choose the ones that truly give you strength and put your heart there.

rows.ko: 혼자 쉬는 시간 속에서 조용한 힘이 자라는 자리입니다.
rows.en: A quiet strength grows in your time alone.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement lets a quiet strength grow during your time alone to rest.

rows.ko: 드러나지 않는 곳에서 남을 돕거나 마음을 정리할 때 깊은 평온을 느끼는 편이에요. 힘든 고비마다 어디선가 도움이 닿는다고 느끼기도 합니다. 너그러운 마음에 남의 짐까지 떠안기 쉬우니 내 쉼의 시간은 따로 지켜 두세요.
rows.en: You find deep peace in helping others behind the scenes or sorting through your feelings. At every rough patch, help seems to find its way to you. Your generosity can have you shouldering other people's burdens, so guard your own rest time.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel a deep peace when helping others out of sight or sorting through your feelings. You may feel that help somehow reaches you at every hard moment. A generous heart makes it easy to take on others' burdens too, so it's okay to protect your own time to rest.

rows.ko: 시간을 들여 나다운 모습을 단단히 세워 가는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Year by year, you build a steady, solid sense of who you are.
rows.en_before_tone: You take time to firmly build the person you truly are.

rows.ko: 일찍부터 스스로에게 높은 기준을 두는 편이라 첫인상이 실제보다 진지해 보인다는 말을 듣기 쉬워요. 해마다 쌓인 경험이 그 진지함을 믿음직한 분위기로 바꿔 줍니다. 나를 다그치게 되는 날에는 지금까지 해 온 것을 한 줄씩 적어 보세요.
rows.en: You've held yourself to high standards since early on, so people often say you seem more serious at first than you really are. Year by year, experience turns that seriousness into a reassuring, steadfast presence. On days you're hard on yourself, write down what you've achieved so far, one line at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: Because you've set high standards for yourself from early on, people often say your first impression seems more serious than you really are. Experience gathered year by year turns that seriousness into a dependable presence. On days when you find yourself pushing yourself hard, try writing down what you've done so far, one line at a time.

rows.ko: 내 것과 자기가치를 천천히, 단단하게 쌓아 가는 자리예요.
rows.en: You build your resources and self-worth slowly but surely.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you build your possessions and sense of worth slowly and solidly.

rows.ko: 돈이나 내 능력의 값어치를 따질 때 신중하고, 넉넉하다는 느낌이 늦게 찾아오는 편입니다. 대신 하나씩 모은 것은 쉽게 흔들리지 않는 바탕이 되어 줘요. 스스로를 낮게 매기고 있다는 생각이 들면 내가 해낸 일의 목록부터 다시 살펴보세요.
rows.en: You're careful about money and about what your skills are worth, and the feeling of having enough arrives late. In return, what you gather bit by bit becomes a foundation that doesn't shake easily. If you catch yourself selling yourself short, look back over everything you've accomplished.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be careful when weighing money or the value of your abilities, and a sense of having enough may come later for you. In return, what you gather piece by piece becomes a foundation that doesn't shake easily. If you sense you're underrating yourself, it can help to start by looking back over the things you've accomplished.

rows.ko: 생각을 다듬어 정확하게 전하는 힘이 자라는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your gift for shaping your thoughts and saying exactly what you mean keeps growing.
rows.en_before_tone: Your ability to refine your thoughts and express them precisely keeps growing.

rows.ko: 말하기 전에 여러 번 고르고, 배울 때도 기초부터 차근차근 밟아야 마음이 놓이는 편이에요. 시간이 걸리는 만큼 한 번 익힌 것은 오래 남고 설명도 깊어집니다. 말이 늦다고 조급해질 때는 생각을 먼저 글로 적어 보세요.
rows.en: You weigh your words carefully before speaking, and you only feel settled once you've mastered the basics step by step. It takes time, but what you learn sticks, and your explanations gain real depth. When the words come slowly and you feel impatient, write your thoughts down first.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to choose your words several times before speaking, and when learning, you feel at ease only after working through the basics step by step. It takes time, but what you learn stays with you, and your explanations grow deeper. When you feel impatient about being slow to speak, try writing your thoughts down first.

rows.ko: 마음의 뿌리를 스스로 다져 가며 단단해지는 자리예요.
rows.en: You grow strong by laying down your own roots.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement makes you stronger as you build up the roots of your heart yourself.

rows.ko: 집과 가족의 일을 진지하게 여기고, 편히 기대기보다 먼저 책임을 떠올리는 편입니다. 그렇게 다진 생활의 바탕이 시간이 갈수록 나만의 든든한 안식처가 되어 줘요. 집에서도 긴장이 풀리지 않는 날에는 오롯이 쉬는 시간을 따로 정해 두세요.
rows.en: You take home and family seriously, and responsibility comes to mind before relaxing does. The groundwork you lay becomes, over time, a safe haven all your own. On days you can't unwind even at home, set aside time that's purely for rest.
rows.en_before_tone: You take matters of home and family seriously, and you tend to think of responsibility before leaning back and relaxing. The foundation you build this way becomes, over time, a solid haven of your own. On days when you can't unwind even at home, it can help to set aside time purely for rest.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것을 오래 다듬어 실력으로 만드는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You polish what you love over time until it becomes real skill.
rows.en_before_tone: You refine what you love over time and turn it into real skill.

rows.ko: 마음껏 즐기거나 감정을 드러내는 일에 조심스러워, 처음에는 재미보다 긴장이 앞서기 쉬워요. 그래도 한 번 고른 취미나 창작은 꾸준히 다듬어 깊이 있는 결과로 남기는 편입니다. 잘해야 한다는 생각이 들 때는 결과를 따지지 않고 즐기는 시간을 일부러 만들어 보세요.
rows.en: Letting loose or showing your feelings doesn't come easily, so at first nerves get ahead of fun. Once you choose a hobby or creative outlet, though, you stick with it and refine it into something with real depth. When you feel pressure to be good at it, make time on purpose to enjoy it without judging the results.
rows.en_before_tone: You're careful about enjoying yourself freely or showing your feelings, so nerves can come before fun at first. Still, once you choose a hobby or creative pursuit, you tend to refine it steadily into something with real depth. When you feel you have to be good at it, you might deliberately make time to enjoy it without judging the results.

rows.ko: 매일의 루틴을 성실하게 쌓아 믿음을 얻는 자리입니다.
rows.en: Steady daily effort earns you people's trust.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you earn trust as you build daily routines faithfully.

rows.ko: 맡은 일을 꼼꼼히 해내려는 마음이 커서 일상의 무게를 일찍부터 느끼기 쉬워요. 시간이 지나며 다듬은 일하는 방식과 생활 리듬이 쉽게 흉내 낼 수 없는 강점이 됩니다. 피로가 쌓이는 날에는 해야 할 일보다 쉬는 시간을 먼저 일정에 넣어 보세요.
rows.en: You want to do every task thoroughly, so you feel the weight of everyday responsibilities early in life. Over time, the work habits and rhythms you've honed become strengths few can match. On days you're running on empty, schedule your rest before your to-do list.
rows.en_before_tone: Your strong wish to do your tasks thoroughly can make you feel the weight of daily life early on. Over time, the work habits and life rhythm you've refined become strengths that are hard to imitate. On days when fatigue builds up, try putting rest into your schedule before your to-dos.

rows.ko: 관계를 천천히 깊고 믿음직하게 쌓아 가는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Slowly but surely, you build relationships that are deep and dependable.
rows.en_before_tone: You build relationships slowly into something deep and dependable.

rows.ko: 가까운 일대일 관계에서 서로의 약속과 책임을 진지하게 여기고, 마음을 여는 데 시간이 걸리는 편이에요. 그렇게 확인하며 쌓은 관계는 오래 버티는 신뢰로 남기 쉽습니다. 혼자 모든 몫을 지려 할 때는 바라는 것을 상대에게 한 문장으로 말해 보세요.
rows.en: In close one-on-one relationships, you take promises and responsibilities seriously, and you take your time to open up. Bonds built this way, one careful step at a time, become lasting trust. When you find yourself carrying the whole load alone, tell the other person what you need in a single sentence.
rows.en_before_tone: In close one-on-one relationships, you take promises and responsibilities seriously, and opening up tends to take time. Relationships built this way, step by step, often turn into lasting trust. When you find yourself trying to carry everything alone, try telling the other person what you need in a single sentence.

rows.ko: 깊은 신뢰를 시간을 들여 단단히 만드는 자리예요.
rows.en: You take your time building deep trust that holds firm.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you take time to build deep trust that holds firm.

rows.ko: 속마음이나 함께 쓰는 자원을 쉽게 내맡기지 않고, 믿을 만한지 오래 지켜보는 편입니다. 조심스러운 만큼 한 번 맺은 깊은 유대는 쉽게 흔들리지 않는 힘이 되어 줘요. 혼자 감당하기 버거운 일이 있다면 믿는 사람 한 명에게 조금씩 나눠 보세요.
rows.en: You don't hand over your inner feelings or shared resources lightly; you watch a long time before deciding someone is trustworthy. Because you're so careful, the deep bonds you do form are rock solid. If something feels too heavy to carry alone, share it, bit by bit, with one person you trust.
rows.en_before_tone: You don't hand over your inner feelings or shared resources easily, and you tend to watch for a long time to see whether someone is trustworthy. Because you're so careful, the deep bonds you do form become a strength that doesn't waver easily. If something feels too heavy to carry alone, try sharing it bit by bit with one person you trust.

rows.ko: 나만의 신념을 오래 다져 깊은 기준으로 만드는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Over the years, your beliefs deepen into a personal code you live by.
rows.en_before_tone: You build your own beliefs over time into deep personal standards.

rows.ko: 큰 생각이나 먼 길 앞에서 신중해져, 배움과 여행을 오래 준비하는 편이에요. 대신 직접 확인하며 세운 신념은 쉽게 흔들리지 않는 나침반이 되어 줍니다. 완벽한 때를 기다리고 있다면 가까운 곳으로 떠나는 짧은 여행이나 하루짜리 수업부터 시작해 보세요.
rows.en: Big ideas and long journeys make you cautious, so you spend a long time preparing for study or travel. In return, the beliefs you've tested for yourself become a compass that keeps you steady. Stop waiting for the perfect moment: start small with a short trip nearby or a one-day class.
rows.en_before_tone: You become careful when facing big ideas or long journeys, so you tend to prepare for learning and travel for a long time. In return, beliefs you've checked for yourself become a compass that doesn't sway easily. If you're waiting for the perfect moment, you might start with a short trip somewhere nearby or a one-day class.

rows.ko: 일과 사회적 역할을 시간과 함께 단단히 쌓아 가는 자리예요.
rows.en: You build your career and reputation brick by brick over time.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you build your work and social role solidly over time.

rows.ko: 책임 있는 역할을 일찍 맡거나 스스로 높은 기준을 세워 일의 무게를 크게 느끼기 쉬워요. 쌓아 온 시간이 실력과 신뢰로 굳어 갈수록 인정도 천천히 따라오는 편입니다. 성과가 더디게 느껴질 때는 지난해의 나와 오늘의 나를 나란히 놓고 견주어 보세요.
rows.en: Taking on responsibility early or holding yourself to high standards makes work feel especially heavy. As years of effort harden into skill and trust, recognition follows, slowly but surely. When progress feels slow, set last year's you beside today's you and compare.
rows.en_before_tone: Taking on responsible roles early or setting high standards for yourself can make the weight of work feel heavy. As the time you've put in hardens into skill and trust, recognition tends to follow, slowly. When progress feels slow, it can help to set last year's you side by side with today's you.

rows.ko: 적지만 깊은 관계 속에서 미래를 단단히 그리는 사람입니다.
rows.en: With a few close friends, you map out your future with care.
rows.en_before_tone: You picture your future steadily within a few deep relationships.

rows.ko: 무리에 쉽게 섞이기보다 한 사람씩 천천히 알아 가는 편이라 북적이는 자리가 어색할 때도 있어요. 시간이 지날수록 오래 함께할 사람들과 현실적인 목표가 곁에 남습니다. 모임이 부담스러운 날에는 마음 편한 한 사람과의 약속부터 잡아 보세요.
rows.en: You'd rather get to know people one at a time than blend into a crowd, so busy gatherings can feel awkward. Over time, you gather people who stay for the long haul and goals you can actually reach. On days groups feel like too much, start by making plans with one person you're comfortable with.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to get to know people one at a time rather than blending into a crowd, so busy gatherings can sometimes feel awkward. Over time, the people who'll stay with you for the long haul and realistic goals remain by your side. On days when groups feel like too much, you might start by making plans with just one person you're comfortable with.

rows.ko: 보이지 않는 곳에서 마음을 정리하는 힘이 자라는 자리예요.
rows.en: Out of sight, your ability to work through your feelings keeps growing.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement grows your ability to sort through your heart out of sight.

rows.ko: 혼자 있는 시간에 걱정이 커지거나 쉬면서도 마음 한쪽이 무거운 날이 있을 수 있어요. 그 시간을 꾸준히 정리해 온 경험이 쉽게 무너지지 않는 내면의 힘으로 쌓입니다. 생각이 꼬리를 물 때는 머릿속 일을 종이에 적어 밖으로 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: Some days, worries grow louder in your time alone, or part of you feels heavy even while you rest. Working through those moments, again and again, builds an inner strength that doesn't crumble. When your thoughts start spiraling, get what's in your head down on paper.
rows.en_before_tone: There may be days when worries grow during time alone, or a corner of your heart feels heavy even while you rest. The experience of steadily working through those times builds an inner strength that doesn't crumble easily. When one thought keeps leading to another, it can help to write what's in your head on paper and get it out.

rows.ko: 나만의 방식으로 나를 드러내는 독특한 분위기가 있어요.
rows.en: You have a one-of-a-kind air, and you show it your own way.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a distinctive air, and you show yourself in your own way.

rows.ko: 유행을 따르기보다 내 마음에 드는 모습을 고르고, 그 모습이 시기마다 크게 바뀌기도 하는 편입니다. 틀에 갇히면 답답함이 쉽게 쌓이지만, 그만큼 새로운 자리에 빨리 적응하는 힘이 있어요. 마음이 들썩일 때는 겉모습을 한 가지 바꿔 보는 정도로 변화를 시험해 보세요.
rows.en: You choose a look you love over whatever's trending, and your style can change dramatically from one phase to the next. Feeling boxed in frustrates you fast, but you also adapt quickly to new situations. When restlessness hits, test the waters by changing just one thing about your look.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to choose a look you like rather than following trends, and that look may change a lot from one period to the next. Frustration builds quickly when you're boxed in, but you also adapt quickly to new places. When you feel restless, try testing change by switching up just one thing about your appearance.

rows.ko: 돈과 내 가치를 남다른 방식으로 다루는 자리예요.
rows.en: You handle money and self-worth in your own unconventional way.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you handle money and your sense of worth in your own unusual way.

rows.ko: 정해진 길보다 내 재주를 독특하게 쓰는 방법에서 자기가치를 느끼는 편이에요. 들어오고 나가는 흐름이 들쭉날쭉하게 느껴질 때도 있지만, 그 덕분에 새로운 쓰임새를 빨리 알아봅니다. 흐름이 자주 바뀐다면 기본 생활에 쓸 몫은 따로 떼어 두세요.
rows.en: You feel your worth most when you find unusual ways to use your talents instead of following a set path. Your income and spending run up and down at times, but that rhythm also helps you spot new opportunities quickly. If the flow shifts often, set aside a separate amount for basic living costs.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel your worth in finding unique ways to use your talents rather than following a set path. Money coming in and going out may sometimes feel uneven, but that helps you spot new uses quickly. If the flow changes often, it can help to set aside a separate share for basic living costs.

rows.ko: 생각이 번뜩이고 말이 신선하게 튀어나오는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your mind sparks with ideas, and fresh thoughts pop right out.
rows.en_before_tone: Your mind sparks, and fresh words pop out of you.

rows.ko: 남들이 지나치는 지점에서 엉뚱하지만 쓸모 있는 아이디어를 떠올리는 편이에요. 배우는 방식도 정해진 순서보다 호기심이 이끄는 대로 갈 때 더 잘 흡수됩니다. 생각이 너무 빨라 말이 앞설 때는 한 박자 쉬고 상대의 반응을 살펴보세요.
rows.en: You come up with offbeat but useful ideas in places others overlook. You learn best when you follow your curiosity instead of a fixed order. When your mind races so fast your mouth gets ahead of you, take a beat and read the other person's reaction.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to come up with quirky but useful ideas at points others pass by. You also absorb things better when you learn by following your curiosity rather than a set order. When your thoughts move so fast your words run ahead, it can help to take a beat and notice how the other person is reacting.

rows.ko: 집과 마음의 뿌리에 자유로운 공기가 필요한 자리예요.
rows.en: At home, you need room to breathe and be free.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you need fresh, free air at home and in the roots of your heart.

rows.ko: 한곳에 오래 머물기보다 생활 공간이나 집안 분위기를 자주 바꾸고 싶어지는 편이에요. 익숙한 틀이 흔들리는 순간도 있지만, 그때마다 나에게 맞는 쉼의 모양을 새로 찾아냅니다. 집이 답답하게 느껴질 때는 가구 배치나 작은 물건 하나를 바꿔 공기를 환기해 보세요.
rows.en: Rather than staying put for long, you want to change your living space or the feel of your home often. Familiar patterns get shaken up at times, but each time you discover a new way to rest that suits you. When home feels stuffy, freshen the air by rearranging the furniture or swapping out one small item.
rows.en_before_tone: Rather than staying in one place for long, you tend to want to change your living space or the feel of your home often. There may be moments when familiar patterns get shaken, but each time you find a new shape of rest that suits you. When home feels stuffy, try freshening the air by rearranging furniture or changing one small item.

rows.ko: 남다른 방식으로 즐기고 표현하는 창작가 기질이 있어요.
rows.en: You have a creative streak that plays and expresses itself like no one else.
rows.en_before_tone: You have a creator's spirit that enjoys and expresses things in its own unique way.

rows.ko: 취미나 연애, 창작에서 뻔한 방식보다 새롭고 낯선 것에 마음이 끌리는 편입니다. 갑자기 빠져든 관심사가 뜻밖의 재능을 깨워 주기도 해요. 흥미가 빨리 바뀌어 아쉬움이 남는다면 끝낸 것보다 시도한 것의 목록을 남겨 보세요.
rows.en: In hobbies, romance, and creative work, the new and unexpected pull you in more than the predictable. A sudden new obsession can awaken a talent you never knew you had. If your interests shift so fast you're left with regrets, keep a list of what you've tried rather than what you've finished.
rows.en_before_tone: In hobbies, romance, and creative work, your heart tends to be drawn to the new and unfamiliar rather than the predictable.
