An interest you suddenly fall into may even awaken an unexpected talent. If your interests change so fast that you're left with regrets, try keeping a list of what you've tried rather than what you've finished.

rows.ko: 나만의 리듬으로 일할 때 힘이 나는 자리입니다.
rows.en: You do your best work when you set your own rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement gives you energy when you work at your own rhythm.

rows.ko: 똑같은 일과가 반복되면 금방 지루해지고, 일하는 방식을 스스로 바꿔 볼 때 집중이 살아나는 편이에요. 새로운 도구나 효율적인 방법을 먼저 찾아내는 재주도 있습니다. 루틴이 자주 흐트러진다면 꼭 지킬 기본 습관 한두 가지만 정해 두세요.
rows.en: The same routine day after day bores you quickly; your focus comes alive when you reinvent how you work. You're often the first to discover new tools or smarter ways of doing things. If your routine keeps falling apart, choose one or two basic habits to keep no matter what.
rows.en_before_tone: When the same routine repeats, you get bored quickly, and your focus tends to come alive when you change how you work yourself. You also have a knack for being the first to find new tools or more efficient methods. If your routine often falls apart, it can help to pick just one or two basic habits to keep no matter what.

rows.ko: 서로의 자유를 존중하는 관계에서 편안해지는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're happiest in relationships where both people have room to be themselves.
rows.en_before_tone: You feel at ease in relationships that respect each other's freedom.

rows.ko: 가까운 일대일 관계에서도 각자의 공간이 있어야 숨이 트이고, 개성 있는 사람에게 마음이 끌리는 편입니다. 관계의 모양이 예상과 다르게 바뀌는 순간이 와도 그때 나에게 맞는 거리를 새로 배우기 쉬워요. 가까워질수록 답답해진다면 혼자만의 시간이 필요하다는 것을 미리 말로 나눠 보세요.
rows.en: Even in close one-on-one relationships, you need your own space to breathe, and people with a strong sense of self catch your eye. When a relationship changes shape in ways you didn't expect, you learn a new kind of closeness that fits you. If getting closer starts to feel stifling, tell the other person early that you need time to yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: Even in close one-on-one relationships, you need your own space to breathe, and you tend to be drawn to people with strong individuality. Even when a relationship changes shape unexpectedly, it's often a chance to learn a new distance that suits you. If you feel stifled as you grow closer, it can help to share early that you need time to yourself.

rows.ko: 깊은 변화가 뜻밖의 순간에 찾아와 나를 새롭게 하는 자리예요.
rows.en: Deep change tends to arrive out of the blue, and it renews you.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement brings deep change at unexpected moments, the kind of change that renews you.

rows.ko: 깊은 유대나 함께 쓰는 자원에서 예상하지 못한 전환을 겪으며 생각이 확 바뀌는 경험을 하기 쉬워요. 그 흔들림이 오히려 낡은 틀을 벗고 새로운 시각을 얻는 계기가 되기도 합니다. 공동의 돈이나 약속은 변화가 생겨도 당황하지 않도록 기본 기록을 남겨 두세요.
rows.en: Unexpected turns in deep bonds or shared resources change your thinking in a flash. That shake-up becomes your chance to shed old patterns and see things in a new light. For shared money or commitments, keep basic records so change never catches you off guard.
rows.en_before_tone: You may go through unexpected turns in deep bonds or shared resources that change your thinking in a flash. That shake-up can actually become a chance to shed old patterns and gain a new perspective. For shared money or commitments, keeping basic records can help you not be caught off guard if things change.

rows.ko: 남다른 생각과 새로운 세계에 끌리는 자유로운 사람이에요.
rows.en: You're a free spirit drawn to unconventional ideas and new worlds.
rows.en_before_tone: You're a free spirit drawn to unusual ideas and new worlds.

rows.ko: 정해진 답보다 스스로 찾은 관점을 믿고, 낯선 문화나 새로운 학문에 금세 빠져드는 편입니다. 여행이나 배움에서 계획에 없던 길이 더 큰 깨달음을 주기도 해요. 생각이 너무 멀리 날아갈 때는 주변 사람에게 말로 풀어 보며 현실에 맞춰 보세요.
rows.en: You trust the perspectives you've found yourself over ready-made answers, and you fall fast for unfamiliar cultures or new fields of study. On a trip or in a class, an unplanned detour leads to the biggest eye-openers. When your ideas drift too far off, talk them through with people around you to bring them back down to earth.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to trust perspectives you've found yourself over set answers, and you quickly fall for unfamiliar cultures or new fields of study. In travel or learning, an unplanned path may bring a bigger realization. When your thoughts fly too far, talking them through with people around you can help bring them back down to earth.

rows.ko: 일과 커리어에서 남다른 길을 만들어 가는 자리입니다.
rows.en: In your career, you blaze a trail of your own.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you carve out an unusual path in your work and career.

rows.ko: 정해진 경로보다 내 방식대로 일할 수 있는 자리에서 힘을 내는 편이에요. 진로가 뜻밖에 방향을 트는 순간도 있지만, 그 변화가 나만의 역할을 찾아 주는 계기가 되기 쉽습니다. 새 길이 끌릴 때는 지금 하는 일과 함께 작게 시험해 보는 단계를 거쳐 보세요.
rows.en: You thrive in roles where you can work your own way rather than follow a set track. Your career takes unexpected turns, and those changes lead you to a role that's truly yours. When a new path calls, test it in a small way alongside your current work first.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to find your energy in roles where you can work your own way rather than follow a set track. Your career may take an unexpected turn at times, but that change often helps you find a role that's truly yours. When a new path calls to you, try testing it in a small way alongside your current work first.

rows.ko: 생각이 통하는 사람들과 새로운 미래를 꿈꾸는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You dream up new futures with people who are on your wavelength.
rows.en_before_tone: You dream of a new future with people who think like you.

rows.ko: 나이나 배경이 다른 사람들과도 쉽게 어울리고, 독특한 모임에서 마음이 맞는 친구를 만나는 편입니다. 함께 그리는 목표가 시대를 앞서가는 아이디어로 이어지기도 해요. 관계가 자주 바뀌어 허전할 때는 오래 알고 지낸 한 사람에게 먼저 안부를 건네 보세요.
rows.en: You get along easily with people of every age and background, and you find kindred spirits in unusual groups. The goals you dream up together can grow into ideas ahead of their time. When your circle keeps shifting and you feel a little empty, reach out first to someone you've known for years.
rows.en_before_tone: You get along easily with people of different ages and backgrounds, and you tend to meet kindred friends in unusual groups. Goals you envision together may even lead to ideas ahead of their time. When relationships change often and you feel a little empty, you might reach out first to someone you've known for a long time.

rows.ko: 혼자 있을 때 번뜩이는 직관이 찾아오는 자리예요.
rows.en: Flashes of intuition come to you in moments alone.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement brings flashes of intuition when you're alone.

rows.ko: 조용히 쉬거나 잠들기 직전에 문득 해답이 떠오르는 경험을 하기 쉬워요. 겉으로 드러내지 않는 내면의 자유로움이 생각보다 큰 버팀목이 되어 줍니다. 마음이 들뜨고 잠이 얕아지는 시기에는 하루를 정리하는 짧은 기록으로 생각을 내려놓아 보세요.
rows.en: Answers arrive out of nowhere while you're resting or drifting off to sleep. The inner freedom you keep to yourself supports you more than you realize. When your mind is buzzing and your sleep runs light, jot down a few lines at day's end and set your thoughts aside.
rows.en_before_tone: You may find answers suddenly come to you while resting quietly or just before falling asleep. A sense of inner freedom you don't show outwardly becomes a bigger support than you'd think. During times when your mind is restless and your sleep is light, try setting your thoughts down with a short note that wraps up the day.

rows.ko: 부드럽고 신비로운 분위기로 사람을 끌어당기는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Your soft, mysterious air draws people in.
rows.en_before_tone: You draw people in with a soft, mysterious air.

rows.ko: 상대에 따라 다르게 비치는 첫인상 덕분에 다가가기 편한 사람으로 느껴지는 편입니다. 주변 분위기를 잘 흡수하는 만큼 내 마음과 남의 마음이 섞여 헷갈리는 날도 있어요. 그럴 때는 '지금 이 기분은 누구의 것일까' 하고 스스로 물어보세요.
rows.en: You come across a little differently to each person, which makes you easy to approach. You soak up the mood around you so well that, some days, your feelings and other people's get tangled. When that happens, ask yourself, 'Whose feeling is this, really?'
rows.en_before_tone: Your first impression seems to shift depending on who's looking, so people tend to find you easy to approach. Because you absorb the mood around you so well, there may be days when your feelings and others' get mixed up. At those times, it can help to ask yourself, 'Whose feeling is this, really?'

rows.ko: 돈과 내 것 앞에서 이상과 현실을 함께 챙기면 좋은 자리예요.
rows.en: With money and possessions, you thrive when you honor both your ideals and reality.
rows.en_before_tone: In this placement, it helps to balance ideals and reality when it comes to money and possessions.

rows.ko: 의미 있는 일이나 아름다운 것에 마음이 끌려 계산보다 감성이 먼저 움직이는 편이에요. 그 감각은 창작이나 돕는 일에서 나만의 가치를 만들어 주는 재능이기도 합니다. 돈의 흐름이 흐릿하게 느껴진다면 달마다 한 번 수입과 지출을 적어 보는 시간을 정해 두세요.
rows.en: Meaningful work and beautiful things draw you in, so feeling leads before the numbers do. That sensitivity is also a gift: it lets you create your own kind of value through creative or helping work. If your finances feel fuzzy, set a monthly date to write down what came in and what went out.
rows.en_before_tone: Your heart is drawn to meaningful work and beautiful things, so feelings tend to move before calculation. That sense is also a talent that creates your own kind of value in creative work or helping others. If your money flow feels fuzzy, it can help to set a time once a month to write down what came in and what went out.

rows.ko: 말과 생각에 상상력이 풍부하게 묻어나는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Imagination colors everything you think and say.
rows.en_before_tone: Your words and thoughts are full of imagination.

rows.ko: 이야기나 글, 그림처럼 느낌을 전하는 표현에서 남다른 재능을 보이는 편이에요. 다만 들은 말을 내 식으로 해석해 오해가 생기기도 쉽습니다. 중요한 약속이나 정보는 마지막에 한 번 더 확인하는 습관을 들여 보세요.
rows.en: You have a rare gift for expressing feelings through stories, writing, or art. You also tend to read your own meaning into what people say, which leads to mix-ups. Make it a habit to double-check important plans and details before you wrap up.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to show a special talent for expressions that convey feeling, like stories, writing, or drawing. That said, interpreting what you hear in your own way can easily lead to misunderstandings. It can help to make a habit of double-checking important plans or information at the end.

rows.ko: 집과 마음의 뿌리에서 꿈과 위로를 찾는 자리예요.
rows.en: At home, you find your dreams and your comfort.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you find dreams and comfort in home and the roots of your heart.

rows.ko: 집을 단순한 공간이라기보다 마음이 쉬는 피난처처럼 여기며, 따뜻한 분위기를 꿈꾸는 편이에요. 집에 대한 그림이 이상에 가까워 현실과의 차이를 느끼는 날도 있습니다. 그럴 때는 내가 바라는 쉼의 모습을 작게라도 지금의 공간에 하나씩 옮겨 보세요.
rows.en: To you, home is more than a place to live; it's a sanctuary where you can rest, and you dream of filling it with warmth. Because your picture of home is so idealized, some days the gap with reality stings. When it does, bring the rest you long for into your current space, one small piece at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to see home not just as a space but as a refuge where your heart rests, and you dream of a warm atmosphere. Because your picture of home is close to an ideal, some days you may feel the gap with reality. At those times, try bringing the kind of rest you long for into your current space, one small piece at a time.

rows.ko: 즐거움과 창작에서 꿈같은 상상력이 피어나는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Dreamy imagination fills your play and creativity.
rows.en_before_tone: Dreamlike imagination blossoms in your joys and creativity.

rows.ko: 음악, 그림, 이야기처럼 감성을 건드리는 일에 깊이 빠져들고, 사랑에도 낭만을 크게 기대하는 편입니다. 그 상상력이 작품이나 놀이로 흘러갈 때 가장 빛나요. 설렘이 커질수록 상대와 상황을 있는 그대로 바라보는 시간도 함께 가져 보세요.
rows.en: You lose yourself in what stirs your emotions, like music, art, and stories, and you long for true romance in love. Your imagination shines brightest when it flows into creative work or play. As the thrill grows, take time to see the person and the situation as they really are.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to get deeply absorbed in things that touch your feelings, like music, art, and stories, and you hope for a lot of romance in love. Your imagination shines brightest when it flows into creative work or play. As the excitement grows, it helps to also take time to see the person and situation as they really are.

rows.ko: 일과 쉼의 경계를 분명히 세울수록 편안해지는 자리입니다.
rows.en: The clearer the line between work and rest, the more at ease you feel.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you feel more at ease the more clearly you separate work and rest.

rows.ko: 남을 돕는 일이나 의미를 느끼는 일에는 아낌없이 마음을 쏟는 편입니다. 그만큼 일과 쉼의 경계가 흐려져 피로를 늦게 알아차리기 쉬워요. 하루의 시작과 끝에 같은 작은 의식을 두면 리듬을 지키는 데 도움이 돼요.
rows.en: You give yourself fully to work that helps others or feels meaningful. That same devotion blurs the line between work and rest, so you notice your tiredness late. Bookend each day with the same small ritual, and you keep your rhythm.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to pour your heart into work that helps others or feels meaningful. Because of that, the line between work and rest can blur, and you may notice fatigue late. Keeping the same small ritual at the start and end of each day helps protect your rhythm.

rows.ko: 관계에서 깊은 공감과 이상을 품는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You bring deep empathy and high ideals to your relationships.
rows.en_before_tone: You hold deep empathy and ideals in your relationships.

rows.ko: 가까운 일대일 관계에서 상대의 마음을 잘 헤아리고, 서로를 깊이 이해하는 연결을 바라는 편이에요. 그 공감이 너무 깊어지면 상대의 좋은 모습만 보거나 내 몫을 놓치기도 합니다. 함께하는 사이일수록 내가 원하는 것과 어려운 것을 말로 나눠 보세요.
rows.en: In close one-on-one relationships, you tune in to how the other person feels, and you long for a bond of true mutual understanding. When that empathy runs too deep, you see only their good side or lose track of your own needs. The closer you are, the more you need to say out loud what you want and what you find hard.
rows.en_before_tone: In close one-on-one relationships, you understand the other person's heart well and tend to long for a connection where you understand each other deeply. When that empathy gets too deep, you may see only their good side or lose sight of your own share. The closer you are, the more it helps to talk about what you want and what's hard for you.

rows.ko: 깊은 유대 속에서 마음의 경계를 살피면 좋은 자리예요.
rows.en: In your deepest bonds, keep a gentle eye on your boundaries.
rows.en_before_tone: In this placement, it helps to watch your emotional boundaries within deep bonds.

rows.ko: 누군가와 깊이 연결될 때 하나로 녹아드는 듯한 느낌을 소중히 여기는 편입니다. 그만큼 함께 쓰는 돈이나 감정의 몫이 어디까지인지 흐려지기 쉬워요. 가까운 사이일수록 서로의 몫을 분명히 적어 두면 그 연결이 더 편안해져요.
rows.en: When you connect deeply with someone, you cherish the feeling of merging into one. That same longing blurs where shared money and emotional responsibilities begin and end. In your closest relationships, write down who handles what; the connection feels easier for it.
rows.en_before_tone: When you connect deeply with someone, you tend to treasure the feeling of melting into one. Because of that, it's easy for the lines around shared money or emotional responsibilities to blur. The closer the relationship, the more comfortable that connection becomes when you clearly write down each person's share.

rows.ko: 넓은 배움과 신념에서 영감을 찾는 이상가예요.
rows.en: You're an idealist who finds inspiration in big ideas and deep beliefs.
rows.en_before_tone: You're an idealist who finds inspiration in wide learning and beliefs.

rows.ko: 철학이나 영성, 먼 나라의 이야기처럼 눈에 보이지 않는 세계에 끌리고 마음이 넓어지는 편이에요. 큰 이상을 품는 힘이 삶에 깊은 의미를 더해 줍니다. 새로운 믿음이나 가르침에 끌릴 때는 직접 확인할 수 있는 근거도 함께 살펴보세요.
rows.en: The unseen calls to you, from philosophy and spirituality to tales of faraway lands, and it broadens your outlook. Your capacity for big ideals brings meaningful insights to your life. When a new belief or teaching pulls you in, look for evidence you can check for yourself as well.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to be drawn to unseen worlds, like philosophy, spirituality, or stories from faraway lands, and your heart grows wider through them. Your ability to hold big ideals adds deep meaning to your life. When you're drawn to a new belief or teaching, it helps to also look at evidence you can check for yourself.

rows.ko: 일과 사회적 역할에서 꿈과 감성을 펼치는 자리입니다.
rows.en: In your work and public life, your dreams and sensitivity shine.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement lets you bring your dreams and sensitivity into your work and social role.

rows.ko: 예술이나 돕는 일처럼 의미와 감성이 담긴 일에서 나다움을 느끼는 편이에요. 다만 원하는 방향이 흐릿해 진로를 오래 고민하거나 남의 기대에 맞추려 할 때도 있습니다. 막연할 때는 하고 싶은 일의 장면을 구체적으로 적고 그중 하나를 작게 시험해 보세요.
rows.en: You feel most like yourself in work rich with meaning and feeling, like art or helping others. When your direction feels hazy, though, you can spend a long time agonizing over your path or bending to other people's expectations. When things feel vague, write out specific scenes of the work you'd love, then test one in a small way.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to feel most like yourself in work filled with meaning and feeling, like art or helping others. Still, when your desired direction feels hazy, you may spend a long time pondering your path or try to fit others' expectations. When things feel vague, you might write down specific scenes of what you'd like to do and test one of them in a small way.

rows.ko: 사람들과 함께 따뜻한 꿈을 그리는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Together with others, you dream warm, hopeful dreams.
rows.en_before_tone: You dream warm dreams together with others.

rows.ko: 공동체나 모임에서 모두가 함께 잘되는 미래를 꿈꾸고, 남을 돕는 일에 마음이 움직이는 편이에요. 사람을 쉽게 믿는 만큼 기대와 다른 모습에 실망하는 날도 있습니다. 목표를 함께할 때는 각자의 역할과 약속을 미리 분명하게 정해 두세요.
rows.en: In communities and groups, you dream of a future where everyone thrives, and helping others moves you deeply. You trust people easily, so some days you feel let down when they don't live up to your hopes. When you share a goal, agree on roles and commitments clearly from the start.
rows.en_before_tone: In communities and groups, you dream of a future where everyone does well together, and your heart is moved by helping others. Because you trust people easily, there may be days you're disappointed when they turn out differently than you hoped. When sharing a goal, it helps to set each person's role and commitments clearly ahead of time.

rows.ko: 쉼과 내면에서 깊은 영감과 위로를 얻는 자리예요.
rows.en: Rest and your inner life are deep wells of inspiration and comfort.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you draw deep inspiration and comfort from rest and your inner life.

rows.ko: 혼자 조용히 음악을 듣거나 상상에 잠길 때 마음이 가장 잘 회복되는 편입니다. 주변의 감정을 스펀지처럼 흡수해 이유 없이 지치는 날도 있어요. 사람을 많이 만난 날에는 혼자 머무는 시간을 일부러 챙겨 마음을 비워 보세요.
rows.en: You recharge best alone, listening to music or lost in daydreams. You soak up the feelings around you like a sponge, so some days you feel drained for no clear reason. After a day full of people, make a point of spending time alone to clear your head.
rows.en_before_tone: You tend to recover best when quietly listening to music alone or drifting into your imagination. You soak up the feelings around you like a sponge, so some days you feel drained for no clear reason. On days you've seen a lot of people, it can help to make a point of spending time alone to clear your mind.

rows.ko: 겉은 조용해도 깊은 존재감과 힘을 지닌 사람이에요.
rows.en: You seem quiet, but you carry a deep, powerful presence.
rows.en_before_tone: You may seem quiet, but you have a deep presence and strength.

rows.ko: 말수가 많지 않아도 강한 인상을 남기고, 쉽게 속을 보이지 않는 편입니다. 삶의 고비마다 나를 새로 세우는 회복력이 이 자리의 큰 힘이에요. 너무 혼자 버티고 있다면 믿을 만한 사람에게 지금의 마음을 조금 털어놓아 보세요.
rows.en: Even without saying much, you leave a strong impression, and you rarely let people see inside. Your great strength is the resilience to rebuild yourself at every turning point. If you've been holding it all together alone for too long, open up a little to someone you trust.
rows.en_before_tone: Even without saying much, you leave a strong impression, and you tend not to show what's inside easily. The resilience to rebuild yourself at each of life's turning points is this placement's great strength. If you've been holding on too much by yourself, try opening up a little about how you feel to someone you trust.

rows.ko: 내 것과 자기가치를 깊이 다시 세우는 힘이 있는 자리예요.
rows.en: You have the power to rebuild your resources and self-worth from the ground up.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement has the power to deeply rebuild your possessions and sense of worth.

rows.ko: 돈이나 가진 것에 대한 감정이 강해, 지키려는 마음과 바꾸려는 마음 사이에서 크게 흔들리기도 해요. 그 과정을 지나며 내가 정말 가치 있게 여기는 것을 스스로 정하는 힘이 자랍니다. 마음이 조급해질 때는 지금 가진 것과 할 수 있는 것을 차분히 적어 보세요.
rows.en: Your feelings about money and possessions run strong, so you swing between wanting to hold on and wanting to change everything. Moving through that tension teaches you to decide for yourself what you truly value. When you feel pressured, calmly write down what you have now and what you can do.
rows.en_before_tone: Your feelings about money and what you own run strong, so you may swing between wanting to protect things and wanting to change them. Going through that process grows your ability to decide for yourself what you truly value. When you feel rushed, it can help to calmly write down what you have now and what you can do.

rows.ko: 말과 생각을 깊이 파고드는 집중력이 있는 사람입니다.
rows.en: Your mind has the focus to get to the bottom of things.
rows.en_before_tone: You have the focus to dig deep into words and ideas.

rows.ko: 궁금한 것이 생기면 끝까지 파고들고, 말 한마디에도 무게를 실어 전하는 편이에요. 그 깊이가 사람의 속마음을 꿰뚫는 통찰로 이어지기도 합니다. 대화가 날카로워진다고 느낄 때는 결론보다 질문으로 먼저 말을 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: When something sparks your curiosity, you keep digging until you understand it fully, and every word you say carries weight. That depth sharpens into insight into what people really feel. When a conversation turns sharp, open with a question instead of a conclusion.
rows.en_before_tone: When you're curious about something, you dig all the way in, and you tend to put weight behind every word you say. That depth can lead to insight that sees right into people's hearts. When a conversation feels like it's getting sharp, try opening with a question rather than a conclusion.

rows.ko: 마음의 뿌리에서 깊이 되살아나는 힘을 지닌 자리예요.
rows.en: Deep in your roots lies the power to come back stronger.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement holds the power to come back to life from the roots of your heart.

rows.ko: 집과 가족을 향한 감정이 깊고 진해서, 내 마음의 바탕을 진지하게 들여다볼 일이 생기기 쉬워요. 그렇게 뿌리를 살피는 과정에서 스스로 다시 일어서는 힘이 자라납니다. 마음이 무거운 날에는 나만의 쉼터가 될 공간을 작게라도 마련해 보세요.
rows.en: Your feelings about home and family run deep, so you often find yourself taking a hard look at your emotional foundations. As you explore those roots, your power to get back on your feet grows. On heavy days, set up a space, even a small one, to be your own refuge.
rows.en_before_tone: Your feelings toward home and family run deep and strong, so you may find reasons to look seriously at the foundation of your heart. In the process of exploring those roots, your strength to get back up on your own grows. On heavy-hearted days, try setting up even a small space that can be your own refuge.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것에 온 마음을 쏟는 강렬함이 있는 사람이에요.
rows.en: You love with an intensity that holds nothing back.
rows.en_before_tone: You have an intensity that pours your whole heart into what you love.

rows.ko: 취미든 창작이든 사랑이든 한 번 빠지면 깊고 진하게 몰입하는 편입니다. 그 몰입이 평범한 재미를 넘어 나를 바꾸는 작품이나 경험으로 남기도 해요. 마음이 한쪽으로 너무 쏠릴 때는 가볍게 즐길 수 있는 놀이 하나를 곁에 두어 보세요.
rows.en: Whether it's a hobby, a creative project, or a romance, once you're drawn in, you commit completely. That focus reaches beyond ordinary fun and leaves you with work or experiences that change you. When you get too absorbed in one thing, keep one light, easy pastime close at hand.
rows.en_before_tone: Whether it's a hobby, creative work, or love, once you fall for something, you tend to dive in deep. That absorption can go beyond ordinary fun and leave behind work or experiences that change you. When your heart leans too far one way, it can help to keep one light, easy pastime close by.

rows.ko: 일상과 루틴을 깊이 바꿔 가며 힘을 되찾는 자리입니다.
rows.en: You get your strength back by transforming your daily routines.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement helps you regain strength by deeply changing your daily life and routines.

rows.ko: 일을 할 때 철저하게 파고들어, 맡은 일의 판을 통째로 바꿔 놓는 힘을 보이는 편이에요. 그만큼 스스로를 몰아붙이다 지치기도 쉬워요. 생활 리듬을 한 번에 갈아엎기보다 하나씩 바꿔 가면 되찾은 힘이 오래 유지됩니다.
rows.en: You dig into your work so thoroughly that you can transform how a whole task gets done. That same intensity tempts you to push yourself until you burn out. Instead of overhauling your daily rhythm all at once, change one thing at a time so the strength you regain lasts.
rows.en_before_tone: When you work, you tend to dig in thoroughly and show the power to transform the whole setup of a task. Because of that, it's also easy to push yourself until you're worn out. Rather than overhauling your daily rhythm all at once, changing one thing at a time helps the strength you regain last.

rows.ko: 관계를 통해 깊이 변화하고 성장하는 사람이에요.
rows.en: In relationships, you transform and grow the most.
rows.en_before_tone: You change and grow deeply through your relationships.

rows.ko: 가까운 일대일 관계에서 진심을 다해 깊이 연결되기를 바라고, 상대와 큰 영향을 주고받는 편입니다. 그 강렬함 덕분에 관계를 지나며 나를 새롭게 알아 가기 쉬워요. 주도권을 두고 마음이 팽팽해질 때는 서로 바라는 것을 차분히 말로 정리해 보세요.
rows.en: In close one-on-one relationships, you want a deep, wholehearted connection, and you and your partner leave a powerful mark on each other. That intensity helps you discover new sides of yourself. When things grow tense over who's in control, calmly put into words what each of you wants.
rows.en_before_tone: In close one-on-one relationships, you long to connect deeply and wholeheartedly, and you tend to influence each other strongly. That intensity makes it easy to get to know yourself anew through your relationships. When things feel tense over who's in charge, it can help to calmly put into words what each of you wants.

rows.ko: 깊은 유대와 변화 속에서 되살아나는 힘이 큰 자리예요.
rows.en: Deep bonds and big changes awaken your remarkable power to renew yourself.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement holds great power to come back to life through deep bonds and change.

rows.ko: 깊은 관계나 함께 나누는 자원에서 진한 감정을 겪으며 나를 근본부터 돌아보기 쉬워요. 큰 변화를 지날 때마다 껍질을 벗듯 단단해지는 회복력이 이 자리의 강점입니다. 감정이 무겁게 고일 때는 믿는 사람이나 기록에 마음을 조금씩 흘려보내 보세요.
rows.en: Intense feelings in close relationships or around shared resources lead you to rethink yourself from the ground up. Like a snake shedding its skin, you come out of each big change tougher; that resilience is your strength. When heavy feelings pool inside, let them out little by little, to someone you trust or onto the page.
rows.en_before_tone: Going through intense feelings in deep relationships or shared resources can lead you to reflect on yourself from the ground up. The resilience to grow stronger with each big change, like shedding a shell, is this placement's strength. When feelings pool heavily, you might let them flow out little by little to someone you trust or into a journal.

rows.ko: 신념과 배움을 깊이 파고들어 삶을 바꾸는 사람이에요.
rows.en: Diving deep into beliefs and ideas, you transform your whole life.
rows.en_before_tone: You dig deep into beliefs and learning, and it changes your life.

rows.ko: 진실이 무엇인지 끝까지 알고 싶어 하고, 한 번 품은 생각에 깊이 몰입하는 편입니다. 배움이나 여행이 세상을 보는 눈을 통째로 바꿔 놓기도 해요. 내 믿음이 강해질수록 다른 생각을 가진 사람의 이야기에도 귀를 기울여 보세요.
rows.en: You want the truth of things, and once an idea takes hold, you're all in. Learning or travel can completely change how you see the world. As your beliefs grow stronger, make a point of truly listening to people who think differently.
rows.en_before_tone: You want to know the truth all the way down, and you tend to become deeply absorbed in ideas once you hold them. Learning or travel may completely change the way you see the world. The stronger your beliefs grow, the more it helps to listen to people who think differently.

rows.ko: 일과 사회적 역할에서 깊은 영향력을 키워 가는 자리입니다.
rows.en: Through your work and public role, you build real influence over time.
rows.en_before_tone: With this placement, you build deep influence through your work and social role.

rows.ko: 일에서 큰 책임과 영향력을 원하고, 목표를 정하면 깊이 집중해 밀고 나가는 편이에요. 진로가 크게 바뀌는 시기를 지나며 오히려 나다운 역할을 다시 찾기 쉽습니다. 일이 삶 전체를 차지한다고 느낄 때는 일 밖의 나를 채우는 시간을 따로 지켜 주세요.
rows.en: You want real responsibility and influence at work, and once you set a goal, you focus hard and push forward. Major career shifts help you rediscover the role that's truly yours. When work starts to take over your whole life, protect time for the parts of you that live outside it.
rows.en_before_tone: You want big responsibility and influence in your work, and once you set a goal, you tend to focus deeply and push forward. Going through times when your career shifts greatly can actually help you rediscover a role that's truly you. When work feels like it's taking over your whole life, it helps to protect time that fills up the you outside of work.

rows.ko: 사람들과 함께할 때 깊은 변화를 만드는 사람이에요.
rows.en: When you join forces with others, you spark deep change.
rows.en_before_tone: You create deep change when you're with others.

rows.ko: 모임이나 공동체에서 넓고 얕은 관계보다 진짜로 통하는 몇 사람과 깊게 연결되는 편입니다. 같이 그리는 목표가 나와 주변을 바꾸는 힘으로 이어지기도 해요. 관계에 마음을 너무 많이 쏟아 지칠 때는 내가 바라는 미래를 혼자 정리해 보세요.
rows.en: In groups and communities, you'd rather connect deeply with a few people you truly click with than keep lots of casual ties. The goals you dream up together become a force that transforms you and everyone around you. When you've poured so much into others that you're worn out, take time alone to get clear on the future you want.
rows.en_before_tone: In groups and communities, you tend to connect deeply with a few people you truly click with, rather than having many light relationships. Goals you picture together may become a force that changes you and those around you. When you've poured so much into relationships that you're worn out, it can help to take time on your own to sort out the future you want.

rows.ko: 보이지 않는 내면에 깊은 회복력이 깃든 자리예요.
rows.en: Deep in your inner world lies a powerful resilience.
rows.en_before_tone: This placement holds deep resilience in your unseen inner world.

rows.ko: 혼자 있는 시간에 깊은 감정이나 오래된 생각이 떠오르고, 그것을 조용히 마주하는 편입니다. 그렇게 내면을 정리하며 스스로를 다시 일으키는 힘이 자라요. 마음이 무겁게 가라앉을 때는 산책이나 기록처럼 감정을 밖으로 흘려보낼 길을 만들어 보세요.
rows.en: In time alone, deep feelings and old thoughts surface, and you face them quietly. Working through your inner world like this builds your power to pick yourself back up. When your mood sinks low, give your feelings a way out, like a walk or a journal.
rows.en_before_tone: During time alone, deep feelings or old thoughts tend to surface, and you face them quietly. Sorting through your inner world this way grows your strength to lift yourself back up. When your heart sinks heavily, it can help to make a way for feelings to flow out, like a walk or journaling.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 감정이 한 방향으로 겹쳐 있어요.
rows.en: Your core self and your emotions align and point the same way.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self and your feelings overlap, pointing the same way.

rows.ko: 원하는 것과 느끼는 것이 같은 쪽을 향해 있어 마음먹은 일에 힘이 잘 실립니다. 다만 한쪽으로 쏠리기 쉬우니 가끔 다른 관점을 들어 보면 균형을 잡기 좋아요.
rows.en: What you want and how you feel point in the same direction, so you throw your full weight behind whatever you set out to do. That focus can turn one-sided, so hear out other perspectives now and then to stay balanced.
rows.en_before_tone: What you want and what you feel point in the same direction, so you put real strength behind what you set your mind to. Still, it's easy to lean too far one way, so hearing other perspectives now and then helps you keep your balance.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 감정이 서로를 자연스럽게 도와요.
rows.en: Your sense of self and your emotions naturally back each other up.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self and your feelings naturally support each other.

rows.ko: 하고 싶은 일과 마음의 상태가 크게 어긋나지 않아 비교적 편안하게 나를 받아들일 수 있어요. 이 안정감을 바탕 삼아 새로운 도전을 하나씩 늘려 가기 좋습니다.
rows.en: What you want and how you feel rarely pull against each other, so you accept yourself with ease. Use that stability as your base and take on new challenges, one at a time.
rows.en_before_tone: What you want to do and how you feel rarely clash, so you can accept yourself with relative ease. With this stability as your base, it's a good base for adding new challenges one at a time.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 감정이 서로 다른 쪽을 바라봐요.
rows.en: Your sense of self and your emotions pull in different directions.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self and your feelings look in different directions.

rows.ko: 머리로 원하는 것과 마음이 편한 것이 달라 속으로 줄다리기를 하는 느낌이 들 수 있습니다. 두 마음을 모두 적어 보고 둘 다 조금씩 채우는 방법을 찾으면 그 긴장이 나를 넓히는 힘이 돼요.
rows.en: What your mind wants and what feels comfortable don't always match, and you feel an inner tug-of-war. Write down both wishes and find ways to honor each a little; that tension then becomes a force that helps you grow.
rows.en_before_tone: What your head wants and what your heart finds comfortable may differ, which can feel like an inner tug-of-war. If you write down both wishes and look for ways to meet each a little, that tension becomes a force that helps you grow.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 생각·말이 겹쳐 있어요.
rows.en: Your sense of self blends with how you think and speak.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self overlaps with your thoughts and words.

rows.ko: 생각과 말에 내 색깔이 또렷하게 묻어나서 의견을 분명히 전하는 편입니다. 내 말에 확신이 강할 때일수록 상대의 생각을 한 번 더 물어보면 대화가 부드러워져요.
rows.en: Your personality shines through how you think and talk, so you state your opinions plainly. When you feel especially sure of yourself, ask what the other person thinks, and the conversation flows smoothly.
rows.en_before_tone: Your own colors show clearly in your thoughts and words, so you tend to express your opinions plainly. Especially when you feel very sure of what you're saying, asking once more what the other person thinks makes the conversation flow more smoothly.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 좋아하는 것이 겹쳐 있어요.
rows.en: Your sense of self blends with what you love.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self overlaps with what you love.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것과 아름다움에 대한 감각이 나다움의 큰 부분을 차지합니다. 사람들에게 맞춰 주는 마음이 커질 때는 내가 정말 좋아하는 것도 함께 챙겨 보세요.
rows.en: Your tastes and your eye for beauty are a big part of who you are. When the urge to please others grows strong, make room for what you truly love as well.
rows.en_before_tone: What you love and your sense of beauty make up a big part of who you are. When your urge to accommodate others grows strong, it helps to look after what you truly love as well.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 의욕이 겹쳐 추진력이 강해요.
rows.en: Your sense of self and your drive merge, giving you serious momentum.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self overlaps with your drive, giving you strong momentum.

rows.ko: 마음먹으면 바로 움직이는 힘이 있어 무언가를 시작하는 데 강합니다. 에너지가 넘칠 때는 운동이나 몸을 쓰는 일로 풀어 주면 조급함이 덜해져요.
rows.en: Once your mind is made up, you're off, which makes you a natural at getting things started. When you have energy to burn, work it off through exercise or physical activity, and the restlessness eases.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you make up your mind, you have the energy to move right away, which makes you strong at starting things. When your energy is overflowing, releasing it through exercise or physical activity helps ease the restlessness.

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 의욕이 자연스럽게 손발을 맞춰요.
rows.en: Your sense of self and your drive work hand in hand.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self and your drive naturally work in step.

rows.ko: 원하는 것을 행동으로 옮기는 과정이 비교적 매끄러워요. 이 실행력을 오래 하고 싶은 일 하나에 꾸준히 쏟으면 눈에 보이는 결과로 쌓이기 좋습니다.
rows.en: You turn what you want into action with ease. Pour that follow-through steadily into one thing you want to keep doing, and it adds up to real, visible results.
rows.en_before_tone: Turning what you want into action tends to go fairly smoothly. If you pour this follow-through steadily into one thing you want to keep doing, it can build into visible results.

rows.en: Sun

rows.en_before_tone: Sun-Mars tension

rows.ko: 나의 중심과 의욕이 부딪치며 불꽃을 내요.
rows.en: Your sense of self and your drive butt heads, throwing off sparks.
rows.en_before_tone: Your core self and your drive clash and give off sparks.

rows.ko: 하고 싶은 마음이 앞서 조급해지거나 쉽게 날이 서는 순간이 있을 수 있습니다. 움직이기 전에 숨을 한 번 고르는 습관을 들이면 그 뜨거운 힘을 원하는 곳에 쓸 수 있어요.
rows.en: Eagerness sometimes makes you impatient or quick to snap. Make a habit of taking one breath before you act, and you aim that fiery energy exactly where you want it.
rows.en_before_tone: There may be moments when eagerness makes you impatient or quick to get edgy. If you make a habit of pausing for a breath before you act, you can put that fiery energy where you want it.

rows.ko: 말씨가 부드럽고 상대가 듣기 좋게 표현하는 감각이 있습니다. 좋은 말만 고르다 속마음을 놓치지 않도록 가끔은 솔직한 생각도 함께 꺼내 보세요.
rows.en: You speak gently and have a gift for saying things in a way people love to hear. Don't let your true feelings get lost in all those kind words; share your honest thoughts now and then, too.
rows.en_before_tone: Your way of speaking is gentle, and you have a knack for saying things in a way that's pleasant to hear. Now and then, it can help to share your honest thoughts too, so your true feelings don't get lost while you choose only nice words.

rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and what you love gently support each other.

rows.en_before_tone: You have a talent for recognizing beauty and expressing it in words or writing. A hobby that shows your sense of style, like writing or design, makes this strength shine even more.

rows.ko: 두 행성 모두 태양 곁을 크게 벗어나지 않아서 서로 긴장하는 각도는 생기지 않습니다. 출생차트에 나타나지 않는 조합이라 따로 읽지 않아도 괜찮아요.

rows.en: Your mind and your drive merge, so your words pack a punch.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and words overlap with your drive, giving your words real force.

rows.ko: 생각이 빠르고 말에 추진력이 있어 의견을 분명하게 밀고 나가는 편입니다. 말이 앞서 나갈 때는 한 박자 쉬고 상대의 반응을 살피면 설득력이 더 커져요.

rows.en_before_tone: Your mind is quick and your words carry drive, so you tend to push your opinions forward clearly. When your words get ahead of you, it can help to pause for a beat and read the other person's reaction; you'll often be even more persuasive.

rows.en: Your thoughts and actions are perfectly in sync.
rows.en_before_tone: Your thoughts and actions work well together.

rows.ko: 떠오른 아이디어를 바로 실행으로 옮기는 순발력이 있어요. 회의나 토론처럼 생각을 빠르게 정리해야 하는 자리에서 이 힘을 잘 쓸 수 있습니다.

rows.en: Your mind and drive clash, which gives your words an edge.
rows.en_before_tone: When your thoughts and drive collide, your words can easily turn sharp.

rows.ko: 답답할 때 말이 빨라지고 표현이 세지는 순간이 있을 수 있습니다. 중요한 대화일수록 하고 싶은 말을 먼저 적어 보면 날카로움은 줄고 핵심은 또렷해져요.
rows.en: When you're frustrated, you talk faster and more bluntly. The more important the conversation, the more it pays to jot down what you want to say first; the edge softens and your point comes through clearly.
rows.en_before_tone: When you feel frustrated, there may be moments when you speak faster and more bluntly. The more important the conversation, the more it helps to write down what you want to say first; the sharpness softens and your main point gets clearer.

rows.en: Your mind is joined by the planet of expansion, giving you a wide-angle view.
rows.en_before_tone: Thought and speech meet the planet of expansion, widening your view.

rows.ko: 큰 그림을 보는 시선과 시원한 말솜씨로 사람들에게 가능성을 보여 주는 편입니다. 아이디어가 넘칠 때는 구체적인 다음 단계 하나를 정해 두면 말이 결과로 이어져요.
rows.en: With your big-picture vision and easy way with words, you show people what's possible. When ideas are overflowing, pick one concrete next step so your words turn into results.
rows.en_before_tone: With a big-picture view and an easy way with words, you tend to show people what's possible. When ideas are overflowing, it can help to settle on one concrete next step, so your words can turn into results.

rows.en: The planet of expansion opens your mind wide.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion opens your thinking wide.

rows.ko: 새로운 지식을 받아들이고 여러 분야를 연결하는 능력이 좋아요. 관심 가는 주제를 깊이 배우거나 누군가에게 가르쳐 보면 이 재능이 더 넓게 쓰입니다.
rows.en: You're great at soaking up new knowledge and connecting the dots between different fields. Dig deep into a topic you're curious about, or try teaching it to someone, and this gift will take you even further.
rows.en_before_tone: You're good at taking in new knowledge and connecting different fields. If you dig deep into a topic that interests you, or try teaching it to someone, this gift can reach even further.

rows.en: Your mind and the planet of expansion feed each other's big thinking.
rows.en_before_tone: Thought and the planet of expansion tend to magnify each other.

rows.ko: 가능성을 크게 보다 보니 세부 사항을 놓치거나 약속을 많이 하기 쉽습니다. 큰 생각은 살리되 확인할 목록을 함께 만들어 두면 믿음직한 실행력으로 이어져요.

rows.en_before_tone: Because you see possibilities on a grand scale, it's easy to miss details or promise too much. You can keep your big ideas and still make a checklist alongside them; that can turn them into dependable follow-through.

rows.en: Your mind is joined by the planet of responsibility, so you choose your words carefully.
rows.en_before_tone: Thought and speech meet the planet of responsibility, so you choose your words carefully.

rows.ko: 한 번 더 생각하고 말하는 신중함과 깊이 있는 사고력이 있습니다. 완벽하게 정리될 때까지 말을 아끼는 편이라면 초안부터 꺼내 보는 연습이 도움이 돼요.
rows.en: You think before you speak, and your mind runs deep. If you hold back until every thought is perfectly in order, share a rough draft first and let it grow from there.
rows.en_before_tone: You have the care to think twice before speaking and a deep, thoughtful mind. If you tend to hold back until everything is perfectly sorted, it can help to practice sharing a rough draft first.

rows.en: Saturn, the planet of responsibility, gives your thinking structure and weight.
rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility helps shape your thinking into something solid.

rows.ko: 꼼꼼하고 체계적으로 생각하는 힘이 있어 복잡한 일도 차근차근 풀어내요. 오래 걸리더라도 깊이 파고드는 공부나 일에서 이 강점이 가장 잘 드러납니다.

rows.en_before_tone: Thought and the planet of responsibility push each other hard.

rows.ko: 말하기 전에 틀릴까 걱정하거나 내 생각을 지나치게 검열하기 쉽습니다. 작은 의견부터 자주 말해 보며 괜찮았던 경험을 쌓으면 신중함이 믿음직한 장점으로 바뀌어요.
rows.en: You worry about getting it wrong before you even open your mouth, and you edit your own thoughts too harshly. Share small opinions often: each time it goes well, your caution grows into a strength people rely on.
rows.en_before_tone: Before speaking, you may worry about being wrong or censor your own thoughts too much. If you share small opinions often and build up experiences where it went fine, your caution can become a trustworthy strength.

rows.en_before_tone: What you love and your drive overlap, so your passion runs strong.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 것을 향해 망설임 없이 다가가는 매력과 열정이 있습니다. 끌림이 강할 때는 상대의 속도도 함께 살피면 관계가 더 편안하게 이어져요.
rows.en: When you want something, you go for it, and that confidence carries real charm. When the pull is strong, tune in to the other person's pace too, and things between you flow more easily.
rows.en_before_tone: You have the charm and passion to go after what you love without hesitating. When an attraction is strong, it can help to keep an eye on the other person's pace too, so the relationship flows more comfortably.

rows.en_before_tone: What you love and your drive blend naturally.

rows.ko: 원하는 것을 부드럽게 표현하면서도 필요할 때는 먼저 다가갈 줄 알아요. 이 균형 감각을 살려 좋아하는 일에 꾸준히 시간을 쓰면 즐거움과 성취를 함께 얻기 좋습니다.

rows.en_before_tone: You can express what you want gently, and still make the first move when it matters. If you use this sense of balance to spend steady time on what you love, you're well placed to find both joy and accomplishment.

rows.en_before_tone: What you love and your drive pull against each other.

rows.ko: 다가가고 싶은 마음과 조화를 지키고 싶은 마음이 엇갈려 관계에서 밀고 당기기가 생길 수 있습니다. 원하는 것을 부드럽지만 분명하게 말해 보면 그 긴장이 서로를 이해하는 계기가 돼요.
rows.en: Part of you wants to close the distance and part of you wants to keep the peace, and that push-pull shows up in your relationships. Say what you want kindly but clearly, and the friction becomes a bridge to understanding.
rows.en_before_tone: The wish to move closer and the wish to keep the peace can pull in different directions, creating some push and pull in relationships. Try saying what you want gently but clearly, and that tension can become a way to understand each other.

rows.en_before_tone: What you love meets the planet of expansion, making your heart generous.

rows.ko: 사람과 아름다운 것을 아끼는 마음이 크고 주변에 따뜻한 분위기를 만드는 편입니다. 즐거움에 쓰는 시간이나 돈이 커질 때는 한도를 정해 두면 여유를 오래 누릴 수 있어요.
rows.en: You have abundant love for people and beautiful things, and you bring warmth wherever you go. When the time or money you spend on pleasure starts creeping up, set a budget so the good times last.
rows.en_before_tone: You care deeply for people and beautiful things, and you tend to create a warm atmosphere around you. When the time or money you spend on pleasure starts to grow, it can help to set a limit so you can enjoy that ease for longer.

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion helps what you love grow abundantly.

rows.ko: 사람들과 어울리며 좋은 인연과 즐거움을 자연스럽게 만나는 편이에요. 고마운 마음을 자주 표현하면 이 따뜻한 흐름이 더 넓게 퍼집니다.
rows.en: Good people and good times find you when you're out mixing with others. Say thank you often, and watch that warmth keep spreading.
rows.en_before_tone: Spending time with people, you tend to come across good connections and joy quite naturally. When you express your gratitude often, this warm flow tends to spread even wider.

rows.en: Love meets the planet of expansion, and you want more of everything.
rows.en_before_tone: What you love meets the planet of expansion, and you want more of everything.

rows.ko: 좋은 것을 더 많이 누리고 싶어 지나치게 베풀거나 쓰기 쉽습니다. 정말 기쁨을 주는 것이 무엇인지 골라 보면 만족은 커지고 부담은 줄어요.
rows.en: Your appetite for the good stuff can tip you into overgiving or overspending. Name what genuinely makes you happy, and you feel more satisfied with less strain.
rows.en_before_tone: Because you want to enjoy more good things, it's easy to give or spend too much. If you pick out what truly brings you joy, your satisfaction can grow while the burden shrinks.

rows.en: Love meets the planet of responsibility, so you take matters of the heart seriously.
rows.en_before_tone: What you love meets the planet of responsibility, so you take matters of the heart seriously.

rows.ko: 관계와 좋아하는 것에 신중하고 한번 마음을 주면 오래 지키는 편입니다. 나를 아끼는 일에 인색해질 때는 작은 선물로 스스로에게 다정함을 건네 보세요.

rows.en_before_tone: You're careful with relationships and the things you love, and once you give your heart, you tend to keep it for a long time. When you find yourself holding back on caring for yourself, you might offer yourself some kindness with a small gift.

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of responsibility helps you hold on to what you love for the long run.

rows.ko: 시간이 지날수록 깊어지는 관계와 취향을 소중히 여기는 편이에요. 오래 함께할 사람과 습관에 꾸준히 마음을 쓰면 단단한 안정감이 쌓입니다.
rows.en: You value relationships and tastes that grow richer with time. Keep investing in the people and habits you mean to keep, and a deep sense of security takes root.
rows.en_before_tone: You treasure relationships and tastes that deepen over time. When you keep giving your heart to the people and habits you'll share a long road with, a solid sense of stability can build up.

rows.ko: 좋아하는 마음을 표현하기 전에 망설이거나 내가 사랑받을 만한지 의심하기 쉽습니다. 작은 호의를 주고받는 경험을 쌓아 가면 조심스러움이 깊고 믿음직한 마음으로 자라요.
rows.en: You hesitate to show affection, or you wonder whether you're truly lovable. Give and receive small, everyday kindnesses, and that caution slowly ripens into a deep, steady love.
rows.en_before_tone: You may hesitate before showing affection, or doubt whether you're worth loving. As you build up small experiences of giving and receiving kindness, your caution can grow into a deep and trustworthy heart.

rows.en_before_tone: You have the courage and passion to move boldly toward big goals. Since it's easy to take on too much at once, it can help to plan out your energy and time in advance so you can keep going to the finish.

rows.en: Once you start something, you have the grit and self-discipline to see it through. You're so used to toughing things out that tiredness can pile up unnoticed, so shake it off early and your strength lasts.
rows.en_before_tone: Once you start something, you have the persistence and self-control to quietly see it through. Because you're so used to holding on, it helps to ease built-up tiredness along the way so your strength can last.

rows.en_before_tone: The part of you that grows dreams and the part that weighs reality meet in one place. You can make big plans and set deadlines and steps along with them; that way, both strengths come alive.

rows.ko: 새로운 기회를 보는 눈과 현실적으로 다지는 힘이 함께 움직이는 편이에요. 긴 목표를 세우고 꾸준히 점검하면 이 균형이 큰 성과로 이어지기 좋습니다.

rows.en_before_tone: The planet of expansion and the planet of responsibility want different speeds.

rows.ko: 앞으로 나아가고 싶은 마음과 지금을 지키고 싶은 마음 사이에서 망설이기 쉽습니다. 시도할 것과 지킬 것을 나눠 정해 두면 두 마음이 서로를 보완하는 힘이 돼요.
